map.2:2: Dhaalikal-kitaabu laa rayba feeh, hudal lil-muttaqeen
map.2:3: Al-ladheena yu'minoona bil-ghaybi wayuqeemoonas-salaata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
map.2:4: Wal-ladheena yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilayka wamaa unzila min qablik, wabil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
map.2:5: Ulaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir rabbihim wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.2:6: Innal-ladheena kafaroo sawaa'un 'alayhim a'andhartahum am lam tundhirhum laa yu'minoon
map.2:7: Khatamallaahu 'alaa quloobihim wa'alaa sam'ihim, wa'alaa absaarihim ghishaawatuw walahum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.2:8: Waminan-naasi may yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi wabil-yawmil-aakhiri wamaa hum bimu'mineen
map.2:9: Yukhaadi'oonallaaha wal-ladheena aamanoo, wamaa yakhda'oona illaa anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
map.2:10: Fee quloobihim maradun fazaadahumullaahu maradaa, walahum 'adhaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakdhiboon
map.2:11: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum laa tufsidoo fil-ardi qaaloo innamaa nahnu muslihoon
map.2:12: Alaa innahum humul-mufsidoona walaakil laa yash'uroon
map.2:13: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum aaminoo kamaa aamanan-naasu qaaloo anu'minu kamaa aamanas-sufahaa', alaa innahum humus-sufahaa'u walaakil laa ya'lamoon
map.2:14: Wa'idhaa laqul-ladheena aamanoo qaaloo aamannaa, wa'idhaa khalaw ilaa shayaateenihim qaaloo innaa ma'akum innamaa nahnu mustahzi'oon
map.2:15: Allaahu yastahzi'u bihim wayamudduhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
map.2:16: Ulaa'ikal-ladheenashtarawud-dalaalata bil-hudaa, famaa rabihat tijaaratuhum wamaa kaanoo muhtadeen
map.2:17: Mathaluhum kamathalil-ladhistawqada naaraa, falammaa adaa'at maa hawlahoo dhahaballaahu binoorihim watarakahum fee zulumaatil laa yubsiroon
map.2:19: Aw kasayyibim minas-samaa'i feehi zulumaatuw wara'duw wabarq, yaj'aloona asaabi'ahum fee aadhaanihim minas-sawaa'iqi hadharal-mawt, wallaahu muheetum bil-kaafireen
map.2:20: Yakaadul-barqu yakhtafu absaarahum, kullamaa adaa'a lahum mashaw feehi wa'idhaa azlama 'alayhim qaamoo, walaw shaa'allaahu ladhahaba bisam'ihim wa'absaarihim, innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.2:21: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu'budoo rabbakumul-ladhee khalaqakum wal-ladheena min qablikum la'allakum tattaqoon
map.2:22: Al-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda firaashaw was-samaa'a binaa'aa, wa'anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'akhraja bihee minath-thamaraati rizqal lakum, falaa taj'aloo lillaahi andaadaw wa'antum ta'lamoon
map.2:23: Wa'in kuntum fee raybim mimmaa nazzalnaa 'alaa 'abdinaa fa'too bisooratim mim mithlih, wad'oo shuhadaa'akum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
map.2:24: Fa'il lam taf'aloo walan taf'aloo fattaqun-naaral-latee waqooduhan-naasu wal-hijaarah, u'iddat lil-kaafireen
map.2:25: Wabashshiril-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati anna lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, kullamaa ruziqoo minhaa min thamaratir rizqan qaaloo haadhal-ladhee ruziqnaa min qablu wa'utoo bihee mutashaabihaa, walahum feehaa azwaajum mutahharatuw wahum feehaa khaalidoon
map.2:26: Innallaaha laa yastahyee ay yadriba mathalam maa ba'oodatan famaa fawqahaa, fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo faya'lamoona annahul-haqqu mir rabbihim, wa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo fayaqooloona maadhaa araadallaahu bihaadhaa mathalaa, yudillu bihee katheeraw wayahdee bihee katheeraa, wamaa yudillu bihee illal-faasiqeen
map.2:27: Al-ladheena yanqudoona 'ahdallaahi mim ba'di meethaaqih, wayaqta'oona maa amarallaahu bihee ay yoosala wayufsidoona fil-ard, ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.2:28: Kayfa takfuroona billaahi wakuntum amwaatan fa'ahyaakum, thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum thumma ilayhi turja'oon
map.2:29: Huwal-ladhee khalaqa lakum maa fil-ardi jamee'an thummastawaa ilas-samaa'i fasawwaahunna sab'a samaawaat, wahuwa bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.2:30: Wa'idh qaala rabbuka lil-malaa'ikati innee jaa'ilun fil-ardi khaleefah, qaaloo ataj'alu feehaa may yufsidu feehaa wayasfikud-dimaa', wanahnu nusabbihu bihamdika wanuqaddisu lak, qaala innee a'lamu maa laa ta'lamoon
map.2:31: Wa'allama aadamal-asmaa'a kullahaa thumma 'aradahum 'alal-malaa'ikati faqaala ambi'oonee bi'asmaa'i haa'ulaa'i in kuntum saadiqeen
map.2:32: Qaaloo subhaanaka laa 'ilma lanaa illaa maa 'allamtanaa, innaka antal-'aleemul-hakeem
map.2:33: Qaala yaa aadamu ambi'hum bi'asmaa'ihim, falammaa amba'ahum bi'asmaa'ihim qaala alam aqul lakum innee a'lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal-ardi wa'a'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa kuntum taktumoon
map.2:34: Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa iblees, abaa wastakbar, wakaana minal-kaafireen
map.2:35: Waqulnaa yaa aadamuskun anta wazawjukal-jannata wakulaa minhaa raghadan haythu shi'tumaa, walaa taqrabaa haadhihish-shajarata fatakoonaa minaz-zaalimeen
map.2:36: Fa'azallahumash-shaytaanu 'anhaa fa'akhrajahumaa mimmaa kaanaa feeh, waqulnahbitoo ba'dukum liba'din 'aduww, walakum fil-ardi mustaqarruw wamataa'un ilaa heen
map.2:37: Fatalaqqaa aadamu mir rabbihee kalimaatin fataaba 'alayh, innahoo huwat-tawwaabur-raheem
map.2:38: Qulnahbitoo minhaa jamee'aa, fa'immaa ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan faman tabi'a hudaaya falaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.2:39: Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.2:40: Yaabanee israa'eeladhkuroo ni'matiyal-latee an'amtu 'alaykum wa'awfoo bi'ahdee oofi bi'ahdikum, wa'iyyaaya farhaboon
map.2:41: Wa'aaminoo bimaa anzaltu musaddiqal limaa ma'akum walaa takoonoo awwala kaafirim bih, walaa tashtaroo bi'aayaatee thamanan qaleelaa, wa'iyyaaya fattaqoon
map.2:42: Walaa talbisul-haqqa bil-baatili wataktumul-haqqa wa'antum ta'lamoon
map.2:44: Ata'muroonan-naasa bil-birri watansawna anfusakum wa'antum tatloonal-kitaab, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.2:45: Wasta'eenoo bis-sabri was-salaah, wa'innahaa lakabeeratun illaa 'alal-khaashi'een

map.2:48: Wattaqoo yawmal laa tajzee nafsun 'an nafsin shay'aw walaa yuqbalu minhaa shafaa'atuw walaa yu'khadhu minhaa 'adluw walaa hum yunsaroon
map.2:49: Wa'idh najjaynaakum min aali fir'awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-'adhaabi yudhabbihoona abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum, wafee dhaalikum balaa'um mir rabbikum 'azeem

map.2:57: Wazallalnaa 'alaykumul-ghamaama wa'anzalnaa 'alaykumul-manna was-salwaa, kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum, wamaa zalamoonaa walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.2:58: Wa'idh qulnadkhuloo haadhihil-qaryata fakuloo minhaa haythu shi'tum raghadaw wadkhulul-baaba sujjadaw waqooloo hittatun naghfir lakum khataayaakum, wasanazeedul-muhsineen

map.2:60: Wa'idhistasqaa moosaa liqawmihee faqulnadrib bi'asaakal-hajar, fanfajarat minhuthnataa 'ashrata 'aynaa, qad 'alima kullu unaasim mashrabahum, kuloo washraboo mir rizqillaahi walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen

map.2:112: Balaa man aslama wajhahoo lillaahi wahuwa muhsinun falahoo ajruhoo 'inda rabbih, walaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.2:113: Waqaalatil-yahoodu laysatin-nasaaraa 'alaa shay', waqaalatin-nasaaraa laysatil-yahoodu 'alaa shay'iw wahum yatloonal-kitaab, kadhaalika qaalal-ladheena laa ya'lamoona mithla qawlihim, fallaahu yahkumu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
map.2:114: Waman azlamu mimmam mana'a masaajidallaahi ay yudhkara feehasmuhoo wasa'aa fee kharaabihaa, ulaa'ika maa kaana lahum ay yadkhuloohaa illaa khaa'ifeen, lahum fid-dunyaa khizyuw walahum fil-aakhirati 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.2:115: Walillaahil-mashriqu wal-maghribu fa'aynamaa tuwalloo fathamma wajhullaah, innallaaha waasi'un 'aleem
map.2:116: Waqaaluttakhadhallaahu waladan subhaanah, bal lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, kullul lahoo qaanitoon
map.2:117: Badee'us-samaawaati wal-ard, wa'idhaa qadaa amran fa'innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
map.2:118: Waqaalal-ladheena laa ya'lamoona lawlaa yukallimunallaahu aw ta'teenaa aayah, kadhaalika qaalal-ladheena min qablihim mithla qawlihim, tashaabahat quloobuhum, qad bayyannal-aayaati liqawmiy yooqinoon
map.2:119: Innaa arsalnaaka bil-haqqi basheeraw wanadheeraw walaa tus'alu 'an ashaabil-jaheem
map.2:120: Walan tardaa 'ankal-yahoodu walan-nasaaraa hattaa tattabi'a millatahum, qul inna hudallaahi huwal-hudaa, wala'inittaba'ta ahwaa'ahum ba'dal-ladhee jaa'aka minal-'ilmi maa laka minallaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
map.2:121: Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yatloonahoo haqqa tilaawatih, ulaa'ika yu'minoona bih, wamay yakfur bihee fa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.2:122: Yaabanee israa'eeladhkuroo ni'matiyal-latee an'amtu 'alaykum wa'annee faddaltukum 'alal-'aalameen
map.2:123: Wattaqoo yawmal laa tajzee nafsun 'an nafsin shay'aw walaa yuqbalu minhaa 'adluw walaa tanfa'uhaa shafaa'atuw walaa hum yunsaroon
map.2:124: Wa'idhibtalaa ibraaheema rabbuhoo bikalimaatin fa'atammahunn, qaala innee jaa'iluka lin-naasi imaamaa, qaala wamin dhurriyyatee, qaala laa yanaalu 'ahdiz-zaalimeen
map.2:125: Wa'idh ja'alnal-bayta mathaabatal lin-naasi wa'amnaa, wattakhidhoo mim maqaami ibraaheema musallaa, wa'ahidnaa ilaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa'eela an tahhiraa baytiya lit-taa'ifeena wal-'aakifeena war-rukka'is-sujood
map.2:126: Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbij'al haadhaa baladan aaminaw warzuq ahlahoo minath-thamaraati man aamana minhum billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, qaala waman kafara fa'umatti'uhoo qaleelan thumma adtarruhoo ilaa 'adhaabin-naar, wabi'sal-maseer
map.2:127: Wa'idh yarfa'u ibraaheemul-qawaa'ida minal-bayti wa'ismaa'eel, rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa, innaka antas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.2:128: Rabbanaa waj'alnaa muslimayni laka wamin dhurriyyatinaa ummatam muslimatal lak, wa'arinaa manaasikanaa watub 'alaynaa, innaka antat-tawwaabur-raheem
map.2:129: Rabbanaa wab'ath feehim rasoolam minhum yatloo 'alayhim aayaatika wayu'allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wayuzakkeehim, innaka antal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.2:130: Wamay yarghabu 'am millati ibraaheema illaa man safiha nafsah, walaqadistafaynaahu fid-dunyaa, wa'innahoo fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
map.2:131: Idh qaala lahoo rabbuhoo aslim qaala aslamtu lirabbil-'aalameen
map.2:132: Wawassaa bihaa ibraaheemu baneehi waya'qoob, yaabaniyya innallaahastafaa lakumud-deena falaa tamootunna illaa wa'antum muslimoon
map.2:133: Am kuntum shuhadaa'a idh hadara ya'qoobal-mawtu idh qaala libaneehi maa ta'budoona mim ba'dee, qaaloo na'budu ilaahaka wa'ilaaha aabaa'ika ibraaheema wa'ismaa'eela wa'ishaaqa ilaahaw waahidaa, wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
map.2:134: Tilka ummatun qad khalat, lahaa maa kasabat walakum maa kasabtum, walaa tus'aloona 'ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.2:135: Waqaaloo koonoo hoodan aw nasaaraa tahtadoo, qul bal millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
map.2:136: Qooloo aamannaa billaahi wamaa unzila ilaynaa wamaa unzila ilaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa'eela wa'ishaaqa waya'qooba wal-asbaati wamaa ootiya moosaa wa'eesaa wamaa ootiyan-nabiyyoona mir rabbihim, laa nufarriqu bayna ahadim minhum, wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
map.2:137: Fa'in aamanoo bimithli maa aamantum bihee faqadihtadaw, wa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa hum fee shiqaaq, fasayakfeekahumullaah, wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.2:138: Sibghatallaah, waman ahsanu minallaahi sibghah, wanahnu lahoo 'aabidoon
map.2:139: Qul atuhaajjoonanaa fillaahi wahuwa rabbunaa warabbukum, walanaa a'maalunaa walakum a'maalukum, wanahnu lahoo mukhlisoon
map.2:140: Am taqooloona inna ibraaheema wa'ismaa'eela wa'ishaaqa waya'qooba wal-asbaata kaanoo hoodan aw nasaaraa, qul a'antum a'lamu amillaah, waman azlamu mimman katama shahaadatan 'indahoo minallaah, wamallaahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
map.2:141: Tilka ummatun qad khalat, lahaa maa kasabat walakum maa kasabtum, walaa tus'aloona 'ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.2:142: Sayaqoolus-sufahaa'u minan-naasi maa wallaahum 'an qiblatihimul-latee kaanoo 'alayhaa, qul lillaahil-mashriqu wal-maghrib, yahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.2:143: Wakadhaalika ja'alnaakum ummataw wasatal litakoonoo shuhadaa'a 'alan-naasi wayakoonar-rasoolu 'alaykum shaheedaa, wamaa ja'alnal-qiblatal-latee kunta 'alayhaa illaa lina'lama may yattabi'ur-rasoola mimmay yanqalibu 'alaa 'aqibayh, wa'in kaanat lakabeeratan illaa 'alal-ladheena hadallaah, wamaa kaanallaahu liyudee'a eemaanakum, innallaaha bin-naasi lara'oofur raheem
map.2:144: Qad naraa taqalluba wajhika fis-samaa', falanuwalliyannaka qiblatan tardaahaa, fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraam, wahaythu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrah, wa'innal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba laya'lamoona annahul-haqqu mir rabbihim, wamallaahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ya'maloon
map.2:145: Wala'in ataytal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba bikulli aayatim maa tabi'oo qiblatak, wamaa anta bitaabi'in qiblatahum, wamaa ba'duhum bitaabi'in qiblata ba'd, wala'inittaba'ta ahwaa'ahum mim ba'di maa jaa'aka minal-'ilmi innaka idhal laminaz-zaalimeen
map.2:146: Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya'rifoonahoo kamaa ya'rifoona abnaa'ahum, wa'inna fareeqam minhum layaktumoonal-haqqa wahum ya'lamoon
map.2:147: Al-haqqu mir rabbika falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
map.2:148: Walikulliw wijhatun huwa muwalleehaa fastabiqul-khayraat, ayna maa takoonoo ya'ti bikumullaahu jamee'aa, innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.2:149: Wamin haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraam, wa'innahoo lal-haqqu mir rabbik, wamallaahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
map.2:150: Wamin haythu kharajta fawalli wajhaka shatral-masjidil-haraam, wahaythu maa kuntum fawalloo wujoohakum shatrahoo li'allaa yakoona lin-naasi 'alaykum hujjatun illal-ladheena zalamoo minhum falaa takhshawhum wakhshawnee wali'utimma ni'matee 'alaykum wala'allakum tahtadoon
map.2:151: Kamaa arsalnaa feekum rasoolam minkum yatloo 'alaykum aayaatinaa wayuzakkeekum wayu'allimukumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wayu'allimukum maa lam takoonoo ta'lamoon
map.2:152: Fadhkuroonee adhkurkum washkuroo lee walaa takfuroon
map.2:153: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanusta'eenoo bis-sabri was-salaah, innallaaha ma'as-saabireen
map.2:154: Walaa taqooloo limay yuqtalu fee sabeelillaahi amwaat, bal ahyaa'uw walaakil laa tash'uroon
map.2:155: Walanabluwannakum bishay'im minal-khawfi wal-joo'i wanaqsim minal-amwaali wal-anfusi wath-thamaraat, wabashshiris-saabireen
map.2:156: Alladheena idhaa asaabathum museebah, qaaloo innaa lillaahi wa'innaa ilayhi raaji'oon
map.2:157: Ulaa'ika 'alayhim salawaatum mir rabbihim warahmah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muhtadoon
map.2:158: Innas-safaa wal-marwata min sha'aa'irillaah, faman hajjal-bayta awi'tamara falaa junaaha 'alayhi ay yattawwafa bihimaa, waman tatawwa'a khayran fa'innallaaha shaakirun 'aleem
map.2:159: Innal-ladheena yaktumoona maa anzalnaa minal-bayyinaati wal-hudaa mim ba'di maa bayyannaahu lin-naasi fil-kitaabi ulaa'ika yal'anuhumullaahu wayal'anuhumullaa'inoon
map.2:160: Illal-ladheena taaboo wa'aslahoo wabayyanoo fa'ulaa'ika atoobu 'alayhim, wa'anat-tawwaabur-raheem
map.2:161: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wamaatoo wahum kuffaarun ulaa'ika 'alayhim la'natullaahi wal-malaa'ikati wan-naasi ajma'een
map.2:162: Khaalideena feehaa, laa yukhaffafu 'anhumul-'adhaabu walaa hum yunzaroon
map.2:163: Wa'ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, laa ilaaha illaa huwar-rahmaanur-raheem
map.2:164: Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wal-fulkil-latee tajree fil-bahri bimaa yanfa'un-naasa wamaa anzalallaahu minas-samaa'i mim maa'in fa'ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa wabaththa feehaa min kulli daabbah, watasreefir-riyaahi was-sahaabil-musakhkhari baynas-samaa'i wal-ardi la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.2:165: Waminan-naasi may yattakhidhu min doonillaahi andaaday yuhibboonahum kahubbillaah, wal-ladheena aamanoo ashaddu hubbal lillaahi walaw yaral-ladheena zalamoo idh yarawnal-'adhaaba annal-quwwata lillaahi jamee'aw wa'annallaaha shadeedul-'adhaab
map.2:166: Idh tabarra'al-ladheenattubi'oo minal-ladheenattaba'oo wara'awul-'adhaaba wataqatta'at bihimul-asbaab
map.2:167: Waqaalal-ladheenattaba'oo law anna lanaa karratan fanatabarra'a minhum, kamaa tabarra'oo minnaa, kadhaalika yureehimullaahu a'maalahum hasaraatin 'alayhim, wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minan-naar
map.2:168: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu kuloo mimmaa fil-ardi halaalan tayyibaa, walaa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
map.2:169: Innamaa ya'murukum bis-soo'i wal-fahshaa'i wa'an taqooloo 'alallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.2:170: Wa'idhaa qeela lahumuttabi'oo maa anzalallaahu qaaloo bal nattabi'u maa alfaynaa 'alayhi aabaa'anaa, awalaw kaana aabaa'uhum laa ya'qiloona shay'aw walaa yahtadoon
map.2:171: Wamathalul-ladheena kafaroo kamathalil-ladhee yan'iqu bimaa laa yasma'u illaa du'aa'aw wanidaa'aa, summum bukmun 'umyun fahum laa ya'qiloon
map.2:172: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum washkuroo lillaahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
map.2:173: Innamaa harrama 'alaykumul-maytata wad-dama walahmal-khinzeeri wamaa uhilla bihee lighayrillaah, famanidturra ghayra baaghiw walaa 'aadin falaa ithma 'alayh, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.2:174: Innal-ladheena yaktumoona maa anzalallaahu minal-kitaabi wayashtaroona bihee thamanan qaleelan ulaa'ika maa ya'kuloona fee butoonihim illan-naara walaa yukallimuhumullaahu yawmal-qiyaamati walaa yuzakkeehim, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.2:175: Ulaa'ikal-ladheenashtarawud-dalaalata bil-hudaa wal-'adhaaba bil-maghfirah, famaa asbarahum 'alan-naar
map.2:176: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha nazzalal-kitaaba bil-haqq, wa'innal-ladheenakhtalafoo fil-kitaabi lafee shiqaaqim ba'eed
map.2:177: Laysal-birra an tuwalloo wujoohakum qibalal-mashriqi wal-maghribi walaakinnal-birra man aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wal-malaa'ikati wal-kitaabi wan-nabiyyeen, wa'aatal-maala 'alaa hubbihee dhawil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeena wabnas-sabeeli was-saa'ileena wafir-riqaab, wa'aqaamas-salaata wa'aataz-zakaah, wal-moofoona bi'ahdihim idhaa 'aahadoo, was-saabireena fil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i waheenal-ba's, ulaa'ikal-ladheena sadaqoo, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon
map.2:178: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kutiba 'alaykumul-qisaasu fil-qatlaa, al-hurru bil-hurri wal-'abdu bil-'abdi wal-unthaa bil-unthaa, faman 'ufiya lahoo min akheehi shay'un fattibaa'um bil-ma'roofi wa'adaa'un ilayhi bi'ihsaan, dhaalika takhfeefum mir rabbikum warahmah, famani'tadaa ba'da dhaalika falahoo 'adhaabun aleem
map.2:179: Walakum fil-qisaasi hayaatuy yaa ulil-albaabi la'allakum tattaqoon
map.2:180: Kutiba 'alaykum idhaa hadara ahadakumul-mawtu in taraka khayraa, al-wasiyyatu lil-waalidayni wal-aqrabeena bil-ma'roof, haqqan 'alal-muttaqeen
map.2:181: Famam baddalahoo ba'da maa sami'ahoo fa'innamaa ithmuhoo 'alal-ladheena yubaddiloonah, innallaaha samee'un 'aleem
map.2:182: Faman khaafa mim moosin janafan aw ithman fa'aslaha baynahum falaa ithma 'alayh, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.2:183: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo kutiba 'alaykumus-siyaamu kamaa kutiba 'alal-ladheena min qablikum la'allakum tattaqoon
map.2:184: Ayyaamam ma'doodaat, faman kaana minkum mareedan aw 'alaa safarin fa'iddatum min ayyaamin ukhar, wa'alal-ladheena yuteeqoonahoo fidyatun ta'aamu miskeen, faman tatawwa'a khayran fahuwa khayrul lah, wa'an tasoomoo khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.2:185: Shahru ramadaanal-ladhee unzila feehil-qur'aanu hudal lin-naasi wabayyinaatim minal-hudaa wal-furqaan, faman shahida minkumush-shahra falyasumh, waman kaana mareedan aw 'alaa safarin fa'iddatum min ayyaamin ukhar, yureedullaahu bikumul-yusra walaa yureedu bikumul-'usr, walitukmilul-'iddata walitukabbirullaaha 'alaa maa hadaakum wala'allakum tashkuroon
map.2:186: Wa'idhaa sa'alaka 'ibaadee 'annee fa'innee qareeb, ujeebu da'watad-daa'i idhaa da'aani falyastajeeboo lee walyu'minoo bee la'allahum yarshudoon
map.2:187: Uhilla lakum laylatas-siyaamir-rafathu ilaa nisaa'ikum, hunna libaasul lakum wa'antum libaasul lahunn, 'alimallaahu annakum kuntum takhtaanoona anfusakum fataaba 'alaykum wa'afaa 'ankum, fal-aana baashiroohunna wabtaghoo maa kataballaahu lakum, wakuloo washraboo hattaa yatabayyana lakumul-khaytul-abyadu minal-khaytil-aswadi minal-fajr, thumma atimmus-siyaama ilal-layl, walaa tubaashiroohunna wa'antum 'aakifoona fil-masaajid, tilka hudoodullaahi falaa taqraboohaa, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu aayaatihee lin-naasi la'allahum yattaqoon
map.2:188: Walaa ta'kuloo amwaalakum baynakum bil-baatili watudloo bihaa ilal-hukkaami lita'kuloo fareeqam min amwaalin-naasi bil-ithmi wa'antum ta'lamoon
map.2:189: Yas'aloonaka 'anil-ahillah, qul hiya mawaaqeetu lin-naasi wal-hajj, walaysal-birru bi'an ta'tul-buyoota min zuhoorihaa walaakinnal-birra manittaqaa, wa'tul-buyoota min abwaabihaa, wattaqullaaha la'allakum tuflihoon
map.2:190: Waqaatiloo fee sabeelillaahil-ladheena yuqaatiloonakum walaa ta'tadoo, innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mu'tadeen
map.2:191: Waqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum wa'akhrijoohum min haythu akhrajookum wal-fitnatu ashaddu minal-qatl, walaa tuqaatiloohum 'indal-masjidil-haraami hattaa yuqaatilookum feeh, fa'in qaatalookum faqtuloohum, kadhaalika jazaa'ul-kaafireen
map.2:193: Waqaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatuw wayakoonad-deenu lillaah, fa'inintahaw falaa 'udwaana illaa 'alaz-zaalimeen
map.2:194: Ash-shahrul-haraamu bish-shahril-haraami wal-hurumaatu qisaas, famani'tadaa 'alaykum fa'tadoo 'alayhi bimithli ma'tadaa 'alaykum, wattaqullaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha ma'al-muttaqeen
map.2:195: Wa'anfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi walaa tulqoo bi'aydeekum ilat-tahlukati wa'ahsinoo, innallaaha yuhibbul-muhsineen
map.2:196: Wa'atimmul-hajja wal-'umrata lillaah, fa'in uhsirtum famastaysara minal-hady, walaa tahliqoo ru'oosakum hattaa yablughal-hadyu mahillah, faman kaana minkum mareedan aw bihee adham mir ra'sihee fafidyatum min siyaamin aw sadaqatin aw nusuk, fa'idhaa amintum, faman tamatta'a bil-'umrati ilal-hajji famastaysara minal-hady, famal lam yajid fasiyaamu thalaathati ayyaamin fil-hajji wasab'atin idhaa raja'tum, tilka 'asharatun kaamilah, dhaalika limal lam yakun ahluhoo haadiril-masjidil-haraam, wattaqullaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.2:197: Al-hajju ashhurum ma'loomaat, faman farada feehinnal-hajja falaa rafatha walaa fusooqa walaa jidaala fil-hajj, wamaa taf'aloo min khayriy ya'lamhullaah, watazawwadoo fa'inna khayraz-zaadit-taqwaa, wattaqooni yaa ulil-albaab
map.2:198: Laysa 'alaykum junaahun an tabtaghoo fadlam mir rabbikum, fa'idhaa afadtum min 'arafaatin fadhkurullaaha 'indal-mash'aril-haraam, wadhkuroohu kamaa hadaakum, wa'in kuntum min qablihee laminad-daalleen
map.2:199: Thumma afeedoo min haythu afaadan-naasu wastaghfirullaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.2:200: Fa'idhaa qadaytum manaasikakum fadhkurullaaha kadhikrikum aabaa'akum aw ashadda dhikraa, faminan-naasi may yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa wamaa lahoo fil-aakhirati min khalaaq
map.2:201: Waminhum may yaqoolu rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanataw wafil-aakhirati hasanataw waqinaa 'adhaaban-naar
map.2:202: Ulaa'ika lahum naseebum mimmaa kasaboo, wallaahu saree'ul-hisaab
map.2:203: Wadhkurullaaha fee ayyaamim ma'doodaat, faman ta'ajjala fee yawmayni falaa ithma 'alayh, waman ta'akhkhara falaa ithma 'alayhi limanittaqaa, wattaqullaaha wa'lamoo annakum ilayhi tuhsharoon
map.2:204: Waminan-naasi may yu'jibuka qawluhoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wayushhidullaaha 'alaa maa fee qalbihee wahuwa aladdul-khisaam
map.2:205: Wa'idhaa tawallaa sa'aa fil-ardi liyufsida feehaa wayuhlikal-hartha wan-nasl, wallaahu laa yuhibbul-fasaad
map.2:206: Wa'idhaa qeela lahuttaqillaaha akhadhathul-'izzatu bil-ithmi fahasbuhoo jahannam, walabi'sal-mihaad
map.2:207: Waminan-naasi may yashree nafsahubtighaa'a mardaatillaah, wallaahu ra'oofum bil-'ibaad
map.2:208: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudkhuloo fis-silmi kaaffah, walaa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
map.2:209: Fa'in zalaltum mim ba'di maa jaa'atkumul-bayyinaatu fa'lamoo annallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.2:210: Hal yanzuroona illaa ay ya'tiyahumullaahu fee zulalim minal-ghamaami wal-malaa'ikatu waqudiyal-amr, wa'ilallaahi turja'ul-umoor
map.2:211: Sal banee israa'eela kam aataynaahum min aayatim bayyinah, wamay yubaddil ni'matallaahi mim ba'di maa jaa'athu fa'innallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.2:212: Zuyyina lilladheena kafarul-hayaatud-dunyaa wayaskharoona minal-ladheena aamanoo, wal-ladheenattaqaw fawqahum yawmal-qiyaamah, wallaahu yarzuqu may yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
map.2:213: Kaanan-naasu ummataw waahidah, faba'athallaahun-nabiyyeena mubashshireena wamundhireen, wa'anzala ma'ahumul-kitaaba bil-haqqi liyahkuma baynan-naasi feemakhtalafoo feeh, wamakhtalafa feehi illal-ladheena ootoohu mim ba'di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu baghyam baynahum, fahadallaahul-ladheena aamanoo limakhtalafoo feehi minal-haqqi bi'idhnih, wallaahu yahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.2:214: Am hasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata walammaa ya'tikum mathalul-ladheena khalaw min qablikum, massathumul-ba'saa'u wad-darraa'u wazulziloo hattaa yaqoolar-rasoolu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo mataa nasrullaah, alaa inna nasrallaahi qareeb
map.2:215: Yas'aloonaka maadhaa yunfiqoon, qul maa anfaqtum min khayrin falilwaalidayni wal-aqrabeena wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeel, wamaa taf'aloo min khayrin fa'innallaaha bihee 'aleem
map.2:216: Kutiba 'alaykumul-qitaalu wahuwa kurhul lakum, wa'asaa an takrahoo shay'aw wahuwa khayrul lakum, wa'asaa an tuhibboo shay'aw wahuwa sharrul lakum, wallaahu ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamoon
map.2:217: Yas'aloonaka 'anish-shahril-haraami qitaalin feeh, qul qitaalun feehi kabeer, wasaddun 'an sabeelillaahi wakufrum bihee wal-masjidil-haraami wa'ikhraaju ahlihee minhu akbaru 'indallaah, wal-fitnatu akbaru minal-qatl, walaa yazaaloona yuqaatiloonakum hattaa yaruddookum 'an deenikum inistataa'oo, wamay yartadid minkum 'an deenihee fayamut wahuwa kaafirun fa'ulaa'ika habitat a'maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.2:218: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haajaroo wajaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi ulaa'ika yarjoona rahmatallaah, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.2:219: Yas'aloonaka 'anil-khamri wal-maysir, qul feehimaa ithmun kabeeruw wamanaafi'u lin-naas, wa'ithmuhumaa akbaru min naf'ihimaa, wayas'aloonaka maadhaa yunfiqoon, qulil-'afw, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaati la'allakum tatafakkaroon
map.2:220: Fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wayas'aloonaka 'anil-yataamaa, qul islaahul lahum khayr, wa'in tukhaalitoohum fa'ikhwaanukum, wallaahu ya'lamul-mufsida minal-muslih, walaw shaa'allaahu la'a'natakum innallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.2:221: Walaa tankihul-mushrikaati hattaa yu'minn, wala'amatum mu'minatun khayrum mim mushrikatiw walaw a'jabatkum, walaa tunkihul-mushrikeena hattaa yu'minoo, wala'abdum mu'minun khayrum mim mushrikiw walaw a'jabakum, ulaa'ika yad'oona ilan-naar, wallaahu yad'oo ilal-jannati wal-maghfirati bi'idhnih, wayubayyinu aayaatihee lin-naasi la'allahum yatadhakkaroon
map.2:222: Wayas'aloonaka 'anil-maheed, qul huwa adhan fa'tazilun-nisaa'a fil-maheedi walaa taqraboohunna hattaa yathurn, fa'idhaa tatahharna fa'toohunna min haythu amarakumullaah, innallaaha yuhibbut-tawwaabeena wayuhibbul-mutatahhireen
map.2:223: Nisaa'ukum harthul lakum, fa'too harthakum annaa shi'tum, waqaddimoo li'anfusikum, wattaqullaaha wa'lamoo annakum mulaaqooh, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
map.2:224: Walaa taj'alullaaha 'urdatal li'aymaanikum an tabarroo watattaqoo watuslihoo baynan-naas, wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.2:225: Laa yu'aakhidhukumullaahu bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum walaakiy yu'aakhidhukum bimaa kasabat quloobukum, wallaahu ghafoorun haleem
map.2:226: Lilladheena yu'loona min nisaa'ihim tarabbusu arba'ati ashhur, fa'in faa'oo fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.2:228: Wal-mutallaqaatu yatarabbasna bi'anfusihinna thalaathata quroo', walaa yahillu lahunna ay yaktumna maa khalaqallaahu fee arhaamihinna in kunna yu'minna billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, wabu'oolatuhunna ahaqqu biraddihinna fee dhaalika in araadoo islaahaa, walahunna mithlul-ladhee 'alayhinna bil-ma'roof, walir-rijaali 'alayhinna darajah, wallaahu 'azeezun hakeem
map.2:229: At-talaaqu marrataan, fa'imsaakum bima'roofin aw tasreehum bi'ihsaan, walaa yahillu lakum an ta'khudhoo mimmaa aataytumoohunna shay'an illaa ay yakhaafaa allaa yuqeemaa hudoodallaah, fa'in khiftum allaa yuqeemaa hudoodallaahi falaa junaaha 'alayhimaa feemaftadat bih, tilka hudoodullaahi falaa ta'tadoohaa, wamay yata'adda hudoodallaahi fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.2:230: Fa'in tallaqahaa falaa tahillu lahoo mim ba'du hattaa tankiha zawjan ghayrah, fa'in tallaqahaa falaa junaaha 'alayhimaa ay yataraaja'aa in zannaa ay yuqeemaa hudoodallaah, watilka hudoodullaahi yubayyinuhaa liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.2:231: Wa'idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa'a fabalaghna ajalahunna fa'amsikoohunna bima'roofin aw sarrihoohunna bima'roof, walaa tumsikoohunna diraaral lita'tadoo, wamay yaf'al dhaalika faqad zalama nafsah, walaa tattakhidhoo aayaatillaahi huzuwaw wadhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum wamaa anzala 'alaykum minal-kitaabi wal-hikmati ya'izukum bih, wattaqullaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.2:232: Wa'idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa'a fabalaghna ajalahunna falaa ta'duloohunna ay yankihna azwaajahunna idhaa taraadaw baynahum bil-ma'roof, dhaalika yoo'azu bihee man kaana minkum yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, dhaalikum azkaa lakum wa'athar, wallaahu ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamoon
map.2:233: Wal-waalidaatu yurdi'na awlaadahunna hawlayni kaamilayni liman araada ay yutimmar-radaa'ah, wa'alal-mawloodi lahoo rizquhunna wakiswatuhunna bil-ma'roof, laa tukallafu nafsun illaa wus'ahaa, laa tudaarra waalidatum biwaladihaa walaa mawloodul lahoo biwaladihee wa'alal-waarithi mithlu dhaalik, fa'in araadaa fisaalan 'an taraadim minhumaa watashaawurin falaa junaaha 'alayhimaa, wa'in arattum an tastardi'oo awlaadakum falaa junaaha 'alaykum idhaa sallamtum maa aataytum bil-ma'roof, wattaqullaaha wa'lamoo annallaaha bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.2:234: Wal-ladheena yutawaffawna minkum wayadharoona azwaajay yatarabbasna bi'anfusihinna arba'ata ashhuriw wa'ashraa, fa'idhaa balaghna ajalahunna falaa junaaha 'alaykum feemaa fa'alna fee anfusihinna bil-ma'roof, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.2:235: Walaa junaaha 'alaykum feemaa 'arradtum bihee min khitbatin-nisaa'i aw aknantum fee anfusikum, 'alimallaahu annakum satadhkuroonahunna walaakil laa tuwaa'idoohunna sirran illaa an taqooloo qawlam ma'roofaa, walaa ta'zimoo 'uqdatan-nikaahi hattaa yablughal-kitaabu ajalah, wa'lamoo annallaaha ya'lamu maa fee anfusikum fahdharooh, wa'lamoo annallaaha ghafoorun haleem
map.2:236: Laa junaaha 'alaykum in tallaqtumun-nisaa'a maa lam tamassoohunna aw tafridoo lahunna fareedah, wamatti'oohunna 'alal-moosi'i qadaruhoo wa'alal-muqtiri qadaruh, mataa'am bil-ma'roof, haqqan 'alal-muhsineen
map.2:237: Wa'in tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna waqad faradtum lahunna fareedatan fanisfu maa faradtum illaa ay ya'foona aw ya'fuwal-ladhee biyadihee 'uqdatun-nikaah, wa'an ta'foo aqrabu lit-taqwaa, walaa tansawul-fadla baynakum, innallaaha bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.2:239: Fa'in khiftum farijaalan aw rukbaanaa, fa'idhaa amintum fadhkurullaaha kamaa 'allamakum maa lam takoonoo ta'lamoon
map.2:240: Wal-ladheena yutawaffawna minkum wayadharoona azwaajaa, wasiyyatal li'azwaajihim mataa'an ilal-hawli ghayra ikhraaj, fa'in kharajna falaa junaaha 'alaykum fee maa fa'alna fee anfusihinna mim ma'roof, wallaahu 'azeezun hakeem
map.2:242: Kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatihee la'allakum ta'qiloon
map.2:243: Alam tara ilal-ladheena kharajoo min diyaarihim wahum uloofun hadharal-mawt, faqaala lahumullaahu mootoo, thumma ahyaahum, innallaaha ladhoo fadlin 'alan-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
map.2:244: Waqaatiloo fee sabeelillaahi wa'lamoo annallaaha samee'un 'aleem
map.2:245: Man dhal-ladhee yuqridullaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa'ifahoo lahoo ad'aafan katheerah, wallaahu yaqbidu wayabsut, wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.2:246: Alam tara ilal-mala'i mim banee israa'eela mim ba'di moosaa, idh qaaloo linabiyyil lahumub'ath lanaa malikan nuqaatil fee sabeelillaah, qaala hal 'asaytum in kutiba 'alaykumul-qitaalu allaa tuqaatiloo, qaaloo wamaa lanaa allaa nuqaatila fee sabeelillaahi waqad ukhrijnaa min diyaarinaa wa'abnaa'inaa, falammaa kutiba 'alayhimul-qitaalu tawallaw illaa qaleelam minhum, wallaahu 'aleemum biz-zaalimeen
map.2:247: Waqaala lahum nabiyyuhum innallaaha qad ba'atha lakum taaloota malikaa, qaaloo annaa yakoonu lahul-mulku 'alaynaa wanahnu ahaqqu bil-mulki minhu walam yu'ta sa'atam minal-maal, qaala innallaahastafaahu 'alaykum wazaadahoo bastatan fil-'ilmi wal-jism, wallaahu yu'tee mulkahoo may yashaa', wallaahu waasi'un 'aleem
map.2:248: Waqaala lahum nabiyyuhum inna aayata mulkihee ay ya'tiyakumut-taabootu feehi sakeenatum mir rabbikum wabaqiyyatum mimmaa taraka aalu moosaa wa'aalu haaroona tahmiluhul-malaa'ikah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
map.2:249: Falammaa fasala taalootu bil-junoodi qaala innallaaha mubtaleekum binahar, faman shariba minhu falaysa minnee, wamal lam yat'amhu fa'innahoo minnee illaa manightarafa ghurfatam biyadih, fashariboo minhu illaa qaleelam minhum, falammaa jaawazahoo huwa wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo qaaloo laa taaqata lanal-yawma bijaaloota wajunoodih, qaalal-ladheena yazunnoona annahum mulaaqullaahi kam min fi'atin qaleelatin ghalabat fi'atan katheeratam bi'idhnillaah, wallaahu ma'as-saabireen
map.2:250: Walammaa barazoo lijaaloota wajunoodihee qaaloo rabbanaa afrigh 'alaynaa sabraw wathabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen
map.2:251: Fahazamoohum bi'idhnillaah, waqatala daawoodu jaaloota wa'aataahullaahul-mulka wal-hikmata wa'allamahoo mimmaa yashaa', walawlaa daf'ullaahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'dil lafasadatil-ardu walaakinnallaaha dhoo fadlin 'alal-'aalameen
map.2:252: Tilka aayaatullaahi natloohaa 'alayka bil-haqq, wa'innaka laminal-mursaleen
map.2:253: Tilkar-rusulu faddalnaa ba'dahum 'alaa ba'd, minhum man kallamallaahu warafa'a ba'dahum darajaat, wa'aataynaa 'eesabna maryamal-bayyinaati wa'ayyadnaahu biroohil-qudus, walaw shaa'allaahu maqtatalal-ladheena mim ba'dihim mim ba'di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu walaakinikhtalafoo faminhum man aamana waminhum man kafar, walaw shaa'allaahu maqtataloo, walaakinnallaaha yaf'alu maa yureed
map.2:254: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo anfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaakum min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa bay'un feehi walaa khullatuw walaa shafaa'ah, wal-kaafiroona humuz-zaalimoon
map.2:255: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, al-hayyul-qayyoom, laa ta'khudhuhoo sinatuw walaa nawm, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, man dhal-ladhee yashfa'u 'indahoo illaa bi'idhnih, ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum, walaa yuheetoona bishay'im min 'ilmihee illaa bimaa shaa', wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-ard, walaa ya'ooduhoo hifzuhumaa, wahuwal-'aliyyul-'azeem
map.2:256: Laa ikraaha fid-deen, qat tabayyanar-rushdu minal-ghayy, famay yakfur bit-taaghooti wayu'mim billaahi faqadistamsaka bil-'urwatil-wuthqaa lanfisaama lahaa, wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.2:257: Allaahu waliyyul-ladheena aamanoo yukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wal-ladheena kafaroo awliyaa'uhumut-taaghootu yukhrijoonahum minan-noori ilaz-zulumaat, ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.2:258: Alam tara ilal-ladhee haajja ibraaheema fee rabbihee an aataahullaahul-mulk, idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbiyal-ladhee yuhyee wayumeetu qaala ana uhyee wa'umeet, qaala ibraaheemu fa'innallaaha ya'tee bish-shamsi minal-mashriqi fa'ti bihaa minal-maghribi fabuhital-ladhee kafar, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.2:259: Aw kal-ladhee marra 'alaa qaryatiw wahiya khaawiyatun 'alaa 'urooshihaa, qaala annaa yuhyee haadhihillaahu ba'da mawtihaa, fa'amaatahullaahu mi'ata 'aamin thumma ba'athah, qaala kam labitht, qaala labithtu yawman aw ba'da yawm, qaala bal labithta mi'ata 'aamin fanzur ilaa ta'aamika washaraabika lam yatasannah, wanzur ilaa himaarik, walinaj'alaka aayatal lin-naasi wanzur ilal-'izaami kayfa nunshizuhaa thumma naksoohaa lahmaa, falammaa tabayyana lahoo qaala a'lamu annallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.2:260: Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbi arinee kayfa tuhyil-mawtaa, qaala awalam tu'min, qaala balaa walaakil liyatma'inna qalbee, qaala fakhudh arba'atam minat-tayri fasurhunna ilayka thummaj'al 'alaa kulli jabalim minhunna juz'an thummad'uhunna ya'teenaka sa'yaa, wa'lam annallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.2:261: Mathalul-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum fee sabeelillaahi kamathali habbatin ambatat sab'a sanaabila fee kulli sumbulatim mi'atu habbah, wallaahu yudaa'ifu limay yashaa', wallaahu waasi'un 'aleem
map.2:262: Alladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum fee sabeelillaahi thumma laa yutbi'oona maa anfaqoo mannaw walaa adhal lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim, walaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.2:263: Qawlum ma'roofuw wamaghfiratun khayrum min sadaqatiy yatba'uhaa adhaa, wallaahu ghaniyyun haleem
map.2:264: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tubtiloo sadaqaatikum bil-manni wal-adhaa kal-ladhee yunfiqu maalahoo ri'aa'an-naasi walaa yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, famathaluhoo kamathali safwaanin 'alayhi turaabun fa'asaabahoo waabilun fatarakahoo saldaa, laa yaqdiroona 'alaa shay'im mimmaa kasaboo, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
map.2:265: Wamathalul-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahumubtighaa'a mardaatillaahi watathbeetam min anfusihim kamathali jannatim birabwatin asaabahaa waabilun fa'aatat ukulahaa di'fayn, fa'il lam yusibhaa waabilun fatall, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.2:266: Ayawaddu ahadukum an takoona lahoo jannatum min nakheeliw wa'a'naabin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahoo feehaa min kullith-thamaraati wa'asaabahul-kibaru walahoo dhurriyyatun du'afaa', fa'asaabahaa i'saarun feehi naarun fahtaraqat, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaati la'allakum tatafakkaroon
map.2:267: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo anfiqoo min tayyibaati maa kasabtum wamimmaa akhrajnaa lakum minal-ard, walaa tayammamul-khabeetha minhu tunfiqoona walastum bi'aakhidheehi illaa an tughmidoo feeh, wa'lamoo annallaaha ghaniyyun hameed
map.2:268: Ash-shaytaanu ya'idukumul-faqra waya'murukum bil-fahshaa', wallaahu ya'idukum maghfiratam minhu wafadlaa, wallaahu waasi'un 'aleem
map.2:269: Yu'til-hikmata may yashaa', wamay yu'tal-hikmata faqad ootiya khayran katheeraa, wamaa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab
map.2:270: Wamaa anfaqtum min nafaqatin aw nadhartum min nadhrin fa'innallaaha ya'lamuh, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
map.2:271: In tubdus-sadaqaati fani'immaa hiy, wa'in tukhfoohaa watu'toohal-fuqaraa'a fahuwa khayrul lakum, wayukaffiru 'ankum min sayyi'aatikum, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.2:272: Laysa 'alayka hudaahum walaakinnallaaha yahdee may yashaa', wamaa tunfiqoo min khayrin fali'anfusikum, wamaa tunfiqoona illabtighaa'a wajhillaah, wamaa tunfiqoo min khayriy yuwaffa ilaykum wa'antum laa tuzlamoon
map.2:273: Lil-fuqaraa'il-ladheena uhsiroo fee sabeelillaahi laa yastatee'oona darban fil-ard, yahsabuhumul-jaahilu aghniyaa'a minat-ta'affuf, ta'rifuhum biseemaahum, laa yas'aloonan-naasa ilhaafaa, wamaa tunfiqoo min khayrin fa'innallaaha bihee 'aleem
map.2:274: Alladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum bil-layli wan-nahaari sirraw wa'alaaniyatan falahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim, walaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.2:275: Alladheena ya'kuloonar-ribaa laa yaqoomoona illaa kamaa yaqoomul-ladhee yatakhabbatuhush-shaytaanu minal-mass, dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo innamal-bay'u mithlur-ribaa, wa'ahallallaahul-bay'a waharramar-ribaa, faman jaa'ahoo maw'izatum mir rabbihee fantahaa falahoo maa salaf, wa'amruhoo ilallaah, waman 'aada fa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.2:276: Yamhaqullaahur-ribaa wayurbis-sadaqaat, wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla kaffaarin atheem
map.2:277: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim, walaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.2:278: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wadharoo maa baqiya minar-ribaa in kuntum mu'mineen
map.2:279: Fa'il lam taf'aloo fa'dhanoo biharbim minallaahi warasoolih, wa'in tubtum falakum ru'oosu amwaalikum, laa tazlimoona walaa tuzlamoon
map.2:280: Wa'in kaana dhoo 'usratin fanaziratun ilaa maysarah, wa'an tasaddaqoo khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.2:281: Wattaqoo yawman turja'oona feehi ilallaah, thumma tuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.2:282: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tadaayantum bidaynin ilaa ajalim musamman faktubooh, walyaktub baynakum kaatibum bil-'adl, walaa ya'ba kaatibun ay yaktuba kamaa 'allamahullaahu falyaktub, walyumlilil-ladhee 'alayhil-haqqu walyattaqillaaha rabbahoo walaa yabkhas minhu shay'aa, fa'in kaanal-ladhee 'alayhil-haqqu safeehan aw da'eefan aw laa yastatee'u ay yumilla huwa falyumlil waliyyuhoo bil-'adl, wastashhidoo shaheedayni mir rijaalikum, fa'il lam yakoonaa rajulayni farajuluw wamra'ataani mimman tardawna minash-shuhadaa'i an tadilla ihdaahumaa fatudhakkira ihdaahumal-ukhraa, walaa ya'bash-shuhadaa'u idhaa maa du'oo, walaa tas'amoo an taktuboohu sagheeran aw kabeeran ilaa ajalih, dhaalikum aqsatu 'indallaahi wa'aqwamu lish-shahaadati wa'adnaa allaa tartaaboo illaa an takoona tijaaratan haadiratan tudeeroonahaa baynakum falaysa 'alaykum junaahun allaa taktuboohaa, wa'ashhidoo idhaa tabaaya'tum, walaa yudaarra kaatibuw walaa shaheed, wa'in taf'aloo fa'innahoo fusooqum bikum, wattaqullaah, wayu'allimukumullaah, wallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.2:283: Wa'in kuntum 'alaa safariw walam tajidoo kaatiban farihaanum maqboodah, fa'in amina ba'dukum ba'dan falyu'addil-ladhi'tumina amaanatahoo walyattaqillaaha rabbah, walaa taktumush-shahaadah, wamay yaktumhaa fa'innahoo aathimun qalbuh, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona 'aleem
map.2:284: Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wa'in tubdoo maa fee anfusikum aw tukhfoohu yuhaasibkum bihillaah, fayaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu'adhdhibu may yashaa', wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.2:285: Aamanar-rasoolu bimaa unzila ilayhi mir rabbihee wal-mu'minoon, kullun aamana billaahi wamalaa'ikatihee wakutubihee warusulih, laa nufarriqu bayna ahadim mir rusulih, waqaaloo sami'naa wa'ata'naa ghufraanaka rabbanaa wa'ilaykal-maseer
map.2:286: Laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa, lahaa maa kasabat wa'alayhaa maktasabat, rabbanaa laa tu'aakhidhnaa in naseenaa aw akhta'naa, rabbanaa walaa tahmil 'alaynaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-ladheena min qablinaa, rabbanaa walaa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih, wa'fu 'annaa, waghfir lanaa, warhamnaa, anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen
map.3:3: Nazzala 'alaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi wa'anzalat-tawraata wal-injeel
map.3:4: Min qablu hudal lin-naasi wa'anzalal-furqaan, innal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi lahum 'adhaabun shadeed, wallaahu 'azeezun dhuntiqaam
map.3:5: Innallaaha laa yakhfaa 'alayhi shay'un fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa'
map.3:6: Huwal-ladhee yusawwirukum fil-arhaami kayfa yashaa', laa ilaaha illaa huwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.3:7: Huwal-ladhee anzala 'alaykal-kitaaba minhu aayaatum muhkamaatun hunna ummul-kitaabi wa'ukharu mutashaabihaat, fa'ammal-ladheena fee quloobihim zayghun fayattabi'oona maa tashaabaha minhubtighaa'al-fitnati wabtighaa'a ta'weelih, wamaa ya'lamu ta'weelahoo illallaah, war-raasikhoona fil-'ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihee kullum min 'indi rabbinaa, wamaa yadhdhakkaru illaa ulul-albaab
map.3:8: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da idh hadaytanaa wahab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah, innaka antal-wahhaab
map.3:9: Rabbanaa innaka jaami'un-naasi liyawmil laa rayba feeh, innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad
map.3:10: Innal-ladheena kafaroo lan tughniya 'anhum amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum minallaahi shay'aa, wa'ulaa'ika hum waqoodun-naar
map.3:11: Kada'bi aali fir'awna wal-ladheena min qablihim, kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, fa'akhadhahumullaahu bidhunoobihim, wallaahu shadeedul-'iqaab
map.3:12: Qul lilladheena kafaroo satughlaboona watuhsharoona ilaa jahannam, wabi'sal-mihaad
map.3:13: Qad kaana lakum aayatun fee fi'ataynil-taqataa, fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelillaahi wa'ukhraa kaafiratuy yarawnahum mithlayhim ra'yal-'ayn, wallaahu yu'ayyidu binasrihee may yashaa', inna fee dhaalika la'ibratal li'ulil-absaar
map.3:14: Zuyyina lin-naasi hubbush-shahawaati minan-nisaa'i wal-baneena wal-qanaateeril-muqantarati minadh-dhahabi wal-fiddati wal-khaylil-musawwamati wal-an'aami wal-harth, dhaalika mataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wallaahu 'indahoo husnul-ma'aab
map.3:15: Qul a'unabbi'ukum bikhayrim min dhaalikum, lilladheenattaqaw 'inda rabbihim jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa'azwaajum mutahharatuw waridwaanum minallaah, wallaahu baseerum bil-'ibaad
map.3:16: Alladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa waqinaa 'adhaaban-naar
map.3:17: As-saabireena was-saadiqeena wal-qaaniteena wal-munfiqeena wal-mustaghfireena bil-ashaar
map.3:18: Shahidallaahu annahoo laa ilaaha illaa huwa wal-malaa'ikatu wa'ulul-'ilmi qaa'imam bil-qist, laa ilaaha illaa huwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.3:19: Innad-deena 'indallaahil-islaam, wamakhtalafal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba illaa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-'ilmu baghyam baynahum, wamay yakfur bi'aayaatillaahi fa'innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
map.3:20: Fa'in haajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillaahi wamanittaba'an, waqul lilladheena ootul-kitaaba wal-ummiyyeena a'aslamtum, fa'in aslamoo faqadihtadaw, wa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa 'alaykal-balaagh, wallaahu baseerum bil-'ibaad
map.3:21: Innal-ladheena yakfuroona bi'aayaatillaahi wayaqtuloonan-nabiyyeena bighayri haqq, wayaqtuloonal-ladheena ya'muroona bil-qisti minan-naasi fabashshirhum bi'adhaabin aleem
map.3:22: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena habitat a'maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wamaa lahum min naasireen
map.3:23: Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaabi yud'awna ilaa kitaabillaahi liyahkuma baynahum thumma yatawallaa fareequm minhum wahum mu'ridoon
map.3:24: Dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo lan tamassanan-naaru illaa ayyaamam ma'doodaat, wagharrahum fee deenihim maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.3:25: Fakayfa idhaa jama'naahum liyawmil laa rayba feeh, wawuffiyat kullu nafsim maa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.3:26: Qulillaahumma maalikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tashaa'u watanzi'ul-mulka mimman tashaa', watu'izzu man tashaa'u watudhillu man tashaa', biyadikal-khayr, innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.3:27: Toolijul-layla fin-nahaari watoolijun-nahaara fil-layli watukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti watukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi watarzuqu man tashaa'u bighayri hisaab
map.3:28: Laa yattakhidhil-mu'minoonal-kaafireena awliyaa'a min doonil-mu'mineen, wamay yaf'al dhaalika falaysa minallaahi fee shay'in illaa an tattaqoo minhum tuqaah, wayuhadhdhirukumullaahu nafsah, wa'ilallaahil-maseer
map.3:29: Qul in tukhfoo maa fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu ya'lamhullaah, waya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.3:30: Yawma tajidu kullu nafsim maa 'amilat min khayrim muhdaran wamaa 'amilat min soo', tawaddu law anna baynahaa wabaynahoo amadam ba'eedaa, wayuhadhdhirukumullaahu nafsah, wallaahu ra'oofum bil-'ibaad
map.3:31: Qul in kuntum tuhibboonallaaha fattabi'oonee yuhbibkumullaahu wayaghfir lakum dhunoobakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.3:32: Qul atee'ullaaha war-rasool, fa'in tawallaw fa'innallaaha laa yuhibbul-kaafireen
map.3:33: Innallaahastafaa aadama wanoohaw wa'aala ibraaheema wa'aala 'imraana 'alal-'aalameen
map.3:34: Dhurriyyatam ba'duhaa mim ba'd, wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.3:35: Idh qaalatimra'atu 'imraana rabbi innee nadhartu laka maa fee batnee muharraran fataqabbal minnee, innaka antas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.3:36: Falammaa wada'athaa qaalat rabbi innee wada'tuhaa unthaa, wallaahu a'lamu bimaa wada'at, walaysadh-dhakaru kal-unthaa, wa'innee sammaytuhaa maryama wa'innee u'eedhuhaa bika wadhurriyyatahaa minash-shaytaanir-rajeem
map.3:37: Fataqabbalahaa rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasaniw wa'ambatahaa nabaatan hasanaa, wakaffalahaa zakariyyaa, kullamaa dakhala 'alayhaa zakariyyal-mihraaba wajada 'indahaa rizqaa, qaala yaamaryamu annaa laki haadhaa, qaalat huwa min 'indillaah, innallaaha yarzuqu may yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
map.3:38: Hunaalika da'aa zakariyyaa rabbah, qaala rabbi hab lee mil ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibah, innaka samee'ud-du'aa'
map.3:39: Fanaadathul-malaa'ikatu wahuwa qaa'imuy yusallee fil-mihraabi annallaaha yubashshiruka biyahyaa musaddiqam bikalimatim minallaahi wasayyidaw wahasooraw wanabiyyam minas-saaliheen
map.3:40: Qaala rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamuw waqad balaghaniyal-kibaru wamra'atee 'aaqir, qaala kadhaalikallaahu yaf'alu maa yashaa'
map.3:41: Qaala rabbij'al lee aayah, qaala aayatuka allaa tukalliman-naasa thalaathata ayyaamin illaa ramzaa, wadhkur rabbaka katheeraw wasabbih bil-'ashiyyi wal-ibkaar
map.3:42: Wa'idh qaalatil-malaa'ikatu yaamaryamu innallaahastafaaki watahharaki wastafaaki 'alaa nisaa'il-'aalameen
map.3:44: Dhaalika min ambaa'il-ghaybi nooheehi ilayk, wamaa kunta ladayhim idh yulqoona aqlaamahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryam, wamaa kunta ladayhim idh yakhtasimoon
map.3:45: Idh qaalatil-malaa'ikatu yaamaryamu innallaaha yubashshiruki bikalimatim minh, ismuhul-maseehu 'eesabnu maryama wajeehan fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati waminal-muqarrabeen
map.3:47: Qaalat rabbi annaa yakoonu lee waladuw walam yamsasnee bashar, qaala kadhaalikillaahu yakhluqu maa yashaa', idhaa qadaa amran fa'innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
map.3:49: Warasoolan ilaa banee israa'eela annee qad ji'tukum bi'aayatim mir rabbikum annee akhluqu lakum minat-teeni kahay'atit-tayri fa'anfukhu feehi fayakoonu tayram bi'idhnillaah, wa'ubri'ul-akmaha wal-abrasa wa'uhyil-mawtaa bi'idhnillaah, wa'unabbi'ukum bimaa ta'kuloona wamaa taddakhiroona fee buyootikum, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
map.3:50: Wamusaddiqal limaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wali'uhilla lakum ba'dal-ladhee hurrima 'alaykum waji'tukum bi'aayatim mir rabbikum, fattaqullaaha wa'atee'oon
map.3:51: Innallaaha rabbee warabbukum fa'budooh, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
map.3:52: Falammaa ahassa 'eesaa minhumul-kufra qaala man ansaaree ilallaah, qaalal-hawaariyyoona nahnu ansaarullaah, aamannaa billaah, washhad bi'annaa muslimoon
map.3:53: Rabbanaa aamannaa bimaa anzalta wattaba'nar-rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen
map.3:55: Idh qaalallaahu yaa'eesaa innee mutawaffeeka waraafi'uka ilayya wamutahhiruka minal-ladheena kafaroo wajaa'ilul-ladheenattaba'ooka fawqal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa yawmil-qiyaamah, thumma ilayya marji'ukum fa'ahkumu baynakum feemaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
map.3:56: Fa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo fa'u'adhdhibuhum 'adhaaban shadeedan fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wamaa lahum min naasireen
map.3:57: Wa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fayuwaffeehim ujoorahum, wallaahu laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
map.3:59: Inna mathala 'eesaa 'indallaahi kamathali aadam, khalaqahoo min turaabin thumma qaala lahoo kun fayakoon
map.3:60: Al-haqqu mir rabbika falaa takum minal-mumtareen
map.3:61: Faman haajjaka feehi mim ba'di maa jaa'aka minal-'ilmi faqul ta'aalaw nad'u abnaa'anaa wa'abnaa'akum wanisaa'anaa wanisaa'akum wa'anfusanaa wa'anfusakum, thumma nabtahil fanaj'al la'natallaahi 'alal-kaadhibeen
map.3:62: Inna haadhaa lahuwal-qasasul-haqq, wamaa min ilaahin illallaah, wa'innallaaha lahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.3:64: Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi ta'aalaw ilaa kalimatin sawaa'im baynanaa wabaynakum allaa na'buda illallaaha walaa nushrika bihee shay'aw walaa yattakhidha ba'dunaa ba'dan arbaabam min doonillaah, fa'in tawallaw faqoolushhadoo bi'annaa muslimoon
map.3:65: Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima tuhaajjoona fee ibraaheema wamaa unzilatit-tawraatu wal-injeelu illaa mim ba'dih, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.3:66: Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i haajajtum feemaa lakum bihee 'ilmun falima tuhaajjoona feemaa laysa lakum bihee 'ilm, wallaahu ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamoon
map.3:67: Maa kaana ibraaheemu yahoodiyyaw walaa nasraaniyyaw walaakin kaana haneefam muslimaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
map.3:68: Inna awlan-naasi bi'ibraaheema lalladheenattaba'oohu wahaadhan-nabiyyu wal-ladheena aamanoo, wallaahu waliyyul-mu'mineen
map.3:69: Waddat taa'ifatum min ahlil-kitaabi law yudilloonakum, wamaa yudilloona illaa anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
map.3:70: Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima takfuroona bi'aayaatillaahi wa'antum tashhadoon
map.3:71: Yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima talbisoonal-haqqa bil-baatili wataktumoonal-haqqa wa'antum ta'lamoon
map.3:72: Waqaalat taa'ifatum min ahlil-kitaabi aaminoo bil-ladhee unzila 'alal-ladheena aamanoo wajhan-nahaari wakfuroo aakhirahoo la'allahum yarji'oon
map.3:73: Walaa tu'minoo illaa liman tabi'a deenakum, qul innal-hudaa hudallaahi ay yu'taa ahadum mithla maa ooteetum aw yuhaajjookum 'inda rabbikum, qul innal-fadla biyadillaah, yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu waasi'un 'aleem
map.3:74: Yakhtassu birahmatihee may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-'azeem
map.3:75: Wamin ahlil-kitaabi man in ta'manhu biqintaariy yu'addihee ilayk, waminhum man in ta'manhu bideenaaril laa yu'addihee ilayka illaa maa dumta 'alayhi qaa'imaa, dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo laysa 'alaynaa fil-ummiyyeena sabeel, wayaqooloona 'alallaahil-kadhiba wahum ya'lamoon
map.3:76: Balaa man awfaa bi'ahdihee wattaqaa fa'innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen
map.3:77: Innal-ladheena yashtaroona bi'ahdillaahi wa'aymaanihim thamanan qaleelan ulaa'ika laa khalaaqa lahum fil-aakhirati walaa yukallimuhumullaahu walaa yanzuru ilayhim yawmal-qiyaamati walaa yuzakkeehim, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.3:78: Wa'inna minhum lafareeqay yalwoona alsinatahum bil-kitaabi litahsaboohu minal-kitaabi wamaa huwa minal-kitaab, wayaqooloona huwa min 'indillaahi wamaa huwa min 'indillaah, wayaqooloona 'alallaahil-kadhiba wahum ya'lamoon
map.3:79: Maa kaana libasharin ay yu'tiyahullaahul-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata thumma yaqoola lin-naasi koonoo 'ibaadal lee min doonillaahi walaakin koonoo rabbaaniyyeena bimaa kuntum tu'allimoonal-kitaaba wabimaa kuntum tadrusoon
map.3:80: Walaa ya'murakum an tattakhidhul-malaa'ikata wan-nabiyyeena arbaabaa, aya'murukum bil-kufri ba'da idh antum muslimoon
map.3:81: Wa'idh akhadhallaahu meethaaqan-nabiyyeena lamaa aataytukum min kitaabiw wahikmatin thumma jaa'akum rasoolum musaddiqul limaa ma'akum latu'minunna bihee walatansurunnah, qaala a'aqrartum wa'akhadhtum 'alaa dhaalikum isree, qaaloo aqrarnaa, qaala fashhadoo wa'ana ma'akum minash-shaahideen
map.3:82: Faman tawallaa ba'da dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
map.3:83: Afaghayra deenillaahi yabghoona walahoo aslama man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi taw'aw wakarhaw wa'ilayhi yurja'oon
map.3:84: Qul aamannaa billaahi wamaa unzila 'alaynaa wamaa unzila 'alaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa'eela wa'ishaaqa waya'qooba wal-asbaati wamaa ootiya moosaa wa'eesaa wan-nabiyyoona mir rabbihim, laa nufarriqu bayna ahadim minhum, wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
map.3:85: Wamay yabtaghi ghayral-islaami deenan falay yuqbala minh, wahuwa fil-aakhirati minal-khaasireen
map.3:86: Kayfa yahdillaahu qawman kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim washahidoo annar-rasoola haqquw wajaa'ahumul-bayyinaat, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.3:87: Ulaa'ika jazaa'uhum anna 'alayhim la'natallaahi wal-malaa'ikati wan-naasi ajma'een
map.3:88: Khaalideena feehaa, laa yukhaffafu 'anhumul-'adhaabu walaa hum yunzaroon
map.3:89: Illal-ladheena taaboo mim ba'di dhaalika wa'aslahoo, fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.3:90: Innal-ladheena kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim thummazdaadoo kufral lan tuqbala tawbatuhum, wa'ulaa'ika humud-daalloon
map.3:91: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wamaatoo wahum kuffaarun falay yuqbala min ahadihim mil'ul-ardi dhahabaw walawiftadaa bih, ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabun aleemuw wamaa lahum min naasireen
map.3:92: Lan tanaalul-birra hattaa tunfiqoo mimmaa tuhibboon, wamaa tunfiqoo min shay'in fa'innallaaha bihee 'aleem
map.3:93: Kullut-ta'aami kaana hillal libanee israa'eela illaa maa harrama israa'eelu 'alaa nafsihee min qabli an tunazzalat-tawraah, qul fa'too bit-tawraati fatloohaa in kuntum saadiqeen
map.3:94: Famaniftaraa 'alallaahil-kadhiba mim ba'di dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.3:95: Qul sadaqallaah, fattabi'oo millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
map.3:96: Inna awwala baytiw wudi'a lin-naasi lalladhee bibakkata mubaarakaw wahudal lil-'aalameen
map.3:97: Feehi aayaatum bayyinaatum maqaamu ibraaheem, waman dakhalahoo kaana aaminaa, walillaahi 'alan-naasi hijjul-bayti manistataa'a ilayhi sabeelaa, waman kafara fa'innallaaha ghaniyyun 'anil-'aalameen
map.3:98: Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima takfuroona bi'aayaatillaahi wallaahu shaheedun 'alaa maa ta'maloon
map.3:99: Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lima tasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi man aamana tabghoonahaa 'iwajaw wa'antum shuhadaa', wamallaahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
map.3:100: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tutee'oo fareeqam minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba yaruddookum ba'da eemaanikum kaafireen
map.3:101: Wakayfa takfuroona wa'antum tutlaa 'alaykum aayaatullaahi wafeekum rasooluh, wamay ya'tasim billaahi faqad hudiya ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.3:102: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha haqqa tuqaatihee walaa tamootunna illaa wa'antum muslimoon
map.3:103: Wa'tasimoo bihablillaahi jamee'aw walaa tafarraqoo, wadhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum idh kuntum a'daa'an fa'allafa bayna quloobikum fa'asbahtum bini'matihee ikhwaanaa, wakuntum 'alaa shafaa hufratim minan-naari fa'anqadhakum minhaa, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatihee la'allakum tahtadoon
map.3:104: Waltakum minkum ummatuy yad'oona ilal-khayri waya'muroona bil-ma'roofi wayanhawna 'anil-munkar, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.3:105: Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena tafarraqoo wakhtalafoo mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-bayyinaat, wa'ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.3:106: Yawma tabyaddu wujoohuw wataswaddu wujooh, fa'ammal-ladheenaswaddat wujoohuhum, akafartum ba'da eemaanikum fadhooqul-'adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
map.3:107: Wa'ammal-ladheenabyaddat wujoohuhum fafee rahmatillaah, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.3:108: Tilka aayaatullaahi natloohaa 'alayka bil-haqq, wamallaahu yureedu zulmal lil-'aalameen
map.3:109: Walillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wa'ilallaahi turja'ul-umoor
map.3:110: Kuntum khayra ummatin ukhrijat lin-naasi ta'muroona bil-ma'roofi watanhawna 'anil-munkari watu'minoona billaah, walaw aamana ahlul-kitaabi lakaana khayral lahum, minhumul-mu'minoona wa'aktharuhumul-faasiqoon
map.3:111: Lay yadurrookum illaa adhaa, wa'iy yuqaatilookum yuwallookumul-adbaar, thumma laa yunsaroon
map.3:112: Duribat 'alayhimudh-dhillatu ayna maa thuqifoo illaa bihablim minallaahi wahablim minan-naasi wabaa'oo bighadabim minallaahi waduribat 'alayhimul-maskanah, dhaalika bi'annahum kaanoo yakfuroona bi'aayaatillaahi wayaqtuloonal-anbiyaa'a bighayri haqq, dhaalika bimaa 'asaw wakaanoo ya'tadoon
map.3:113: Laysoo sawaa'aa, min ahlil-kitaabi ummatun qaa'imatuy yatloona aayaatillaahi aanaa'al-layli wahum yasjudoon
map.3:114: Yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri waya'muroona bil-ma'roofi wayanhawna 'anil-munkari wayusaari'oona fil-khayraat, wa'ulaa'ika minas-saaliheen
map.3:115: Wamaa yaf'aloo min khayrin falay yukfarooh, wallaahu 'aleemum bil-muttaqeen
map.3:116: Innal-ladheena kafaroo lan tughniya 'anhum amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum minallaahi shay'aa, wa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.3:117: Mathalu maa yunfiqoona fee haadhihil-hayaatid-dunyaa kamathali reehin feehaa sirrun asaabat hartha qawmin zalamoo anfusahum fa'ahlakath, wamaa zalamahumullaahu walaakin anfusahum yazlimoon
map.3:118: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo bitaanatam min doonikum laa ya'loonakum khabaalaa, waddoo maa 'anittum, qad badatil-baghdaa'u min afwaahihim, wamaa tukhfee sudooruhum akbar, qad bayyannaa lakumul-aayaati in kuntum ta'qiloon
map.3:119: Haa'antum ulaa'i tuhibboonahum walaa yuhibboonakum watu'minoona bil-kitaabi kullih, wa'idhaa laqookum qaaloo aamannaa, wa'idhaa khalaw 'addoo 'alaykumul-anaamila minal-ghayz, qul mootoo bighayzikum, innallaaha 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.3:120: In tamsaskum hasanatun tasu'hum, wa'in tusibkum sayyi'atuy yafrahoo bihaa, wa'in tasbiroo watattaqoo laa yadurrukum kayduhum shay'aa, innallaaha bimaa ya'maloona muheet
map.3:121: Wa'idh ghadawta min ahlika tubawwi'ul-mu'mineena maqaa'ida lil-qitaal, wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.3:122: Idh hammat taa'ifataani minkum an tafshalaa wallaahu waliyyuhumaa, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.3:123: Walaqad nasarakumullaahu bibadriw wa'antum adhillah, fattaqullaaha la'allakum tashkuroon
map.3:124: Idh taqoolu lil-mu'mineena alay yakfiyakum ay yumiddakum rabbukum bithalaathati aalaafim minal-malaa'ikati munzaleen
map.3:125: Balaa in tasbiroo watattaqoo waya'tookum min fawrihim haadhaa yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati aalaafim minal-malaa'ikati musawwimeen
map.3:126: Wamaa ja'alahullaahu illaa bushraa lakum walitatma'inna quloobukum bih, waman-nasru illaa min 'indillaahil-'azeezil-hakeem
map.3:127: Liyaqta'a tarafam minal-ladheena kafaroo aw yakbitahum fayanqaliboo khaa'ibeen
map.3:128: Laysa laka minal-amri shay'un aw yatooba 'alayhim aw yu'adhdhibahum fa'innahum zaalimoon
map.3:129: Walillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, yaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu'adhdhibu may yashaa', wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.3:130: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa ta'kulur-ribaa ad'aafam mudaa'afah, wattaqullaaha la'allakum tuflihoon
map.3:133: Wasaari'oo ilaa maghfiratim mir rabbikum wajannatin 'arduhas-samaawaatu wal-ardu u'iddat lil-muttaqeen
map.3:134: Al-ladheena yunfiqoona fis-sarraa'i wad-darraa'i wal-kaazimeenal-ghayza wal-'aafeena 'anin-naas, wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen
map.3:135: Wal-ladheena idhaa fa'aloo faahishatan aw zalamoo anfusahum dhakarullaaha fastaghfaroo lidhunoobihim, wamay yaghfirudh-dhunooba illallaah, walam yusirroo 'alaa maa fa'aloo wahum ya'lamoon
map.3:136: Ulaa'ika jazaa'uhum maghfiratum mir rabbihim wajannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wani'ma ajrul-'aamileen
map.3:137: Qad khalat min qablikum sunanun faseeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
map.3:138: Haadhaa bayaanul lin-naasi wahudaw wamaw'izatul lil-muttaqeen
map.3:139: Walaa tahinoo walaa tahzanoo wa'antumul-a'lawna in kuntum mu'mineen
map.3:140: Iy yamsaskum qarhun faqad massal-qawma qarhum mithluh, watilkal-ayyaamu nudaawiluhaa baynan-naas, waliya'lamallaahul-ladheena aamanoo wayattakhidha minkum shuhadaa', wallaahu laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
map.3:142: Am hasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata walammaa ya'lamillaahul-ladheena jaahadoo minkum waya'lamas-saabireen
map.3:143: Walaqad kuntum tamannawnal-mawta min qabli an talqawh, faqad ra'aytumoohu wa'antum tanzuroon
map.3:144: Wamaa muhammadun illaa rasool, qad khalat min qablihir-rusul, afa'im maata aw qutilanqalabtum 'alaa a'qaabikum, wamay yanqalib 'alaa 'aqibayhi falay yadurrallaaha shay'aa, wasayajzillaahush-shaakireen
map.3:145: Wamaa kaana linafsin an tamoota illaa bi'idhnillaahi kitaabam mu'ajjalaa, wamay yurid thawaabad-dunyaa nu'tihee minhaa, wamay yurid thawaabal-aakhirati nu'tihee minhaa, wasanajzish-shaakireen
map.3:146: Waka'ayyim min nabiyyin qaatala ma'ahoo ribbiyyoona katheer, famaa wahanoo limaa asaabahum fee sabeelillaahi wamaa da'ufoo wamastakaanoo, wallaahu yuhibbus-saabireen
map.3:147: Wamaa kaana qawlahum illaa an qaaloo rabbanaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa'israafanaa fee amrinaa wathabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen
map.3:148: Fa'aataahumullaahu thawaabad-dunyaa wahusna thawaabil-aakhirah, wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen
map.3:149: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tutee'ul-ladheena kafaroo yaruddookum 'alaa a'qaabikum fatanqaliboo khaasireen
map.3:151: Sanulqee fee quloobil-ladheena kafarur-ru'ba bimaa ashrakoo billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaanaa, wama'waahumun-naar, wabi'sa mathwaz-zaalimeen
map.3:152: Walaqad sadaqakumullaahu wa'dahoo idh tahussoonahum bi'idhnih, hattaa idhaa fashiltum watanaaza'tum fil-amri wa'asaytum mim ba'di maa araakum maa tuhibboon, minkum may yureedud-dunyaa waminkum may yureedul-aakhirah, thumma sarafakum 'anhum liyabtaliyakum, walaqad 'afaa 'ankum, wallaahu dhoo fadlin 'alal-mu'mineen
map.3:153: Idh tus'idoona walaa talwoona 'alaa ahadiw war-rasoolu yad'ookum fee ukhraakum fa'athaabakum ghammam bighammil likaylaa tahzanoo 'alaa maa faatakum walaa maa asaabakum, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.3:154: Thumma anzala 'alaykum mim ba'dil-ghammi amanatan nu'aasay yaghshaa taa'ifatam minkum wataa'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona billaahi ghayral-haqqi zannal-jaahiliyyah, yaqooloona hal lanaa minal-amri min shay', qul innal-amra kullahoo lillaah, yukhfoona fee anfusihim maa laa yubdoona lak, yaqooloona law kaana lanaa minal-amri shay'um maa qutilnaa haahunaa, qul law kuntum fee buyootikum labarazal-ladheena kutiba 'alayhimul-qatlu ilaa madaaji'ihim, waliyabtaliyallaahu maa fee sudoorikum waliyumahhisa maa fee quloobikum, wallaahu 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.3:155: Innal-ladheena tawallaw minkum yawmal-taqal-jam'aani innamastazallahumush-shaytaanu biba'di maa kasaboo, walaqad 'afallaahu 'anhum, innallaaha ghafoorun haleem
map.3:156: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena kafaroo waqaaloo li'ikhwaanihim idhaa daraboo fil-ardi aw kaanoo ghuzzal law kaanoo 'indanaa maa maatoo wamaa qutiloo, liyaj'alallaahu dhaalika hasratan fee quloobihim, wallaahu yuhyee wayumeet, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.3:157: Wala'in qutiltum fee sabeelillaahi aw muttum lamaghfiratum minallaahi warahmatun khayrum mimmaa yajma'oon
map.3:158: Wala'im muttum aw qutiltum la'ilallaahi tuhsharoon
map.3:159: Fabimaa rahmatim minallaahi linta lahum, walaw kunta fazzan ghaleezal-qalbi lanfaddoo min hawlik, fa'fu 'anhum wastaghfir lahum washaawirhum fil-amr, fa'idhaa 'azamta fatawakkal 'alallaah, innallaaha yuhibbul-mutawakkileen
map.3:160: Iy yansurkumullaahu falaa ghaaliba lakum, wa'iy yakhdhulkum faman dhal-ladhee yansurukum mim ba'dih, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.3:161: Wamaa kaana linabiyyin ay yaghull, wamay yaghlul ya'ti bimaa ghalla yawmal-qiyaamah, thumma tuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.3:162: Afamanittaba'a ridwaanallaahi kamam baa'a bisakhatim minallaahi wama'waahu jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
map.3:163: Hum darajaatun 'indallaah, wallaahu baseerum bimaa ya'maloon
map.3:164: Laqad mannallaahu 'alal-mu'mineena idh ba'atha feehim rasoolam min anfusihim yatloo 'alayhim aayaatihee wayuzakkeehim wayu'allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmah, wa'in kaanoo min qablu lafee dalaalim mubeen
map.3:165: Awalammaa asaabatkum museebatun qad asabtum mithlayhaa qultum annaa haadhaa, qul huwa min 'indi anfusikum, innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.3:167: Waliya'lamal-ladheena naafaqoo, waqeela lahum ta'aalaw qaatiloo fee sabeelillaahi awidfa'oo, qaaloo law na'lamu qitaalal lattaba'naakum, hum lil-kufri yawma'idhin aqrabu minhum lil-eemaan, yaqooloona bi'afwaahihim maa laysa fee quloobihim, wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yaktumoon
map.3:168: Alladheena qaaloo li'ikhwaanihim waqa'adoo law ataa'oonaa maa qutiloo, qul fadra'oo 'an anfusikumul-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
map.3:169: Walaa tahsabannal-ladheena qutiloo fee sabeelillaahi amwaataa, bal ahyaa'un 'inda rabbihim yurzaqoon
map.3:170: Fariheena bimaa aataahumullaahu min fadlihee wayastabshiroona bil-ladheena lam yalhaqoo bihim min khalfihim allaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.3:171: Yastabshiroona bini'matim minallaahi wafadl, wa'annallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-mu'mineen
map.3:172: Alladheenastajaaboo lillaahi war-rasooli mim ba'di maa asaabahumul-qarh, lilladheena ahsanoo minhum wattaqaw ajrun 'azeem
map.3:173: Alladheena qaala lahumun-naasu innan-naasa qad jama'oo lakum fakhshawhum fazaadahum eemaanaa, waqaaloo hasbunallaahu wani'mal-wakeel
map.3:174: Fanqalaboo bini'matim minallaahi wafadlil lam yamsashum soo'uw wattaba'oo ridwaanallaah, wallaahu dhoo fadlin 'azeem
map.3:175: Innamaa dhaalikumush-shaytaanu yukhawwifu awliyaa'ah, falaa takhaafoohum wakhaafooni in kuntum mu'mineen
map.3:176: Walaa yahzunkal-ladheena yusaari'oona fil-kufr, innahum lay yadurrullaaha shay'aa, yureedullaahu allaa yaj'ala lahum hazzan fil-aakhirati walahum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.3:177: Innal-ladheenashtarawul-kufra bil-eemaani lay yadurrullaaha shay'aa, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.3:178: Walaa yahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo annamaa numlee lahum khayrul li'anfusihim, innamaa numlee lahum liyazdaadoo ithmaa, walahum 'adhaabum muheen
map.3:179: Maa kaanallaahu liyadharal-mu'mineena 'alaa maa antum 'alayhi hattaa yameezal-khabeetha minat-tayyib, wamaa kaanallaahu liyutli'akum 'alal-ghaybi walaakinnallaaha yajtabee mir rusulihee may yashaa', fa'aaminoo billaahi warusulih, wa'in tu'minoo watattaqoo falakum ajrun 'azeem
map.3:180: Walaa yahsabannal-ladheena yabkhaloona bimaa aataahumullaahu min fadlihee huwa khayral lahum, bal huwa sharrul lahum, sayutawwaqoona maa bakhiloo bihee yawmal-qiyaamah, walillaahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal-ard, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.3:181: Laqad sami'allaahu qawlal-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha faqeeruw wanahnu aghniyaa', sanaktubu maa qaaloo waqatlahumul-ambiyaa'a bighayri haqqiw wanaqoolu dhooqoo 'adhaabal-hareeq
map.3:182: Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat aydeekum wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil-'abeed
map.3:183: Alladheena qaaloo innallaaha 'ahida ilaynaa allaa nu'mina lirasoolin hattaa ya'tiyanaa biqurbaanin ta'kuluhun-naar, qul qad jaa'akum rusulum min qablee bil-bayyinaati wabil-ladhee qultum falima qataltumoohum in kuntum saadiqeen
map.3:184: Fa'in kadhdhabooka faqad kudhdhiba rusulum min qablika jaa'oo bil-bayyinaati waz-zuburi wal-kitaabil-muneer
map.3:185: Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawt, wa'innamaa tuwaffawna ujoorakum yawmal-qiyaamah, faman zuhziha 'anin-naari wa'udkhilal-jannata faqad faaz, wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa mataa'ul-ghuroor
map.3:186: Latublawunna fee amwaalikum wa'anfusikum, walatasma'unna minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum waminal-ladheena ashrakoo adhan katheeraa, wa'in tasbiroo watattaqoo fa'inna dhaalika min 'azmil-umoor
map.3:187: Wa'idh akhadhallaahu meethaaqal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba latubayyinunnahoo lin-naasi walaa taktumoonah, fanabadhoohu waraa'a zuhoorihim washtaraw bihee thamanan qaleelaa, fabi'sa maa yashtaroon
map.3:188: Laa tahsabannal-ladheena yafrahoona bimaa ataw wayuhibboona ay yuhmadoo bimaa lam yaf'aloo falaa tahsabannahum bimafaazatim minal-'adhaab, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.3:189: Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.3:190: Inna fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari la'aayaatil li'ulil-albaab
map.3:191: Al-ladheena yadhkuroonallaaha qiyaamaw waqu'oodaw wa'alaa junoobihim wayatafakkaroona fee khalqis-samaawaati wal-ard, rabbanaa maa khalaqta haadhaa baatilaa, subhaanaka faqinaa 'adhaaban-naar
map.3:192: Rabbanaa innaka man tudkhilin-naara faqad akhzaytah, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
map.3:193: Rabbanaa innanaa sami'naa munaadiyay yunaadee lil-eemaani an aaminoo birabbikum fa'aamannaa, rabbanaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wakaffir 'annaa sayyi'aatinaa watawaffanaa ma'al-abraar
map.3:194: Rabbanaa wa'aatinaa maa wa'attanaa 'alaa rusulika walaa tukhzinaa yawmal-qiyaamah, innaka laa tukhliful-mee'aad
map.3:195: Fastajaaba lahum rabbuhum annee laa udee'u 'amala 'aamilim minkum min dhakarin aw unthaa, ba'dukum mim ba'd, fal-ladheena haajaroo wa'ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa'oodhoo fee sabeelee waqaataloo waqutiloo la'ukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'aatihim wala'udkhilannahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, thawaabam min 'indillaah, wallaahu 'indahoo husnuth-thawaab
map.3:197: Mataa'un qaleel, thumma ma'waahum jahannam, wabi'sal-mihaad
map.3:198: Laakinil-ladheenattaqaw rabbahum lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa nuzulam min 'indillaah, wamaa 'indallaahi khayrul lil-abraar
map.3:199: Wa'inna min ahlil-kitaabi lamay yu'minu billaahi wamaa unzila ilaykum wamaa unzila ilayhim khaashi'eena lillaahi laa yashtaroona bi'aayaatillaahi thamanan qaleelaa, ulaa'ika lahum ajruhum 'inda rabbihim, innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
map.3:200: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanusbiroo wasaabiroo waraabitoo, wattaqullaaha la'allakum tuflihoon
map.4:1: Yaa ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakumul-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsiw waahidatiw wakhalaqa minhaa zawjahaa wabaththa minhumaa rijaalan katheeraw wanisaa'aa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee tasaa'aloona bihee wal-arhaam, innallaaha kaana 'alaykum raqeebaa
map.4:2: Wa'aatul-yataamaa amwaalahum walaa tatabaddalul-khabeetha bit-tayyib, walaa ta'kuloo amwaalahum ilaa amwaalikum, innahoo kaana hooban kabeeraa
map.4:3: Wa'in khiftum allaa tuqsitoo fil-yataamaa fankihoo maa taaba lakum minan-nisaa'i mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa', fa'in khiftum allaa ta'diloo fawaahidatan aw maa malakat aymaanukum, dhaalika adnaa allaa ta'ooloo
map.4:4: Wa'aatun-nisaa'a saduqaatihinna nihlah, fa'in tibna lakum 'an shay'im minhu nafsan fakuloohu hanee'am maree'aa
map.4:5: Walaa tu'tus-sufahaa'a amwaalakumul-latee ja'alallaahu lakum qiyaamaw warzuqoohum feehaa waksoohum waqooloo lahum qawlam ma'roofaa
map.4:6: Wabtalul-yataamaa hattaa idhaa balaghun-nikaah, fa'in aanastum minhum rushdan fadfa'oo ilayhim amwaalahum, walaa ta'kuloohaa israafaw wabidaaran ay yakbaroo, waman kaana ghaniyyan falyasta'fif, waman kaana faqeeran falya'kul bil-ma'roof, fa'idhaa dafa'tum ilayhim amwaalahum fa'ashhidoo 'alayhim, wakafaa billaahi haseebaa
map.4:7: Lir-rijaali naseebum mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboon, walin-nisaa'i naseebum mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboona mimmaa qalla minhu aw kathur, naseebam mafroodaa
map.4:8: Wa'idhaa hadaral-qismata ulul-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeenu farzuqoohum minhu waqooloo lahum qawlam ma'roofaa
map.4:9: Walyakhshal-ladheena law tarakoo min khalfihim dhurriyyatan di'aafan khaafoo 'alayhim, falyattaqullaaha walyaqooloo qawlan sadeedaa
map.4:10: Innal-ladheena ya'kuloona amwaalal-yataamaa zulman innamaa ya'kuloona fee butoonihim naaraa, wasayaslawna sa'eeraa
map.4:11: Yooseekumullaahu fee awlaadikum lidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayn, fa'in kunna nisaa'an fawqathnatayni falahunna thuluthaa maa tarak, wa'in kaanat waahidatan falahan-nisf, wali'abawayhi likulli waahidim minhumas-sudusu mimmaa taraka in kaana lahoo walad, fa'il lam yakul lahoo waladuw wawarithahoo abawaahu fali'ummihith-thuluth, fa'in kaana lahoo ikhwatun fali'ummihis-sudusu mim ba'di wasiyyatiy yoosee bihaa aw dayn, aabaa'ukum wa'abnaa'ukum, laa tadroona ayyuhum aqrabu lakum naf'aa, fareedatam minallaah, innallaaha kaana 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:12: Walakum nisfu maa taraka azwaajukum il lam yakul lahunna walad, fa'in kaana lahunna waladun falakumur-rubu'u mimmaa tarakna mim ba'di wasiyyatiy yooseena bihaa aw dayn, walahunnar-rubu'u mimmaa taraktum il lam yakul lakum walad, fa'in kaana lakum waladun falahunnath-thumunu mimmaa taraktum mim ba'di wasiyyatin toosoona bihaa aw dayn, wa'in kaana rajuluy yoorathu kalaalatan awimra'atuw walahoo akhun aw ukhtun falikulli waahidim minhumas-sudus, fa'in kaanoo akthara min dhaalika fahum shurakaa'u fith-thuluthi mim ba'di wasiyyatiy yoosaa bihaa aw daynin ghayra mudaarr, wasiyyatam minallaah, wallaahu 'aleemun haleem
map.4:13: Tilka hudoodullaah, wamay yuti'illaaha warasoolahoo yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wadhaalikal-fawzul-'azeem
map.4:14: Wamay ya'sillaaha warasoolahoo wayata'adda hudoodahoo yudkhilhu naaran khaalidan feehaa, walahoo 'adhaabum muheen
map.4:15: Wallaatee ya'teenal-faahishata min nisaa'ikum fastashhidoo 'alayhinna arba'atam minkum, fa'in shahidoo fa'amsikoohunna fil-buyooti hattaa yatawaffaahunnal-mawtu aw yaj'alallaahu lahunna sabeelaa
map.4:16: Wal-ladhaani ya'tiyaanihaa minkum fa'aadhoohumaa, fa'in taabaa wa'aslahaa fa'a'ridoo 'anhumaa, innallaaha kaana tawwaabar raheemaa
map.4:17: Innamat-tawbatu 'alallaahi lilladheena ya'maloonas-soo'a bijahaalatin thumma yatooboona min qareebin fa'ulaa'ika yatoobullaahu 'alayhim, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:18: Walaysatit-tawbatu lilladheena ya'maloonas-sayyi'aat, hattaa idhaa hadara ahadahumul-mawtu qaala innee tubtul-aana walal-ladheena yamootoona wahum kuffaar, ulaa'ika a'tadnaa lahum 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.4:19: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yahillu lakum an tarithun-nisaa'a karhaa, walaa ta'duloohunna litadhhaboo biba'di maa aataytumoohunna illaa ay ya'teena bifaahishatim mubayyinah, wa'aashiroohunna bil-ma'roof, fa'in karihtumoohunna fa'asaa an takrahoo shay'aw wayaj'alallaahu feehi khayran katheeraa
map.4:20: Wa'in arattumustibdaala zawjim makaana zawjiw wa'aataytum ihdaahunna qintaaran falaa ta'khudhoo minhu shay'aa, ata'khudhoonahoo buhtaanaw wa'ithmam mubeenaa
map.4:21: Wakayfa ta'khudhoonahoo waqad afdaa ba'dukum ilaa ba'diw wa'akhadhna minkum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
map.4:22: Walaa tankihoo maa nakaha aabaa'ukum minan-nisaa'i illaa maa qad salaf, innahoo kaana faahishataw wamaqtaa, wasaa'a sabeelaa
map.4:23: Hurrimat 'alaykum ummahaatukum wabanaatukum wa'akhawaatukum wa'ammaatukum wakhaalaatukum wabanaatul-akhi wabanaatul-ukhti wa'ummahaatukumullaatee arda'nakum wa'akhawaatukum minar-radaa'ati wa'ummahaatu nisaa'ikum warabaa'ibukumullaatee fee hujoorikum min nisaa'ikumullaatee dakhaltum bihinn, fa'il lam takoonoo dakhaltum bihinna falaa junaaha 'alaykum, wahalaa'ilu abnaa'ikumul-ladheena min aslaabikum wa'an tajma'oo baynal-ukhtayni illaa maa qad salaf, innallaaha kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
map.4:24: Wal-muhsanaatu minan-nisaa'i illaa maa malakat aymaanukum, kitaaballaahi 'alaykum, wa'uhilla lakum maa waraa'a dhaalikum an tabtaghoo bi'amwaalikum muhsineena ghayra musaafiheen, famastamta'tum bihee minhunna fa'aatoohunna ujoorahunna fareedah, walaa junaaha 'alaykum feemaa taraadaytum bihee mim ba'dil-fareedah, innallaaha kaana 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:25: Wamal lam yastati' minkum tawlan ay yankihal-muhsanaatil-mu'minaati famim maa malakat aymaanukum min fatayaatikumul-mu'minaat, wallaahu a'lamu bi'eemaanikum, ba'dukum mim ba'd, fankihoohunna bi'idhni ahlihinna wa'aatoohunna ujoorahunna bil-ma'roofi muhsanaatin ghayra musaafihaatiw walaa muttakhidhaati akhdaan, fa'idhaa uhsinna fa'in atayna bifaahishatin fa'alayhinna nisfu maa 'alal-muhsanaati minal-'adhaab, dhaalika liman khashiyal-'anata minkum, wa'an tasbiroo khayrul lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.4:26: Yureedullaahu liyubayyina lakum wayahdiyakum sunanal-ladheena min qablikum wayatooba 'alaykum, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.4:27: Wallaahu yureedu ay yatooba 'alaykum, wayureedul-ladheena yattabi'oonash-shahawaati an tameeloo maylan 'azeemaa
map.4:29: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa ta'kuloo amwaalakum baynakum bil-baatili illaa an takoona tijaaratan 'an taraadim minkum, walaa taqtuloo anfusakum, innallaaha kaana bikum raheemaa
map.4:30: Wamay yaf'al dhaalika 'udwaanaw wazulman fasawfa nusleehi naaraa, wakaana dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseeraa
map.4:31: In tajtaniboo kabaa'ira maa tunhawna 'anhu nukaffir 'ankum sayyi'aatikum wanudkhilkum mudkhalan kareemaa
map.4:32: Walaa tatamannaw maa faddalallaahu bihee ba'dakum 'alaa ba'd, lir-rijaali naseebum mimmaktasaboo, walin-nisaa'i naseebum mimmaktasabn, was'alullaaha min fadlih, innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in 'aleemaa
map.4:33: Walikullin ja'alnaa mawaaliya mimmaa tarakal-waalidaani wal-aqraboon, wal-ladheena 'aqadat aymaanukum fa'aatoohum naseebahum, innallaaha kaana 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheedaa
map.4:34: Ar-rijaalu qawwaamoona 'alan-nisaa'i bimaa faddalallaahu ba'dahum 'alaa ba'diw wabimaa anfaqoo min amwaalihim, fas-saalihaatu qaanitaatun haafizaatul lil-ghaybi bimaa hafizallaah, wallaatee takhaafoona nushoozahunna fa'izoohunna wahjuroohunna fil-madaaji'i wadriboohunn, fa'in ata'nakum falaa tabghoo 'alayhinna sabeelaa, innallaaha kaana 'aliyyan kabeeraa
map.4:35: Wa'in khiftum shiqaaqa baynihimaa fab'athoo hakamam min ahlihee wahakamam min ahlihaa, iy yureedaa islaahay yuwaffiqillaahu baynahumaa, innallaaha kaana 'aleeman khabeeraa
map.4:36: Wa'budullaaha walaa tushrikoo bihee shay'aw wabil-waalidayni ihsaanaw wabidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wal-jaari dhil-qurbaa wal-jaaril-junubi was-saahibi bil-jambi wabnis-sabeeli wamaa malakat aymaanukum, innallaaha laa yuhibbu man kaana mukhtaalan fakhooraa
map.4:37: Al-ladheena yabkhaloona waya'muroonan-naasa bil-bukhli wayaktumoona maa aataahumullaahu min fadlih, wa'a'tadnaa lil-kaafireena 'adhaabam muheenaa
map.4:38: Wal-ladheena yunfiqoona amwaalahum ri'aa'an-naasi walaa yu'minoona billaahi walaa bil-yawmil-aakhir, wamay yakunish-shaytaanu lahoo qareenan fasaa'a qareenaa
map.4:39: Wamaadhaa 'alayhim law aamanoo billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa'anfaqoo mimmaa razaqahumullaah, wakaanallaahu bihim 'aleemaa
map.4:40: Innallaaha laa yazlimu mithqaala dharrah, wa'in taku hasanatay yudaa'ifhaa wayu'ti mil ladunhu ajran 'azeemaa
map.4:41: Fakayfa idhaa ji'naa min kulli ummatim bishaheediw waji'naa bika 'alaa haa'ulaa'i shaheedaa
