map.4:42: Yawma'idhiy yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo wa'asawur-rasoola law tusawwaa bihimul-ard, walaa yaktumoonallaaha hadeethaa
map.4:43: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqrabus-salaata wa'antum sukaaraa hattaa ta'lamoo maa taqooloona walaa junuban illaa 'aabiree sabeelin hattaa taghtasiloo, wa'in kuntum mardaa aw 'alaa safarin aw jaa'a ahadum minkum minal-ghaa'iti aw laamastumun-nisaa'a falam tajidoo maa'an fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum wa'aydeekum, innallaaha kaana 'afuwwan ghafooraa
map.4:44: Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaabi yashtaroonad-dalaalata wayureedoona an tadillus-sabeel
map.4:45: Wallaahu a'lamu bi'a'daa'ikum, wakafaa billaahi waliyyaw wakafaa billaahi naseeraa
map.4:46: Minal-ladheena haadoo yuharrifoonal-kalima 'am mawaadi'ihee wayaqooloona sami'naa wa'asaynaa wasma' ghayra musma'iw waraa'inaa layyam bi'alsinatihim wata'nan fid-deen, walaw annahum qaaloo sami'naa wa'ata'naa wasma' wanzurnaa lakaana khayral lahum wa'aqwama walaakil la'anahumullaahu bikufrihim falaa yu'minoona illaa qaleelaa
map.4:47: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba aaminoo bimaa nazzalnaa musaddiqal limaa ma'akum min qabli an natmisa wujoohan fanaruddahaa 'alaa adbaarihaa aw nal'anahum kamaa la'annaa ashaabas-sabt, wakaana amrullaahi maf'oolaa
map.4:48: Innallaaha laa yaghfiru ay yushraka bihee wayaghfiru maa doona dhaalika limay yashaa', wamay yushrik billaahi faqadiftaraa ithman 'azeemaa
map.4:49: Alam tara ilal-ladheena yuzakkoona anfusahum, balillaahu yuzakkee may yashaa'u walaa yuzlamoona fateelaa
map.4:50: Unzur kayfa yaftaroona 'alallaahil-kadhib, wakafaa bihee ithmam mubeenaa
map.4:51: Alam tara ilal-ladheena ootoo naseebam minal-kitaabi yu'minoona bil-jibti wat-taaghooti wayaqooloona lilladheena kafaroo haa'ulaa'i ahdaa minal-ladheena aamanoo sabeelaa
map.4:52: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena la'anahumullaah, wamay yal'anillaahu falan tajida lahoo naseeraa
map.4:53: Am lahum naseebum minal-mulki fa'idhal laa yu'toonan-naasa naqeeraa
map.4:54: Am yahsudoonan-naasa 'alaa maa aataahumullaahu min fadlih, faqad aataynaa aala ibraaheemal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa'aataynaahum mulkan 'azeemaa
map.4:55: Faminhum man aamana bihee waminhum man sadda 'anh, wakafaa bijahannama sa'eeraa
map.4:56: Innal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatinaa sawfa nusleehim naaraa, kullamaa nadijat julooduhum baddalnaahum juloodan ghayrahaa liyadhooqul-'adhaab, innallaaha kaana 'azeezan hakeemaa
map.4:57: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati sanudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, lahum feehaa azwaajum mutahharatuw wanudkhiluhum zillan zaleelaa
map.4:58: Innallaaha ya'murukum an tu'addul-amaanaati ilaa ahlihaa wa'idhaa hakamtum baynan-naasi an tahkumoo bil-'adl, innallaaha ni'immaa ya'izukum bih, innallaaha kaana samee'am baseeraa
map.4:59: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee'ullaaha wa'atee'ur-rasoola wa'ulil-amri minkum, fa'in tanaaza'tum fee shay'in faruddoohu ilallaahi war-rasooli in kuntum tu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, dhaalika khayruw wa'ahsanu ta'weelaa
map.4:60: Alam tara ilal-ladheena yaz'umoona annahum aamanoo bimaa unzila ilayka wamaa unzila min qablika yureedoona ay yatahaakamoo ilat-taaghooti waqad umiroo ay yakfuroo bih, wayureedush-shaytaanu ay yudillahum dalaalam ba'eedaa
map.4:61: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw ilaa maa anzalallaahu wa'ilar-rasooli ra'aytal-munaafiqeena yasuddoona 'anka sudoodaa
map.4:62: Fakayfa idhaa asaabathum museebatum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim thumma jaa'ooka yahlifoona billaah, in aradnaa illaa ihsaanaw watawfeeqaa
map.4:63: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena ya'lamullaahu maa fee quloobihim fa'a'rid 'anhum wa'izhum waqul lahum fee anfusihim qawlam baleeghaa
map.4:64: Wamaa arsalnaa mir rasoolin illaa liyutaa'a bi'idhnillaah, walaw annahum iz zalamoo anfusahum jaa'ooka fastaghfarullaaha wastaghfara lahumur-rasoolu lawajadullaaha tawwaabar raheemaa
map.4:65: Falaa warabbika laa yu'minoona hattaa yuhakkimooka feemaa shajara baynahum thumma laa yajidoo fee anfusihim harajam mimmaa qadayta wayusallimoo tasleemaa
map.4:66: Walaw annaa katabnaa 'alayhim aniqtuloo anfusakum awikhrujoo min diyaarikum maa fa'aloohu illaa qaleelum minhum, walaw annahum fa'aloo maa yoo'azoona bihee lakaana khayral lahum wa'ashadda tathbeetaa
map.4:69: Wamay yuti'illaaha war-rasoola fa'ulaa'ika ma'al-ladheena an'amallaahu 'alayhim minan-nabiyyeena was-siddeeqeena wash-shuhadaa'i was-saaliheen, wahasuna ulaa'ika rafeeqaa
map.4:71: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo khudhoo hidhrakum fanfiroo thubaatin awinfiroo jamee'aa
map.4:72: Wa'inna minkum lamal layubatti'ann, fa'in asaabatkum museebatun qaala qad an'amallaahu 'alayya idh lam akum ma'ahum shaheedaa
map.4:73: Wala'in asaabakum fadlum minallaahi layaqoolanna ka'al lam takum baynakum wabaynahoo mawaddatuy yaalaytanee kuntu ma'ahum fa'afooza fawzan 'azeemaa
map.4:74: Falyuqaatil fee sabeelillaahil-ladheena yashroonal-hayaatad-dunyaa bil-aakhirah, wamay yuqaatil fee sabeelillaahi fayuqtal aw yaghlib fasawfa nu'teehi ajran 'azeemaa
map.4:75: Wamaa lakum laa tuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi wal-mustad'afeena minar-rijaali wan-nisaa'i wal-wildaanil-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa akhrijnaa min haadhihil-qaryatiz-zaalimi ahluhaa, waj'al lanaa mil ladunka waliyyaa, waj'al lanaa mil ladunka naseeraa
map.4:76: Alladheena aamanoo yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaah, wal-ladheena kafaroo yuqaatiloona fee sabeelit-taaghooti faqaatiloo awliyaa'ash-shaytaan, inna kaydash-shaytaani kaana da'eefaa
map.4:77: Alam tara ilal-ladheena qeela lahum kuffoo aydiyakum wa'aqeemus-salaata wa'aatuz-zakaah, falammaa kutiba 'alayhimul-qitaalu idhaa fareequm minhum yakhshawnan-naasa kakhashyatillaahi aw ashadda khashyah, waqaaloo rabbanaa lima katabta 'alaynal-qitaal, lawlaa akhkhartanaa ilaa ajalin qareeb, qul mataa'ud-dunyaa qaleel, wal-aakhiratu khayrul limanittaqaa, walaa tuzlamoona fateelaa
map.4:78: Ayna maa takoonoo yudrikkumul-mawtu walaw kuntum fee buroojim mushayyadah, wa'in tusibhum hasanatuy yaqooloo haadhihee min 'indillaah, wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atuy yaqooloo haadhihee min 'indik, qul kullum min 'indillaah, famaali haa'ulaa'il-qawmi laa yakaadoona yafqahoona hadeethaa
map.4:79: Maa asaabaka min hasanatin faminallaah, wamaa asaabaka min sayyi'atin famin nafsik, wa'arsalnaaka lin-naasi rasoolaa, wakafaa billaahi shaheedaa
map.4:80: May yuti'ir-rasoola faqad ataa'allaah, waman tawallaa famaa arsalnaaka 'alayhim hafeezaa
map.4:81: Wayaqooloona taa'ah, fa'idhaa barazoo min 'indika bayyata taa'ifatum minhum ghayral-ladhee taqool, wallaahu yaktubu maa yubayyitoon, fa'a'rid 'anhum watawakkal 'alallaah, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
map.4:82: Afalaa yatadabbaroonal-qur'aan, walaw kaana min 'indi ghayrillaahi lawajadoo feehikhtilaafan katheeraa
map.4:83: Wa'idhaa jaa'ahum amrum minal-amni awil-khawfi adhaa'oo bih, walaw raddoohu ilar-rasooli wa'ilaa ulil-amri minhum la'alimahul-ladheena yastambitoonahoo minhum, walawlaa fadlullaahi 'alaykum warahmatuhoo lattaba'tumush-shaytaana illaa qaleelaa
map.4:84: Faqaatil fee sabeelillaah, laa tukallafu illaa nafsaka waharridil-mu'mineen, 'asallaahu ay yakuffa ba'sal-ladheena kafaroo, wallaahu ashaddu ba'saw wa'ashaddu tankeelaa
map.4:85: May yashfa' shafaa'atan hasanatay yakul lahoo naseebum minhaa, wamay yashfa' shafaa'atan sayyi'atay yakul lahoo kiflum minhaa, wakaanallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'im muqeetaa
map.4:86: Wa'idhaa huyyeetum bitahiyyatin fahayyoo bi'ahsana minhaa aw ruddoohaa, innallaaha kaana 'alaa kulli shay'in haseebaa
map.4:87: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, layajma'annakum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feeh, waman asdaqu minallaahi hadeethaa
map.4:88: Famaa lakum fil-munaafiqeena fi'atayni wallaahu arkasahum bimaa kasaboo, atureedoona an tahdoo man adallallaah, wamay yudlilillaahu falan tajida lahoo sabeelaa
map.4:89: Waddoo law takfuroona kamaa kafaroo fatakoonoona sawaa'an falaa tattakhidhoo minhum awliyaa'a hattaa yuhaajiroo fee sabeelillaah, fa'in tawallaw fakhudhoohum waqtuloohum haythu wajattumoohum, walaa tattakhidhoo minhum waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
map.4:90: Illal-ladheena yasiloona ilaa qawmim baynakum wabaynahum meethaaqun aw jaa'ookum hasirat sudooruhum ay yuqaatilookum aw yuqaatiloo qawmahum, walaw shaa'allaahu lasallatahum 'alaykum falaqaatalookum, fa'ini'tazalookum falam yuqaatilookum wa'alqaw ilaykumus-salama famaa ja'alallaahu lakum 'alayhim sabeelaa
map.4:91: Satajidoona aakhareena yureedoona ay ya'manookum waya'manoo qawmahum, kulla maa ruddoo ilal-fitnati urkisoo feehaa, fa'il lam ya'tazilookum wayulqoo ilaykumus-salama wayakuffoo aydiyahum fakhudhoohum waqtuloohum haythu thaqiftumoohum, wa'ulaa'ikum ja'alnaa lakum 'alayhim sultaanam mubeenaa
map.4:92: Wamaa kaana limu'minin ay yaqtula mu'minan illaa khata'aa, waman qatala mu'minan khata'an fatahreeru raqabatim mu'minatiw wadiyatum musallamatun ilaa ahlihee illaa ay yassaddaqoo, fa'in kaana min qawmin 'aduwwil lakum wahuwa mu'minun fatahreeru raqabatim mu'minah, wa'in kaana min qawmim baynakum wabaynahum meethaaqun fadiyatum musallamatun ilaa ahlihee watahreeru raqabatim mu'minah, famal lam yajid fasiyaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayn, tawbatam minallaah, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:93: Wamay yaqtul mu'minam muta'ammidan fajazaa'uhoo jahannamu khaalidan feehaa waghadiballaahu 'alayhi wala'anahoo wa'a'adda lahoo 'adhaaban 'azeemaa
map.4:94: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa darabtum fee sabeelillaahi fatabayyanoo walaa taqooloo liman alqaa ilaykumus-salaama lasta mu'minaa, tabtaghoona 'aradal-hayaatid-dunyaa, fa'indallaahi maghaanimu katheerah, kadhaalika kuntum min qablu famannallaahu 'alaykum fatabayyanoo, innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
map.4:95: Laa yastawil-qaa'idoona minal-mu'mineena ghayru ulid-darari wal-mujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim, faddalallaahul-mujaahideena bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim 'alal-qaa'ideena darajah, wakullaw wa'adallaahul-husnaa, wafaddalallaahul-mujaahideena 'alal-qaa'ideena ajran 'azeemaa
map.4:96: Darajaatim minhu wamaghfirataw warahmah, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.4:97: Innal-ladheena tawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu zaalimee anfusihim qaaloo feema kuntum, qaaloo kunnaa mustad'afeena fil-ard, qaaloo alam takun ardullaahi waasi'atan fatuhaajiroo feehaa, fa'ulaa'ika ma'waahum jahannam, wasaa'at maseeraa
map.4:98: Illal-mustad'afeena minar-rijaali wan-nisaa'i wal-wildaani laa yastatee'oona heelataw walaa yahtadoona sabeelaa
map.4:100: Wamay yuhaajir fee sabeelillaahi yajid fil-ardi muraaghaman katheeraw wasa'ah, wamay yakhruj mim baytihee muhaajiran ilallaahi warasoolihee thumma yudrikhul-mawtu faqad waqa'a ajruhoo 'alallaah, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.4:101: Wa'idhaa darabtum fil-ardi falaysa 'alaykum junaahun an taqsuroo minas-salaah, in khiftum ay yaftinakumul-ladheena kafaroo, innal-kaafireena kaanoo lakum 'aduwwam mubeenaa
map.4:102: Wa'idhaa kunta feehim fa'aqamta lahumus-salaata faltaqum taa'ifatum minhum ma'aka walya'khudhoo aslihatahum, fa'idhaa sajadoo falyakoonoo miw waraa'ikum, walta'ti taa'ifatun ukhraa lam yusalloo falyusalloo ma'aka walya'khudhoo hidhrahum wa'aslihatahum, waddal-ladheena kafaroo law taghfuloona 'an aslihatikum wa'amti'atikum fayameeloona 'alaykum maylataw waahidah, walaa junaaha 'alaykum in kaana bikum adham mim matarin aw kuntum mardaa an tada'oo aslihatakum wakhudhoo hidhrakum, innallaaha a'adda lil-kaafireena 'adhaabam muheenaa
map.4:103: Fa'idhaa qadaytumus-salaata fadhkurullaaha qiyaamaw waqu'oodaw wa'alaa junoobikum, fa'idhatma'nantum fa'aqeemus-salaah, innas-salaata kaanat 'alal-mu'mineena kitaabam mawqootaa
map.4:104: Walaa tahinoo fibtighaa'il-qawm, in takoonoo ta'lamoona fa'innahum ya'lamoona kamaa ta'lamoon, watarjoona minallaahi maa laa yarjoon, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:105: Innaa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi litahkuma baynan-naasi bimaa araakallaah, walaa takul lil-khaa'ineena khaseemaa
map.4:107: Walaa tujaadil 'anil-ladheena yakhtaanoona anfusahum, innallaaha laa yuhibbu man kaana khawwaanan atheemaa
map.4:108: Yastakhfoona minan-naasi walaa yastakhfoona minallaahi wahuwa ma'ahum idh yubayyitoona maa laa yardaa minal-qawl, wakaanallaahu bimaa ya'maloona muheetaa
map.4:109: Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i jaadaltum 'anhum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, famay yujaadilullaaha 'anhum yawmal-qiyaamati am may yakoonu 'alayhim wakeelaa
map.4:110: Wamay ya'mal soo'an aw yazlim nafsahoo thumma yastaghfirillaaha yajidillaaha ghafoorar raheemaa
map.4:111: Wamay yaksib ithman fa'innamaa yaksibuhoo 'alaa nafsih, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:112: Wamay yaksib khatee'atan aw ithman thumma yarmi bihee baree'an faqadihtamala buhtaanaw wa'ithmam mubeenaa
map.4:113: Walawlaa fadlullaahi 'alayka warahmatuhoo lahammat taa'ifatum minhum ay yudillook, wamaa yudilloona illaa anfusahum wamaa yadurroonaka min shay', wa'anzalallaahu 'alaykal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa'allamaka maa lam takun ta'lam, wakaana fadlullaahi 'alayka 'azeemaa
map.4:114: Laa khayra fee katheerim min najwaahum illaa man amara bisadaqatin aw ma'roofin aw islaahim baynan-naas, wamay yaf'al dhaalikabtighaa'a mardaatillaahi fasawfa nu'teehi ajran 'azeemaa
map.4:115: Wamay yushaaqiqir-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahul-hudaa wayattabi' ghayra sabeelil-mu'mineena nuwallihee maa tawallaa wanuslihee jahannam, wasaa'at maseeraa
map.4:116: Innallaaha laa yaghfiru ay yushraka bihee wayaghfiru maa doona dhaalika limay yashaa', wamay yushrik billaahi faqad dalla dalaalam ba'eedaa
map.4:117: Iy yad'oona min doonihee illaa inaathaa, wa'iy yad'oona illaa shaytaanam mareedaa
map.4:118: La'anahullaah, waqaala la'attakhidhanna min 'ibaadika naseebam mafroodaa
map.4:119: Wala'udillannahum wala'umanniyannahum wala'aamurannahum falayubattikunna aadhaanal-an'aami wala'aamurannahum falayughayyirunna khalqallaah, wamay yattakhidhish-shaytaana waliyyam min doonillaahi faqad khasira khusraanam mubeenaa
map.4:120: Ya'iduhum wayumanneehim, wamaa ya'iduhumush-shaytaanu illaa ghurooraa
map.4:121: Ulaa'ika ma'waahum jahannam, walaa yajidoona 'anhaa maheesaa
map.4:122: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati sanudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, wa'dallaahi haqqaa, waman asdaqu minallaahi qeelaa
map.4:123: Laysa bi'amaaniyyikum walaa amaaniyyi ahlil-kitaab, may ya'mal soo'ay yujza bihee walaa yajid lahoo min doonillaahi waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
map.4:124: Wamay ya'mal minas-saalihaati min dhakarin aw unthaa wahuwa mu'minun fa'ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata walaa yuzlamoona naqeeraa
map.4:125: Waman ahsanu deenam mimman aslama wajhahoo lillaahi wahuwa muhsinuw wattaba'a millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wattakhadhallaahu ibraaheema khaleelaa
map.4:126: Walillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wakaanallaahu bikulli shay'im muheetaa
map.4:127: Wayastaftoonaka fin-nisaa', qulillaahu yufteekum feehinna wamaa yutlaa 'alaykum fil-kitaabi fee yataaman-nisaa'illaatee laa tu'toonahunna maa kutiba lahunna watarghaboona an tankihoohunna wal-mustad'afeena minal-wildaani wa'an taqoomoo lil-yataamaa bil-qist, wamaa taf'aloo min khayrin fa'innallaaha kaana bihee 'aleemaa
map.4:128: Wa'inimra'atun khaafat mim ba'lihaa nushoozan aw i'raadan falaa junaaha 'alayhimaa ay yuslihaa baynahumaa sulhaa, was-sulhu khayr, wa'uhdiratil-anfusush-shuhh, wa'in tuhsinoo watattaqoo fa'innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
map.4:129: Walan tastatee'oo an ta'diloo baynan-nisaa'i walaw harastum falaa tameeloo kullal-mayli fatadharoohaa kal-mu'allaqah, wa'in tuslihoo watattaqoo fa'innallaaha kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
map.4:130: Wa'iy yatafarraqaa yughnillaahu kullam min sa'atih, wakaanallaahu waasi'an hakeemaa
map.4:131: Walillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, walaqad wassaynal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum wa'iyyaakum anittaqullaah, wa'in takfuroo fa'inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wakaanallaahu ghaniyyan hameedaa
map.4:132: Walillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
map.4:133: Iy yasha' yudhhibkum ayyuhan-naasu waya'ti bi'aakhareen, wakaanallaahu 'alaa dhaalika qadeeraa
map.4:134: Man kaana yureedu thawaabad-dunyaa fa'indallaahi thawaabud-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wakaanallaahu samee'am baseeraa
map.4:135: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo qawwaameena bil-qisti shuhadaa'a lillaahi walaw 'alaa anfusikum awil-waalidayni wal-aqrabeen, iy yakun ghaniyyan aw faqeeran fallaahu awlaa bihimaa, falaa tattabi'ul-hawaa an ta'diloo, wa'in talwoo aw tu'ridoo fa'innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
map.4:136: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo aaminoo billaahi warasoolihee wal-kitaabil-ladhee nazzala 'alaa rasoolihee wal-kitaabil-ladhee anzala min qabl, wamay yakfur billaahi wamalaa'ikatihee wakutubihee warusulihee wal-yawmil-aakhiri faqad dalla dalaalam ba'eedaa
map.4:137: Innal-ladheena aamanoo thumma kafaroo thumma aamanoo thumma kafaroo thummazdaadoo kufral lam yakunillaahu liyaghfira lahum walaa liyahdiyahum sabeelaa
map.4:139: Al-ladheena yattakhidhoonal-kaafireena awliyaa'a min doonil-mu'mineen, ayabtaghoona 'indahumul-'izzata fa'innal-'izzata lillaahi jamee'aa
map.4:140: Waqad nazzala 'alaykum fil-kitaabi an idhaa sami'tum aayaatillaahi yukfaru bihaa wayustahza'u bihaa falaa taq'udoo ma'ahum hattaa yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrih, innakum idham mithluhum, innallaaha jaami'ul-munaafiqeena wal-kaafireena fee jahannama jamee'aa
map.4:141: Al-ladheena yatarabbasoona bikum, fa'in kaana lakum fathum minallaahi qaaloo alam nakum ma'akum, wa'in kaana lil-kaafireena naseebun qaaloo alam nastahwidh 'alaykum wanamna'kum minal-mu'mineen, fallaahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyaamah, walay yaj'alallaahu lil-kaafireena 'alal-mu'mineena sabeelaa
map.4:142: Innal-munaafiqeena yukhaadi'oonallaaha wahuwa khaadi'uhum, wa'idhaa qaamoo ilas-salaati qaamoo kusaalaa yuraa'oonan-naasa walaa yadhkuroonallaaha illaa qaleelaa
map.4:143: Mudhabdhabeena bayna dhaalik, laa ilaa haa'ulaa'i walaa ilaa haa'ulaa', wamay yudlilillaahu falan tajida lahoo sabeelaa
map.4:144: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-kaafireena awliyaa'a min doonil-mu'mineen, atureedoona an taj'aloo lillaahi 'alaykum sultaanam mubeenaa
map.4:145: Innal-munaafiqeena fid-darkil-asfali minan-naar, walan tajida lahum naseeraa
map.4:146: Illal-ladheena taaboo wa'aslahoo wa'tasamoo billaahi wa'akhlasoo deenahum lillaahi fa'ulaa'ika ma'al-mu'mineen, wasawfa yu'tillaahul-mu'mineena ajran 'azeemaa
map.4:147: Maa yaf'alullaahu bi'adhaabikum in shakartum wa'aamantum, wakaanallaahu shaakiran 'aleemaa
map.4:148: Laa yuhibbullaahul-jahra bis-soo'i minal-qawli illaa man zulim, wakaanallaahu samee'an 'aleemaa
map.4:149: In tubdoo khayran aw tukhfoohu aw ta'foo 'an soo'in fa'innallaaha kaana 'afuwwan qadeeraa
map.4:150: Innal-ladheena yakfuroona billaahi warusulihee wayureedoona ay yufarriqoo baynallaahi warusulihee wayaqooloona nu'minu biba'diw wanakfuru biba'diw wayureedoona ay yattakhidhoo bayna dhaalika sabeelaa
map.4:151: Ulaa'ika humul-kaafiroona haqqaa, wa'a'tadnaa lil-kaafireena 'adhaabam muheenaa
map.4:152: Wal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warusulihee walam yufarriqoo bayna ahadim minhum ulaa'ika sawfa yu'teehim ujoorahum, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.4:153: Yas'aluka ahlul-kitaabi an tunazzila 'alayhim kitaabam minas-samaa'i faqad sa'aloo moosaa akbara min dhaalika faqaaloo arinallaaha jahratan fa'akhadhathumus-saa'iqatu bizulmihim, thummattakhadhul-'ijla mim ba'di maa jaa'athumul-bayyinaatu fa'afawnaa 'an dhaalik, wa'aataynaa moosaa sultaanam mubeenaa
map.4:154: Warafa'naa fawqahumut-toora bimeethaaqihim waqulnaa lahumudkhulul-baaba sujjadaw waqulnaa lahum laa ta'doo fis-sabti wa'akhadhnaa minhum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
map.4:155: Fabimaa naqdihim meethaaqahum wakufrihim bi'aayaatillaahi waqatlihimul-ambiyaa'a bighayri haqqiw waqawlihim quloobunaa ghulf, bal taba'allaahu 'alayhaa bikufrihim falaa yu'minoona illaa qaleelaa
map.4:157: Waqawlihim innaa qatalnal-maseeha 'eesabna maryama rasoolallaah, wamaa qataloohu wamaa salaboohu walaakin shubbiha lahum, wa'innal-ladheenakhtalafoo feehi lafee shakkim minh, maa lahum bihee min 'ilmin illattibaa'az-zanni wamaa qataloohu yaqeenaa
map.4:159: Wa'im min ahlil-kitaabi illaa layu'minanna bihee qabla mawtih, wayawmal-qiyaamati yakoonu 'alayhim shaheedaa
map.4:160: Fabizulmim minal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa 'alayhim tayyibaatin uhillat lahum wabisaddihim 'an sabeelillaahi katheeraa
map.4:161: Wa'akhdhihimur-ribaa waqad nuhoo 'anhu wa'aklihim amwaalan-naasi bil-baatil, wa'a'tadnaa lil-kaafireena minhum 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.4:162: Laakinir-raasikhoona fil-'ilmi minhum wal-mu'minoona yu'minoona bimaa unzila ilayka wamaa unzila min qablika wal-muqeemeenas-salaata wal-mu'toonaz-zakaata wal-mu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, ulaa'ika sanu'teehim ajran 'azeemaa
map.4:163: Innaa awhaynaa ilayka kamaa awhaynaa ilaa noohiw wan-nabiyyeena mim ba'dih, wa'awhaynaa ilaa ibraaheema wa'ismaa'eela wa'ishaaqa waya'qooba wal-asbaati wa'eesaa wa'ayyooba wayoonusa wahaaroona wasulaymaan, wa'aataynaa daawooda zabooraa
map.4:164: Warusulan qad qasasnaahum 'alayka min qablu warusulal lam naqsushum 'alayk, wakallamallaahu moosaa takleemaa
map.4:165: Rusulam mubashshireena wamundhireena li'allaa yakoona lin-naasi 'alallaahi hujjatum ba'dar-rusul, wakaanallaahu 'azeezan hakeemaa
map.4:166: Laakinillaahu yashhadu bimaa anzala ilayka anzalahoo bi'ilmih, wal-malaa'ikatu yashhadoon, wakafaa billaahi shaheedaa
map.4:167: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeelillaahi qad dalloo dalaalam ba'eedaa
map.4:168: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wazalamoo lam yakunillaahu liyaghfira lahum walaa liyahdiyahum tareeqaa
map.4:169: Illaa tareeqa jahannama khaalideena feehaa abadaa, wakaana dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseeraa
map.4:170: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akumur-rasoolu bil-haqqi mir rabbikum fa'aaminoo khayral lakum, wa'in takfuroo fa'inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.4:171: Yaa ahlal-kitaabi laa taghloo fee deenikum walaa taqooloo 'alallaahi illal-haqq, innamal-maseehu 'eesabnu maryama rasoolullaahi wakalimatuh, al-qaahaa ilaa maryama waroohum minh, fa'aaminoo billaahi warusulih, walaa taqooloo thalaathah, intahoo khayral lakum, innamallaahu ilaahuw waahid, subhaanahoo ay yakoona lahoo walad, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
map.4:172: Lay yastankifal-maseehu ay yakoona 'abdal lillaahi walal-malaa'ikatul-muqarraboon, wamay yastankif 'an 'ibaadatihee wayastakbir fasayahshuruhum ilayhi jamee'aa
map.4:173: Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fayuwaffeehim ujoorahum wayazeeduhum min fadlih, wa'ammal-ladheenastankafoo wastakbaroo fayu'adhdhibuhum 'adhaaban aleemaw walaa yajidoona lahum min doonillaahi waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
map.4:174: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akum burhaanum mir rabbikum wa'anzalnaa ilaykum nooram mubeenaa
map.4:175: Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi wa'tasamoo bihee fasayudkhiluhum fee rahmatim minhu wafadliw wayahdeehim ilayhi siraatam mustaqeemaa
map.4:176: Yastaftoonak, qulillaahu yufteekum fil-kalaalah, inimru'un halaka laysa lahoo waladuw walahoo ukhtun falahaa nisfu maa tarak, wahuwa yarithuhaa il lam yakul lahaa walad, fa'in kaanatathnatayni falahumath-thuluthaani mimmaa tarak, wa'in kaanoo ikhwatar rijaalaw wanisaa'an falidh-dhakari mithlu hazzil-unthayayn, yubayyinullaahu lakum an tadilloo, wallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.5:1: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo awfoo bil-'uqood, uhillat lakum baheematul-an'aami illaa maa yutlaa 'alaykum ghayra muhillis-saydi wa'antum hurum, innallaaha yahkumu maa yureed
map.5:2: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuhilloo sha'aa'irallaahi walash-shahral-haraama walal-hadya walal-qalaa'ida walaa aammeenal-baytal-haraama yabtaghoona fadlam mir rabbihim waridwaanaa, wa'idhaa halaltum fastaadoo, walaa yajrimannakum shana'aanu qawmin an saddookum 'anil-masjidil-haraami an ta'tadoo, wata'aawanoo 'alal-birri wat-taqwaa, walaa ta'aawanoo 'alal-ithmi wal-'udwaan, wattaqullaah, innallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.5:3: Hurrimat 'alaykumul-maytatu wad-damu walahmul-khinzeeri wamaa uhilla lighayrillaahi bihee wal-munkhaniqatu wal-mawqoodhatu wal-mutaraddiyatu wan-nateehatu wamaa akalas-sabu'u illaa maa dhakkaytum, wamaa dhubiha 'alan-nusubi wa'an tastaqsimoo bil-azlaam, dhaalikum fisq, al-yawma ya'isal-ladheena kafaroo min deenikum falaa takhshawhum wakhshawn, al-yawma akmaltu lakum deenakum wa'atmamtu 'alaykum ni'matee waradeetu lakumul-islaama deenaa, famanidturra fee makhmasatin ghayra mutajaanifil li'ithmin fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.5:4: Yas'aloonaka maadhaa uhilla lahum, qul uhilla lakumut-tayyibaatu wamaa 'allamtum minal-jawaarihi mukallibeena tu'allimoonahunna mimmaa 'allamakumullaahu fakuloo mimmaa amsakna 'alaykum wadhkurusmallaahi 'alayh, wattaqullaah, innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
map.5:5: Al-yawma uhilla lakumut-tayyibaat, wata'aamul-ladheena ootul-kitaaba hillul lakum, wata'aamukum hillul lahum, wal-muhsanaatu minal-mu'minaati wal-muhsanaatu minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum idhaa aataytumoohunna ujoorahunna muhsineena ghayra musaafiheena walaa muttakhidhee akhdaan, wamay yakfur bil-eemaani faqad habita 'amaluh, wahuwa fil-aakhirati minal-khaasireen
map.5:6: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa qumtum ilas-salaati faghsiloo wujoohakum wa'aydiyakum ilal-maraafiqi wamsahoo biru'oosikum wa'arjulakum ilal-ka'bayn, wa'in kuntum junuban fattahharoo, wa'in kuntum mardaa aw 'alaa safarin aw jaa'a ahadum minkum minal-ghaa'iti aw laamastumun-nisaa'a falam tajidoo maa'an fatayammamoo sa'eedan tayyiban famsahoo biwujoohikum wa'aydeekum minh, maa yureedullaahu liyaj'ala 'alaykum min harajiw walaakiy yureedu liyutahhirakum waliyutimma ni'matahoo 'alaykum la'allakum tashkuroon
map.5:7: Wadhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum wameethaaqahul-ladhee waathaqakum bihee idh qultum sami'naa wa'ata'naa, wattaqullaah, innallaaha 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.5:8: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo qawwaameena lillaahi shuhadaa'a bil-qist, walaa yajrimannakum shana'aanu qawmin 'alaa allaa ta'diloo, i'diloo, huwa aqrabu lit-taqwaa, wattaqullaah, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.5:9: Wa'adallaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun 'azeem
map.5:10: Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
map.5:11: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum idh hamma qawmun ay yabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum fakaffa aydiyahum 'ankum, wattaqullaah, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.5:12: Walaqad akhadhallaahu meethaaqa banee israa'eel, waba'athnaa minhumuthnay 'ashara naqeebaa, waqaalallaahu innee ma'akum, la'in aqamtumus-salaata wa'aataytumuz-zakaata wa'aamantum birusulee wa'azzartumoohum wa'aqradtumullaaha qardan hasanal la'ukaffiranna 'ankum sayyi'aatikum wala'udkhilannakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, faman kafara ba'da dhaalika minkum faqad dalla sawaa'as-sabeel
map.5:13: Fabimaa naqdihim meethaaqahum la'annaahum waja'alnaa quloobahum qaasiyah, yuharrifoonal-kalima 'am mawaadi'ihee wanasoo hazzam mimmaa dhukkiroo bih, walaa tazaalu tattali'u 'alaa khaa'inatim minhum illaa qaleelam minhum, fa'fu 'anhum wasfah, innallaaha yuhibbul-muhsineen
map.5:14: Waminal-ladheena qaaloo innaa nasaaraa akhadhnaa meethaaqahum fanasoo hazzam mimmaa dhukkiroo bih, fa'aghraynaa baynahumul-'adaawata wal-baghdaa'a ilaa yawmil-qiyaamah, wasawfa yunabbi'uhumullaahu bimaa kaanoo yasna'oon
map.5:15: Yaa ahlal-kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum katheeram mimmaa kuntum tukhfoona minal-kitaabi waya'foo 'an katheer, qad jaa'akum minallaahi nooruw wakitaabum mubeen
map.5:16: Yahdee bihillaahu manittaba'a ridwaanahoo subulas-salaami wayukhrijuhum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori bi'idhnihee wayahdeehim ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.5:17: Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha huwal-maseehubnu maryam, qul famay yamliku minallaahi shay'an in araada ay yuhlikal-maseehabna maryama wa'ummahoo waman fil-ardi jamee'aa, walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, yakhluqu maa yashaa', wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.5:18: Waqaalatil-yahoodu wan-nasaaraa nahnu abnaa'ullaahi wa'ahibbaa'uh, qul falima yu'adhdhibukum bidhunoobikum, bal antum basharum mimman khalaq, yaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu'adhdhibu may yashaa', walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, wa'ilayhil-maseer
map.5:19: Yaa ahlal-kitaabi qad jaa'akum rasoolunaa yubayyinu lakum 'alaa fatratim minar-rusuli an taqooloo maa jaa'anaa mim basheeriw walaa nadheer, faqad jaa'akum basheeruw wanadheer, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.5:20: Wa'idh qaala moosaa liqawmihee yaaqawmidhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum idh ja'ala feekum ambiyaa'a waja'alakum mulookaw wa'aataakum maa lam yu'ti ahadam minal-'aalameen
map.5:21: Yaaqawmidkhulul-ardal-muqaddasatal-latee kataballaahu lakum walaa tartaddoo 'alaa adbaarikum fatanqaliboo khaasireen
map.5:22: Qaaloo yaamoosaa inna feehaa qawman jabbaareen, wa'innaa lan nadkhulahaa hattaa yakhrujoo minhaa, fa'iy yakhrujoo minhaa fa'innaa daakhiloon
map.5:23: Qaala rajulaani minal-ladheena yakhaafoona an'amallaahu 'alayhimadkhuloo 'alayhimul-baab, fa'idhaa dakhaltumoohu fa'innakum ghaaliboona wa'alallaahi fatawakkaloo in kuntum mu'mineen
map.5:24: Qaaloo yaamoosaa innaa lan nadkhulahaa abadam maa daamoo feehaa, fadhhab anta warabbuka faqaatilaa innaa haahunaa qaa'idoon
map.5:25: Qaala rabbi innee laa amliku illaa nafsee wa'akhee fafruq baynanaa wabaynal-qawmil-faasiqeen
map.5:26: Qaala fa'innahaa muharramatun 'alayhim arba'eena sanah, yateehoona fil-ard, falaa ta'sa 'alal-qawmil-faasiqeen
map.5:27: Watlu 'alayhim naba'abnay aadama bil-haqq, idh qarrabaa qurbaanan fatuqubbila min ahadihimaa walam yutaqabbal minal-aakhar, qaala la'aqtulannak, qaala innamaa yataqabbalullaahu minal-muttaqeen
map.5:28: La'im basatta ilayya yadaka litaqtulanee maa ana bibaasitiy yadiya ilayka li'aqtulak, innee akhaafullaaha rabbal-'aalameen
map.5:29: Innee ureedu an taboo'a bi'ithmee wa'ithmika fatakoona min ashaabin-naar, wadhaalika jazaa'uz-zaalimeen
map.5:30: Fatawwa'at lahoo nafsuhoo qatla akheehi faqatalahoo fa'asbaha minal-khaasireen
map.5:31: Faba'athallaahu ghuraabay yabhathu fil-ardi liyuriyahoo kayfa yuwaaree saw'ata akheeh, qaala yaawaylataa a'ajaztu an akoona mithla haadhal-ghuraabi fa'uwaariya saw'ata akhee, fa'asbaha minan-naadimeen
map.5:32: Min ajli dhaalika katabnaa 'alaa banee israa'eela annahoo man qatala nafsam bighayri nafsin aw fasaadin fil-ardi faka'annamaa qatalan-naasa jamee'aa, waman ahyaahaa faka'annamaa ahyan-naasa jamee'aa, walaqad jaa'athum rusulunaa bil-bayyinaati thumma inna katheeram minhum ba'da dhaalika fil-ardi lamusrifoon
map.5:33: Innamaa jazaa'ul-ladheena yuhaariboonallaaha warasoolahoo wayas'awna fil-ardi fasaadan ay yuqattaloo aw yusallaboo aw tuqatta'a aydeehim wa'arjuluhum min khilaafin aw yunfaw minal-ard, dhaalika lahum khizyun fid-dunyaa walahum fil-aakhirati 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.5:34: Illal-ladheena taaboo min qabli an taqdiroo 'alayhim, fa'lamoo annallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.5:35: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wabtaghoo ilayhil-waseelata wajaahidoo fee sabeelihee la'allakum tuflihoon
map.5:36: Innal-ladheena kafaroo law anna lahum maa fil-ardi jamee'aw wamithlahoo ma'ahoo liyaftadoo bihee min 'adhaabi yawmil-qiyaamati maa tuqubbila minhum, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.5:37: Yureedoona ay yakhrujoo minan-naari wamaa hum bikhaarijeena minhaa, walahum 'adhaabum muqeem
map.5:38: Was-saariqu was-saariqatu faqta'oo aydiyahumaa jazaa'am bimaa kasabaa nakaalam minallaah, wallaahu 'azeezun hakeem
map.5:39: Faman taaba mim ba'di zulmihee wa'aslaha fa'innallaaha yatoobu 'alayh, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.5:40: Alam ta'lam annallaaha lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yu'adhdhibu may yashaa'u wayaghfiru limay yashaa', wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.5:41: Yaa ayyuhar-rasoolu laa yahzunkal-ladheena yusaari'oona fil-kufri minal-ladheena qaaloo aamannaa bi'afwaahihim walam tu'min quloobuhum waminal-ladheena haadoo, sammaa'oona lil-kadhibi sammaa'oona liqawmin aakhareena lam ya'took, yuharrifoonal-kalima mim ba'di mawaadi'ih, yaqooloona in ooteetum haadhaa fakhudhoohu wa'il lam tu'tawhu fahdharoo, wamay yuridillaahu fitnatahoo falan tamlika lahoo minallaahi shay'aa, ulaa'ikal-ladheena lam yuridillaahu ay yutahhira quloobahum, lahum fid-dunyaa khizy, walahum fil-aakhirati 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.5:42: Sammaa'oona lil-kadhibi akkaaloona lis-suht, fa'in jaa'ooka fahkum baynahum aw a'rid 'anhum, wa'in tu'rid 'anhum falay yadurrooka shay'aa, wa'in hakamta fahkum baynahum bil-qist, innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
map.5:43: Wakayfa yuhakkimoonaka wa'indahumut-tawraatu feehaa hukmullaahi thumma yatawallawna mim ba'di dhaalik, wamaa ulaa'ika bil-mu'mineen
map.5:44: Innaa anzalnat-tawraata feehaa hudaw wanoor, yahkumu bihan-nabiyyoonal-ladheena aslamoo lilladheena haadoo war-rabbaaniyyoona wal-ahbaaru bimastuhfizoo min kitaabillaahi wakaanoo 'alayhi shuhadaa', falaa takhshawun-naasa wakhshawni walaa tashtaroo bi'aayaatee thamanan qaleelaa, wamal lam yahkum bimaa anzalallaahu fa'ulaa'ika humul-kaafiroon
map.5:45: Wakatabnaa 'alayhim feehaa annan-nafsa bin-nafsi wal-'ayna bil-'ayni wal-anfa bil-anfi wal-udhuna bil-udhuni was-sinna bis-sinni wal-jurooha qisaas, faman tasaddaqa bihee fahuwa kaffaaratul lah, wamal lam yahkum bimaa anzalallaahu fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.5:46: Waqaffaynaa 'alaa aathaarihim bi'eesabni maryama musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraah, wa'aataynaahul-injeela feehi hudaw wanooruw wamusaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi minat-tawraati wahudaw wamaw'izatal lil-muttaqeen
map.5:47: Walyahkum ahlul-injeeli bimaa anzalallaahu feeh, wamal lam yahkum bimaa anzalallaahu fa'ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
map.5:48: Wa'anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi minal-kitaabi wamuhayminan 'alayhi fahkum baynahum bimaa anzalallaahu walaa tattabi' ahwaa'ahum 'ammaa jaa'aka minal-haqq, likullin ja'alnaa minkum shir'ataw waminhaajaa, walaw shaa'allaahu laja'alakum ummataw waahidataw walaakil liyabluwakum fee maa aataakum fastabiqul-khayraat, ilallaahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
map.5:49: Wa'anihkum baynahum bimaa anzalallaahu walaa tattabi' ahwaa'ahum wahdharhum ay yaftinooka 'am ba'di maa anzalallaahu ilayk, fa'in tawallaw fa'lam annamaa yureedullaahu ay yuseebahum biba'di dhunoobihim, wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi lafaasiqoon
map.5:50: Afahukmal-jaahiliyyati yabghoon, waman ahsanu minallaahi hukmal liqawmiy yooqinoon
map.5:51: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-yahooda wan-nasaaraa awliyaa', ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'd, wamay yatawallahum minkum fa'innahoo minhum, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.5:52: Fataral-ladheena fee quloobihim maraduy yusaari'oona feehim yaqooloona nakhshaa an tuseebanaa daa'irah, fa'asallaahu ay ya'tiya bil-fathi aw amrim min 'indihee fayusbihoo 'alaa maa asarroo fee anfusihim naadimeen
map.5:53: Wayaqoolul-ladheena aamanoo ahaa'ulaa'il-ladheena aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim innahum lama'akum, habitat a'maaluhum fa'asbahoo khaasireen
map.5:54: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo may yartadda minkum 'an deenihee fasawfa ya'tillaahu biqawmiy yuhibbuhum wayuhibboonahoo adhillatin 'alal-mu'mineena a'izzatin 'alal-kaafireen, yujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi walaa yakhaafoona lawmata laa'im, dhaalika fadlullaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu waasi'un 'aleem
map.5:55: Innamaa waliyyukumullaahu warasooluhoo wal-ladheena aamanul-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum raaki'oon
map.5:56: Wamay yatawallallaaha warasoolahoo wal-ladheena aamanoo fa'inna hizballaahi humul-ghaaliboon
map.5:57: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhul-ladheenattakhadhoo deenakum huzuwaw wala'ibam minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablikum wal-kuffaara awliyaa', wattaqullaaha in kuntum mu'mineen
map.5:58: Wa'idhaa naadaytum ilas-salaatittakhadhoohaa huzuwaw wala'ibaa, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa ya'qiloon
map.5:59: Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi hal tanqimoona minnaa illaa an aamannaa billaahi wamaa unzila ilaynaa wamaa unzila min qablu wa'anna aktharakum faasiqoon
map.5:60: Qul hal unabbi'ukum bisharrim min dhaalika mathoobatan 'indallaah, mal la'anahullaahu waghadiba 'alayhi waja'ala minhumul-qiradata wal-khanaazeera wa'abadat-taaghoot, ulaa'ika sharrum makaanaw wa'adallu 'an sawaa'is-sabeel
map.5:61: Wa'idhaa jaa'ookum qaaloo aamannaa waqad dakhaloo bil-kufri wahum qad kharajoo bih, wallaahu a'lamu bimaa kaanoo yaktumoon
map.5:62: Wataraa katheeram minhum yusaari'oona fil-ithmi wal-'udwaani wa'aklihimus-suht, labi'sa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.5:63: Lawlaa yanhaahumur-rabbaaniyyoona wal-ahbaaru 'an qawlihimul-ithma wa'aklihimus-suht, labi'sa maa kaanoo yasna'oon
map.5:64: Waqaalatil-yahoodu yadullaahi maghloolah, ghullat aydeehim walu'inoo bimaa qaaloo, bal yadaahu mabsootataani yunfiqu kayfa yashaa', walayazeedanna katheeram minhum maa unzila ilayka mir rabbika tughyaanaw wakufraa, wa'alqaynaa baynahumul-'adaawata wal-baghdaa'a ilaa yawmil-qiyaamah, kullamaa awqadoo naaral lil-harbi atfa'ahallaahu wayas'awna fil-ardi fasaadaa, wallaahu laa yuhibbul-mufsideen
map.5:65: Walaw anna ahlal-kitaabi aamanoo wattaqaw lakaffarnaa 'anhum sayyi'aatihim wala'adkhalnaahum jannaatin-na'eem
map.5:66: Walaw annahum aqaamut-tawraata wal-injeela wamaa unzila ilayhim mir rabbihim la'akaloo min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim, minhum ummatum muqtasidah, wakatheerum minhum saa'a maa ya'maloon
map.5:67: Yaa ayyuhar-rasoolu balligh maa unzila ilayka mir rabbik, wa'il lam taf'al famaa ballaghta risaalatah, wallaahu ya'simuka minan-naas, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
map.5:68: Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi lastum 'alaa shay'in hattaa tuqeemut-tawraata wal-injeela wamaa unzila ilaykum mir rabbikum, walayazeedanna katheeram minhum maa unzila ilayka mir rabbika tughyaanaw wakufraa, falaa ta'sa 'alal-qawmil-kaafireen
map.5:69: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'oona wan-nasaaraa man aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa'amila saalihan falaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.5:70: Laqad akhadhnaa meethaaqa banee israa'eela wa'arsalnaa ilayhim rusulaa, kullamaa jaa'ahum rasoolum bimaa laa tahwaa anfusuhum fareeqan kadhdhaboo wafareeqay yaqtuloon
map.5:71: Wahasiboo allaa takoona fitnatun fa'amoo wasammoo thumma taaballaahu 'alayhim thumma 'amoo wasammoo katheerum minhum, wallaahu baseerum bimaa ya'maloon
map.5:72: Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha huwal-maseehubnu maryam, waqaalal-maseehu yaabanee israa'eela'budullaaha rabbee warabbakum, innahoo may yushrik billaahi faqad harramallaahu 'alayhil-jannata wama'waahun-naar, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min ansaar
map.5:73: Laqad kafaral-ladheena qaaloo innallaaha thaalithu thalaathah, wamaa min ilaahin illaa ilaahuw waahid, wa'il lam yantahoo 'ammaa yaqooloona layamassannal-ladheena kafaroo minhum 'adhaabun aleem
map.5:74: Afalaa yatooboona ilallaahi wayastaghfiroonah, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.5:75: Mal-maseehubnu maryama illaa rasool, qad khalat min qablihir-rusul, wa'ummuhoo siddeeqah, kaanaa ya'kulaanit-ta'aam, unzur kayfa nubayyinu lahumul-aayaati thummanzur annaa yu'fakoon
map.5:76: Qul ata'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yamliku lakum darraw walaa naf'aa, wallaahu huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.5:77: Qul yaa ahlal-kitaabi laa taghloo fee deenikum ghayral-haqqi walaa tattabi'oo ahwaa'a qawmin qad dalloo min qablu wa'adalloo katheeraw wadalloo 'an sawaa'is-sabeel
map.5:78: Lu'inal-ladheena kafaroo mim banee israa'eela 'alaa lisaani daawooda wa'eesabni maryam, dhaalika bimaa 'asaw wakaanoo ya'tadoon
map.5:79: Kaanoo laa yatanaahawna 'am munkarin fa'alooh, labi'sa maa kaanoo yaf'aloon
map.5:80: Taraa katheeram minhum yatawallawnal-ladheena kafaroo, labi'sa maa qaddamat lahum anfusuhum an sakhitallaahu 'alayhim wafil-'adhaabi hum khaalidoon
map.5:81: Walaw kaanoo yu'minoona billaahi wan-nabiyyi wamaa unzila ilayhi mattakhadhoohum awliyaa'a walaakinna katheeram minhum faasiqoon
map.5:82: Latajidanna ashaddan-naasi 'adaawatal lilladheena aamanul-yahooda wal-ladheena ashrakoo, walatajidanna aqrabahum mawaddatal lilladheena aamanul-ladheena qaaloo innaa nasaaraa, dhaalika bi'anna minhum qisseeseena waruhbaanaw wa'annahum laa yastakbiroon
map.5:83: Wa'idhaa sami'oo maa unzila ilar-rasooli taraa a'yunahum tafeedu minad-dam'i mimmaa 'arafoo minal-haqq, yaqooloona rabbanaa aamannaa faktubnaa ma'ash-shaahideen
map.5:84: Wamaa lanaa laa nu'minu billaahi wamaa jaa'anaa minal-haqqi wanatma'u ay yudkhilanaa rabbunaa ma'al-qawmis-saaliheen
map.5:85: Fa'athaabahumullaahu bimaa qaaloo jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wadhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
map.5:86: Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
map.5:87: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuharrimoo tayyibaati maa ahallallaahu lakum walaa ta'tadoo, innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mu'tadeen
map.5:88: Wakuloo mimmaa razaqakumullaahu halaalan tayyibaa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee antum bihee mu'minoon
map.5:89: Laa yu'aakhidhukumullaahu bil-laghwi fee aymaanikum walaakiy yu'aakhidhukum bimaa 'aqqattumul-aymaan, fakaffaaratuhoo it'aamu 'asharati masaakeena min awsati maa tut'imoona ahleekum aw kiswatuhum aw tahreeru raqabah, famal lam yajid fasiyaamu thalaathati ayyaam, dhaalika kaffaaratu aymaanikum idhaa halaftum, wahfazoo aymaanakum, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatihee la'allakum tashkuroon
map.5:90: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo innamal-khamru wal-maysiru wal-ansaabu wal-azlaamu rijsum min 'amalish-shaytaani fajtaniboohu la'allakum tuflihoon
map.5:91: Innamaa yureedush-shaytaanu ay yooqi'a baynakumul-'adaawata wal-baghdaa'a fil-khamri wal-maysiri wayasuddakum 'an dhikrillaahi wa'anis-salaati fahal antum muntahoon
map.5:92: Wa'atee'ullaaha wa'atee'ur-rasoola wahdharoo, fa'in tawallaytum fa'lamoo annamaa 'alaa rasoolinal-balaaghul-mubeen
map.5:93: Laysa 'alal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati junaahun feemaa ta'imoo idhaa mattaqaw wa'aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati thummattaqaw wa'aamanoo thummattaqaw wa'ahsanoo, wallaahu yuhibbul-muhsineen
map.5:94: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo layabluwannakumullaahu bishay'im minas-saydi tanaaluhoo aydeekum warimaahukum liya'lamallaahu may yakhaafuhoo bil-ghayb, famani'tadaa ba'da dhaalika falahoo 'adhaabun aleem
map.5:95: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa taqtulus-sayda wa'antum hurum, waman qatalahoo minkum muta'ammidan fajazaa'um mithlu maa qatala minan-na'ami yahkumu bihee dhawaa 'adlim minkum hadyam baalighal-ka'bati aw kaffaaratun ta'aamu masaakeena aw 'adlu dhaalika siyaamal liyadhooqa wabaala amrih, 'afallaahu 'ammaa salaf, waman 'aada fayantaqimullaahu minh, wallaahu 'azeezun dhuntiqaam
map.5:96: Uhilla lakum saydul-bahri wata'aamuhoo mataa'al lakum walis-sayyaarah, wahurrima 'alaykum saydul-barri maa dumtum hurumaa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
map.5:97: Ja'alallaahul-ka'batal-baytal-haraama qiyaamal lin-naasi wash-shahral-haraama wal-hadya wal-qalaa'id, dhaalika lita'lamoo annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wa'annallaaha bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.5:98: I'lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-'iqaabi wa'annallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.5:99: Maa 'alar-rasooli illal-balaagh, wallaahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
map.5:100: Qul laa yastawil-khabeethu wat-tayyibu walaw a'jabaka kathratul-khabeeth, fattaqullaaha yaa ulil-albaabi la'allakum tuflihoon
map.5:101: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tas'aloo 'an ashyaa'a in tubda lakum tasu'kum, wa'in tas'aloo 'anhaa heena yunazzalul-qur'aanu tubda lakum, 'afallaahu 'anhaa, wallaahu ghafoorun haleem
map.5:102: Qad sa'alahaa qawmum min qablikum thumma asbahoo bihaa kaafireen
map.5:103: Maa ja'alallaahu mim baheeratiw walaa saa'ibatiw walaa waseelatiw walaa haamiw walaakinnal-ladheena kafaroo yaftaroona 'alallaahil-kadhib, wa'aktharuhum laa ya'qiloon
map.5:104: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw ilaa maa anzalallaahu wa'ilar-rasooli qaaloo hasbunaa maa wajadnaa 'alayhi aabaa'anaa, awalaw kaana aabaa'uhum laa ya'lamoona shay'aw walaa yahtadoon
map.5:105: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo 'alaykum anfusakum, laa yadurrukum man dalla idhahtadaytum, ilallaahi marji'ukum jamee'an fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.5:106: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo shahaadatu baynikum idhaa hadara ahadakumul-mawtu heenal-wasiyyatithnaani dhawaa 'adlim minkum aw aakharaani min ghayrikum in antum darabtum fil-ardi fa'asaabatkum museebatul-mawt, tahbisoonahumaa mim ba'dis-salaati fayuqsimaani billaahi inirtabtum laa nashtaree bihee thamanaw walaw kaana dhaa qurbaa walaa naktumu shahaadatallaahi innaa idhal laminal-aathimeen
map.5:107: Fa'in 'uthira 'alaa annahumastahaqqaa ithman fa'aakharaani yaqoomaani maqaamahumaa minal-ladheenastahaqqa 'alayhimul-awlayaani fayuqsimaani billaahi lashahaadatunaa ahaqqu min shahaadatihimaa wama'tadaynaa, innaa idhal laminaz-zaalimeen
map.5:108: Dhaalika adnaa ay ya'too bish-shahaadati 'alaa wajhihaa aw yakhaafoo an turadda aymaanum ba'da aymaanihim, wattaqullaaha wasma'oo, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
map.5:109: Yawma yajma'ullaahur-rusula fayaqoolu maadhaa ujibtum, qaaloo laa 'ilma lanaa, innaka anta 'allaamul-ghuyoob
map.5:110: Idh qaalallaahu yaa'eesabna maryamadhkur ni'matee 'alayka wa'alaa waalidatik, idh ayyattuka biroohil-qudus, tukallimun-naasa fil-mahdi wakahlaa, wa'idh 'allamtukal-kitaaba wal-hikmata wat-tawraata wal-injeel, wa'idh takhluqu minat-teeni kahay'atit-tayri bi'idhnee fatanfukhu feehaa fatakoonu tayram bi'idhnee watubri'ul-akmaha wal-abrasa bi'idhnee, wa'idh tukhrijul-mawtaa bi'idhnee, wa'idh kafaftu banee israa'eela 'anka idh ji'tahum bil-bayyinaati faqaalal-ladheena kafaroo minhum in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
map.5:111: Wa'idh awhaytu ilal-hawaariyyeena an aaminoo bee wabirasoolee, qaaloo aamannaa washhad bi'annanaa muslimoon
map.5:112: Idh qaalal-hawaariyyoona yaa'eesabna maryama hal yastatee'u rabbuka ay yunazzila 'alaynaa maa'idatam minas-samaa', qaalattaqullaaha in kuntum mu'mineen
map.5:113: Qaaloo nureedu an na'kula minhaa watatma'inna quloobunaa wana'lama an qad sadaqtanaa wanakoona 'alayhaa minash-shaahideen
map.5:114: Qaala 'eesabnu maryamallaahumma rabbanaa anzil 'alaynaa maa'idatam minas-samaa'i takoonu lanaa 'eedal li'awwalinaa wa'aakhirinaa wa'aayatam minka warzuqnaa wa'anta khayrur-raaziqeen
map.5:115: Qaalallaahu innee munazziluhaa 'alaykum, famay yakfur ba'du minkum fa'innee u'adhdhibuhoo 'adhaabal laa u'adhdhibuhoo ahadam minal-'aalameen
map.5:116: Wa'idh qaalallaahu yaa'eesabna maryama a'anta qulta lin-naasittakhidhoonee wa'ummiya ilaahayni min doonillaah, qaala subhaanaka maa yakoonu lee an aqoola maa laysa lee bihaqq, in kuntu qultuhoo faqad 'alimtah, ta'lamu maa fee nafsee walaa a'lamu maa fee nafsik, innaka anta 'allaamul-ghuyoob
map.5:117: Maa qultu lahum illaa maa amartanee bihee ani'budullaaha rabbee warabbakum, wakuntu 'alayhim shaheedam maa dumtu feehim, falammaa tawaffaytanee kunta antar-raqeeba 'alayhim, wa'anta 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
map.5:118: In tu'adhdhibhum fa'innahum 'ibaaduk, wa'in taghfir lahum fa'innaka antal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.5:119: Qaalallaahu haadhaa yawmu yanfa'us-saadiqeena sidquhum, lahum jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, radiyallaahu 'anhum waradoo 'anh, dhaalikal-fawzul-'azeem
map.5:120: Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa feehinn, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.6:1: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda waja'alaz-zulumaati wan-noor, thummal-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim ya'diloon
map.6:2: Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min teenin thumma qadaa ajalaa, wa'ajalum musamman 'indahoo thumma antum tamtaroon
map.6:3: Wahuwallaahu fis-samaawaati wafil-ard, ya'lamu sirrakum wajahrakum waya'lamu maa taksiboon
map.6:4: Wamaa ta'teehim min aayatim min aayaati rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
map.6:5: Faqad kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum, fasawfa ya'teehim ambaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.6:6: Alam yaraw kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnim makkannaahum fil-ardi maa lam numakkil lakum wa'arsalnas-samaa'a 'alayhim midraaraa, waja'alnal-anhaara tajree min tahtihim fa'ahlaknaahum bidhunoobihim wa'ansha'naa mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen
map.6:7: Walaw nazzalnaa 'alayka kitaaban fee qirtaasin falamasoohu bi'aydeehim laqaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
map.6:8: Waqaaloo lawlaa unzila 'alayhi malak, walaw anzalnaa malakal laqudiyal-amru thumma laa yunzaroon
map.6:9: Walaw ja'alnaahu malakal laja'alnaahu rajulaw walalabasnaa 'alayhim maa yalbisoon
map.6:10: Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fahaaqa bil-ladheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.6:11: Qul seeroo fil-ardi thummanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
map.6:12: Qul limam maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, qul lillaah, kataba 'alaa nafsihir-rahmah, layajma'annakum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feeh, alladheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
map.6:13: Walahoo maa sakana fil-layli wan-nahaar, wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.6:14: Qul aghayrallaahi attakhidhu waliyyan faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi wahuwa yut'imu walaa yut'am, qul innee umirtu an akoona awwala man aslama walaa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
map.6:15: Qul innee akhaafu in 'asaytu rabbee 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
map.6:16: May yusraf 'anhu yawma'idhin faqad rahimah, wadhaalikal-fawzul-mubeen
map.6:17: Wa'iy yamsaskallaahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahoo illaa huw, wa'iy yamsaska bikhayrin fahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.6:19: Qul ayyu shay'in akbaru shahaadah, qulillaah, shaheedum baynee wabaynakum, wa'oohiya ilayya haadhal-qur'aanu li'undhirakum bihee wamam balagh, a'innakum latashhadoona anna ma'allaahi aalihatan ukhraa, qul laa ashhad, qul innamaa huwa ilaahuw waahiduw wa'innanee baree'um mimmaa tushrikoon
map.6:20: Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya'rifoonahoo kamaa ya'rifoona abnaa'ahum, alladheena khasiroo anfusahum fahum laa yu'minoon
map.6:21: Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi'aayaatih, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
map.6:22: Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'an thumma naqoolu lilladheena ashrakoo ayna shurakaa'ukumul-ladheena kuntum taz'umoon
map.6:23: Thumma lam takun fitnatuhum illaa an qaaloo wallaahi rabbinaa maa kunnaa mushrikeen
map.6:24: Unzur kayfa kadhaboo 'alaa anfusihim wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.6:25: Waminhum may yastami'u ilayk, waja'alnaa 'alaa quloobihim akinnatan ay yafqahoohu wafee aadhaanihim waqraa, wa'iy yaraw kulla aayatil laa yu'minoo bihaa, hattaa idhaa jaa'ooka yujaadiloonaka yaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
map.6:26: Wahum yanhawna 'anhu wayan'awna 'anh, wa'iy yuhlikoona illaa anfusahum wamaa yash'uroon
map.6:27: Walaw taraa idh wuqifoo 'alan-naari faqaaloo yaalaytanaa nuraddu walaa nukadhdhiba bi'aayaati rabbinaa wanakoona minal-mu'mineen
map.6:28: Bal badaa lahum maa kaanoo yukhfoona min qabl, walaw ruddoo la'aadoo limaa nuhoo 'anhu wa'innahum lakaadhiboon
map.6:29: Waqaaloo in hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
map.6:30: Walaw taraa idh wuqifoo 'alaa rabbihim, qaala alaysa haadhaa bil-haqq, qaaloo balaa warabbinaa, qaala fadhooqul-'adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
map.6:31: Qad khasiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo biliqaa'illaah, hattaa idhaa jaa'athumus-saa'atu baghtatan qaaloo yaahasratanaa 'alaa maa farratnaa feehaa wahum yahmiloona awzaarahum 'alaa zuhoorihim, alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
map.6:32: Wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa la'ibuw walahw, walad-daarul-aakhiratu khayrul lilladheena yattaqoon, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.6:33: Qad na'lamu innahoo layahzunukal-ladhee yaqooloona fa'innahum laa yukadhdhiboonaka walaakinnaz-zaalimeena bi'aayaatillaahi yajhadoon
map.6:34: Walaqad kudhdhibat rusulum min qablika fasabaroo 'alaa maa kudhdhiboo wa'oodhoo hattaa ataahum nasrunaa, walaa mubaddila likalimaatillaah, walaqad jaa'aka min naba'il-mursaleen
map.6:35: Wa'in kaana kabura 'alayka i'raaduhum fa'inistata'ta an tabtaghiya nafaqan fil-ardi aw sullaman fis-samaa'i fata'tiyahum bi'aayah, walaw shaa'allaahu lajama'ahum 'alal-hudaa falaa takoonanna minal-jaahileen
map.6:36: Innamaa yastajeebul-ladheena yasma'oon, wal-mawtaa yab'athuhumullaahu thumma ilayhi yurja'oon
map.6:37: Waqaaloo lawlaa nuzzila 'alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, qul innallaaha qaadirun 'alaa ay yunazzila aayataw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.6:38: Wamaa min daabbatin fil-ardi walaa taa'iriy yateeru bijanaahayhi illaa umamun amthaalukum, maa farratnaa fil-kitaabi min shay'in thumma ilaa rabbihim yuhsharoon
map.6:39: Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa summuw wabukmun fiz-zulumaat, may yasha'illaahu yudlilhu wamay yasha' yaj'alhu 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.6:40: Qul ara'aytakum in ataakum 'adhaabullaahi aw atatkumus-saa'atu aghayrallaahi tad'oon, in kuntum saadiqeen
map.6:41: Bal iyyaahu tad'oona fayakshifu maa tad'oona ilayhi in shaa'a watansawna maa tushrikoon
map.6:42: Walaqad arsalnaa ilaa umamim min qablika fa'akhadhnaahum bil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i la'allahum yatadarra'oon
map.6:43: Falawlaa idh jaa'ahum ba'sunaa tadarra'oo walaakin qasat quloobuhum wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.6:44: Falammaa nasoo maa dhukkiroo bihee fatahnaa 'alayhim abwaaba kulli shay', hattaa idhaa farihoo bimaa ootoo akhadhnaahum baghtatan fa'idhaa hum mublisoon
map.6:45: Faquti'a daabirul-qawmil-ladheena zalamoo, wal-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.6:46: Qul ara'aytum in akhadhallaahu sam'akum wa'absaarakum wakhatama 'alaa quloobikum man ilaahun ghayrullaahi ya'teekum bih, unzur kayfa nusarriful-aayaati thumma hum yasdifoon
map.6:47: Qul ara'aytakum in ataakum 'adhaabullaahi baghtatan aw jahratan hal yuhlaku illal-qawmuz-zaalimoon
map.6:48: Wamaa nursilul-mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wamundhireen, faman aamana wa'aslaha falaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.6:49: Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa yamassuhumul-'adhaabu bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
map.6:50: Qul laa aqoolu lakum 'indee khazaa'inullaahi walaa a'lamul-ghayba walaa aqoolu lakum innee malak, in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaa ilayy, qul hal yastawil-a'maa wal-baseer, afalaa tatafakkaroon
map.6:51: Wa'andhir bihil-ladheena yakhaafoona ay yuhsharoo ilaa rabbihim laysa lahum min doonihee waliyyuw walaa shafee'ul la'allahum yattaqoon
map.6:52: Walaa tatrudil-ladheena yad'oona rabbahum bil-ghadaati wal-'ashiyyi yureedoona wajhah, maa 'alayka min hisaabihim min shay'iw wamaa min hisaabika 'alayhim min shay'in fatatrudahum fatakoona minaz-zaalimeen
map.6:53: Wakadhaalika fatannaa ba'dahum biba'dil liyaqooloo ahaa'ulaa'i mannallaahu 'alayhim mim bayninaa, alaysallaahu bi'a'lama bish-shaakireen
map.6:54: Wa'idhaa jaa'akal-ladheena yu'minoona bi'aayaatinaa faqul salaamun 'alaykum kataba rabbukum 'alaa nafsihir-rahmata annahoo man 'amila minkum soo'am bijahaalatin thumma taaba mim ba'dihee wa'aslaha fa'annahoo ghafoorur raheem
map.6:56: Qul innee nuheetu an a'budal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaah, qul laa attabi'u ahwaa'akum qad dalaltu idhaw wamaa ana minal-muhtadeen
map.6:57: Qul innee 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee wakadhdhabtum bih, maa 'indee maa tasta'jiloona bih, inil-hukmu illaa lillaah, yaqussul-haqqa wahuwa khayrul-faasileen
map.6:58: Qul law anna 'indee maa tasta'jiloona bihee laqudiyal-amru baynee wabaynakum, wallaahu a'lamu biz-zaalimeen
map.6:59: Wa'indahoo mafaatihul-ghaybi laa ya'lamuhaa illaa huw, waya'lamu maa fil-barri wal-bahr, wamaa tasqutu miw waraqatin illaa ya'lamuhaa walaa habbatin fee zulumaatil-ardi walaa ratbiw walaa yaabisin illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
map.6:60: Wahuwal-ladhee yatawaffaakum bil-layli waya'lamu maa jarahtum bin-nahaari thumma yab'athukum feehi liyuqdaa ajalum musammaa, thumma ilayhi marji'ukum thumma yunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.6:61: Wahuwal-qaahiru fawqa 'ibaadihee wayursilu 'alaykum hafazah, hattaa idhaa jaa'a ahadakumul-mawtu tawaffathu rusulunaa wahum laa yufarritoon
map.6:62: Thumma ruddoo ilallaahi mawlaahumul-haqq, alaa lahul-hukmu wahuwa asra'ul-haasibeen
map.6:63: Qul may yunajjeekum min zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri tad'oonahoo tadarru'aw wakhufyah, la'in anjaanaa min haadhihee lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
map.6:64: Qulillaahu yunajjeekum minhaa wamin kulli karbin thumma antum tushrikoon
map.6:65: Qul huwal-qaadiru 'alaa ay yab'atha 'alaykum 'adhaabam min fawqikum aw min tahti arjulikum aw yalbisakum shiya'aw wayudheeqa ba'dakum ba'sa ba'd, unzur kayfa nusarriful-aayaati la'allahum yafqahoon
map.6:66: Wakadhdhaba bihee qawmuka wahuwal-haqq, qul lastu 'alaykum biwakeel
map.6:68: Wa'idhaa ra'aytal-ladheena yakhoodoona fee aayaatinaa fa'a'rid 'anhum hattaa yakhoodoo fee hadeethin ghayrih, wa'immaa yunsiyannakash-shaytaanu falaa taq'ud ba'dadh-dhikraa ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.6:69: Wamaa 'alal-ladheena yattaqoona min hisaabihim min shay'iw walaakin dhikraa la'allahum yattaqoon
map.6:70: Wadharil-ladheenattakhadhoo deenahum la'ibaw walahwaw wagharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa wadhakkir bihee an tubsala nafsum bimaa kasabat, laysa lahaa min doonillaahi waliyyuw walaa shafee', wa'in ta'dil kulla 'adlil laa yu'khadh minhaa, ulaa'ikal-ladheena ubsiloo bimaa kasaboo lahum sharaabum min hameemiw wa'adhaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
map.6:71: Qul anad'oo min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'unaa walaa yadurrunaa wanuraddu 'alaa a'qaabinaa ba'da idh hadaanallaahu kal-ladhistahwathush-shayaateenu fil-ardi hayraana lahoo ashaabuy yad'oonahoo ilal-huda'tinaa, qul inna hudallaahi huwal-hudaa, wa'umirnaa linuslima lirabbil-'aalameen
map.6:72: Wa'an aqeemus-salaata wattaqooh, wahuwal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
map.6:73: Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, wayawma yaqoolu kun fayakoon, qawluhul-haqq, walahul-mulku yawma yunfakhu fis-soor, 'aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadati wahuwal-hakeemul-khabeer
map.6:74: Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu li'abeehi aazara atattakhidhu asnaaman aalihah, innee araaka waqawmaka fee dalaalim mubeen
map.6:75: Wakadhaalika nuree ibraaheema malakootas-samaawaati wal-ardi waliyakoona minal-mooqineen
map.6:76: Falammaa janna 'alayhil-laylu ra'aa kawkabaa, qaala haadhaa rabbee, falammaa afala qaala laa uhibbul-aafileen
map.6:77: Falammaa ra'al-qamara baazighan qaala haadhaa rabbee, falammaa afala qaala la'il lam yahdinee rabbee la'akoonanna minal-qawmid-daalleen
map.6:78: Falammaa ra'ash-shamsa baazighatan qaala haadhaa rabbee haadhaa akbar, falammaa afalat qaala yaaqawmi innee baree'um mimmaa tushrikoon
map.6:79: Innee wajjahtu wajhiya lilladhee fataras-samaawaati wal-arda haneefaw wamaa ana minal-mushrikeen
map.6:80: Wahaajjahoo qawmuh, qaala atuhaajjoonnee fillaahi waqad hadaan, walaa akhaafu maa tushrikoona bihee illaa ay yashaa'a rabbee shay'aa, wasi'a rabbee kulla shay'in 'ilmaa, afalaa tatadhakkaroon
map.6:81: Wakayfa akhaafu maa ashraktum walaa takhaafoona annakum ashraktum billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee 'alaykum sultaanaa, fa'ayyul-fareeqayni ahaqqu bil-amn, in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.6:82: Alladheena aamanoo walam yalbisoo eemaanahum bizulmin ulaa'ika lahumul-amnu wahum muhtadoon
map.6:83: Watilka hujjatunaa aataynaahaa ibraaheema 'alaa qawmih, narfa'u darajaatim man nashaa', inna rabbaka hakeemun 'aleem
map.6:84: Wawahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya'qoob, kullan hadaynaa wanoohan hadaynaa min qablu wamin dhurriyyatihee daawooda wasulaymaana wa'ayyooba wayoosufa wamoosaa wahaaroon, wakadhaalika najzil-muhsineen
map.6:85: Wazakariyyaa wayahyaa wa'eesaa wa'ilyaas, kullum minas-saaliheen
map.6:86: Wa'ismaa'eela wal-yasa'a wayoonusa walootaa, wakullan faddalnaa 'alal-'aalameen
map.6:87: Wamin aabaa'ihim wadhurriyyaatihim wa'ikhwaanihim, wajtabaynaahum wahadaynaahum ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.6:88: Dhaalika hudallaahi yahdee bihee may yashaa'u min 'ibaadih, walaw ashrakoo lahabita 'anhum maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.6:89: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwah, fa'iy yakfur bihaa haa'ulaa'i faqad wakkalnaa bihaa qawmal laysoo bihaa bikaafireen
map.6:90: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena hadallaahu fabihudaahumuqtadih, qul laa as'alukum 'alayhi ajraa, in huwa illaa dhikraa lil-'aalameen
map.6:91: Wamaa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrihee idh qaaloo maa anzalallaahu 'alaa basharim min shay', qul man anzalal-kitaabal-ladhee jaa'a bihee moosaa nooraw wahudal lin-naasi taj'aloonahoo qaraateesa tubdoonahaa watukhfoona katheeraa, wa'ullimtum maa lam ta'lamoo antum walaa aabaa'ukum, qulillaahu thumma dharhum fee khawdihim yal'aboon
map.6:92: Wahaadhaa kitaabun anzalnaahu mubaarakum musaddiqul-ladhee bayna yadayhi walitundhira ummal-quraa waman hawlahaa, wal-ladheena yu'minoona bil-aakhirati yu'minoona bihee wahum 'alaa salaatihim yuhaafizoon
map.6:93: Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban aw qaala oohiya ilayya walam yooha ilayhi shay'uw waman qaala sa'unzilu mithla maa anzalallaah, walaw taraa idhiz-zaalimoona fee ghamaraatil-mawti wal-malaa'ikatu baasitoo aydeehim, akhrijoo anfusakum, al-yawma tujzawna 'adhaabal-hooni bimaa kuntum taqooloona 'alallaahi ghayral-haqqi wakuntum 'an aayaatihee tastakbiroon
map.6:94: Walaqad ji'tumoonaa furaadaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awwala marratiw wataraktum maa khawwalnaakum waraa'a zuhoorikum, wamaa naraa ma'akum shufa'aa'akumul-ladheena za'amtum annahum feekum shurakaa', laqat taqatta'a baynakum wadalla 'ankum maa kuntum taz'umoon
map.6:95: Innallaaha faaliqul-habbi wan-nawaa, yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wamukhrijul-mayyiti minal-hayy, dhaalikumullaahu fa'annaa tu'fakoon
map.6:96: Faaliqul-isbaah, waja'alal-layla sakanaw wash-shamsa wal-qamara husbaanaa, dhaalika taqdeerul-'azeezil-'aleem
map.6:97: Wahuwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumun-nujooma litahtadoo bihaa fee zulumaatil-barri wal-bahr, qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.6:98: Wahuwal-ladhee ansha'akum min nafsiw waahidatin famustaqarruw wamustawda', qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmiy yafqahoon
map.6:99: Wahuwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'aa, fa'akhrajnaa bihee nabaata kulli shay'in fa'akhrajnaa minhu khadiran nukhriju minhu habbam mutaraakibaa, waminan-nakhli min tal'ihaa qinwaanun daaniyatuw wajannaatim min a'naabiw waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mushtabihaw waghayra mutashaabih, unzuroo ilaa thamarihee idhaa athmara wayan'ih, inna fee dhaalikum la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.6:100: Waja'aloo lillaahi shurakaa'al-jinna wakhalaqahum wakharaqoo lahoo baneena wabanaatim bighayri 'ilm, subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yasifoon
map.6:101: Badee'us-samaawaati wal-ard, annaa yakoonu lahoo waladuw walam takul lahoo saahibah, wakhalaqa kulla shay', wahuwa bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.6:102: Dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum, laa ilaaha illaa huw, khaaliqu kulli shay'in fa'budooh, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'iw wakeel
map.6:104: Qad jaa'akum basaa'iru mir rabbikum, faman absara falinafsih, waman 'amiya fa'alayhaa, wamaa ana 'alaykum bihafeez
map.6:105: Wakadhaalika nusarriful-aayaati waliyaqooloo darasta walinubayyinahoo liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.6:106: Ittabi' maa oohiya ilayka mir rabbik, laa ilaaha illaa huw, wa'a'rid 'anil-mushrikeen
map.6:107: Walaw shaa'allaahu maa ashrakoo, wamaa ja'alnaaka 'alayhim hafeezaa, wamaa anta 'alayhim biwakeel
map.6:108: Walaa tasubbul-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi fayasubbullaaha 'adwam bighayri 'ilm, kadhaalika zayyannaa likulli ummatin 'amalahum, thumma ilaa rabbihim marji'uhum fayunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.6:109: Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim la'in jaa'athum aayatul layu'minunna bihaa, qul innamal-aayaatu 'indallaahi wamaa yush'irukum annahaa idhaa jaa'at laa yu'minoon
map.6:110: Wanuqallibu af'idatahum wa'absaarahum kamaa lam yu'minoo bihee awwala marratiw wanadharuhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
map.6:111: Walaw annanaa nazzalnaa ilayhimul-malaa'ikata wakallamahumul-mawtaa wahasharnaa 'alayhim kulla shay'in qubulam maa kaanoo liyu'minoo illaa ay yashaa'allaahu walaakinna aktharahum yajhaloon
map.6:112: Wakadhaalika ja'alnaa likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwan shayaateenal-insi wal-jinni yoohee ba'duhum ilaa ba'din zukhrufal-qawli ghurooraa, walaw shaa'a rabbuka maa fa'aloohu fadharhum wamaa yaftaroon
map.6:113: Walitasghaa ilayhi af'idatul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati waliyardawhu waliyaqtarifoo maa hum muqtarifoon
map.6:114: Afaghayrallaahi abtaghee hakamaw wahuwal-ladhee anzala ilaykumul-kitaaba mufassalaa, wal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba ya'lamoona annahoo munazzalum mir rabbika bil-haqqi falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
map.6:115: Watammat kalimatu rabbika sidqaw wa'adlaa, laa mubaddila likalimaatih, wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.6:116: Wa'in tuti' akthara man fil-ardi yudillooka 'an sabeelillaah, iy yattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa'in hum illaa yakhrusoon
map.6:117: Inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu may yadillu 'an sabeelih, wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
map.6:118: Fakuloo mimmaa dhukirasmullaahi 'alayhi in kuntum bi'aayaatihee mu'mineen
map.6:119: Wamaa lakum allaa ta'kuloo mimmaa dhukirasmullaahi 'alayhi waqad fassala lakum maa harrama 'alaykum illaa madturirtum ilayh, wa'inna katheeral layudilloona bi'ahwaa'ihim bighayri 'ilm, inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu bil-mu'tadeen
map.6:120: Wadharoo zaahiral-ithmi wabaatinah, innal-ladheena yaksiboonal-ithma sayujzawna bimaa kaanoo yaqtarifoon
map.6:121: Walaa ta'kuloo mimmaa lam yudhkarismullaahi 'alayhi wa'innahoo lafisq, wa'innash-shayaateena layoohoona ilaa awliyaa'ihim liyujaadilookum, wa'in ata'tumoohum innakum lamushrikoon
map.6:122: Awaman kaana maytan fa'ahyaynaahu waja'alnaa lahoo nooray yamshee bihee fin-naasi kamam mathaluhoo fiz-zulumaati laysa bikhaarijim minhaa, kadhaalika zuyyina lil-kaafireena maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.6:123: Wakadhaalika ja'alnaa fee kulli qaryatin akaabira mujrimeehaa liyamkuroo feehaa, wamaa yamkuroona illaa bi'anfusihim wamaa yash'uroon
map.6:124: Wa'idhaa jaa'athum aayatun qaaloo lan nu'mina hattaa nu'taa mithla maa ootiya rusulullaah, allaahu a'lamu haythu yaj'alu risaalatah, sayuseebul-ladheena ajramoo saghaarun 'indallaahi wa'adhaabun shadeedum bimaa kaanoo yamkuroon
map.6:125: Famay yuridillaahu ay yahdiyahoo yashrah sadrahoo lil-islaam, wamay yurid ay yudillahoo yaj'al sadrahoo dayyiqan harajan ka'annamaa yassa''adu fis-samaa', kadhaalika yaj'alullaahur-rijsa 'alal-ladheena laa yu'minoon
map.6:126: Wahaadhaa siraatu rabbika mustaqeemaa, qad fassalnal-aayaati liqawmiy yadhdhakkaroon
map.6:127: Lahum daarus-salaami 'inda rabbihim wahuwa waliyyuhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.6:128: Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'aa, yaama'sharal-jinni qadistakthartum minal-ins, waqaala awliyaa'uhum minal-insi rabbanastamta'a ba'dunaa biba'diw wabalaghnaa ajalanal-ladhee ajjalta lanaa, qaalan-naaru mathwaakum khaalideena feehaa illaa maa shaa'allaah, inna rabbaka hakeemun 'aleem
map.6:129: Wakadhaalika nuwallee ba'daz-zaalimeena ba'dam bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.6:130: Yaama'sharal-jinni wal-insi alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yaqussoona 'alaykum aayaatee wayundhiroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa, qaaloo shahidnaa 'alaa anfusinaa wagharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa washahidoo 'alaa anfusihim annahum kaanoo kaafireen
map.6:131: Dhaalika al lam yakur rabbuka muhlikal-quraa bizulmiw wa'ahluhaa ghaafiloon
map.6:132: Walikullin darajaatum mimmaa 'amiloo, wamaa rabbuka bighaafilin 'ammaa ya'maloon
map.6:133: Warabbukal-ghaniyyu dhur-rahmah, iy yasha' yudhhibkum wayastakhlif mim ba'dikum maa yashaa'u kamaa ansha'akum min dhurriyyati qawmin aakhareen
map.6:134: Inna maa too'adoona la'aatiw wamaa antum bimu'jizeen
map.6:135: Qul yaaqawmi'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamil, fasawfa ta'lamoona man takoonu lahoo 'aaqibatud-daar, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
map.6:136: Waja'aloo lillaahi mimmaa dhara'a minal-harthi wal-an'aami naseeban faqaaloo haadhaa lillaahi biza'mihim wahaadhaa lishurakaa'inaa, famaa kaana lishurakaa'ihim falaa yasilu ilallaah, wamaa kaana lillaahi fahuwa yasilu ilaa shurakaa'ihim, saa'a maa yahkumoon
map.6:137: Wakadhaalika zayyana likatheerim minal-mushrikeena qatla awlaadihim shurakaa'uhum liyurdoohum waliyalbisoo 'alayhim deenahum, walaw shaa'allaahu maa fa'aloohu fadharhum wamaa yaftaroon
map.6:138: Waqaaloo haadhihee an'aamuw waharthun hijrul laa yat'amuhaa illaa man nashaa'u biza'mihim wa'an'aamun hurrimat zuhooruhaa wa'an'aamul laa yadhkuroonasmallaahi 'alayhaftiraa'an 'alayh, sayajzeehim bimaa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.6:139: Waqaaloo maa fee butooni haadhihil-an'aami khaalisatul lidhukoorinaa wamuharramun 'alaa azwaajinaa, wa'iy yakum maytatan fahum feehi shurakaa', sayajzeehim wasfahum, innahoo hakeemun 'aleem
map.6:140: Qad khasiral-ladheena qataloo awlaadahum safaham bighayri 'ilmiw waharramoo maa razaqahumullaahuftiraa'an 'alallaah, qad dalloo wamaa kaanoo muhtadeen
map.6:141: Wahuwal-ladhee ansha'a jannaatim ma'rooshaatiw waghayra ma'rooshaatiw wan-nakhla waz-zar'a mukhtalifan ukuluhoo waz-zaytoona war-rummaana mutashaabihaw waghayra mutashaabih, kuloo min thamarihee idhaa athmara wa'aatoo haqqahoo yawma hasaadih, walaa tusrifoo, innahoo laa yuhibbul-musrifeen
map.6:142: Waminal-an'aami hamoolataw wafarshaa, kuloo mimmaa razaqakumullaahu walaa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
map.6:143: Thamaaniyata azwaaj, minad-da'nithnayni waminal-ma'zithnayn, qul aadh-dhakarayni harrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat 'alayhi arhaamul-unthayayn, nabbi'oonee bi'ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen
map.6:144: Waminal-ibilithnayni waminal-baqarithnayn, qul aadh-dhakarayni harrama amil-unthayayni ammashtamalat 'alayhi arhaamul-unthayayn, am kuntum shuhadaa'a idh wassaakumullaahu bihaadhaa, faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhibal liyudillan-naasa bighayri 'ilm, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.6:145: Qul laa ajidu fee maa oohiya ilayya muharraman 'alaa taa'imiy yat'amuhoo illaa ay yakoona maytatan aw damam masfoohan aw lahma khinzeerin fa'innahoo rijsun aw fisqan uhilla lighayrillaahi bih, famanidturra ghayra baaghiw walaa 'aadin fa'inna rabbaka ghafoorur raheem
map.6:146: Wa'alal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa kulla dhee zufur, waminal-baqari wal-ghanami harramnaa 'alayhim shuhoomahumaa illaa maa hamalat zuhooruhumaa awil-hawaayaa aw makhtalata bi'azm, dhaalika jazaynaahum bibaghyihim, wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
map.6:147: Fa'in kadhdhabooka faqur rabbukum dhoo rahmatiw waasi'ah, walaa yuraddu ba'suhoo 'anil-qawmil-mujrimeen
map.6:148: Sayaqoolul-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'allaahu maa ashraknaa walaa aabaa'unaa walaa harramnaa min shay', kadhaalika kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim hattaa dhaaqoo ba'sanaa, qul hal 'indakum min 'ilmin fatukhrijoohu lanaa, in tattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa'in antum illaa takhrusoon
map.6:149: Qul falillaahil-hujjatul-baalighah, falaw shaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een
map.6:150: Qul halumma shuhadaa'akumul-ladheena yashhadoona annallaaha harrama haadhaa, fa'in shahidoo falaa tashhad ma'ahum, walaa tattabi' ahwaa'al-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati wahum birabbihim ya'diloon
map.6:151: Qul ta'aalaw atlu maa harrama rabbukum 'alaykum allaa tushrikoo bihee shay'aw wabil-waalidayni ihsaanaa, walaa taqtuloo awlaadakum min imlaaq, nahnu narzuqukum wa'iyyaahum, walaa taqrabul-fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batan, walaa taqtulun-nafsal-latee harramallaahu illaa bil-haqq, dhaalikum wassaakum bihee la'allakum ta'qiloon
map.6:152: Walaa taqraboo maalal-yateemi illaa bil-latee hiya ahsanu hattaa yablugha ashuddah, wa'awful-kayla wal-meezaana bil-qist, laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa, wa'idhaa qultum fa'diloo walaw kaana dhaa qurbaa, wabi'ahdillaahi awfoo, dhaalikum wassaakum bihee la'allakum tadhakkaroon
map.6:153: Wa'anna haadhaa siraatee mustaqeeman fattabi'ooh, walaa tattabi'us-subula fatafarraqa bikum 'an sabeelih, dhaalikum wassaakum bihee la'allakum tattaqoon
map.6:154: Thumma aataynaa moosal-kitaaba tamaaman 'alal-ladhee ahsana watafseelal likulli shay'iw wahudaw warahmatal la'allahum biliqaa'i rabbihim yu'minoon
map.6:155: Wahaadhaa kitaabun anzalnaahu mubaarakun fattabi'oohu wattaqoo la'allakum turhamoon
map.6:156: An taqooloo innamaa unzilal-kitaabu 'alaa taa'ifatayni min qablinaa, wa'in kunnaa 'an diraasatihim laghaafileen
map.6:157: Aw taqooloo law annaa unzila 'alaynal-kitaabu lakunnaa ahdaa minhum, faqad jaa'akum bayyinatum mir rabbikum wahudaw warahmah, faman azlamu mimman kadhdhaba bi'aayaatillaahi wasadafa 'anhaa, sanajzil-ladheena yasdifoona 'an aayaatinaa soo'al-'adhaabi bimaa kaanoo yasdifoon
map.6:158: Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya rabbuka aw ya'tiya ba'du aayaati rabbik, yawma ya'tee ba'du aayaati rabbika laa yanfa'u nafsan eemaanuhaa lam takun aamanat min qablu aw kasabat fee eemaanihaa khayraa, qulintaziroo innaa muntaziroon
map.6:159: Innal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wakaanoo shiya'al lasta minhum fee shay', innamaa amruhum ilallaahi thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa kaanoo yaf'aloon
map.6:160: Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahoo 'ashru amthaalihaa, waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.6:161: Qul innanee hadaanee rabbee ilaa siraatim mustaqeem, deenan qiyamam millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
map.6:162: Qul inna salaatee wanusukee wamahyaaya wamamaatee lillaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.6:163: Laa shareeka lah, wabidhaalika umirtu wa'ana awwalul-muslimeen
map.6:164: Qul aghayrallaahi abghee rabbaw wahuwa rabbu kulli shay', walaa taksibu kullu nafsin illaa 'alayhaa, walaa taziru waaziratuw wizra ukhraa, thumma ilaa rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
map.6:165: Wahuwal-ladhee ja'alakum khalaa'ifal-ardi warafa'a ba'dakum fawqa ba'din darajaatil liyabluwakum fee maa aataakum, inna rabbaka saree'ul-'iqaab, wa'innahoo laghafoorur raheem
map.7:2: Kitaabun unzila ilayka falaa yakun fee sadrika harajum minhu litundhira bihee wadhikraa lil-mu'mineen
map.7:3: Ittabi'oo maa unzila ilaykum mir rabbikum walaa tattabi'oo min doonihee awliyaa', qaleelam maa tadhakkaroon
map.7:4: Wakam min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa fajaa'ahaa ba'sunaa bayaatan aw hum qaa'iloon
map.7:5: Famaa kaana da'waahum idh jaa'ahum ba'sunaa illaa an qaaloo innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
map.7:8: Wal-waznu yawma'idhinil-haqq, faman thaqulat mawaazeenuhoo fa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.7:9: Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhoo fa'ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum bimaa kaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yazlimoon
map.7:10: Walaqad makkannaakum fil-ardi waja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayish, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
map.7:11: Walaqad khalaqnaakum thumma sawwarnaakum thumma qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa iblees, lam yakum minas-saajideen
map.7:12: Qaala maa mana'aka allaa tasjuda idh amartuk, qaala ana khayrum minh, khalaqtanee min naariw wakhalaqtahoo min teen
map.7:13: Qaala fahbit minhaa famaa yakoonu laka an tatakabbara feehaa fakhruj innaka minas-saaghireen
map.7:16: Qaala fabimaa aghwaytanee la'aq'udanna lahum siraatakal-mustaqeem
map.7:17: Thumma la'aatiyannahum mim bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim wa'an aymaanihim wa'an shamaa'ilihim, walaa tajidu aktharahum shaakireen
map.7:18: Qaalakhruj minhaa madh'oomam madhooraa, laman tabi'aka minhum la'amla'anna jahannama minkum ajma'een
map.7:19: Wayaa'aadamuskun anta wazawjukal-jannata fakulaa min haythu shi'tumaa walaa taqrabaa haadhihish-shajarata fatakoonaa minaz-zaalimeen
map.7:20: Fawaswasa lahumash-shaytaanu liyubdiya lahumaa maa wooriya 'anhumaa min saw'aatihimaa waqaala maa nahaakumaa rabbukumaa 'an haadhihish-shajarati illaa an takoonaa malakayni aw takoonaa minal-khaalideen
map.7:22: Fadallaahumaa bighuroor, falammaa dhaaqash-shajarata badat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa watafiqaa yakhsifaani 'alayhimaa miw waraqil-jannah, wanaadaahumaa rabbuhumaa alam anhakumaa 'an tilkumash-shajarati wa'aqul lakumaa innash-shaytaana lakumaa 'aduwwum mubeen
map.7:23: Qaalaa rabbanaa zalamnaa anfusanaa wa'il lam taghfir lanaa watarhamnaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen
map.7:24: Qaalahbitoo ba'dukum liba'din 'aduww, walakum fil-ardi mustaqarruw wamataa'un ilaa heen
map.7:25: Qaala feehaa tahyawna wafeehaa tamootoona waminhaa tukhrajoon
map.7:26: Yaabanee aadama qad anzalnaa 'alaykum libaasay yuwaaree saw'aatikum wareeshaa, walibaasut-taqwaa dhaalika khayr, dhaalika min aayaatillaahi la'allahum yadhdhakkaroon
map.7:27: Yaabanee aadama laa yaftinannakumush-shaytaanu kamaa akhraja abawaykum minal-jannati yanzi'u 'anhumaa libaasahumaa liyuriyahumaa saw'aatihimaa, innahoo yaraakum huwa waqabeeluhoo min haythu laa tarawnahum, innaa ja'alnash-shayaateena awliyaa'a lilladheena laa yu'minoon
map.7:28: Wa'idhaa fa'aloo faahishatan qaaloo wajadnaa 'alayhaa aabaa'anaa wallaahu amaranaa bihaa, qul innallaaha laa ya'muru bil-fahshaa', ataqooloona 'alallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.7:29: Qul amara rabbee bil-qist, wa'aqeemoo wujoohakum 'inda kulli masjidiw wad'oohu mukhliseena lahud-deen, kamaa bada'akum ta'oodoon
map.7:30: Fareeqan hadaa wafareeqan haqqa 'alayhimud-dalaalah, innahumuttakhadhush-shayaateena awliyaa'a min doonillaahi wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoon
map.7:31: Yaabanee aadama khudhoo zeenatakum 'inda kulli masjidiw wakuloo washraboo walaa tusrifoo, innahoo laa yuhibbul-musrifeen
map.7:32: Qul man harrama zeenatallaahil-latee akhraja li'ibaadihee wat-tayyibaati minar-rizq, qul hiya lilladheena aamanoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa khaalisatay yawmal-qiyaamah, kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.7:33: Qul innamaa harrama rabbiyal-fawaahisha maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana wal-ithma wal-baghya bighayril-haqqi wa'an tushrikoo billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaanaw wa'an taqooloo 'alallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.7:34: Walikulli ummatin ajal, fa'idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum laa yasta'khiroona saa'ataw walaa yastaqdimoon
map.7:35: Yaabanee aadama immaa ya'tiyannakum rusulum minkum yaqussoona 'alaykum aayaatee famanittaqaa wa'aslaha falaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.7:36: Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wastakbaroo 'anhaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.7:37: Faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi'aayaatih, ulaa'ika yanaaluhum naseebuhum minal-kitaab, hattaa idhaa jaa'athum rusulunaa yatawaffawnahum qaaloo ayna maa kuntum tad'oona min doonillaah, qaaloo dalloo 'annaa washahidoo 'alaa anfusihim annahum kaanoo kaafireen
map.7:38: Qaaladkhuloo fee umamin qad khalat min qablikum minal-jinni wal-insi fin-naari kullamaa dakhalat ummatul la'anat ukhtahaa, hattaa idhaddaarakoo feehaa jamee'an qaalat ukhraahum li'oolaahum rabbanaa haa'ulaa'i adalloonaa fa'aatihim 'adhaaban di'fam minan-naar, qaala likullin di'fuw walaakil laa ta'lamoon
map.7:39: Waqaalat oolaahum li'ukhraahum famaa kaana lakum 'alaynaa min fadlin fadhooqul-'adhaaba bimaa kuntum taksiboon
map.7:40: Innal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wastakbaroo 'anhaa laa tufattahu lahum abwaabus-samaa'i walaa yadkhuloonal-jannata hattaa yalijal-jamalu fee sammil-khiyaat, wakadhaalika najzil-mujrimeen
map.7:41: Lahum min jahannama mihaaduw wamin fawqihim ghawaash, wakadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
map.7:42: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati laa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannah, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.7:43: Wanaza'naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin tajree min tahtihimul-anhaar, waqaalul-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee hadaanaa lihaadhaa, wamaa kunnaa linahtadiya lawlaa an hadaanallaah, laqad jaa'at rusulu rabbinaa bil-haqq, wanoodoo an tilkumul-jannatu oorithtumoohaa bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.7:44: Wanaadaa ashaabul-jannati ashaaban-naari an qad wajadnaa maa wa'adanaa rabbunaa haqqan fahal wajattum maa wa'ada rabbukum haqqaa, qaaloo na'am, fa'adhdhana mu'adhdhinum baynahum al la'natullaahi 'alaz-zaalimeen
map.7:45: Alladheena yasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwajaa, wahum bil-aakhirati kaafiroon
map.7:46: Wabaynahumaa hijaab, wa'alal-a'raafi rijaaluy ya'rifoona kullam biseemaahum, wanaadaw ashaabal-jannati an salaamun 'alaykum, lam yadkhuloohaa wahum yatma'oon
map.7:47: Wa'idhaa surifat absaaruhum tilqaa'a ashaabin-naari qaaloo rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.7:48: Wanaadaa ashaabul-a'raafi rijaalay ya'rifoonahum biseemaahum qaaloo maa aghnaa 'ankum jam'ukum wamaa kuntum tastakbiroon
map.7:49: Ahaa'ulaa'il-ladheena aqsamtum laa yanaaluhumullaahu birahmah, udkhulul-jannata laa khawfun 'alaykum walaa antum tahzanoon
map.7:50: Wanaadaa ashaabun-naari ashaabal-jannati an afeedoo 'alaynaa minal-maa'i aw mimmaa razaqakumullaah, qaaloo innallaaha harramahumaa 'alal-kaafireen
map.7:51: Al-ladheenattakhadhoo deenahum lahwaw wala'ibaw wagharrathumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, fal-yawma nansaahum kamaa nasoo liqaa'a yawmihim haadhaa wamaa kaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yajhadoon
map.7:52: Walaqad ji'naahum bikitaabin fassalnaahu 'alaa 'ilmin hudaw warahmatal liqawmiy yu'minoon
