map.7:53: Hal yanzuroona illaa ta'weelah, yawma ya'tee ta'weeluhoo yaqoolul-ladheena nasoohu min qablu qad jaa'at rusulu rabbinaa bil-haqq, fahal lanaa min shufa'aa'a fayashfa'oo lanaa aw nuraddu fana'mala ghayral-ladhee kunnaa na'mal, qad khasiroo anfusahum wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.7:54: Inna rabbakumullaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arsh, yughshil-laylan-nahaara yatlubuhoo hatheethaw wash-shamsa wal-qamara wan-nujooma musakhkharaatim bi'amrihee alaa lahul-khalqu wal-amr, tabaarakallaahu rabbul-'aalameen
map.7:55: Ud'oo rabbakum tadarru'aw wakhufyah, innahoo laa yuhibbul-mu'tadeen
map.7:56: Walaa tufsidoo fil-ardi ba'da islaahihaa wad'oohu khawfaw watama'aa, inna rahmatallaahi qareebum minal-muhsineen
map.7:57: Wahuwal-ladhee yursilur-riyaaha bushram bayna yaday rahmatih, hattaa idhaa aqallat sahaaban thiqaalan suqnaahu libaladim mayyitin fa'anzalnaa bihil-maa'a fa'akhrajnaa bihee min kullith-thamaraat, kadhaalika nukhrijul-mawtaa la'allakum tadhakkaroon
map.7:58: Wal-baladut-tayyibu yakhruju nabaatuhoo bi'idhni rabbih, wal-ladhee khabutha laa yakhruju illaa nakidaa, kadhaalika nusarriful-aayaati liqawmiy yashkuroon
map.7:59: Laqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, innee akhaafu 'alaykum 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
map.7:60: Qaalal-mala'u min qawmihee innaa lanaraaka fee dalaalim mubeen
map.7:61: Qaala yaaqawmi laysa bee dalaalatuw walaakinnee rasoolum mir rabbil-'aalameen
map.7:62: Uballighukum risaalaati rabbee wa'ansahu lakum wa'a'lamu minallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.7:63: Awa'ajibtum an jaa'akum dhikrum mir rabbikum 'alaa rajulim minkum liyundhirakum walitattaqoo wala'allakum turhamoon
map.7:64: Fakadhdhaboohu fa'anjaynaahu wal-ladheena ma'ahoo fil-fulki wa'aghraqnal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, innahum kaanoo qawman 'ameen
map.7:65: Wa'ilaa 'aadin akhaahum hoodaa, qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, afalaa tattaqoon
map.7:66: Qaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihee innaa lanaraaka fee safaahatiw wa'innaa lanazunnuka minal-kaadhibeen
map.7:67: Qaala yaaqawmi laysa bee safaahatuw walaakinnee rasoolum mir rabbil-'aalameen
map.7:68: Uballighukum risaalaati rabbee wa'ana lakum naasihun ameen
map.7:69: Awa'ajibtum an jaa'akum dhikrum mir rabbikum 'alaa rajulim minkum liyundhirakum, wadhkuroo idh ja'alakum khulafaa'a mim ba'di qawmi noohiw wazaadakum fil-khalqi bastah, fadhkuroo aalaa'allaahi la'allakum tuflihoon
map.7:70: Qaaloo aji'tanaa lina'budallaaha wahdahoo wanadhara maa kaana ya'budu aabaa'unaa, fa'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.7:71: Qaala qad waqa'a 'alaykum mir rabbikum rijsuw waghadab, atujaadiloonanee fee asmaa'in sammaytumoohaa antum wa'aabaa'ukum maa nazzalallaahu bihaa min sultaan, fantaziroo innee ma'akum minal-muntazireen
map.7:72: Fa'anjaynaahu wal-ladheena ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa waqata'naa daabiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wamaa kaanoo mu'mineen
map.7:73: Wa'ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihaa, qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, qad jaa'atkum bayyinatum mir rabbikum, haadhihee naaqatullaahi lakum aayatan fadharoohaa ta'kul fee ardillaahi walaa tamassoohaa bisoo'in faya'khudhakum 'adhaabun aleem
map.7:74: Wadhkuroo idh ja'alakum khulafaa'a mim ba'di 'aadiw wabawwa'akum fil-ardi tattakhidhoona min suhoolihaa qusooraw watanhitoonal-jibaala buyootaa, fadhkuroo aalaa'allaahi walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
map.7:75: Qaalal-mala'ul-ladheenastakbaroo min qawmihee lilladheenastud'ifoo liman aamana minhum ata'lamoona anna saaliham mursalum mir rabbih, qaaloo innaa bimaa ursila bihee mu'minoon
map.7:76: Qaalal-ladheenastakbaroo innaa bil-ladhee aamantum bihee kaafiroon
map.7:77: Fa'aqarun-naaqata wa'ataw 'an amri rabbihim waqaaloo yaasaalihu'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minal-mursaleen
map.7:79: Fatawallaa 'anhum waqaala yaaqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risaalata rabbee wanasahtu lakum walaakil laa tuhibboonan-naasiheen
map.7:80: Walootan idh qaala liqawmihee ata'toonal-faahishata maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadim minal-'aalameen
map.7:81: Innakum lata'toonar-rijaala shahwatam min doonin-nisaa', bal antum qawmum musrifoon
map.7:82: Wamaa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaaloo akhrijoohum min qaryatikum, innahum unaasuy yatatahharoon
map.7:85: Wa'ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'aybaa, qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, qad jaa'atkum bayyinatum mir rabbikum fa'awful-kayla wal-meezaana walaa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum walaa tufsidoo fil-ardi ba'da islaahihaa, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
map.7:86: Walaa taq'udoo bikulli siraatin too'idoona watasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi man aamana bihee watabghoonahaa 'iwajaa, wadhkuroo idh kuntum qaleelan fakaththarakum, wanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mufsideen
map.7:87: Wa'in kaana taa'ifatum minkum aamanoo bil-ladhee ursiltu bihee wataa'ifatul lam yu'minoo fasbiroo hattaa yahkumallaahu baynanaa, wahuwa khayrul-haakimeen
map.7:88: Qaalal-mala'ul-ladheenastakbaroo min qawmihee lanukhrijannaka yaashu'aybu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'aka min qaryatinaa aw lata'oodunna fee millatinaa, qaala awalaw kunnaa kaariheen
map.7:89: Qadiftaraynaa 'alallaahi kadhiban in 'udnaa fee millatikum ba'da idh najjaanallaahu minhaa, wamaa yakoonu lanaa an na'ooda feehaa illaa ay yashaa'allaahu rabbunaa, wasi'a rabbunaa kulla shay'in 'ilmaa, 'alallaahi tawakkalnaa, rabbanaftah baynanaa wabayna qawminaa bil-haqqi wa'anta khayrul-faatiheen
map.7:90: Waqaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihee la'inittaba'tum shu'ayban innakum idhal lakhaasiroon
map.7:92: Al-ladheena kadhdhaboo shu'ayban ka'al lam yaghnaw feehaa, alladheena kadhdhaboo shu'ayban kaanoo humul-khaasireen
map.7:93: Fatawallaa 'anhum waqaala yaaqawmi laqad ablaghtukum risaalaati rabbee wanasahtu lakum, fakayfa aasaa 'alaa qawmin kaafireen
map.7:94: Wamaa arsalnaa fee qaryatim min nabiyyin illaa akhadhnaa ahlahaa bil-ba'saa'i wad-darraa'i la'allahum yaddarra'oon
map.7:95: Thumma baddalnaa makaanas-sayyi'atil-hasanata hattaa 'afaw waqaaloo qad massa aabaa'anad-darraa'u was-sarraa'u fa'akhadhnaahum baghtataw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.7:96: Walaw anna ahlal-quraa aamanoo wattaqaw lafatahnaa 'alayhim barakaatim minas-samaa'i wal-ardi walaakin kadhdhaboo fa'akhadhnaahum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.7:97: Afa'amina ahlul-quraa ay ya'tiyahum ba'sunaa bayaataw wahum naa'imoon
map.7:98: Awa'amina ahlul-quraa ay ya'tiyahum ba'sunaa duhaw wahum yal'aboon
map.7:99: Afa'aminoo makrallaah, falaa ya'manu makrallaahi illal-qawmul-khaasiroon
map.7:100: Awalam yahdi lilladheena yarithoonal-arda mim ba'di ahlihaa al law nashaa'u asabnaahum bidhunoobihim, wanatba'u 'alaa quloobihim fahum laa yasma'oon
map.7:101: Tilkal-quraa naqussu 'alayka min ambaa'ihaa, walaqad jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaat, famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kadhdhaboo min qabl, kadhaalika yatba'ullaahu 'alaa quloobil-kaafireen
map.7:102: Wamaa wajadnaa li'aktharihim min 'ahd, wa'iw wajadnaa aktharahum lafaasiqeen
map.7:103: Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim moosaa bi'aayaatinaa ilaa fir'awna wamala'ihee fazalamoo bihaa, fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mufsideen
map.7:104: Waqaala moosaa yaafir'awnu innee rasoolum mir rabbil-'aalameen
map.7:105: Haqeequn 'alaa al laa aqoola 'alallaahi illal-haqq, qad ji'tukum bibayyinatim mir rabbikum fa'arsil ma'iya banee israa'eel
map.7:106: Qaala in kunta ji'ta bi'aayatin fa'ti bihaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.7:108: Wanaza'a yadahoo fa'idhaa hiya baydaa'u lin-naazireen
map.7:109: Qaalal-mala'u min qawmi fir'awna inna haadhaa lasaahirun 'aleem
map.7:110: Yureedu ay yukhrijakum min ardikum, famaadhaa ta'muroon
map.7:111: Qaaloo arjih wa'akhaahu wa'arsil fil-madaa'ini haashireen
map.7:113: Wajaa'as-saharatu fir'awna qaaloo inna lanaa la'ajran in kunnaa nahnul-ghaalibeen
map.7:115: Qaaloo yaamoosaa immaa an tulqiya wa'immaa an nakoona nahnul-mulqeen
map.7:116: Qaala alqoo, falammaa alqaw saharoo a'yunan-naasi wastarhaboohum wajaa'oo bisihrin 'azeem
map.7:117: Wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an alqi 'asaak, fa'idhaa hiya talqafu maa ya'fikoon
map.7:123: Qaala fir'awnu aamantum bihee qabla an aadhana lakum, inna haadhaa lamakrum makartumoohu fil-madeenati litukhrijoo minhaa ahlahaa, fasawfa ta'lamoon
map.7:124: La'uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa'arjulakum min khilaafin thumma la'usallibannakum ajma'een
map.7:126: Wamaa tanqimu minnaa illaa an aamannaa bi'aayaati rabbinaa lammaa jaa'atnaa, rabbanaa afrigh 'alaynaa sabraw watawaffanaa muslimeen
map.7:127: Waqaalal-mala'u min qawmi fir'awna atadharu moosaa waqawmahoo liyufsidoo fil-ardi wayadharaka wa'aalihatak, qaala sanuqattilu abnaa'ahum wanastahyee nisaa'ahum, wa'innaa fawqahum qaahiroon
map.7:128: Qaala moosaa liqawmihista'eenoo billaahi wasbiroo, innal-arda lillaah, yoorithuhaa may yashaa'u min 'ibaadih, wal-'aaqibatu lil-muttaqeen
map.7:129: Qaaloo oodheenaa min qabli an ta'tiyanaa wamim ba'di maa ji'tanaa, qaala 'asaa rabbukum ay yuhlika 'aduwwakum wayastakhlifakum fil-ardi fayanzura kayfa ta'maloon
map.7:130: Walaqad akhadhnaa aala fir'awna bis-sineena wanaqsim minath-thamaraati la'allahum yadhdhakkaroon
map.7:131: Fa'idhaa jaa'athumul-hasanatu qaaloo lanaa haadhih, wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atuy yattayyaroo bimoosaa wamam ma'ah, alaa innamaa taa'iruhum 'indallaahi walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.7:132: Waqaaloo mahmaa ta'tinaa bihee min aayatil litasharanaa bihaa famaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
map.7:133: Fa'arsalnaa 'alayhimut-toofaana wal-jaraada wal-qummala wad-dafaadi'a wad-dama aayaatim mufassalaat, fastakbaroo wakaanoo qawmam mujrimeen
map.7:134: Walammaa waqa'a 'alayhimur-rijzu qaaloo yaamoosad'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indak, la'in kashafta 'annar-rijza lanu'minanna laka walanursilanna ma'aka banee israa'eel
map.7:135: Falammaa kashafnaa 'anhumur-rijza ilaa ajalin hum baalighoohu idhaa hum yankuthoon
map.7:136: Fantaqamnaa minhum fa'aghraqnaahum fil-yammi bi'annahum kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wakaanoo 'anhaa ghaafileen
map.7:137: Wa'awrathnal-qawmal-ladheena kaanoo yustad'afoona mashaariqal-ardi wamaghaaribahal-latee baaraknaa feehaa, watammat kalimatu rabbikal-husnaa 'alaa banee israa'eela bimaa sabaroo, wadammarnaa maa kaana yasna'u fir'awnu waqawmuhoo wamaa kaanoo ya'rishoon
map.7:138: Wajaawaznaa bibanee israa'eelal-bahra fa'ataw 'alaa qawmiy ya'kufoona 'alaa asnaamil lahum, qaaloo yaamoosaj'al lanaa ilaahan kamaa lahum aalihah, qaala innakum qawmun tajhaloon
map.7:139: Inna haa'ulaa'i mutabbarum maa hum feehi wabaatilum maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.7:140: Qaala aghayrallaahi abgheekum ilaahaw wahuwa faddalakum 'alal-'aalameen
map.7:141: Wa'idh anjaynaakum min aali fir'awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-'adhaab, yuqattiloona abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum, wafee dhaalikum balaa'um mir rabbikum 'azeem
map.7:142: Wawaa'adnaa moosaa thalaatheena laylataw wa'atmamnaahaa bi'ashrin fatamma meeqaatu rabbihee arba'eena laylah, waqaala moosaa li'akheehi haaroonakhlufnee fee qawmee wa'aslih walaa tattabi' sabeelal-mufsideen
map.7:143: Walammaa jaa'a moosaa limeeqaatinaa wakallamahoo rabbuhoo qaala rabbi arinee anzur ilayk, qaala lan taraanee walaakininzur ilal-jabali fa'inistaqarra makaanahoo fasawfa taraanee, falammaa tajallaa rabbuhoo lil-jabali ja'alahoo dakkaw wakharra moosaa sa'iqaa, falammaa afaaqa qaala subhaanaka tubtu ilayka wa'ana awwalul-mu'mineen
map.7:144: Qaala yaamoosaa innistafaytuka 'alan-naasi birisaalaatee wabikalaamee, fakhudh maa aataytuka wakum minash-shaakireen
map.7:145: Wakatabnaa lahoo fil-alwaahi min kulli shay'im maw'izataw watafseelal likulli shay', fakhudhhaa biquwwatiw wa'mur qawmaka ya'khudhoo bi'ahsanihaa, sa'ureekum daaral-faasiqeen
map.7:146: Sa'asrifu 'an aayaatiyal-ladheena yatakabbaroona fil-ardi bighayril-haqq, wa'iy yaraw kulla aayatil laa yu'minoo bihaa, wa'iy yaraw sabeelar-rushdi laa yattakhidhoohu sabeelaa, wa'iy yaraw sabeelal-ghayyi yattakhidhoohu sabeelaa, dhaalika bi'annahum kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wakaanoo 'anhaa ghaafileen
map.7:147: Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa waliqaa'il-aakhirati habitat a'maaluhum, hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.7:148: Wattakhadha qawmu moosaa mim ba'dihee min huliyyihim 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaar, alam yaraw annahoo laa yukallimuhum walaa yahdeehim sabeelaa, ittakhadhoohu wakaanoo zaalimeen
map.7:149: Walammaa suqita fee aydeehim wara'aw annahum qad dalloo qaaloo la'il lam yarhamnaa rabbunaa wayaghfir lanaa lanakoonanna minal-khaasireen
map.7:150: Walammaa raja'a moosaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifan qaala bi'samaa khalaftumoonee mim ba'dee, a'ajiltum amra rabbikum, wa'alqal-alwaaha wa'akhadha bira'si akheehi yajurruhoo ilayh, qaalabna umma innal-qawmastad'afoonee wakaadoo yaqtuloonanee, falaa tushmit biyal-a'daa'a walaa taj'alnee ma'al-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.7:151: Qaala rabbighfir lee wali'akhee wa'adkhilnaa fee rahmatik, wa'anta arhamur-raahimeen
map.7:152: Innal-ladheenattakhadhul-'ijla sayanaaluhum ghadabum mir rabbihim wadhillatun fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wakadhaalika najzil-muftareen
map.7:153: Wal-ladheena 'amilus-sayyi'aati thumma taaboo mim ba'dihaa wa'aamanoo inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoorur raheem
map.7:154: Walammaa sakata 'am moosal-ghadabu akhadhal-alwaah, wafee nuskhatihaa hudaw warahmatul lilladheena hum lirabbihim yarhaboon
map.7:155: Wakhtaara moosaa qawmahoo sab'eena rajulal limeeqaatinaa, falammaa akhadhathumur-rajfatu qaala rabbi law shi'ta ahlaktahum min qablu wa'iyyaay, atuhlikunaa bimaa fa'alas-sufahaa'u minnaa, in hiya illaa fitnatuk, tudillu bihaa man tashaa'u watahdee man tashaa', anta waliyyunaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa'anta khayrul-ghaafireen
map.7:156: Waktub lanaa fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanataw wafil-aakhirati innaa hudnaa ilayk, qaala 'adhaabee useebu bihee man ashaa', warahmatee wasi'at kulla shay', fasa'aktubuhaa lilladheena yattaqoona wayu'toonaz-zakaata wal-ladheena hum bi'aayaatinaa yu'minoon
map.7:157: Alladheena yattabi'oonar-rasoolan-nabiyyal-ummiyyal-ladhee yajidoonahoo maktooban 'indahum fit-tawraati wal-injeeli ya'muruhum bil-ma'roofi wayanhaahum 'anil-munkari wayuhillu lahumut-tayyibaati wayuharrimu 'alayhimul-khabaa'itha wayada'u 'anhum israhum wal-aghlaalal-latee kaanat 'alayhim, fal-ladheena aamanoo bihee wa'azzaroohu wanasaroohu wattaba'un-nooral-ladhee unzila ma'ahoo ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.7:158: Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu innee rasoolullaahi ilaykum jamee'anil-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wayumeet, fa'aaminoo billaahi warasoolihin-nabiyyil-ummiyyil-ladhee yu'minu billaahi wakalimaatihee wattabi'oohu la'allakum tahtadoon
map.7:159: Wamin qawmi moosaa ummatuy yahdoona bil-haqqi wabihee ya'diloon
map.7:160: Waqatta'naahumuthnatay 'ashrata asbaatan umamaa, wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa idhistasqaahu qawmuhoo anidrib bi'asaakal-hajar, fambajasat minhuthnataa 'ashrata 'aynaa, qad 'alima kullu unaasim mashrabahum, wazallalnaa 'alayhimul-ghamaama wa'anzalnaa 'alayhimul-manna was-salwaa, kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum, wamaa zalamoonaa walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.7:161: Wa'idh qeela lahumuskunoo haadhihil-qaryata wakuloo minhaa haythu shi'tum waqooloo hittatuw wadkhulul-baaba sujjadan naghfir lakum khatee'aatikum, sanazeedul-muhsineen
map.7:162: Fabaddalal-ladheena zalamoo minhum qawlan ghayral-ladhee qeela lahum fa'arsalnaa 'alayhim rijzam minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yazlimoon
map.7:163: Was'alhum 'anil-qaryatil-latee kaanat haadiratal-bahr, idh ya'doona fis-sabti idh ta'teehim heetaanuhum yawma sabtihim shurra'aw wayawma laa yasbitoona laa ta'teehim kadhaalik, nabloohum bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
map.7:164: Wa'idh qaalat ummatum minhum lima ta'izoona qawmanillaahu muhlikuhum aw mu'adhdhibuhum 'adhaaban shadeedaa, qaaloo ma'dhiratan ilaa rabbikum wala'allahum yattaqoon
map.7:165: Falammaa nasoo maa dhukkiroo bihee anjaynal-ladheena yanhawna 'anis-soo'i wa'akhadhnal-ladheena zalamoo bi'adhaabim ba'eesim bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
map.7:166: Falammaa 'ataw 'am maa nuhoo 'anhu qulnaa lahum koonoo qiradatan khaasi'een
map.7:167: Wa'idh ta'adhdhana rabbuka layab'athanna 'alayhim ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati may yasoomuhum soo'al-'adhaab, inna rabbaka lasaree'ul-'iqaab, wa'innahoo laghafoorur raheem
map.7:168: Waqatta'naahum fil-ardi umamaa, minhumus-saalihoona waminhum doona dhaalik, wabalawnaahum bil-hasanaati was-sayyi'aati la'allahum yarji'oon
map.7:169: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfuw warithul-kitaaba ya'khudhoona 'arada haadhal-adnaa wayaqooloona sayughfaru lanaa, wa'iy ya'tihim 'aradum mithluhoo ya'khudhooh, alam yu'khadh 'alayhim meethaaqul-kitaabi al laa yaqooloo 'alallaahi illal-haqqa wadarasoo maa feeh, wad-daarul-aakhiratu khayrul lilladheena yattaqoon, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.7:170: Wal-ladheena yumassikoona bil-kitaabi wa'aqaamus-salaah, innaa laa nudee'u ajral-musliheen
map.7:171: Wa'idh nataqnal-jabala fawqahum ka'annahoo zullatuw wazannoo annahoo waaqi'um bihim, khudhoo maa aataynaakum biquwwatiw wadhkuroo maa feehi la'allakum tattaqoon
map.7:172: Wa'idh akhadha rabbuka mim banee aadama min zuhoorihim dhurriyyatahum wa'ashhadahum 'alaa anfusihim, alastu birabbikum, qaaloo balaa shahidnaa, an taqooloo yawmal-qiyaamati innaa kunnaa 'an haadhaa ghaafileen
map.7:173: Aw taqooloo innamaa ashraka aabaa'unaa min qablu wakunnaa dhurriyyatam mim ba'dihim, afatuhlikunaa bimaa fa'alal-mubtiloon
map.7:175: Watlu 'alayhim naba'al-ladhee aataynaahu aayaatinaa fansalakha minhaa fa'atba'ahush-shaytaanu fakaana minal-ghaaween
map.7:176: Walaw shi'naa larafa'naahu bihaa walaakinnahoo akhlada ilal-ardi wattaba'a hawaah, famathaluhoo kamathalil-kalb, in tahmil 'alayhi yalhath aw tatrukhu yalhath, dhaalika mathalul-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, faqsusil-qasasa la'allahum yatafakkaroon
map.7:177: Saa'a mathalanil-qawmul-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa wa'anfusahum kaanoo yazlimoon
map.7:178: May yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtadee, wamay yudlil fa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.7:179: Walaqad dhara'naa lijahannama katheeram minal-jinni wal-ins, lahum quloobul laa yafqahoona bihaa, walahum a'yunul laa yubsiroona bihaa, walahum aadhaanul laa yasma'oona bihaa, ulaa'ika kal-an'aami bal hum adall, ulaa'ika humul-ghaafiloon
map.7:180: Walillaahil-asmaa'ul-husnaa fad'oohu bihaa, wadharul-ladheena yulhidoona fee asmaa'ih, sayujzawna maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.7:181: Wamimman khalaqnaa ummatuy yahdoona bil-haqqi wabihee ya'diloon
map.7:182: Wal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa sanastadrijuhum min haythu laa ya'lamoon
map.7:184: Awalam yatafakkaroo maa bisaahibihim min jinnah, in huwa illaa nadheerum mubeen
map.7:185: Awalam yanzuroo fee malakootis-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa khalaqallaahu min shay'iw wa'an 'asaa ay yakoona qadiqtaraba ajaluhum, fabi'ayyi hadeethim ba'dahoo yu'minoon
map.7:186: May yudlilillaahu falaa haadiya lah, wayadharuhum fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
map.7:187: Yas'aloonaka 'anis-saa'ati ayyaana mursaahaa, qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'inda rabbee, laa yujalleehaa liwaqtihaa illaa huw, thaqulat fis-samaawaati wal-ard, laa ta'teekum illaa baghtah, yas'aloonaka ka'annaka hafiyyun 'anhaa, qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'indallaahi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.7:188: Qul laa amliku linafsee naf'aw walaa darran illaa maa shaa'allaah, walaw kuntu a'lamul-ghayba lastakthartu minal-khayri wamaa massaniyas-soo', in ana illaa nadheeruw wabasheerul liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.7:189: Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min nafsiw waahidatiw waja'ala minhaa zawjahaa liyaskuna ilayhaa, falammaa taghashshaahaa hamalat hamlan khafeefan famarrat bih, falammaa athqalad da'awallaaha rabbahumaa la'in aataytanaa saalihal lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
map.7:190: Falammaa aataahumaa saalihan ja'alaa lahoo shurakaa'a feemaa aataahumaa, fata'aalallaahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.7:191: Ayushrikoona maa laa yakhluqu shay'aw wahum yukhlaqoon
map.7:192: Walaa yastatee'oona lahum nasraw walaa anfusahum yansuroon
map.7:193: Wa'in tad'oohum ilal-hudaa laa yattabi'ookum, sawaa'un 'alaykum ada'awtumoohum am antum saamitoon
map.7:194: Innal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi 'ibaadun amthaalukum fad'oohum falyastajeeboo lakum in kuntum saadiqeen
map.7:195: Alahum arjuluy yamshoona bihaa, am lahum aydiy yabtishoona bihaa, am lahum a'yunuy yubsiroona bihaa, am lahum aadhaanuy yasma'oona bihaa, qulid'oo shurakaa'akum thumma keedooni falaa tunziroon
map.7:197: Wal-ladheena tad'oona min doonihee laa yastatee'oona nasrakum walaa anfusahum yansuroon
map.7:198: Wa'in tad'oohum ilal-hudaa laa yasma'oo, wataraahum yanzuroona ilayka wahum laa yubsiroon
map.7:200: Wa'immaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazghun fasta'idh billaah, innahoo samee'un 'aleem
map.7:201: Innal-ladheenattaqaw idhaa massahum taa'ifum minash-shaytaani tadhakkaroo fa'idhaa hum mubsiroon
map.7:202: Wa'ikhwaanuhum yamuddoonahum fil-ghayyi thumma laa yuqsiroon
map.7:203: Wa'idhaa lam ta'tihim bi'aayatin qaaloo lawlajtabaytahaa, qul innamaa attabi'u maa yoohaa ilayya mir rabbee, haadhaa basaa'iru mir rabbikum wahudaw warahmatul liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.7:204: Wa'idhaa quri'al-qur'aanu fastami'oo lahoo wa'ansitoo la'allakum turhamoon
map.7:205: Wadhkur rabbaka fee nafsika tadarru'aw wakheefataw wadoonal-jahri minal-qawli bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaali walaa takum minal-ghaafileen
map.7:206: Innal-ladheena 'inda rabbika laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihee wayusabbihoonahoo walahoo yasjudoon
map.8:1: Yas'aloonaka 'anil-anfaal, qulil-anfaalu lillaahi war-rasool, fattaqullaaha wa'aslihoo dhaata baynikum, wa'atee'ullaaha warasoolahoo in kuntum mu'mineen
map.8:2: Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena idhaa dhukirallaahu wajilat quloobuhum wa'idhaa tuliyat 'alayhim aayaatuhoo zaadathum eemaanaw wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
map.8:4: Ulaa'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqaa, lahum darajaatun 'inda rabbihim wamaghfiratuw warizqun kareem
map.8:5: Kamaa akhrajaka rabbuka mim baytika bil-haqq, wa'inna fareeqam minal-mu'mineena lakaarihoon
map.8:6: Yujaadiloonaka fil-haqqi ba'da maa tabayyana ka'annamaa yusaaqoona ilal-mawti wahum yanzuroon
map.8:7: Wa'idh ya'idukumullaahu ihdat-taa'ifatayni annahaa lakum watawaddoona anna ghayra dhaatish-shawkati takoonu lakum wayureedullaahu ay yuhiqqal-haqqa bikalimaatihee wayaqta'a daabiral-kaafireen
map.8:9: Idh tastagheethoona rabbakum fastajaaba lakum annee mumiddukum bi'alfim minal-malaa'ikati murdifeen
map.8:10: Wamaa ja'alahullaahu illaa bushraa walitatma'inna bihee quloobukum, waman-nasru illaa min 'indillaah, innallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.8:11: Idh yughashsheekumun-nu'aasa amanatam minhu wayunazzilu 'alaykum minas-samaa'i maa'al liyutahhirakum bihee wayudhhiba 'ankum rijzash-shaytaani waliyarbita 'alaa quloobikum wayuthabbita bihil-aqdaam
map.8:12: Idh yoohee rabbuka ilal-malaa'ikati annee ma'akum fathabbitul-ladheena aamanoo, sa'ulqee fee quloobil-ladheena kafarur-ru'ba fadriboo fawqal-a'naaqi wadriboo minhum kulla banaan
map.8:13: Dhaalika bi'annahum shaaqqullaaha warasoolah, wamay yushaaqiqillaaha warasoolahoo fa'innallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.8:15: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa laqeetumul-ladheena kafaroo zahfan falaa tuwalloohumul-adbaar
map.8:16: Wamay yuwallihim yawma'idhin duburahoo illaa mutaharrifal liqitaalin aw mutahayyizan ilaa fi'atin faqad baa'a bighadabim minallaahi wama'waahu jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
map.8:17: Falam taqtuloohum walaakinnallaaha qatalahum, wamaa ramayta idh ramayta walaakinnallaaha ramaa, waliyubliyal-mu'mineena minhu balaa'an hasanaa, innallaaha samee'un 'aleem
map.8:19: In tastaftihoo faqad jaa'akumul-fath, wa'in tantahoo fahuwa khayrul lakum, wa'in ta'oodoo na'ud, walan tughniya 'ankum fi'atukum shay'aw walaw kathurat wa'annallaaha ma'al-mu'mineen
map.8:20: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee'ullaaha warasoolahoo walaa tawallaw 'anhu wa'antum tasma'oon
map.8:21: Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena qaaloo sami'naa wahum laa yasma'oon
map.8:23: Walaw 'alimallaahu feehim khayral la'asma'ahum, walaw asma'ahum latawallaw wahum mu'ridoon
map.8:24: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanustajeeboo lillaahi walir-rasooli idhaa da'aakum limaa yuhyeekum, wa'lamoo annallaaha yahoolu baynal-mar'i waqalbihee wa'annahoo ilayhi tuhsharoon
map.8:25: Wattaqoo fitnatal laa tuseebannal-ladheena zalamoo minkum khaassah, wa'lamoo annallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.8:26: Wadhkuroo idh antum qaleelum mustad'afoona fil-ardi takhaafoona ay yatakhattafakumun-naasu fa'aawaakum wa'ayyadakum binasrihee warazaqakum minat-tayyibaati la'allakum tashkuroon
map.8:27: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takhoonullaaha war-rasoola watakhoonoo amaanaatikum wa'antum ta'lamoon
map.8:28: Wa'lamoo annamaa amwaalukum wa'awlaadukum fitnatuw wa'annallaaha 'indahoo ajrun 'azeem
map.8:29: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tattaqullaaha yaj'al lakum furqaanaw wayukaffir 'ankum sayyi'aatikum wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu dhul-fadlil-'azeem
map.8:30: Wa'idh yamkuru bikal-ladheena kafaroo liyuthbitooka aw yaqtulooka aw yukhrijook, wayamkuroona wayamkurullaah, wallaahu khayrul-maakireen
map.8:31: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa qaaloo qad sami'naa law nashaa'u laqulnaa mithla haadhaa in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
map.8:32: Wa'idh qaalullaahumma in kaana haadhaa huwal-haqqa min 'indika fa'amtir 'alaynaa hijaaratam minas-samaa'i awi'tinaa bi'adhaabin aleem
map.8:33: Wamaa kaanallaahu liyu'adhdhibahum wa'anta feehim, wamaa kaanallaahu mu'adhdhibahum wahum yastaghfiroon
map.8:34: Wamaa lahum allaa yu'adhdhibahumullaahu wahum yasuddoona 'anil-masjidil-haraami wamaa kaanoo awliyaa'ah, in awliyaa'uhoo illal-muttaqoona walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.8:35: Wamaa kaana salaatuhum 'indal-bayti illaa mukaa'aw watasdiyah, fadhooqul-'adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
map.8:36: Innal-ladheena kafaroo yunfiqoona amwaalahum liyasuddoo 'an sabeelillaah, fasayunfiqoonahaa thumma takoonu 'alayhim hasratan thumma yughlaboon, wal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama yuhsharoon
map.8:37: Liyameezallaahul-khabeetha minat-tayyibi wayaj'alal-khabeetha ba'dahoo 'alaa ba'din fayarkumahoo jamee'an fayaj'alahoo fee jahannam, ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.8:38: Qul lilladheena kafaroo iy yantahoo yughfar lahum maa qad salaf, wa'iy ya'oodoo faqad madat sunnatul-awwaleen
map.8:39: Waqaatiloohum hattaa laa takoona fitnatuw wayakoonad-deenu kulluhoo lillaah, fa'inintahaw fa'innallaaha bimaa ya'maloona baseer
map.8:40: Wa'in tawallaw fa'lamoo annallaaha mawlaakum, ni'mal-mawlaa wani'man-naseer
map.8:41: Wa'lamoo annamaa ghanimtum min shay'in fa'anna lillaahi khumusahoo walir-rasooli walidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli in kuntum aamantum billaahi wamaa anzalnaa 'alaa 'abdinaa yawmal-furqaani yawmal-taqal-jam'aan, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.8:42: Idh antum bil-'udwatid-dunyaa wahum bil-'udwatil-quswaa war-rakbu asfala minkum, walaw tawaa'attum lakhtalaftum fil-mee'aadi walaakil liyaqdiyallaahu amran kaana maf'oolal liyahlika man halaka 'am bayyinatiw wayahyaa man hayya 'am bayyinah, wa'innallaaha lasamee'un 'aleem
map.8:43: Idh yureekahumullaahu fee manaamika qaleelaa, walaw araakahum katheeral lafashiltum walatanaaza'tum fil-amri walaakinnallaaha sallam, innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.8:44: Wa'idh yureekumoohum idhil-taqaytum fee a'yunikum qaleelaw wayuqallilukum fee a'yunihim liyaqdiyallaahu amran kaana maf'oolaa, wa'ilallaahi turja'ul-umoor
map.8:45: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa laqeetum fi'atan fathbutoo wadhkurullaaha katheeral la'allakum tuflihoon
map.8:46: Wa'atee'ullaaha warasoolahoo walaa tanaaza'oo fatafshaloo watadhhaba reehukum wasbiroo, innallaaha ma'as-saabireen
map.8:47: Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena kharajoo min diyaarihim bataraw wari'aa'an-naasi wayasuddoona 'an sabeelillaah, wallaahu bimaa ya'maloona muheet
map.8:48: Wa'idh zayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum waqaala laa ghaaliba lakumul-yawma minan-naasi wa'innee jaarul lakum, falammaa taraa'atil-fi'ataani nakasa 'alaa 'aqibayhi waqaala innee baree'um minkum innee araa maa laa tarawna innee akhaafullaah, wallaahu shadeedul-'iqaab
map.8:49: Idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun gharra haa'ulaa'i deenuhum, wamay yatawakkal 'alallaahi fa'innallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.8:50: Walaw taraa idh yatawaffal-ladheena kafarul-malaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa'adbaarahum, wadhooqoo 'adhaabal-hareeq
map.8:51: Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat aydeekum wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil-'abeed
map.8:52: Kada'bi aali fir'awna wal-ladheena min qablihim, kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi fa'akhadhahumullaahu bidhunoobihim, innallaaha qawiyyun shadeedul-'iqaab
map.8:53: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha lam yaku mughayyiran ni'matan an'amahaa 'alaa qawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi'anfusihim wa'annallaaha samee'un 'aleem
map.8:54: Kada'bi aali fir'awna wal-ladheena min qablihim, kadhdhaboo bi'aayaati rabbihim fa'ahlaknaahum bidhunoobihim wa'aghraqnaa aala fir'awn, wakullun kaanoo zaalimeen
map.8:55: Inna sharrad-dawaabbi 'indallaahil-ladheena kafaroo fahum laa yu'minoon
map.8:56: Al-ladheena 'aahatta minhum thumma yanqudoona 'ahdahum fee kulli marratiw wahum laa yattaqoon
map.8:57: Fa'immaa tathqafannahum fil-harbi fasharrid bihim man khalfahum la'allahum yadhdhakkaroon
map.8:58: Wa'immaa takhaafanna min qawmin khiyaanatan fambidh ilayhim 'alaa sawaa', innallaaha laa yuhibbul-khaa'ineen
map.8:59: Walaa yahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo sabaqoo, innahum laa yu'jizoon
map.8:60: Wa'a'iddoo lahum mastata'tum min quwwatiw wamir ribaatil-khayli turhiboona bihee 'aduwwallaahi wa'aduwwakum wa'aakhareena min doonihim, laa ta'lamoonahum, allaahu ya'lamuhum, wamaa tunfiqoo min shay'in fee sabeelillaahi yuwaffa ilaykum wa'antum laa tuzlamoon
map.8:61: Wa'in janahoo lis-salmi fajnah lahaa watawakkal 'alallaah, innahoo huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.8:62: Wa'iy yureedoo ay yakhda'ooka fa'inna hasbakallaah, huwal-ladhee ayyadaka binasrihee wabil-mu'mineen
map.8:63: Wa'allafa bayna quloobihim, law anfaqta maa fil-ardi jamee'am maa allafta bayna quloobihim walaakinnallaaha allafa baynahum, innahoo 'azeezun hakeem
map.8:65: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu harridil-mu'mineena 'alal-qitaal, iy yakum minkum 'ishroona saabiroona yaghliboo mi'atayn, wa'iy yakum minkum mi'atuy yaghliboo alfam minal-ladheena kafaroo bi'annahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
map.8:66: Al-aana khaffafallaahu 'ankum wa'alima anna feekum da'faa, fa'iy yakum minkum mi'atun saabiratuy yaghliboo mi'atayn, wa'iy yakum minkum alfuy yaghliboo alfayni bi'idhnillaah, wallaahu ma'as-saabireen
map.8:67: Maa kaana linabiyyin ay yakoona lahoo asraa hattaa yuthkhina fil-ard, tureedoona 'aradad-dunyaa, wallaahu yureedul-aakhirah, wallaahu 'azeezun hakeem
map.8:68: Lawlaa kitaabum minallaahi sabaqa lamassakum feemaa akhadhtum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.8:69: Fakuloo mimmaa ghanimtum halaalan tayyibaa, wattaqullaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.8:70: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul liman fee aydeekum minal-asraa iy ya'lamillaahu fee quloobikum khayray yu'tikum khayram mimmaa ukhidha minkum wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.8:71: Wa'iy yureedoo khiyaanataka faqad khaanullaaha min qablu fa'amkana minhum wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.8:72: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wahaajaroo wajaahadoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena aawaw wanasaroo ulaa'ika ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'd, wal-ladheena aamanoo walam yuhaajiroo maa lakum miw walaayatihim min shay'in hattaa yuhaajiroo, wa'inistansarookum fid-deeni fa'alaykumun-nasru illaa 'alaa qawmim baynakum wabaynahum meethaaq, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.8:73: Wal-ladheena kafaroo ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'd, illaa taf'aloohu takun fitnatun fil-ardi wafasaadun kabeer
map.8:74: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wahaajaroo wajaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi wal-ladheena aawaw wanasaroo ulaa'ika humul-mu'minoona haqqaa, lahum maghfiratuw warizqun kareem
map.8:75: Wal-ladheena aamanoo mim ba'du wahaajaroo wajaahadoo ma'akum fa'ulaa'ika minkum, wa'ulul-arhaami ba'duhum awlaa biba'din fee kitaabillaah, innallaaha bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.9:2: Faseehoo fil-ardi arba'ata ashhuriw wa'lamoo annakum ghayru mu'jizillaahi wa'annallaaha mukhzil-kaafireen
map.9:3: Wa'adhaanum minallaahi warasoolihee ilan-naasi yawmal-hajjil-akbari annallaaha baree'um minal-mushrikeena warasooluh, fa'in tubtum fahuwa khayrul lakum, wa'in tawallaytum fa'lamoo annakum ghayru mu'jizillaah, wabashshiril-ladheena kafaroo bi'adhaabin aleem
map.9:4: Illal-ladheena 'aahattum minal-mushrikeena thumma lam yanqusookum shay'aw walam yuzaahiroo 'alaykum ahadan fa'atimmoo ilayhim 'ahdahum ilaa muddatihim, innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen
map.9:5: Fa'idhansalakhal-ashhurul-hurumu faqtulul-mushrikeena haythu wajattumoohum wakhudhoohum wahsuroohum waq'udoo lahum kulla marsad, fa'in taaboo wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata fakhalloo sabeelahum, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.9:6: Wa'in ahadum minal-mushrikeenastajaaraka fa'ajirhu hattaa yasma'a kalaamallaahi thumma ablighhu ma'manah, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa ya'lamoon
map.9:7: Kayfa yakoonu lil-mushrikeena 'ahdun 'indallaahi wa'inda rasoolihee illal-ladheena 'aahattum 'indal-masjidil-haraam, famastaqaamoo lakum fastaqeemoo lahum, innallaaha yuhibbul-muttaqeen
map.9:8: Kayfa wa'iy yazharoo 'alaykum laa yarquboo feekum illaw walaa dhimmah, yurdoonakum bi'afwaahihim wata'baa quloobuhum, wa'aktharuhum faasiqoon
map.9:9: Ishtaraw bi'aayaatillaahi thamanan qaleelan fasaddoo 'an sabeelih, innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.9:10: Laa yarquboona fee mu'minin illaw walaa dhimmah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-mu'tadoon
map.9:11: Fa'in taaboo wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata fa'ikhwaanukum fid-deen, wanufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.9:12: Wa'in nakathoo aymaanahum mim ba'di 'ahdihim wata'anoo fee deenikum faqaatiloo a'immatal-kufri innahum laa aymaana lahum la'allahum yantahoon
map.9:13: Alaa tuqaatiloona qawman nakathoo aymaanahum wahammoo bi'ikhraajir-rasooli wahum bada'ookum awwala marrah, atakhshawnahum, fallaahu ahaqqu an takhshawhu in kuntum mu'mineen
map.9:14: Qaatiloohum yu'adhdhibhumullaahu bi'aydeekum wayukhzihim wayansurkum 'alayhim wayashfi sudoora qawmim mu'mineen
map.9:15: Wayudhhib ghayza quloobihim, wayatoobullaahu 'alaa may yashaa', wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.9:16: Am hasibtum an tutrakoo walammaa ya'lamillaahul-ladheena jaahadoo minkum walam yattakhidhoo min doonillaahi walaa rasoolihee walal-mu'mineena waleejah, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.9:17: Maa kaana lil-mushrikeena ay ya'muroo masaajidallaahi shaahideena 'alaa anfusihim bil-kufr, ulaa'ika habitat a'maaluhum, wafin-naari hum khaalidoon
map.9:18: Innamaa ya'muru masaajidallaahi man aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wa'aqaamas-salaata wa'aataz-zakaata walam yakhsha illallaah, fa'asaa ulaa'ika ay yakoonoo minal-muhtadeen
map.9:19: Aja'altum siqaayatal-haajji wa'imaaratal-masjidil-haraami kaman aamana billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wajaahada fee sabeelillaah, laa yastawoona 'indallaah, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.9:20: Alladheena aamanoo wahaajaroo wajaahadoo fee sabeelillaahi bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim a'zamu darajatan 'indallaah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-faa'izoon
map.9:21: Yubashshiruhum rabbuhum birahmatim minhu waridwaaniw wajannaatil lahum feehaa na'eemum muqeem
map.9:23: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo aabaa'akum wa'ikhwaanakum awliyaa'a inistahabbul-kufra 'alal-eemaan, wamay yatawallahum minkum fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.9:24: Qul in kaana aabaa'ukum wa'abnaa'ukum wa'ikhwaanukum wa'azwaajukum wa'asheeratukum wa'amwaaluniqtaraftumoohaa watijaaratun takhshawna kasaadahaa wamasaakinu tardawnahaa ahabba ilaykum minallaahi warasoolihee wajihaadin fee sabeelihee fatarabbasoo hattaa ya'tiyallaahu bi'amrih, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
map.9:25: Laqad nasarakumullaahu fee mawaatina katheeratiw wayawma hunaynin idh a'jabatkum kathratukum falam tughni 'ankum shay'aw wadaaqat 'alaykumul-ardu bimaa rahubat thumma wallaytum mudbireen
map.9:26: Thumma anzalallaahu sakeenatahoo 'alaa rasoolihee wa'alal-mu'mineena wa'anzala junoodal lam tarawhaa wa'adhdhabal-ladheena kafaroo, wadhaalika jazaa'ul-kaafireen
map.9:27: Thumma yatoobullaahu mim ba'di dhaalika 'alaa may yashaa', wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.9:28: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo innamal-mushrikoona najasun falaa yaqrabul-masjidal-haraama ba'da 'aamihim haadhaa, wa'in khiftum 'aylatan fasawfa yughneekumullaahu min fadlihee in shaa', innallaaha 'aleemun hakeem
map.9:29: Qaatilul-ladheena laa yu'minoona billaahi walaa bil-yawmil-aakhiri walaa yuharrimoona maa harramallaahu warasooluhoo walaa yadeenoona deenal-haqqi minal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba hattaa yu'tul-jizyata 'ay yadiw wahum saaghiroon
map.9:30: Waqaalatil-yahoodu 'uzayrunibnullaahi waqaalatin-nasaaral-maseehubnullaah, dhaalika qawluhum bi'afwaahihim, yudaahi'oona qawlal-ladheena kafaroo min qabl, qaatalahumullaah, annaa yu'fakoon
map.9:31: Ittakhadhoo ahbaarahum waruhbaanahum arbaabam min doonillaahi wal-maseehabna maryam, wamaa umiroo illaa liya'budoo ilaahaw waahidaa, laa ilaaha illaa huw, subhaanahoo 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.9:32: Yureedoona ay yutfi'oo noorallaahi bi'afwaahihim waya'ballaahu illaa ay yutimma noorahoo walaw karihal-kaafiroon
map.9:33: Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahoo bil-hudaa wadeenil-haqqi liyuzhirahoo 'alad-deeni kullihee walaw karihal-mushrikoon
map.9:34: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo inna katheeram minal-ahbaari war-ruhbaani laya'kuloona amwaalan-naasi bil-baatili wayasuddoona 'an sabeelillaah, wal-ladheena yaknizoonadh-dhahaba wal-fiddata walaa yunfiqoonahaa fee sabeelillaahi fabashshirhum bi'adhaabin aleem
map.9:35: Yawma yuhmaa 'alayhaa fee naari jahannama fatukwaa bihaa jibaahuhum wajunoobuhum wazuhooruhum, haadhaa maa kanaztum li'anfusikum fadhooqoo maa kuntum taknizoon
map.9:36: Inna 'iddatash-shuhoori 'indallaahithnaa 'ashara shahran fee kitaabillaahi yawma khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda minhaa arba'atun hurum, dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu falaa tazlimoo feehinna anfusakum waqaatilul-mushrikeena kaaffatan kamaa yuqaatiloonakum kaaffah, wa'lamoo annallaaha ma'al-muttaqeen
map.9:37: Innaman-nasee'u ziyaadatun fil-kufri yudallu bihil-ladheena kafaroo yuhilloonahoo 'aamaw wayuharrimoonahoo 'aamal liyuwaati'oo 'iddata maa harramallaahu fayuhilloo maa harramallaah, zuyyina lahum soo'u a'maalihim, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-kaafireen
map.9:38: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo maa lakum idhaa qeela lakumunfiroo fee sabeelillaahiththaaqaltum ilal-ard, aradeetum bil-hayaatid-dunyaa minal-aakhirah, famaa mataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa fil-aakhirati illaa qaleel
map.9:39: Illaa tanfiroo yu'adhdhibkum 'adhaaban aleemaw wayastabdil qawman ghayrakum walaa tadurroohu shay'aa, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.9:40: Illaa tansuroohu faqad nasarahullaahu idh akhrajahul-ladheena kafaroo thaaniyathnayni idh humaa fil-ghaari idh yaqoolu lisaahibihee laa tahzan innallaaha ma'anaa, fa'anzalallaahu sakeenatahoo 'alayhi wa'ayyadahoo bijunoodil lam tarawhaa waja'ala kalimatal-ladheena kafarus-suflaa, wakalimatullaahi hiyal-'ulyaa, wallaahu 'azeezun hakeem
map.9:41: Infiroo khifaafaw wathiqaalaw wajaahidoo bi'amwaalikum wa'anfusikum fee sabeelillaah, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.9:42: Law kaana 'aradan qareebaw wasafaran qaasidal lattaba'ooka walaakim ba'udat 'alayhimush-shuqqah, wasayahlifoona billaahi lawistata'naa lakharajnaa ma'akum, yuhlikoona anfusahum, wallaahu ya'lamu innahum lakaadhiboon
map.9:43: 'Afallaahu 'ank, lima adhinta lahum hattaa yatabayyana lakal-ladheena sadaqoo wata'lamal-kaadhibeen
map.9:44: Laa yasta'dhinukal-ladheena yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri ay yujaahidoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim, wallaahu 'aleemum bil-muttaqeen
map.9:45: Innamaa yasta'dhinukal-ladheena laa yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wartaabat quloobuhum fahum fee raybihim yataraddadoon
map.9:46: Walaw araadul-khurooja la'a'addoo lahoo 'uddataw walaakin karihallaahumbi'aathahum fathabbatahum waqeelaq'udoo ma'al-qaa'ideen
map.9:47: Law kharajoo feekum maa zaadookum illaa khabaalaw wala'awda'oo khilaalakum yabghoonakumul-fitnah, wafeekum sammaa'oona lahum, wallaahu 'aleemum biz-zaalimeen
map.9:48: Laqadibtaghawul-fitnata min qablu waqallaboo lakal-umoora hattaa jaa'al-haqqu wazahara amrullaahi wahum kaarihoon
map.9:49: Waminhum may yaqoolu'dhal lee walaa taftinnee, alaa fil-fitnati saqatoo, wa'inna jahannama lamuheetatum bil-kaafireen
map.9:50: In tusibka hasanatun tasu'hum, wa'in tusibka museebatuy yaqooloo qad akhadhnaa amranaa min qablu wayatawallaw wahum farihoon
map.9:51: Qul lay yuseebanaa illaa maa kataballaahu lanaa, huwa mawlaanaa wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.9:52: Qul hal tarabbasoona binaa illaa ihdal-husnayayn, wanahnu natarabbasu bikum ay yuseebakumullaahu bi'adhaabim min 'indihee aw bi'aydeenaa, fatarabbasoo innaa ma'akum mutarabbisoon
map.9:53: Qul anfiqoo taw'an aw karhal lay yutaqabbala minkum, innakum kuntum qawman faasiqeen
map.9:54: Wamaa mana'ahum an tuqbala minhum nafaqaatuhum illaa annahum kafaroo billaahi wabirasoolihee walaa ya'toonas-salaata illaa wahum kusaalaa walaa yunfiqoona illaa wahum kaarihoon
map.9:55: Falaa tu'jibka amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum, innamaa yureedullaahu liyu'adhdhibahum bihaa fil-hayaatid-dunyaa watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
map.9:56: Wayahlifoona billaahi innahum laminkum, wamaa hum minkum walaakinnahum qawmuy yafraqoon
map.9:57: Law yajidoona malja'an aw maghaaraatin aw muddakhalal lawallaw ilayhi wahum yajmahoon
map.9:58: Waminhum may yalmizuka fis-sadaqaat, fa'in u'too minhaa radoo wa'il lam yu'taw minhaa idhaa hum yaskhatoon
map.9:59: Walaw annahum radoo maa aataahumullaahu warasooluhoo waqaaloo hasbunallaahu sayu'teenallaahu min fadlihee warasooluhoo innaa ilallaahi raaghiboon
map.9:60: Innamas-sadaqaatu lil-fuqaraa'i wal-masaakeeni wal-'aamileena 'alayhaa wal-mu'allafati quloobuhum wafir-riqaabi wal-ghaarimeena wafee sabeelillaahi wabnis-sabeel, fareedatam minallaah, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.9:61: Waminhumul-ladheena yu'dhoonan-nabiyya wayaqooloona huwa udhun, qul udhunu khayril lakum yu'minu billaahi wayu'minu lil-mu'mineena warahmatul lilladheena aamanoo minkum, wal-ladheena yu'dhoona rasoolallaahi lahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.9:62: Yahlifoona billaahi lakum liyurdookum wallaahu warasooluhoo ahaqqu ay yurdoohu in kaanoo mu'mineen
map.9:63: Alam ya'lamoo annahoo may yuhaadidillaaha warasoolahoo fa'anna lahoo naara jahannama khaalidan feehaa, dhaalikal-khizyul-'azeem
map.9:64: Yahdharul-munaafiqoona an tunazzala 'alayhim sooratun tunabbi'uhum bimaa fee quloobihim, qulistahzi'oo, innallaaha mukhrijum maa tahdharoon
map.9:65: Wala'in sa'altahum layaqoolunna innamaa kunnaa nakhoodu wanal'ab, qul abillaahi wa'aayaatihee warasoolihee kuntum tastahzi'oon
map.9:66: Laa ta'tadhiroo qad kafartum ba'da eemaanikum, in na'fu 'an taa'ifatim minkum nu'adhdhib taa'ifatam bi'annahum kaanoo mujrimeen
map.9:67: Al-munaafiqoona wal-munaafiqaatu ba'duhum mim ba'd, ya'muroona bil-munkari wayanhawna 'anil-ma'roofi wayaqbidoona aydiyahum, nasullaaha fanasiyahum, innal-munaafiqeena humul-faasiqoon
map.9:68: Wa'adallaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-kuffaara naara jahannama khaalideena feehaa, hiya hasbuhum, wala'anahumullaah, walahum 'adhaabum muqeem
map.9:69: Kal-ladheena min qablikum kaanoo ashadda minkum quwwataw wa'akthara amwaalaw wa'awlaadaa, fastamta'oo bikhalaaqihim fastamta'tum bikhalaaqikum kamastamta'al-ladheena min qablikum bikhalaaqihim wakhudtum kal-ladhee khaadoo, ulaa'ika habitat a'maaluhum fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.9:70: Alam ya'tihim naba'ul-ladheena min qablihim qawmi noohiw wa'aadiw wathamooda waqawmi ibraaheema wa'ashaabi madyana wal-mu'tafikaat, atathum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaat, famaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.9:71: Wal-mu'minoona wal-mu'minaatu ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'd, ya'muroona bil-ma'roofi wayanhawna 'anil-munkari wayuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wayutee'oonallaaha warasoolah, ulaa'ika sayarhamuhumullaah, innallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.9:72: Wa'adallaahul-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wamasaakina tayyibatan fee jannaati 'adn, waridwaanum minallaahi akbar, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem
map.9:73: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu jaahidil-kuffaara wal-munaafiqeena waghluz 'alayhim, wama'waahum jahannamu wabi'sal-maseer
map.9:74: Yahlifoona billaahi maa qaaloo, walaqad qaaloo kalimatal-kufri wakafaroo ba'da islaamihim wahammoo bimaa lam yanaaloo, wamaa naqamoo illaa an aghnaahumullaahu warasooluhoo min fadlih, fa'iy yatooboo yaku khayral lahum, wa'iy yatawallaw yu'adhdhibhumullaahu 'adhaaban aleeman fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wamaa lahum fil-ardi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
map.9:75: Waminhum man 'aahadallaaha la'in aataanaa min fadlihee lanassaddaqanna walanakoonanna minas-saaliheen
map.9:76: Falammaa aataahum min fadlihee bakhiloo bihee watawallaw wahum mu'ridoon
map.9:77: Fa'a'qabahum nifaaqan fee quloobihim ilaa yawmi yalqawnahoo bimaa akhlafullaaha maa wa'adoohu wabimaa kaanoo yakdhiboon
map.9:78: Alam ya'lamoo annallaaha ya'lamu sirrahum wanajwaahum wa'annallaaha 'allaamul-ghuyoob
map.9:79: Alladheena yalmizoonal-muttawwi'eena minal-mu'mineena fis-sadaqaati wal-ladheena laa yajidoona illaa juhdahum fayaskharoona minhum, sakhirallaahu minhum, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.9:80: Istaghfir lahum aw laa tastaghfir lahum, in tastaghfir lahum sab'eena marratan falay yaghfirallaahu lahum, dhaalika bi'annahum kafaroo billaahi warasoolih, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
map.9:81: Farihal-mukhallafoona bimaq'adihim khilaafa rasoolillaahi wakarihoo ay yujaahidoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim fee sabeelillaahi waqaaloo laa tanfiroo fil-harr, qul naaru jahannama ashaddu harraa, law kaanoo yafqahoon
map.9:82: Falyadhakoo qaleelaw walyabkoo katheeraa, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.9:83: Fa'ir raja'akallaahu ilaa taa'ifatim minhum fasta'dhanooka lil-khurooji faqul lan takhrujoo ma'iya abadaw walan tuqaatiloo ma'iya 'aduwwaa, innakum radeetum bil-qu'oodi awwala marrah, faq'udoo ma'al-khaalifeen
map.9:84: Walaa tusalli 'alaa ahadim minhum maata abadaw walaa taqum 'alaa qabrih, innahum kafaroo billaahi warasoolihee wamaatoo wahum faasiqoon
map.9:85: Walaa tu'jibka amwaaluhum wa'awlaaduhum, innamaa yureedullaahu ay yu'adhdhibahum bihaa fid-dunyaa watazhaqa anfusuhum wahum kaafiroon
map.9:86: Wa'idhaa unzilat sooratun an aaminoo billaahi wajaahidoo ma'a rasoolihista'dhanaka ulut-tawli minhum waqaaloo dharnaa nakum ma'al-qaa'ideen
map.9:87: Radoo bi'ay yakoonoo ma'al-khawaalifi watubi'a 'alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
map.9:88: Laakinir-rasoolu wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo jaahadoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim, wa'ulaa'ika lahumul-khayraat, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.9:89: A'addallaahu lahum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, dhaalikal-fawzul-'azeem
map.9:90: Wajaa'al-mu'adhdhiroona minal-a'raabi liyu'dhana lahum waqa'adal-ladheena kadhabullaaha warasoolah, sayuseebul-ladheena kafaroo minhum 'adhaabun aleem
map.9:91: Laysa 'alad-du'afaa'i walaa 'alal-mardaa walaa 'alal-ladheena laa yajidoona maa yunfiqoona harajun idhaa nasahoo lillaahi warasoolih, maa 'alal-muhsineena min sabeel, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.9:92: Walaa 'alal-ladheena idhaa maa atawka litahmilahum qulta laa ajidu maa ahmilukum 'alayh, tawallaw wa'a'yunuhum tafeedu minad-dam'i hazanan allaa yajidoo maa yunfiqoon
map.9:93: Innamas-sabeelu 'alal-ladheena yasta'dhinoonaka wahum aghniyaa', radoo bi'ay yakoonoo ma'al-khawaalifi wataba'allaahu 'alaa quloobihim fahum laa ya'lamoon
map.9:94: Ya'tadhiroona ilaykum idhaa raja'tum ilayhim, qul laa ta'tadhiroo lan nu'mina lakum qad nabba'anallaahu min akhbaarikum wasayarallaahu 'amalakum warasooluhoo thumma turaddoona ilaa 'aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.9:95: Sayahlifoona billaahi lakum idhanqalabtum ilayhim litu'ridoo 'anhum, fa'a'ridoo 'anhum, innahum rijsuw wama'waahum jahannamu jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.9:96: Yahlifoona lakum litardaw 'anhum, fa'in tardaw 'anhum fa'innallaaha laa yardaa 'anil-qawmil-faasiqeen
map.9:97: Al-a'raabu ashaddu kufraw wanifaaqaw wa'ajdaru allaa ya'lamoo hudooda maa anzalallaahu 'alaa rasoolih, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.9:98: Waminal-a'raabi may yattakhidhu maa yunfiqu maghramaw wayatarabbasu bikumud-dawaa'ir, 'alayhim daa'iratus-saw', wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.9:99: Waminal-a'raabi may yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri wayattakhidhu maa yunfiqu qurubaatin 'indallaahi wasalawaatir-rasool, alaa innahaa qurbatul lahum, sayudkhiluhumullaahu fee rahmatih, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.9:100: Was-saabiqoonal-awwaloona minal-muhaajireena wal-ansaari wal-ladheenattaba'oohum bi'ihsaanir radiyallaahu 'anhum waradoo 'anhu wa'a'adda lahum jannaatin tajree tahtahal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, dhaalikal-fawzul-'azeem
map.9:101: Wamimman hawlakum minal-a'raabi munaafiqoon, wamin ahlil-madeenati maradoo 'alan-nifaaq, laa ta'lamuhum, nahnu na'lamuhum, sanu'adhdhibuhum marratayni thumma yuraddoona ilaa 'adhaabin 'azeem
map.9:102: Wa'aakharoona'tarafoo bidhunoobihim khalatoo 'amalan saalihaw wa'aakhara sayyi'aa, 'asallaahu ay yatooba 'alayhim, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.9:103: Khudh min amwaalihim sadaqatan tutahhiruhum watuzakkeehim bihaa wasalli 'alayhim, inna salaataka sakanul lahum, wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.9:104: Alam ya'lamoo annallaaha huwa yaqbalut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihee waya'khudhus-sadaqaati wa'annallaaha huwat-tawwaabur-raheem
map.9:105: Waquli'maloo fasayarallaahu 'amalakum warasooluhoo wal-mu'minoon, wasaturaddoona ilaa 'aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.9:106: Wa'aakharoona murjawna li'amrillaahi immaa yu'adhdhibuhum wa'immaa yatoobu 'alayhim, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.9:107: Wal-ladheenattakhadhoo masjidan diraaraw wakufraw watafreeqam baynal-mu'mineena wa'irsaadal liman haaraballaaha warasoolahoo min qabl, walayahlifunna in aradnaa illal-husnaa, wallaahu yashhadu innahum lakaadhiboon
map.9:108: Laa taqum feehi abadaa, lamasjidun ussisa 'alat-taqwaa min awwali yawmin ahaqqu an taqooma feeh, feehi rijaaluy yuhibboona ay yatatahharoo, wallaahu yuhibbul-muttahhireen
map.9:109: Afaman assasa bunyaanahoo 'alaa taqwaa minallaahi waridwaanin khayrun am man assasa bunyaanahoo 'alaa shafaa jurufin haarin fanhaara bihee fee naari jahannam, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.9:110: Laa yazaalu bunyaanuhumul-ladhee banaw reebatan fee quloobihim illaa an taqatta'a quloobuhum, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.9:111: Innallaahashtaraa minal-mu'mineena anfusahum wa'amwaalahum bi'anna lahumul-jannah, yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi fayaqtuloona wayuqtaloona wa'dan 'alayhi haqqan fit-tawraati wal-injeeli wal-qur'aan, waman awfaa bi'ahdihee minallaahi fastabshiroo bibay'ikumul-ladhee baaya'tum bih, wadhaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem
map.9:113: Maa kaana lin-nabiyyi wal-ladheena aamanoo ay yastaghfiroo lil-mushrikeena walaw kaanoo ulee qurbaa mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahum annahum ashaabul-jaheem
map.9:114: Wamaa kaanastighfaaru ibraaheema li'abeehi illaa 'am maw'idatiw wa'adahaa iyyaah, falammaa tabayyana lahoo annahoo 'aduwwul lillaahi tabarra'a minh, inna ibraaheema la'awwaahun haleem
map.9:115: Wamaa kaanallaahu liyudilla qawmam ba'da idh hadaahum hattaa yubayyina lahum maa yattaqoon, innallaaha bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.9:116: Innallaaha lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yuhyee wayumeet, wamaa lakum min doonillaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
map.9:117: Laqat taaballaahu 'alan-nabiyyi wal-muhaajireena wal-ansaaril-ladheenattaba'oohu fee saa'atil-'usrati mim ba'di maa kaada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqim minhum thumma taaba 'alayhim, innahoo bihim ra'oofur raheem
map.9:118: Wa'alath-thalaathatil-ladheena khullifoo, hattaa idhaa daaqat 'alayhimul-ardu bimaa rahubat wadaaqat 'alayhim anfusuhum wazannoo al laa malja'a minallaahi illaa ilayh, thumma taaba 'alayhim liyatooboo, innallaaha huwat-tawwaabur-raheem
map.9:120: Maa kaana li'ahlil-madeenati waman hawlahum minal-a'raabi ay yatakhallafoo 'ar rasoolillaahi walaa yarghaboo bi'anfusihim 'an nafsih, dhaalika bi'annahum laa yuseebuhum zama'uw walaa nasabuw walaa makhmasatun fee sabeelillaahi walaa yata'oona mawti'ay yagheezul-kuffaara walaa yanaaloona min 'aduwwin naylan illaa kutiba lahum bihee 'amalun saalih, innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
map.9:121: Walaa yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheerataw walaa kabeerataw walaa yaqta'oona waadiyan illaa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumullaahu ahsana maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.9:122: Wamaa kaanal-mu'minoona liyanfiroo kaaffah, falawlaa nafara min kulli firqatim minhum taa'ifatul liyatafaqqahoo fid-deeni waliyundhiroo qawmahum idhaa raja'oo ilayhim la'allahum yahdharoon
map.9:123: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo qaatilul-ladheena yaloonakum minal-kuffaari walyajidoo feekum ghilzah, wa'lamoo annallaaha ma'al-muttaqeen
map.9:124: Wa'idhaa maa unzilat sooratun faminhum may yaqoolu ayyukum zaadathu haadhihee eemaanaa, fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo fazaadathum eemaanaw wahum yastabshiroon
map.9:125: Wa'ammal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun fazaadathum rijsan ilaa rijsihim wamaatoo wahum kaafiroon
map.9:126: Awalaa yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli 'aamim marratan aw marratayni thumma laa yatooboona walaa hum yadhdhakkaroon
map.9:127: Wa'idhaa maa unzilat sooratun nazara ba'duhum ilaa ba'd, hal yaraakum min ahadin thummansarafoo, sarafallaahu quloobahum bi'annahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
map.9:128: Laqad jaa'akum rasoolum min anfusikum 'azeezun 'alayhi maa 'anittum hareesun 'alaykum bil-mu'mineena ra'oofur raheem
map.9:129: Fa'in tawallaw faqul hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbul-'arshil-'azeem
map.10:2: Akaana lin-naasi 'ajaban an awhaynaa ilaa rajulim minhum an andhirin-naasa wabashshiril-ladheena aamanoo anna lahum qadama sidqin 'inda rabbihim, qaalal-kaafiroona inna haadhaa lasaahirum mubeen
map.10:3: Inna rabbakumullaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arshi yudabbirul-amr, maa min shafee'in illaa mim ba'di idhnih, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum fa'budooh, afalaa tadhakkaroon
map.10:4: Ilayhi marji'ukum jamee'aa, wa'dallaahi haqqaa, innahoo yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati bil-qist, wal-ladheena kafaroo lahum sharaabum min hameemiw wa'adhaabun aleemum bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
map.10:5: Huwal-ladhee ja'alash-shamsa diyaa'aw wal-qamara nooraw waqaddarahoo manaazila lita'lamoo 'adadas-sineena wal-hisaab, maa khalaqallaahu dhaalika illaa bil-haqq, yufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.10:6: Inna fikhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wamaa khalaqallaahu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi la'aayaatil liqawmiy yattaqoon
map.10:7: Innal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa waradoo bil-hayaatid-dunyaa watma'annoo bihaa wal-ladheena hum 'an aayaatinaa ghaafiloon
map.10:9: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati yahdeehim rabbuhum bi'eemaanihim, tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru fee jannaatin-na'eem
map.10:10: Da'waahum feehaa subhaanakallaahumma watahiyyatuhum feehaa salaam, wa'aakhiru da'waahum anil-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.10:11: Walaw yu'ajjilullaahu lin-naasish-sharrasti'jaalahum bil-khayri laqudiya ilayhim ajaluhum, fanadharul-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
map.10:12: Wa'idhaa massal-insaanad-durru da'aanaa lijambihee aw qaa'idan aw qaa'imaa, falammaa kashafnaa 'anhu durrahoo marra ka'al lam yad'unaa ilaa durrim massah, kadhaalika zuyyina lil-musrifeena maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.10:13: Walaqad ahlaknal-quroona min qablikum lammaa zalamoo wajaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati wamaa kaanoo liyu'minoo, kadhaalika najzil-qawmal-mujrimeen
map.10:14: Thumma ja'alnaakum khalaa'ifa fil-ardi mim ba'dihim linanzura kayfa ta'maloon
map.10:15: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'ana'ti biqur'aanin ghayri haadhaa aw baddilh, qul maa yakoonu lee an ubaddilahoo min tilqaa'i nafsee, in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaa ilayy, innee akhaafu in 'asaytu rabbee 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
map.10:16: Qul law shaa'allaahu maa talawtuhoo 'alaykum walaa adraakum bih, faqad labithtu feekum 'umuram min qablih, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.10:17: Faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bi'aayaatih, innahoo laa yuflihul-mujrimoon
map.10:18: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhum walaa yanfa'uhum wayaqooloona haa'ulaa'i shufa'aa'unaa 'indallaah, qul atunabbi'oonallaaha bimaa laa ya'lamu fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ard, subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.10:19: Wamaa kaanan-naasu illaa ummataw waahidatan fakhtalafoo, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum feemaa feehi yakhtalifoon
map.10:20: Wayaqooloona lawlaa unzila 'alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, faqul innamal-ghaybu lillaahi fantaziroo, innee ma'akum minal-muntazireen
map.10:21: Wa'idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatam mim ba'di darraa'a massathum idhaa lahum makrun fee aayaatinaa, qulillaahu asra'u makraa, inna rusulanaa yaktuboona maa tamkuroon
map.10:22: Huwal-ladhee yusayyirukum fil-barri wal-bahr, hattaa idhaa kuntum fil-fulk, wajarayna bihim bireehin tayyibatiw wafarihoo bihaa jaa'athaa reehun 'aasifuw wajaa'ahumul-mawju min kulli makaaniw wazannoo annahum uheeta bihim da'awullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deen, la'in anjaytanaa min haadhihee lanakoonanna minash-shaakireen
map.10:23: Falammaa anjaahum idhaa hum yabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqq, yaa ayyuhan-naasu innamaa baghyukum 'alaa anfusikum mataa'al-hayaatid-dunyaa, thumma ilaynaa marji'ukum fanunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.10:24: Innamaa mathalul-hayaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in anzalnaahu minas-samaa'i fakhtalata bihee nabaatul-ardi mimmaa ya'kulun-naasu wal-an'aam, hattaa idhaa akhadhatil-ardu zukhrufahaa wazzayyanat wazanna ahluhaa annahum qaadiroona 'alayhaa ataahaa amrunaa laylan aw nahaaran faja'alnaahaa haseedan ka'al lam taghna bil-ams, kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.10:25: Wallaahu yad'oo ilaa daaris-salaam, wayahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.10:26: Lilladheena ahsanul-husnaa waziyaadah, walaa yarhaqu wujoohahum qataruw walaa dhillah, ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.10:27: Wal-ladheena kasabus-sayyi'aati jazaa'u sayyi'atim bimithlihaa watarhaquhum dhillah, maa lahum minallaahi min 'aasim, ka'annamaa ughshiyat wujoohuhum qita'am minal-layli muzlimaa, ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.10:28: Wayawma nahshuruhum jamee'an thumma naqoolu lilladheena ashrakoo makaanakum antum washurakaa'ukum, fazayyalnaa baynahum waqaala shurakaa'uhum maa kuntum iyyaanaa ta'budoon
map.10:29: Fakafaa billaahi shaheedam baynanaa wabaynakum in kunnaa 'an 'ibaadatikum laghaafileen
map.10:30: Hunaalika tabloo kullu nafsim maa aslafat waruddoo ilallaahi mawlaahumul-haqqi wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.10:31: Qul may yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ardi ammay yamlikus-sam'a wal-absaara wamay yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wayukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wamay yudabbirul-amr, fasayaqooloonallaah, faqul afalaa tattaqoon
map.10:32: Fadhaalikumullaahu rabbukumul-haqq, famaadhaa ba'dal-haqqi illad-dalaal, fa'annaa tusrafoon
map.10:33: Kadhaalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'alal-ladheena fasaqoo annahum laa yu'minoon
map.10:34: Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum may yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduh, qulillaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo fa'annaa tu'fakoon
map.10:35: Qul hal min shurakaa'ikum may yahdee ilal-haqq, qulillaahu yahdee lil-haqq, afamay yahdee ilal-haqqi ahaqqu ay yuttaba'a ammal laa yahiddee illaa ay yuhdaa, famaa lakum, kayfa tahkumoon
map.10:36: Wamaa yattabi'u aktharuhum illaa zannaa, innaz-zanna laa yughnee minal-haqqi shay'aa, innallaaha 'aleemum bimaa yaf'aloon
map.10:37: Wamaa kaana haadhal-qur'aanu ay yuftaraa min doonillaahi walaakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi watafseelal-kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rabbil-'aalameen
map.10:38: Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul fa'too bisooratim mithlihee wad'oo manistata'tum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
map.10:39: Bal kadhdhaboo bimaa lam yuheetoo bi'ilmihee walammaa ya'tihim ta'weeluh, kadhaalika kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatuz-zaalimeen
map.10:40: Waminhum may yu'minu bihee waminhum mal laa yu'minu bih, warabbuka a'lamu bil-mufsideen
map.10:41: Wa'in kadhdhabooka faqul lee 'amalee walakum 'amalukum, antum baree'oona mimmaa a'malu wa'ana baree'um mimmaa ta'maloon
map.10:42: Waminhum may yastami'oona ilayk, afa'anta tusmi'us-summa walaw kaanoo laa ya'qiloon
map.10:43: Waminhum may yanzuru ilayk, afa'anta tahdil-'umya walaw kaanoo laa yubsiroon
map.10:44: Innallaaha laa yazlimun-naasa shay'aw walaakinnan-naasa anfusahum yazlimoon
map.10:45: Wayawma yahshuruhum ka'al lam yalbathoo illaa saa'atam minan-nahaari yata'aarafoona baynahum, qad khasiral-ladheena kadhdhaboo biliqaa'illaahi wamaa kaanoo muhtadeen
map.10:46: Wa'immaa nuriyannaka ba'dal-ladhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'ilaynaa marji'uhum thummallaahu shaheedun 'alaa maa yaf'aloon
map.10:47: Walikulli ummatir rasool, fa'idhaa jaa'a rasooluhum qudiya baynahum bil-qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.10:48: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
map.10:49: Qul laa amliku linafsee darraw walaa naf'an illaa maa shaa'allaah, likulli ummatin ajal, idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum falaa yasta'khiroona saa'ataw walaa yastaqdimoon
map.10:50: Qul ara'aytum in ataakum 'adhaabuhoo bayaatan aw nahaaram maadhaa yasta'jilu minhul-mujrimoon
map.10:51: Athumma idhaa maa waqa'a aamantum bih, aal-aana waqad kuntum bihee tasta'jiloon
map.10:52: Thumma qeela lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo 'adhaabal-khuld, hal tujzawna illaa bimaa kuntum taksiboon
map.10:53: Wayastambi'oonaka ahaqqun huw, qul ee warabbee innahoo lahaqq, wamaa antum bimu'jizeen
map.10:54: Walaw anna likulli nafsin zalamat maa fil-ardi laftadat bih, wa'asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'awul-'adhaab, waqudiya baynahum bil-qisti wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.10:55: Alaa inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, alaa inna wa'dallaahi haqquw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.10:57: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'atkum maw'izatum mir rabbikum washifaa'ul limaa fis-sudoori wahudaw warahmatul lil-mu'mineen
map.10:58: Qul bifadlillaahi wabirahmatihee fabidhaalika falyafrahoo, huwa khayrum mimmaa yajma'oon
map.10:59: Qul ara'aytum maa anzalallaahu lakum mir rizqin faja'altum minhu haraamaw wahalaalaa, qul aallaahu adhina lakum am 'alallaahi taftaroon
map.10:60: Wamaa zannul-ladheena yaftaroona 'alallaahil-kadhiba yawmal-qiyaamah, innallaaha ladhoo fadlin 'alan-naasi walaakinna aktharahum laa yashkuroon
map.10:61: Wamaa takoonu fee sha'niw wamaa tatloo minhu min qur'aaniw walaa ta'maloona min 'amalin illaa kunnaa 'alaykum shuhoodan idh tufeedoona feeh, wamaa ya'zubu 'ar rabbika mim mithqaali dharratin fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa'i walaa asghara min dhaalika walaa akbara illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
map.10:62: Alaa inna awliyaa'allaahi laa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.10:64: Lahumul-bushraa fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wafil-aakhirah, laa tabdeela likalimaatillaah, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem
map.10:65: Walaa yahzunka qawluhum, innal-'izzata lillaahi jamee'aa, huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.10:66: Alaa inna lillaahi man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ard, wamaa yattabi'ul-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi shurakaa', iy yattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa'in hum illaa yakhrusoon
map.10:67: Huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla litaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiraa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yasma'oon
map.10:68: Qaaluttakhadhallaahu waladan subhaanah, huwal-ghaniyy, lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, in 'indakum min sultaanim bihaadhaa, ataqooloona 'alallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.10:70: Mataa'un fid-dunyaa thumma ilaynaa marji'uhum thumma nudheequhumul-'adhaabash-shadeeda bimaa kaanoo yakfuroon
map.10:71: Watlu 'alayhim naba'a nooh, idh qaala liqawmihee yaaqawmi in kaana kabura 'alaykum maqaamee watadhkeeree bi'aayaatillaahi fa'alallaahi tawakkaltu fa'ajmi'oo amrakum washurakaa'akum thumma laa yakun amrukum 'alaykum ghummatan thummaqdoo ilayya walaa tunziroon
map.10:72: Fa'in tawallaytum famaa sa'altukum min ajr, in ajriya illaa 'alallaahi wa'umirtu an akoona minal-muslimeen
map.10:73: Fakadhdhaboohu fanajjaynaahu wamam ma'ahoo fil-fulki waja'alnaahum khalaa'ifa wa'aghraqnal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mundhareen
map.10:74: Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihee rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaanoo liyu'minoo bimaa kadhdhaboo bihee min qabl, kadhaalika natba'u 'alaa quloobil-mu'tadeen
map.10:75: Thumma ba'athnaa mim ba'dihim moosaa wahaaroona ilaa fir'awna wamala'ihee bi'aayaatinaa fastakbaroo wakaanoo qawmam mujrimeen
map.10:76: Falammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu min 'indinaa qaaloo inna haadhaa lasihrum mubeen
map.10:77: Qaala moosaa ataqooloona lil-haqqi lammaa jaa'akum, asihrun haadhaa, walaa yuflihus-saahiroon
map.10:78: Qaaloo aji'tanaa litalfitanaa 'ammaa wajadnaa 'alayhi aabaa'anaa watakoona lakumal-kibriyaa'u fil-ard, wamaa nahnu lakumaa bimu'mineen
map.10:80: Falammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaala lahum moosaa alqoo maa antum mulqoon
map.10:81: Falammaa alqaw qaala moosaa maa ji'tum bihis-sihr, innallaaha sayubtiluh, innallaaha laa yuslihu 'amalal-mufsideen
map.10:83: Famaa aamana limoosaa illaa dhurriyyatum min qawmihee 'alaa khawfim min fir'awna wamala'ihim ay yaftinahum, wa'inna fir'awna la'aalin fil-ard, wa'innahoo laminal-musrifeen
map.10:84: Waqaala moosaa yaaqawmi in kuntum aamantum billaahi fa'alayhi tawakkaloo in kuntum muslimeen
map.10:85: Faqaaloo 'alallaahi tawakkalnaa, rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.10:87: Wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa wa'akheehi an tabawwa'aa liqawmikumaa bimisra buyootaw waj'aloo buyootakum qiblataw wa'aqeemus-salaah, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
map.10:88: Waqaala moosaa rabbanaa innaka aatayta fir'awna wamala'ahoo zeenataw wa'amwaalan fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, rabbanaa liyudilloo 'an sabeelik, rabbanatmis 'alaa amwaalihim washdud 'alaa quloobihim falaa yu'minoo hattaa yarawul-'adhaabal-aleem
map.10:89: Qaala qad ujeebad da'watukumaa fastaqeemaa walaa tattabi'aanni sabeelal-ladheena laa ya'lamoon
map.10:90: Wajaawaznaa bibanee israa'eelal-bahra fa'atba'ahum fir'awnu wajunooduhoo baghyaw wa'adwaa, hattaa idhaa adrakahul-gharaqu qaala aamantu annahoo laa ilaaha illal-ladhee aamanat bihee banoo israa'eela wa'ana minal-muslimeen
map.10:92: Fal-yawma nunajjeeka bibadanika litakoona liman khalfaka aayah, wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi 'an aayaatinaa laghaafiloon
map.10:93: Walaqad bawwa'naa banee israa'eela mubawwa'a sidqiw warazaqnaahum minat-tayyibaat, famakhtalafoo hattaa jaa'ahumul-'ilm, inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
map.10:94: Fa'in kunta fee shakkim mimmaa anzalnaa ilayka fas'alil-ladheena yaqra'oonal-kitaaba min qablik, laqad jaa'akal-haqqu mir rabbika falaa takoonanna minal-mumtareen
map.10:95: Walaa takoonanna minal-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaahi fatakoona minal-khaasireen
map.10:96: Innal-ladheena haqqat 'alayhim kalimatu rabbika laa yu'minoon
map.10:97: Walaw jaa'athum kullu aayatin hattaa yarawul-'adhaabal-aleem
map.10:98: Falawlaa kaanat qaryatun aamanat fanafa'ahaa eemaanuhaa illaa qawma yoonus, lammaa aamanoo kashafnaa 'anhum 'adhaabal-khizyi fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wamatta'naahum ilaa heen
map.10:99: Walaw shaa'a rabbuka la'aamana man fil-ardi kulluhum jamee'aa, afa'anta tukrihun-naasa hattaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
map.10:100: Wamaa kaana linafsin an tu'mina illaa bi'idhnillaah, wayaj'alur-rijsa 'alal-ladheena laa ya'qiloon
map.10:101: Qulinzuroo maadhaa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wamaa tughnil-aayaatu wan-nudhuru 'an qawmil laa yu'minoon
map.10:102: Fahal yantaziroona illaa mithla ayyaamil-ladheena khalaw min qablihim, qul fantaziroo innee ma'akum minal-muntazireen
map.10:103: Thumma nunajjee rusulanaa wal-ladheena aamanoo kadhaalik, haqqan 'alaynaa nunjil-mu'mineen
map.10:104: Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee shakkim min deenee falaa a'budul-ladheena ta'budoona min doonillaahi walaakin a'budullaahal-ladhee yatawaffaakum, wa'umirtu an akoona minal-mu'mineen
map.10:105: Wa'an aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefaa, walaa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
map.10:106: Walaa tad'u min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'uka walaa yadurruk, fa'in fa'alta fa'innaka idham minaz-zaalimeen
map.10:107: Wa'iy yamsaskallaahu bidurrin falaa kaashifa lahoo illaa huw, wa'iy yuridka bikhayrin falaa raadda lifadlih, yuseebu bihee may yashaa'u min 'ibaadih, wahuwal-ghafoorur-raheem
map.10:108: Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu qad jaa'akumul-haqqu mir rabbikum, famanihtadaa fa'innamaa yahtadee linafsih, waman dalla fa'innamaa yadillu 'alayhaa, wamaa ana 'alaykum biwakeel
map.10:109: Wattabi' maa yoohaa ilayka wasbir hattaa yahkumallaah, wahuwa khayrul-haakimeen
map.11:1: Alif laam raa, kitaabun uhkimat aayaatuhoo thumma fussilat mil ladun hakeemin khabeer
map.11:2: Allaa ta'budoo illallaah, innanee lakum minhu nadheeruw wabasheer
map.11:3: Wa'anistaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yumatti'kum mataa'an hasanan ilaa ajalim musammaw wayu'ti kulla dhee fadlin fadlah, wa'in tawallaw fa'innee akhaafu 'alaykum 'adhaaba yawmin kabeer
map.11:4: Ilallaahi marji'ukum, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.11:5: Alaa innahum yathnoona sudoorahum liyastakhfoo minh, alaa heena yastaghshoona thiyaabahum ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoon, innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.11:6: Wamaa min daabbatin fil-ardi illaa 'alallaahi rizquhaa waya'lamu mustaqarrahaa wamustawda'ahaa, kullun fee kitaabim mubeen
map.11:7: Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamiw wakaana 'arshuhoo 'alal-maa'i liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa, wala'in qulta innakum mab'oothoona mim ba'dil-mawti layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
map.11:8: Wala'in akhkharnaa 'anhumul-'adhaaba ilaa ummatim ma'doodatil layaqoolunna maa yahbisuh, alaa yawma ya'teehim laysa masroofan 'anhum wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.11:9: Wala'in adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan thumma naza'naahaa minh, innahoo laya'oosun kafoor
map.11:10: Wala'in adhaqnaahu na'maa'a ba'da darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna dhahabas-sayyi'aatu 'annee, innahoo lafarihun fakhoor
map.11:11: Illal-ladheena sabaroo wa'amilus-saalihaat, ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun kabeer
map.11:12: Fala'allaka taarikum ba'da maa yoohaa ilayka wadaa'iqum bihee sadruka ay yaqooloo lawlaa unzila 'alayhi kanzun aw jaa'a ma'ahoo malak, innamaa anta nadheer, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'iw wakeel
map.11:13: Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul fa'too bi'ashri suwarim mithlihee muftarayaatiw wad'oo manistata'tum min doonillaahi in kuntum saadiqeen
map.11:14: Fa'illam yastajeeboo lakum fa'lamoo annamaa unzila bi'ilmillaahi wa'al laa ilaaha illaa huw, fahal antum muslimoon
map.11:15: Man kaana yureedul-hayaatad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa nuwaffi ilayhim a'maalahum feehaa wahum feehaa laa yubkhasoon
map.11:16: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena laysa lahum fil-aakhirati illan-naar, wahabita maa sana'oo feehaa wabaatilum maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.11:17: Afaman kaana 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbihee wayatloohu shaahidum minhu wamin qablihee kitaabu moosaa imaamaw warahmah, ulaa'ika yu'minoona bih, wamay yakfur bihee minal-ahzaabi fan-naaru maw'iduhoo falaa taku fee miryatim minhu innahul-haqqu mir rabbika walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
map.11:18: Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhibaa, ulaa'ika yu'radoona 'alaa rabbihim wayaqoolul-ashhaadu haa'ulaa'il-ladheena kadhaboo 'alaa rabbihim, alaa la'natullaahi 'alaz-zaalimeen
map.11:19: Al-ladheena yasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwajaa, wahum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
map.11:20: Ulaa'ika lam yakoonoo mu'jizeena fil-ardi wamaa kaana lahum min doonillaahi min awliyaa', yudaa'afu lahumul-'adhaab, maa kaanoo yastatee'oonas-sam'a wamaa kaanoo yubsiroon
map.11:21: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.11:23: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wa'akhbatoo ilaa rabbihim ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannah, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.11:24: Mathalul-fareeqayni kal-a'maa wal-asammi wal-baseeri was-samee', hal yastawiyaani mathalaa, afalaa tadhakkaroon
map.11:25: Walaqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee innee lakum nadheerum mubeen
map.11:26: Al laa ta'budoo illallaah, innee akhaafu 'alaykum 'adhaaba yawmin aleem
map.11:27: Faqaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihee maa naraaka illaa basharam mithlanaa wamaa naraakattaba'aka illal-ladheena hum araadhilunaa baadiyar-ra'y, wamaa naraa lakum 'alaynaa min fadlim bal nazunnukum kaadhibeen
map.11:28: Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee wa'aataanee rahmatam min 'indihee fa'ummiyat 'alaykum, anulzimukumoohaa wa'antum lahaa kaarihoon
map.11:29: Wayaaqawmi laa as'alukum 'alayhi maalaa, in ajriya illaa 'alallaahi wamaa ana bitaaridil-ladheena aamanoo, innahum mulaaqoo rabbihim walaakinnee araakum qawman tajhaloon
map.11:30: Wayaaqawmi may yansurunee minallaahi in tarattuhum, afalaa tadhakkaroon
map.11:31: Walaa aqoolu lakum 'indee khazaa'inullaahi walaa a'lamul-ghayba walaa aqoolu innee malakuw walaa aqoolu lilladheena tazdaree a'yunukum lay yu'tiyahumullaahu khayraa, allaahu a'lamu bimaa fee anfusihim, innee idhal laminaz-zaalimeen
map.11:32: Qaaloo yaanoohu qad jaadaltanaa fa'aktharta jidaalanaa fa'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.11:33: Qaala innamaa ya'teekum bihillaahu in shaa'a wamaa antum bimu'jizeen
map.11:34: Walaa yanfa'ukum nushee in arattu an ansaha lakum in kaanallaahu yureedu ay yughwiyakum, huwa rabbukum, wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.11:35: Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul iniftaraytuhoo fa'alayya ijraamee wa'ana baree'um mimmaa tujrimoon
map.11:36: Wa'oohiya ilaa noohin annahoo lay yu'mina min qawmika illaa man qad aamana falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo yaf'aloon
map.11:37: Wasna'il-fulka bi'a'yuninaa wawahyinaa walaa tukhaatibnee fil-ladheena zalamoo, innahum mughraqoon
map.11:38: Wayasna'ul-fulk, wakullamaa marra 'alayhi mala'um min qawmihee sakhiroo minh, qaala in taskharoo minnaa fa'innaa naskharu minkum kamaa taskharoon
map.11:39: Fasawfa ta'lamoona may ya'teehi 'adhaabuy yukhzeehi wayahillu 'alayhi 'adhaabum muqeem
map.11:40: Hattaa idhaa jaa'a amrunaa wafaarat-tannooru qulnahmil feehaa min kullin zawjaynithnayni wa'ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alayhil-qawlu waman aaman, wamaa aamana ma'ahoo illaa qaleel
map.11:41: Waqaalarkaboo feehaa bismillaahi majrayhaa wamursaahaa, inna rabbee laghafoorur raheem
map.11:42: Wahiya tajree bihim fee mawjin kal-jibaal, wanaadaa noohunibnahoo wakaana fee ma'ziliy yaabunayyarkam ma'anaa walaa takum ma'al-kaafireen
map.11:43: Qaala sa'aawee ilaa jabaliy ya'simunee minal-maa', qaala laa 'aasimal-yawma min amrillaahi illaa mar rahim, wahaala baynahumal-mawju fakaana minal-mughraqeen
map.11:44: Waqeela yaa ardubla'ee maa'aki wayaasamaa'u aqli'ee wagheedal-maa'u waqudiyal-amru wastawat 'alal-joodiyyi waqeela bu'dal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.11:45: Wanaadaa noohur rabbahoo faqaala rabbi innabnee min ahlee, wa'inna wa'dakal-haqqu wa'anta ahkamul-haakimeen
map.11:46: Qaala yaanoohu innahoo laysa min ahlik, innahoo 'amalun ghayru saalihin falaa tas'alni maa laysa laka bihee 'ilm, innee a'izuka an takoona minal-jaahileen
map.11:47: Qaala rabbi innee a'oodhu bika an as'alaka maa laysa lee bihee 'ilm, wa'illaa taghfir lee watarhamnee akum minal-khaasireen
map.11:48: Qeela yaanoohuhbit bisalaamim minnaa wabarakaatin 'alayka wa'alaa umamim mimmam ma'ak, wa'umamun sanumatti'uhum thumma yamassuhum minnaa 'adhaabun aleem
map.11:49: Tilka min ambaa'il-ghaybi nooheehaa ilayk, maa kunta ta'lamuhaa anta walaa qawmuka min qabli haadhaa, fasbir, innal-'aaqibata lil-muttaqeen
map.11:50: Wa'ilaa 'aadin akhaahum hoodaa, qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, in antum illaa muftaroon
map.11:51: Yaaqawmi laa as'alukum 'alayhi ajraa, in ajriya illaa 'alal-ladhee fataranee, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.11:52: Wayaaqawmistaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayhi yursilis-samaa'a 'alaykum midraaraw wayazidkum quwwatan ilaa quwwatikum walaa tatawallaw mujrimeen
map.11:53: Qaaloo yaahoodu maa ji'tanaa bibayyinatiw wamaa nahnu bitaarikee aalihatinaa 'an qawlika wamaa nahnu laka bimu'mineen
map.11:54: In naqoolu illa'taraaka ba'du aalihatinaa bisoo', qaala innee ushhidullaaha washhadoo annee baree'um mimmaa tushrikoon
map.11:55: Min doonihee fakeedoonee jamee'an thumma laa tunziroon
map.11:56: Innee tawakkaltu 'alallaahi rabbee warabbikum, maa min daabbatin illaa huwa aakhidhum binaasiyatihaa, inna rabbee 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.11:57: Fa'in tawallaw faqad ablaghtukum maa ursiltu bihee ilaykum, wayastakhlifu rabbee qawman ghayrakum, walaa tadurroonahoo shay'aa, inna rabbee 'alaa kulli shay'in hafeez
map.11:58: Walammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa hoodaw wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa, wanajjaynaahum min 'adhaabin ghaleez
map.11:59: Watilka 'aad, jahadoo bi'aayaati rabbihim wa'asaw rusulahoo wattaba'oo amra kulli jabbaarin 'aneed
map.11:60: Wa'utbi'oo fee haadhihid-dunyaa la'nataw wayawmal-qiyaamah, alaa inna 'aadan kafaroo rabbahum, alaa bu'dal li'aadin qawmi hood
map.11:61: Wa'ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihaa, qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, huwa ansha'akum minal-ardi wasta'marakum feehaa fastaghfiroohu thumma tooboo ilayh, inna rabbee qareebum mujeeb
map.11:62: Qaaloo yaasaalihu qad kunta feenaa marjuwwan qabla haadhaa atanhaanaa an na'buda maa ya'budu aabaa'unaa wa'innanaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad'oonaa ilayhi mureeb
map.11:63: Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee, wa'aataanee minhu rahmatan famay yansurunee minallaahi in 'asaytuh, famaa tazeedoonanee ghayra takhseer
map.11:64: Wayaaqawmi haadhihee naaqatullaahi lakum aayatan fadharoohaa ta'kul fee ardillaahi walaa tamassoohaa bisoo'in faya'khudhakum 'adhaabun qareeb
map.11:65: Fa'aqaroohaa faqaala tamatta'oo fee daarikum thalaathata ayyaam, dhaalika wa'dun ghayru makdhoob
map.11:66: Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa saalihaw wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa wamin khizyi yawmi'idh, inna rabbaka huwal-qawiyyul-'azeez
map.11:67: Wa'akhadhal-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa'asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
map.11:68: Ka'al lam yaghnaw feehaa, alaa inna thamooda kafaroo rabbahum, alaa bu'dal lithamood
map.11:69: Walaqad jaa'at rusulunaa ibraaheema bil-bushraa qaaloo salaamaa, qaala salaamun famaa labitha an jaa'a bi'ijlin haneedh
map.11:70: Falammaa ra'aa aydiyahum laa tasilu ilayhi nakirahum wa'awjasa minhum kheefah, qaaloo laa takhaf innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmi loot
map.11:71: Wamra'atuhoo qaa'imatun fadahikat fabashsharnaahaa bi'ishaaqa wamiw waraa'i ishaaqa ya'qoob
map.11:72: Qaalat yaawaylataa a'alidu wa'ana 'ajoozuw wahaadhaa ba'lee shaykhaa, inna haadhaa lashay'un 'ajeeb
map.11:73: Qaaloo ata'jabeena min amrillaahi rahmatullaahi wabarakaatuhoo 'alaykum ahlal-bayt, innahoo hameedum majeed
map.11:74: Falammaa dhahaba 'an ibraaheemar-raw'u wajaa'athul-bushraa yujaadilunaa fee qawmi loot
map.11:76: Yaa ibraaheemu a'rid 'an haadhaa, innahoo qad jaa'a amru rabbik, wa'innahum aateehim 'adhaabun ghayru mardood
map.11:77: Walammaa jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wadaaqa bihim dhar'aw waqaala haadhaa yawmun 'aseeb
map.11:78: Wajaa'ahoo qawmuhoo yuhra'oona ilayh, wamin qablu kaanoo ya'maloonas-sayyi'aat, qaala yaaqawmi haa'ulaa'i banaatee hunna atharu lakum fattaqullaaha walaa tukhzooni fee dayfee, alaysa minkum rajulur rasheed
map.11:79: Qaaloo laqad 'alimta maa lanaa fee banaatika min haqq, wa'innaka lata'lamu maa nureed
map.11:80: Qaala law anna lee bikum quwwatan aw aawee ilaa ruknin shadeed
map.11:81: Qaaloo yaalootu innaa rusulu rabbika lay yasiloo ilayka fa'asri bi'ahlika biqit'im minal-layli walaa yaltafit minkum ahadun illamra'atak, innahoo museebuhaa maa asaabahum, inna maw'idahumus-subh, alaysas-subhu biqareeb
map.11:82: Falammaa jaa'a amrunaa ja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa'amtarnaa 'alayhaa hijaaratam min sijjeelim mandood
map.11:83: Musawwamatan 'inda rabbik, wamaa hiya minaz-zaalimeena biba'eed
map.11:84: Wa'ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'aybaa, qaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, walaa tanqusul-mikyaala wal-meezaana innee araakum bikhayriw wa'innee akhaafu 'alaykum 'adhaaba yawmim muheet
map.11:85: Wayaaqawmi awful-mikyaala wal-meezaana bil-qisti walaa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
map.11:86: Baqiyyatullaahi khayrul lakum in kuntum mu'mineen, wamaa ana 'alaykum bihafeez
map.11:87: Qaaloo yaashu'aybu asalaatuka ta'muruka an natruka maa ya'budu aabaa'unaa aw an naf'ala fee amwaalinaa maa nashaa', innaka la'antal-haleemur-rasheed
