map.11:88: Qaala yaaqawmi ara'aytum in kuntu 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbee warazaqanee minhu rizqan hasanaw wamaa ureedu an ukhaalifakum ilaa maa anhaakum 'anh, in ureedu illal-islaaha mastata't, wamaa tawfeeqee illaa billaah, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa'ilayhi uneeb
map.11:89: Wayaaqawmi laa yajrimannakum shiqaaqee ay yuseebakum mithlu maa asaaba qawma noohin aw qawma hoodin aw qawma saalih, wamaa qawmu lootim minkum biba'eed
map.11:90: Wastaghfiroo rabbakum thumma tooboo ilayh, inna rabbee raheemuw wadood
map.11:91: Qaaloo yaashu'aybu maa nafqahu katheeram mimmaa taqoolu wa'innaa lanaraaka feenaa da'eefaa, walawlaa rahtuka larajamnaak, wamaa anta 'alaynaa bi'azeez
map.11:92: Qaala yaaqawmi arahtee a'azzu 'alaykum minallaah, wattakhadhtumoohu waraa'akum zihriyyaa, inna rabbee bimaa ta'maloona muheet
map.11:93: Wayaaqawmi'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamil, sawfa ta'lamoona may ya'teehi 'adhaabuy yukhzeehi waman huwa kaadhib, wartaqiboo innee ma'akum raqeeb
map.11:94: Walammaa jaa'a amrunaa najjaynaa shu'aybaw wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo birahmatim minnaa, wa'akhadhatil-ladheena zalamus-sayhatu fa'asbahoo fee diyaarihim jaathimeen
map.11:95: Ka'al lam yaghnaw feehaa, alaa bu'dal limadyana kamaa ba'idat thamood
map.11:96: Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa wasultaanim mubeen
map.11:97: Ilaa fir'awna wamala'ihee fattaba'oo amra fir'awn, wamaa amru fir'awna birasheed
map.11:99: Wa'utbi'oo fee haadhihee la'nataw wayawmal-qiyaamah, bi'sar-rifdul-marfood
map.11:100: Dhaalika min ambaa'il-quraa naqussuhoo 'alayka minhaa qaa'imuw wahaseed
map.11:101: Wamaa zalamnaahum walaakin zalamoo anfusahum famaa aghnat 'anhum aalihatuhumul-latee yad'oona min doonillaahi min shay'il lammaa jaa'a amru rabbik, wamaa zaadoohum ghayra tatbeeb
map.11:102: Wakadhaalika akhdhu rabbika idhaa akhadhal-quraa wahiya zaalimah, inna akhdhahoo aleemun shadeed
map.11:103: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liman khaafa 'adhaabal-aakhirah, dhaalika yawmum majmoo'ul lahun-naasu wadhaalika yawmum mashhood
map.11:105: Yawma ya'ti laa takallamu nafsun illaa bi'idhnih, faminhum shaqiyyuw wasa'eed
map.11:106: Fa'ammal-ladheena shaqoo fafin-naari lahum feehaa zafeeruw washaheeq
map.11:107: Khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuk, inna rabbaka fa''aalul limaa yureed
map.11:108: Wa'ammal-ladheena su'idoo fafil-jannati khaalideena feehaa maa daamatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu illaa maa shaa'a rabbuk, 'ataa'an ghayra majdhoodh
map.11:109: Falaa taku fee miryatim mimmaa ya'budu haa'ulaa', maa ya'budoona illaa kamaa ya'budu aabaa'uhum min qabl, wa'innaa lamuwaffoohum naseebahum ghayra manqoos
map.11:110: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feeh, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum, wa'innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
map.11:111: Wa'inna kullal lammaa layuwaffiyannahum rabbuka a'maalahum, innahoo bimaa ya'maloona khabeer
map.11:112: Fastaqim kamaa umirta waman taaba ma'aka walaa tatghaw, innahoo bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.11:113: Walaa tarkanoo ilal-ladheena zalamoo fatamassakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min doonillaahi min awliyaa'a thumma laa tunsaroon
map.11:114: Wa'aqimis-salaata tarafayin-nahaari wazulafam minal-layl, innal-hasanaati yudhhibnas-sayyi'aat, dhaalika dhikraa lidh-dhaakireen
map.11:116: Falawlaa kaana minal-qurooni min qablikum uloo baqiyyatiy yanhawna 'anil-fasaadi fil-ardi illaa qaleelam mimman anjaynaa minhum, wattaba'al-ladheena zalamoo maa utrifoo feehi wakaanoo mujrimeen
map.11:117: Wamaa kaana rabbuka liyuhlikal-quraa bizulmiw wa'ahluhaa muslihoon
map.11:118: Walaw shaa'a rabbuka laja'alan-naasa ummataw waahidataw walaa yazaaloona mukhtalifeen
map.11:119: Illaa mar rahima rabbuk, walidhaalika khalaqahum, watammat kalimatu rabbika la'amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma'een
map.11:120: Wakullan naqussu 'alayka min ambaa'ir-rusuli maa nuthabbitu bihee fu'aadaka wajaa'aka fee haadhihil-haqqu wamaw'izatuw wadhikraa lil-mu'mineen
map.11:121: Waqul lilladheena laa yu'minoona'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum, innaa 'aamiloon
map.11:123: Walillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa'ilayhi yurja'ul-amru kulluhoo fa'budhu watawakkal 'alayh, wamaa rabbuka bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
map.12:3: Nahnu naqussu 'alayka ahsanal-qasasi bimaa awhaynaa ilayka haadhal-qur'aan, wa'in kunta min qablihee laminal-ghaafileen
map.12:4: Idh qaala yoosufu li'abeehi yaa abati innee ra'aytu ahada 'ashara kawkabaw wash-shamsa wal-qamara ra'aytuhum lee saajideen
map.12:5: Qaala yaabunayya laa taqsus ru'yaaka 'alaa ikhwatika fayakeedoo laka kaydaa, innash-shaytaana lil-insaani 'aduwwum mubeen
map.12:6: Wakadhaalika yajtabeeka rabbuka wayu'allimuka min ta'weelil-ahaadeethi wayutimmu ni'matahoo 'alayka wa'alaa aali ya'qooba kamaa atammahaa 'alaa abawayka min qablu ibraaheema wa'ishaaq, inna rabbaka 'aleemun hakeem
map.12:7: Laqad kaana fee yoosufa wa'ikhwatihee aayaatul lis-saa'ileen
map.12:8: Idh qaaloo layoosufu wa'akhoohu ahabbu ilaa abeenaa minnaa wanahnu 'usbah, inna abaanaa lafee dalaalim mubeen
map.12:9: Uqtuloo yoosufa awitrahoohu arday yakhlu lakum wajhu abeekum watakoonoo mim ba'dihee qawman saaliheen
map.12:10: Qaala qaa'ilum minhum laa taqtuloo yoosufa wa'alqoohu fee ghayaabatil-jubbi yaltaqithu ba'dus-sayyaarati in kuntum faa'ileen
map.12:11: Qaaloo yaa abaanaa maa laka laa ta'mannaa 'alaa yoosufa wa'innaa lahoo lanaasihoon
map.12:12: Arsilhu ma'anaa ghaday yarta' wayal'ab wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
map.12:13: Qaala innee layahzununee an tadhhaboo bihee wa'akhaafu ay ya'kulahudh-dhi'bu wa'antum 'anhu ghaafiloon
map.12:14: Qaaloo la'in akalahudh-dhi'bu wanahnu 'usbatun innaa idhal lakhaasiroon
map.12:15: Falammaa dhahaboo bihee wa'ajma'oo ay yaj'aloohu fee ghayaabatil-jubb, wa'awhaynaa ilayhi latunabbi'annahum bi'amrihim haadhaa wahum laa yash'uroon
map.12:17: Qaaloo yaa abaanaa innaa dhahabnaa nastabiqu wataraknaa yoosufa 'inda mataa'inaa fa'akalahudh-dhi'b, wamaa anta bimu'minil lanaa walaw kunnaa saadiqeen
map.12:18: Wajaa'oo 'alaa qameesihee bidamin kadhib, qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amraa, fasabrun jameel, wallaahul-musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon
map.12:19: Wajaa'at sayyaaratun fa'arsaloo waaridahum fa'adlaa dalwah, qaala yaabushraa haadhaa ghulaam, wa'asarroohu bidaa'ah, wallaahu 'aleemum bimaa ya'maloon
map.12:20: Washarawhu bithamanim bakhsin daraahima ma'doodah, wakaanoo feehi minaz-zaahideen
map.12:21: Waqaalal-ladhishtaraahu mim misra limra'atihee akrimee mathwaahu 'asaa ay yanfa'anaa aw nattakhidhahoo waladaa, wakadhaalika makkannaa liyoosufa fil-ard, walinu'allimahoo min ta'weelil-ahaadeeth, wallaahu ghaalibun 'alaa amrihee walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.12:22: Walammaa balagha ashuddahoo aataynaahu hukmaw wa'ilmaa, wakadhaalika najzil-muhsineen
map.12:23: Waraawadathul-latee huwa fee baytihaa 'an nafsihee waghallaqatil-abwaaba waqaalat hayta lak, qaala ma'aadhallaahi innahoo rabbee ahsana mathwaay, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
map.12:24: Walaqad hammat bihee wahamma bihaa, lawlaa ar ra'aa burhaana rabbih, kadhaalika linasrifa 'anhus-soo'a wal-fahshaa', innahoo min 'ibaadinal-mukhlaseen
map.12:25: Wastabaqal-baaba waqaddat qameesahoo min duburiw wa'alfayaa sayyidahaa ladal-baab, qaalat maa jazaa'u man araada bi'ahlika soo'an illaa ay yusjana aw 'adhaabun aleem
map.12:26: Qaala hiya raawadatnee 'an nafsee washahida shaahidum min ahlihaa, in kaana qameesuhoo qudda min qubulin fasadaqat wahuwa minal-kaadhibeen
map.12:27: Wa'in kaana qameesuhoo qudda min duburin fakadhabat wahuwa minas-saadiqeen
map.12:28: Falammaa ra'aa qameesahoo qudda min duburin qaala innahoo min kaydikunn, inna kaydakunna 'azeem
map.12:29: Yoosufu a'rid 'an haadhaa wastaghfiree lidhambik, innaki kunti minal-khaati'een
map.12:30: Waqaala niswatun fil-madeenatimra'atul-'azeezi turaawidu fataahaa 'an nafsih, qad shaghafahaa hubbaa, innaa lanaraahaa fee dalaalim mubeen
map.12:31: Falammaa sami'at bimakrihinna arsalat ilayhinna wa'a'tadat lahunna muttaka'aw wa'aatat kulla waahidatim minhunna sikkeenaw waqaalatikhruj 'alayhinn, falammaa ra'aynahoo akbarnahoo waqatta'na aydiyahunn, waqulna haasha lillaahi maa haadhaa basharaa, in haadhaa illaa malakun kareem
map.12:32: Qaalat fadhaalikunnal-ladhee lumtunnanee feeh, walaqad raawattuhoo 'an nafsihee fasta'sam, wala'il lam yaf'al maa aamuruhoo layusjananna walayakoonam minas-saaghireen
map.12:33: Qaala rabbis-sijnu ahabbu ilayya mimmaa yad'oonanee ilayh, wa'illaa tasrif 'annee kaydahunna asbu ilayhinna wa'akum minal-jaahileen
map.12:34: Fastajaaba lahoo rabbuhoo fasarafa 'anhu kaydahunn, innahoo huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.12:35: Thumma badaa lahum mim ba'di maa ra'awul-aayaati layasjununnahoo hattaa heen
map.12:36: Wadakhala ma'ahus-sijna fatayaan, qaala ahaduhumaa innee araanee a'siru khamraa, waqaalal-aakharu innee araanee ahmilu fawqa ra'see khubzan ta'kulut-tayru minh, nabbi'naa bita'weelih, innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen
map.12:37: Qaala laa ya'teekumaa ta'aamun turzaqaanihee illaa nabba'tukumaa bita'weelihee qabla ay ya'tiyakumaa, dhaalikumaa mimmaa 'allamanee rabbee, innee taraktu millata qawmil laa yu'minoona billaahi wahum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
map.12:38: Wattaba'tu millata aabaa'ee ibraaheema wa'ishaaqa waya'qoob, maa kaana lanaa an nushrika billaahi min shay', dhaalika min fadlillaahi 'alaynaa wa'alan-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
map.12:40: Maa ta'budoona min doonihee illaa asmaa'an sammaytumoohaa antum wa'aabaa'ukum maa anzalallaahu bihaa min sultaan, inil-hukmu illaa lillaah, amara allaa ta'budoo illaa iyyaah, dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.12:41: Yaasaahibayis-sijni ammaa ahadukumaa fayasqee rabbahoo khamraa, wa'ammal-aakharu fayuslabu fata'kulut-tayru mir ra'sih, qudiyal-amrul-ladhee feehi tastaftiyaan
map.12:42: Waqaala lilladhee zanna annahoo naajim minhumadhkurnee 'inda rabbik, fa'ansaahush-shaytaanu dhikra rabbihee falabitha fis-sijni bid'a sineen
map.12:43: Waqaalal-maliku innee araa sab'a baqaraatin simaaniy ya'kuluhunna sab'un 'ijaafuw wasab'a sumbulaatin khudriw wa'ukhara yaabisaat, yaa ayyuhal-mala'u aftoonee fee ru'yaaya in kuntum lir-ru'yaa ta'buroon
map.12:44: Qaaloo adghaathu ahlaam, wamaa nahnu bita'weelil-ahlaami bi'aalimeen
map.12:45: Waqaalal-ladhee najaa minhumaa waddakara ba'da ummatin ana unabbi'ukum bita'weelihee fa'arsiloon
map.12:46: Yoosufu ayyuhas-siddeequ aftinaa fee sab'i baqaraatin simaaniy ya'kuluhunna sab'un 'ijaafuw wasab'i sumbulaatin khudriw wa'ukhara yaabisaatil la'allee arji'u ilan-naasi la'allahum ya'lamoon
map.12:47: Qaala tazra'oona sab'a sineena da'abaa, famaa hasattum fadharoohu fee sumbulihee illaa qaleelam mimmaa ta'kuloon
map.12:48: Thumma ya'tee mim ba'di dhaalika sab'un shidaaduy ya'kulna maa qaddamtum lahunna illaa qaleelam mimmaa tuhsinoon
map.12:49: Thumma ya'tee mim ba'di dhaalika 'aamun feehi yughaathun-naasu wafeehi ya'siroon
map.12:50: Waqaalal-maliku'toonee bih, falammaa jaa'ahur-rasoolu qaalarji' ilaa rabbika fas'alhu maa baalun-niswatillaatee qatta'na aydiyahunn, inna rabbee bikaydihinna 'aleem
map.12:51: Qaala maa khatbukunna idh raawattunna yoosufa 'an nafsih, qulna haasha lillaahi maa 'alimnaa 'alayhi min soo', qaalatimra'atul-'azeezil-aana hashasal-haqq, ana raawattuhoo 'an nafsihee wa'innahoo laminas-saadiqeen
map.12:52: Dhaalika liya'lama annee lam akhunhu bil-ghaybi wa'annallaaha laa yahdee kaydal-khaa'ineen
map.12:53: Wamaa ubarri'u nafsee, innan-nafsa la'ammaaratum bis-soo'i illaa maa rahima rabbee, inna rabbee ghafoorur raheem
map.12:54: Waqaalal-maliku'toonee bihee astakhlishu linafsee, falammaa kallamahoo qaala innakal-yawma ladaynaa makeenun ameen
map.12:56: Wakadhaalika makkannaa liyoosufa fil-ardi yatabawwa'u minhaa haythu yashaa', nuseebu birahmatinaa man nashaa'u walaa nudee'u ajral-muhsineen
map.12:57: Wala'ajrul-aakhirati khayrul lilladheena aamanoo wakaanoo yattaqoon
map.12:58: Wajaa'a ikhwatu yoosufa fadakhaloo 'alayhi fa'arafahum wahum lahoo munkiroon
map.12:59: Walammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim qaala'toonee bi'akhil lakum min abeekum, alaa tarawna annee oofil-kayla wa'ana khayrul-munzileen
map.12:60: Fa'il lam ta'toonee bihee falaa kayla lakum 'indee walaa taqraboon
map.12:62: Waqaala lifityaanihij'aloo bidaa'atahum fee rihaalihim la'allahum ya'rifoonahaa idhanqalaboo ilaa ahlihim la'allahum yarji'oon
map.12:63: Falammaa raja'oo ilaa abeehim qaaloo yaa abaanaa muni'a minnal-kaylu fa'arsil ma'anaa akhaanaa naktal wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
map.12:64: Qaala hal aamanukum 'alayhi illaa kamaa amintukum 'alaa akheehi min qabl, fallaahu khayrun haafizaw wahuwa arhamur-raahimeen
map.12:65: Walammaa fatahoo mataa'ahum wajadoo bidaa'atahum ruddat ilayhim, qaaloo yaa abaanaa maa nabghee, haadhihee bidaa'atunaa ruddat ilaynaa wanameeru ahlanaa wanahfazu akhaanaa wanazdaadu kayla ba'eer, dhaalika kayluy yaseer
map.12:66: Qaala lan ursilahoo ma'akum hattaa tu'tooni mawthiqam minallaahi lata'tunnanee bihee illaa ay yuhaata bikum, falammaa aatawhu mawthiqahum qaalallaahu 'alaa maa naqoolu wakeel
map.12:67: Waqaala yaabaniyya laa tadkhuloo mim baabiw waahidiw wadkhuloo min abwaabim mutafarriqah, wamaa ughnee 'ankum minallaahi min shay', inil-hukmu illaa lillaah, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa'alayhi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkiloon
map.12:68: Walammaa dakhaloo min haythu amarahum aboohum, maa kaana yughnee 'anhum minallaahi min shay'in illaa haajatan fee nafsi ya'qooba qadaahaa, wa'innahoo ladhoo 'ilmil limaa 'allamnaahu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.12:69: Walammaa dakhaloo 'alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi akhaahu qaala innee ana akhooka falaa tabta'is bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.12:70: Falammaa jahhazahum bijahaazihim ja'alas-siqaayata fee rahli akheehi thumma adhdhana mu'adhdhinun ayyatuhal-'eeru innakum lasaariqoon
map.12:72: Qaaloo nafqidu suwaa'al-maliki waliman jaa'a bihee himlu ba'eeriw wa'ana bihee za'eem
map.12:73: Qaaloo tallaahi laqad 'alimtum maa ji'naa linufsida fil-ardi wamaa kunnaa saariqeen
map.12:74: Qaaloo famaa jazaa'uhoo in kuntum kaadhibeen
map.12:75: Qaaloo jazaa'uhoo maw wujida fee rahlihee fahuwa jazaa'uh, kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
map.12:76: Fabada'a bi'aw'iyatihim qabla wi'aa'i akheehi thummastakhrajahaa miw wi'aa'i akheeh, kadhaalika kidnaa liyoosuf, maa kaana liya'khudha akhaahu fee deenil-maliki illaa ay yashaa'allaah, narfa'u darajaatim man nashaa', wafawqa kulli dhee 'ilmin 'aleem
map.12:77: Qaaloo iy yasriq faqad saraqa akhul lahoo min qabl, fa'asarrahaa yoosufu fee nafsihee walam yubdihaa lahum, qaala antum sharrum makaanaa, wallaahu a'lamu bimaa tasifoon
map.12:78: Qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-'azeezu inna lahoo aban shaykhan kabeeran fakhudh ahadanaa makaanah, innaa naraaka minal-muhsineen
map.12:79: Qaala ma'aadhallaahi an na'khudha illaa maw wajadnaa mataa'anaa 'indahoo innaa idhal lazaalimoon
map.12:80: Falammastay'asoo minhu khalasoo najiyyaa, qaala kabeeruhum alam ta'lamoo anna abaakum qad akhadha 'alaykum mawthiqam minallaahi wamin qablu maa farrattum fee yoosufa falan abrahal-arda hattaa ya'dhana lee abee aw yahkumallaahu lee, wahuwa khayrul-haakimeen
map.12:81: Irji'oo ilaa abeekum faqooloo yaa abaanaa innabnaka saraq, wamaa shahidnaa illaa bimaa 'alimnaa wamaa kunnaa lil-ghaybi haafizeen
map.12:82: Was'alil-qaryatal-latee kunnaa feehaa wal-'eeral-latee aqbalnaa feehaa, wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
map.12:83: Qaala bal sawwalat lakum anfusukum amraa, fasabrun jameel, 'asallaahu ay ya'tiyanee bihim jamee'aa, innahoo huwal-'aleemul-hakeem
map.12:84: Watawallaa 'anhum waqaala yaa asafaa 'alaa yoosufa wabyaddat 'aynaahu minal-huzni fahuwa kazeem
map.12:85: Qaaloo tallaahi tafta'u tadhkuru yoosufa hattaa takoona haradan aw takoona minal-haalikeen
map.12:86: Qaala innamaa ashkoo baththee wahuznee ilallaahi wa'a'lamu minallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.12:87: Yaabaniyyadhhaboo fatahassasoo miy yoosufa wa'akheehi walaa tay'asoo mir rawhillaah, innahoo laa yay'asu mir rawhillaahi illal-qawmul-kaafiroon
map.12:88: Falammaa dakhaloo 'alayhi qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-'azeezu massanaa wa'ahlanad-durru waji'naa bibidaa'atim muzjaatin fa'awfi lanal-kayla watasaddaq 'alaynaa, innallaaha yajzil-mutasaddiqeen
map.12:89: Qaala hal 'alimtum maa fa'altum biyoosufa wa'akheehi idh antum jaahiloon
map.12:90: Qaaloo a'innaka la'anta yoosuf, qaala ana yoosufu wahaadhaa akhee qad mannallaahu 'alaynaa, innahoo may yattaqi wayasbir fa'innallaaha laa yudee'u ajral-muhsineen
map.12:91: Qaaloo tallaahi laqad aatharakallaahu 'alaynaa wa'in kunnaa lakhaati'een
map.12:92: Qaala laa tathreeba 'alaykumul-yawm, yaghfirullaahu lakum, wahuwa arhamur-raahimeen
map.12:93: Idhhaboo biqameesee haadhaa fa'alqoohu 'alaa wajhi abee ya'ti baseeraa, wa'toonee bi'ahlikum ajma'een
map.12:94: Walammaa fasalatil-'eeru qaala aboohum innee la'ajidu reeha yoosufa lawlaa an tufannidoon
map.12:96: Falammaa an jaa'al-basheeru alqaahu 'alaa wajhihee fartadda baseeraa, qaala alam aqul lakum innee a'lamu minallaahi maa laa ta'lamoon
map.12:97: Qaaloo yaa abaanastaghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa innaa kunnaa khaati'een
map.12:98: Qaala sawfa astaghfiru lakum rabbee, innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
map.12:99: Falammaa dakhaloo 'alaa yoosufa aawaa ilayhi abawayhi waqaaladkhuloo misra in shaa'allaahu aamineen
map.12:100: Warafa'a abawayhi 'alal-'arshi wakharroo lahoo sujjadaa, waqaala yaa abati haadhaa ta'weelu ru'yaaya min qabl, qad ja'alahaa rabbee haqqaa, waqad ahsana bee idh akhrajanee minas-sijni wajaa'a bikum minal-badwi mim ba'di an nazaghash-shaytaanu baynee wabayna ikhwatee, inna rabbee lateeful limaa yashaa', innahoo huwal-'aleemul-hakeem
map.12:101: Rabbi qad aataytanee minal-mulki wa'allamtanee min ta'weelil-ahaadeeth, faatiras-samaawaati wal-ard, anta waliyyee fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, tawaffanee muslimaw wa'alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
map.12:102: Dhaalika min ambaa'il-ghaybi nooheehi ilayk, wamaa kunta ladayhim idh ajma'oo amrahum wahum yamkuroon
map.12:104: Wamaa tas'aluhum 'alayhi min ajr, in huwa illaa dhikrul lil-'aalameen
map.12:105: Waka'ayyim min aayatin fis-samaawaati wal-ardi yamurroona 'alayhaa wahum 'anhaa mu'ridoon
map.12:106: Wamaa yu'minu aktharuhum billaahi illaa wahum mushrikoon
map.12:107: Afa'aminoo an ta'tiyahum ghaashiyatum min 'adhaabillaahi aw ta'tiyahumus-saa'atu baghtataw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.12:108: Qul haadhihee sabeelee ad'oo ilallaah, 'alaa baseeratin ana wamanittaba'anee, wasubhaanallaahi wamaa ana minal-mushrikeen
map.12:109: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim min ahlil-quraa, afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, waladaarul-aakhirati khayrul lilladheenattaqaw, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.12:110: Hattaa idhastay'asar-rusulu wazannoo annahum qad kudhiboo jaa'ahum nasrunaa fanujjiya man nashaa', walaa yuraddu ba'sunaa 'anil-qawmil-mujrimeen
map.12:111: Laqad kaana fee qasasihim 'ibratul li'ulil-albaab, maa kaana hadeethay yuftaraa walaakin tasdeeqal-ladhee bayna yadayhi watafseela kulli shay'iw wahudaw warahmatal liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.13:1: Alif laam meem raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaab, wal-ladhee unzila ilayka mir rabbikal-haqqu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
map.13:2: Allaahul-ladhee rafa'as-samaawaati bighayri 'amadin tarawnahaa thummastawaa 'alal-'arshi wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamar, kulluy yajree li'ajalim musammaa, yudabbirul-amra yufassilul-aayaati la'allakum biliqaa'i rabbikum tooqinoon
map.13:3: Wahuwal-ladhee maddal-arda waja'ala feehaa rawaasiya wa'anhaaraa, wamin kullith-thamaraati ja'ala feehaa zawjaynithnayni yughshil-laylan-nahaar, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.13:4: Wafil-ardi qita'um mutajaawiraatuw wajannaatum min a'naabiw wazar'uw wanakheelun sinwaanuw waghayru sinwaaniy yusqaa bimaa'iw waahidiw wanufaddilu ba'dahaa 'alaa ba'din fil-ukul, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.13:5: Wa'in ta'jab fa'ajabun qawluhum a'idhaa kunnaa turaaban a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeed, ulaa'ikal-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim, wa'ulaa'ikal-aghlaalu fee a'naaqihim, wa'ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.13:6: Wayasta'jiloonaka bis-sayyi'ati qablal-hasanati waqad khalat min qablihimul-mathulaat, wa'inna rabbaka ladhoo maghfiratil lin-naasi 'alaa zulmihim, wa'inna rabbaka lashadeedul-'iqaab
map.13:7: Wayaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa unzila 'alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, innamaa anta mundhiruw walikulli qawmin haad
map.13:8: Allaahu ya'lamu maa tahmilu kullu unthaa wamaa tagheedul-arhaamu wamaa tazdaad, wakullu shay'in 'indahoo bimiqdaar
map.13:10: Sawaa'um minkum man asarral-qawla waman jahara bihee waman huwa mustakhfim bil-layli wasaaribum bin-nahaar
map.13:11: Lahoo mu'aqqibaatum mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihee yahfazoonahoo min amrillaah, innallaaha laa yughayyiru maa biqawmin hattaa yughayyiroo maa bi'anfusihim, wa'idhaa araadallaahu biqawmin soo'an falaa maradda lah, wamaa lahum min doonihee miw waal
map.13:13: Wayusabbihur-ra'du bihamdihee wal-malaa'ikatu min kheefatih, wayursilus-sawaa'iqa fayuseebu bihaa may yashaa'u wahum yujaadiloona fillaah, wahuwa shadeedul-mihaal
map.13:14: Lahoo da'watul-haqq, wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonihee laa yastajeeboona lahum bishay'in illaa kabaasiti kaffayhi ilal-maa'i liyablugha faahu wamaa huwa bibaalighih, wamaa du'aa'ul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
map.13:15: Walillaahi yasjudu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi taw'aw wakarhaw wazilaaluhum bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaal
map.13:16: Qul mar rabbus-samaawaati wal-ard, qulillaah, qul afattakhadhtum min doonihee awliyaa'a laa yamlikoona li'anfusihim naf'aw walaa darraa, qul hal yastawil-a'maa wal-baseeru am hal tastawiz-zulumaatu wan-noor, am ja'aloo lillaahi shurakaa'a khalaqoo kakhalqihee fatashaabahal-khalqu 'alayhim, qulillaahu khaaliqu kulli shay'iw wahuwal-waahidul-qahhaar
map.13:17: Anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasaalat awdiyatum biqadarihaa fahtamalas-saylu zabadar raabiyaa, wamimmaa yooqidoona 'alayhi fin-naaribtighaa'a hilyatin aw mataa'in zabadum mithluh, kadhaalika yadribullaahul-haqqa wal-baatil, fa'ammaz-zabadu fayadhhabu jufaa'aa, wa'ammaa maa yanfa'un-naasa fayamkuthu fil-ard, kadhaalika yadribullaahul-amthaal
map.13:18: Lilladheenastajaaboo lirabbihimul-husnaa, wal-ladheena lam yastajeeboo lahoo law anna lahum maa fil-ardi jamee'aw wamithlahoo ma'ahoo laftadaw bih, ulaa'ika lahum soo'ul-hisaabi wama'waahum jahannam, wabi'sal-mihaad
map.13:19: Afamay ya'lamu annamaa unzila ilayka mir rabbikal-haqqu kaman huwa a'maa, innamaa yatadhakkaru ulul-albaab
map.13:21: Wal-ladheena yasiloona maa amarallaahu bihee ay yoosala wayakhshawna rabbahum wayakhaafoona soo'al-hisaab
map.13:22: Wal-ladheena sabarubtighaa'a wajhi rabbihim wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'anfaqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirraw wa'alaaniyataw wayadra'oona bil-hasanatis-sayyi'ata ulaa'ika lahum 'uqbad-daar
map.13:23: Jannaatu 'adniy yadkhuloonahaa waman salaha min aabaa'ihim wa'azwaajihim wadhurriyyaatihim wal-malaa'ikatu yadkhuloona 'alayhim min kulli baab
map.13:25: Wal-ladheena yanqudoona 'ahdallaahi mim ba'di meethaaqihee wayaqta'oona maa amarallaahu bihee ay yoosala wayufsidoona fil-ardi ulaa'ika lahumul-la'natu walahum soo'ud-daar
map.13:26: Allaahu yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, wafarihoo bil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa fil-aakhirati illaa mataa'
map.13:27: Wayaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa unzila 'alayhi aayatum mir rabbih, qul innallaaha yudillu may yashaa'u wayahdee ilayhi man anaab
map.13:28: Al-ladheena aamanoo watatma'innu quloobuhum bidhikrillaah, alaa bidhikrillaahi tatma'innul-quloob
map.13:29: Alladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati toobaa lahum wahusnu ma'aab
map.13:30: Kadhaalika arsalnaaka fee ummatin qad khalat min qablihaa umamul litatluwa 'alayhimul-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wahum yakfuroona bir-rahmaan, qul huwa rabbee laa ilaaha illaa huw, 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa'ilayhi mataab
map.13:31: Walaw anna qur'aanan suyyirat bihil-jibaalu aw qutti'at bihil-ardu aw kullima bihil-mawtaa, bal lillaahil-amru jamee'aa, afalam yay'asil-ladheena aamanoo al law yashaa'ullaahu lahadan-naasa jamee'aa, walaa yazaalul-ladheena kafaroo tuseebuhum bimaa sana'oo qaari'atun aw tahullu qareebam min daarihim hattaa ya'tiya wa'dullaah, innallaaha laa yukhliful-mee'aad
map.13:32: Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fa'amlaytu lilladheena kafaroo thumma akhadhtuhum fakayfa kaana 'iqaab
map.13:33: Afaman huwa qaa'imun 'alaa kulli nafsim bimaa kasabat, waja'aloo lillaahi shurakaa', qul sammoohum, am tunabbi'oonahoo bimaa laa ya'lamu fil-ardi am bizaahirim minal-qawl, bal zuyyina lilladheena kafaroo makruhum wasuddoo 'anis-sabeel, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
map.13:34: Lahum 'adhaabun fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wala'adhaabul-aakhirati ashaqq, wamaa lahum minallaahi miw waaq
map.13:35: Mathalul-jannatil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoon, tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, ukuluhaa daa'imuw wazilluhaa, tilka 'uqbal-ladheenattaqaw, wa'uqbal-kaafireenan-naar
map.13:36: Wal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yafrahoona bimaa unzila ilayka waminal-ahzaabi may yunkiru ba'dah, qul innamaa umirtu an a'budallaaha walaa ushrika bih, ilayhi ad'oo wa'ilayhi ma'aab
map.13:37: Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu hukman 'arabiyyaa, wala'inittaba'ta ahwaa'ahum ba'da maa jaa'aka minal-'ilmi maa laka minallaahi miw waliyyiw walaa waaq
map.13:38: Walaqad arsalnaa rusulam min qablika waja'alnaa lahum azwaajaw wadhurriyyah, wamaa kaana lirasoolin ay ya'tiya bi'aayatin illaa bi'idhnillaah, likulli ajalin kitaab
map.13:39: Yamhullaahu maa yashaa'u wayuthbit, wa'indahoo ummul-kitaab
map.13:40: Wa'im maa nuriyannaka ba'dal-ladhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'innamaa 'alaykal-balaaghu wa'alaynal-hisaab
map.13:41: Awalam yaraw annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa, wallaahu yahkumu laa mu'aqqiba lihukmih, wahuwa saree'ul-hisaab
map.13:42: Waqad makaral-ladheena min qablihim falillaahil-makru jamee'aa, ya'lamu maa taksibu kullu nafs, wasaya'lamul-kuffaaru liman 'uqbad-daar
map.13:43: Wayaqoolul-ladheena kafaroo lasta mursalaa, qul kafaa billaahi shaheedam baynee wabaynakum waman 'indahoo 'ilmul-kitaab
map.14:1: Alif laam raa, kitaabun anzalnaahu ilayka litukhrijan-naasa minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori bi'idhni rabbihim ilaa siraatil-'azeezil-hameed
map.14:2: Allaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wawaylul lil-kaafireena min 'adhaabin shadeed
map.14:3: Al-ladheena yastahibboonal-hayaatad-dunyaa 'alal-aakhirati wayasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi wayabghoonahaa 'iwajaa, ulaa'ika fee dalaalim ba'eed
map.14:4: Wamaa arsalnaa mir rasoolin illaa bilisaani qawmihee liyubayyina lahum, fayudillullaahu may yashaa'u wayahdee may yashaa', wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.14:5: Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa an akhrij qawmaka minaz-zulumaati ilan-noori wadhakkirhum bi'ayyaamillaah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
map.14:6: Wa'idh qaala moosaa liqawmihidhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum idh anjaakum min aali fir'awna yasoomoonakum soo'al-'adhaabi wayudhabbihoona abnaa'akum wayastahyoona nisaa'akum, wafee dhaalikum balaa'um mir rabbikum 'azeem
map.14:7: Wa'idh ta'adhdhana rabbukum la'in shakartum la'azeedannakum wala'in kafartum inna 'adhaabee lashadeed
map.14:8: Waqaala moosaa in takfuroo antum waman fil-ardi jamee'an fa'innallaaha laghaniyyun hameed
map.14:9: Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-ladheena min qablikum qawmi noohiw wa'aadiw wathamood, wal-ladheena mim ba'dihim, laa ya'lamuhum illallaah, jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwaahihim waqaaloo innaa kafarnaa bimaa ursiltum bihee wa'innaa lafee shakkim mimmaa tad'oonanaa ilayhi mureeb
map.14:10: Qaalat rusuluhum afillaahi shakkun faatiris-samaawaati wal-ard, yad'ookum liyaghfira lakum min dhunoobikum wayu'akhkhirakum ilaa ajalim musammaa, qaaloo in antum illaa basharum mithlunaa, tureedoona an tasuddoonaa 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaa'unaa fa'toonaa bisultaanim mubeen
map.14:11: Qaalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illaa basharum mithlukum walaakinnallaaha yamunnu 'alaa may yashaa'u min 'ibaadih, wamaa kaana lanaa an na'tiyakum bisultaanin illaa bi'idhnillaah, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.14:12: Wamaa lanaa allaa natawakkala 'alallaahi waqad hadaanaa subulanaa, walanasbiranna 'alaa maa aadhaytumoonaa, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mutawakkiloon
map.14:13: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardinaa aw lata'oodunna fee millatinaa, fa'awhaa ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikannaz-zaalimeen
map.14:14: Walanuskinannakumul-arda mim ba'dihim, dhaalika liman khaafa maqaamee wakhaafa wa'eed
map.14:16: Miw waraa'ihee jahannamu wayusqaa mim maa'in sadeed
map.14:17: Yatajarra'uhoo walaa yakaadu yuseeghuhoo waya'teehil-mawtu min kulli makaaniw wamaa huwa bimayyit, wamiw waraa'ihee 'adhaabun ghaleez
map.14:18: Mathalul-ladheena kafaroo birabbihim a'maaluhum karamaadinishtaddat bihir-reehu fee yawmin 'aasif, laa yaqdiroona mimmaa kasaboo 'alaa shay', dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba'eed
map.14:19: Alam tara annallaaha khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, iy yasha' yudhhibkum waya'ti bikhalqin jadeed
map.14:21: Wabarazoo lillaahi jamee'an faqaalad-du'afaa'u lilladheenastakbaroo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona 'annaa min 'adhaabillaahi min shay', qaaloo law hadaanallaahu lahadaynaakum, sawaa'un 'alaynaa ajazi'naa am sabarnaa maa lanaa mim mahees
map.14:22: Waqaalash-shaytaanu lammaa qudiyal-amru innallaaha wa'adakum wa'dal-haqqi wawa'attukum fa'akhlaftukum, wamaa kaana liya 'alaykum min sultaanin illaa an da'awtukum fastajabtum lee, falaa taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum, maa ana bimusrikhikum wamaa antum bimusrikhiyy, innee kafartu bimaa ashraktumooni min qabl, innaz-zaalimeena lahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.14:23: Wa'udkhilal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa bi'idhni rabbihim, tahiyyatuhum feehaa salaam
map.14:24: Alam tara kayfa daraballaahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluhaa thaabituw wafar'uhaa fis-samaa'
map.14:25: Tu'tee ukulahaa kulla heenim bi'idhni rabbihaa, wayadribullaahul-amthaala lin-naasi la'allahum yatadhakkaroon
map.14:26: Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatinijtuththat min fawqil-ardi maa lahaa min qaraar
map.14:27: Yuthabbitullaahul-ladheena aamanoo bil-qawlith-thaabiti fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wafil-aakhirah, wayudillullaahuz-zaalimeen, wayaf'alullaahu maa yashaa'
map.14:28: Alam tara ilal-ladheena baddaloo ni'matallaahi kufraw wa'ahalloo qawmahum daaral-bawaar
map.14:30: Waja'aloo lillaahi andaadal liyudilloo 'an sabeelih, qul tamatta'oo fa'inna maseerakum ilan-naar
map.14:31: Qul li'ibaadiyal-ladheena aamanoo yuqeemus-salaata wayunfiqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirraw wa'alaaniyatam min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa bay'un feehi walaa khilaal
map.14:32: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa'anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'akhraja bihee minath-thamaraati rizqal lakum, wasakhkhara lakumul-fulka litajriya fil-bahri bi'amrih, wasakhkhara lakumul-anhaar
map.14:33: Wasakhkhara lakumush-shamsa wal-qamara daa'ibayn, wasakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaar
map.14:34: Wa'aataakum min kulli maa sa'altumooh, wa'in ta'uddoo ni'matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa, innal-insaana lazaloomun kaffaar
map.14:35: Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu rabbij'al haadhal-balada aaminaw wajnubnee wabaniyya an na'budal-asnaam
map.14:36: Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeram minan-naas, faman tabi'anee fa'innahoo minnee, waman 'asaanee fa'innaka ghafoorur raheem
map.14:37: Rabbanaa innee askantu min dhurriyyatee biwaadin ghayri dhee zar'in 'inda baytikal-muharrami rabbanaa liyuqeemus-salaata faj'al af'idatam minan-naasi tahwee ilayhim warzuqhum minath-thamaraati la'allahum yashkuroon
map.14:38: Rabbanaa innaka ta'lamu maa nukhfee wamaa nu'lin, wamaa yakhfaa 'alallaahi min shay'in fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa'
map.14:39: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee wahaba lee 'alal-kibari ismaa'eela wa'ishaaq, inna rabbee lasamee'ud-du'aa'
map.14:40: Rabbij'alnee muqeemas-salaati wamin dhurriyyatee, rabbanaa wataqabbal du'aa'
map.14:41: Rabbanaghfir lee waliwaalidayya walilmu'mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab
map.14:42: Walaa tahsabannallaaha ghaafilan 'ammaa ya'maluz-zaalimoon, innamaa yu'akhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehil-absaar
map.14:43: Muhti'eena muqni'ee ru'oosihim laa yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum, wa'af'idatuhum hawaa'
map.14:44: Wa'andhirin-naasa yawma ya'teehimul-'adhaabu fayaqoolul-ladheena zalamoo rabbanaa akhkhirnaa ilaa ajalin qareebin nujib da'wataka wanattabi'ir-rusul, awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu maa lakum min zawaal
map.14:45: Wasakantum fee masaakinil-ladheena zalamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa fa'alnaa bihim wadarabnaa lakumul-amthaal
map.14:46: Waqad makaroo makrahum wa'indallaahi makruhum, wa'in kaana makruhum litazoola minhul-jibaal
map.14:47: Falaa tahsabannallaaha mukhlifa wa'dihee rusulah, innallaaha 'azeezun dhuntiqaam
map.14:48: Yawma tubaddalul-ardu ghayral-ardi was-samaawaatu wabarazoo lillaahil-waahidil-qahhaar
map.14:51: Liyajziyallaahu kulla nafsim maa kasabat, innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
map.14:52: Haadhaa balaaghul lin-naasi waliyundharoo bihee waliya'lamoo annamaa huwa ilaahuw waahiduw waliyadhdhakkara ulul-albaab
map.15:1: Alif laam raa, tilka aayaatul-kitaabi waqur'aanim mubeen
map.15:2: Rubamaa yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen
map.15:3: Dharhum ya'kuloo wayatamatta'oo wayulhihimul-amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon
map.15:4: Wamaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa walahaa kitaabum ma'loom
map.15:5: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wamaa yasta'khiroon
map.15:6: Waqaaloo yaa ayyuhal-ladhee nuzzila 'alayhidh-dhikru innaka lamajnoon
map.15:7: Lawmaa ta'teenaa bil-malaa'ikati in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.15:8: Maa nunazzilul-malaa'ikata illaa bil-haqqi wamaa kaanoo idham munzareen
map.15:9: Innaa nahnu nazzalnadh-dhikra wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
map.15:10: Walaqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il-awwaleen
map.15:11: Wamaa ya'teehim mir rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.15:13: Laa yu'minoona bihee waqad khalat sunnatul-awwaleen
map.15:14: Walaw fatahnaa 'alayhim baabam minas-samaa'i fazalloo feehi ya'rujoon
map.15:15: Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mashooroon
map.15:16: Walaqad ja'alnaa fis-samaa'i buroojaw wazayyannaahaa lin-naazireen
map.15:19: Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa'alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shay'im mawzoon
map.15:20: Waja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha wamal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen
map.15:21: Wa'im min shay'in illaa 'indanaa khazaa'inuhoo wamaa nunazziluhoo illaa biqadarim ma'loom
map.15:22: Wa'arsalnar-riyaaha lawaaqiha fa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'asqaynaakumooh, wamaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen
map.15:25: Wa'inna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum, innahoo hakeemun 'aleem
map.15:26: Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
map.15:27: Wal-jaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris-samoom
map.15:28: Wa'idh qaala rabbuka lil-malaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
map.15:29: Fa'idhaa sawwaytuhoo wanafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen
map.15:31: Illaa iblees, abaa ay yakoona ma'as-saajideen
map.15:32: Qaala yaa ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as-saajideen
map.15:33: Qaala lam akul li'asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
map.15:36: Qaala rabbi fa'anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
map.15:39: Qaala rabbi bimaa aghwaytanee la'uzayyinanna lahum fil-ardi wala'ughwiyannahum ajma'een
map.15:42: Inna 'ibaadee laysa laka 'alayhim sultaanun illaa manittaba'aka minal-ghaaween
map.15:44: Lahaa sab'atu abwaab, likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom
map.15:47: Wanaza'naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan 'alaa sururim mutaqaabileen
map.15:48: Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasabuw wamaa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen
map.15:52: Idh dakhaloo 'alayhi faqaaloo salaamaa, qaala innaa minkum wajiloon
map.15:53: Qaaloo laa tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin 'aleem
map.15:54: Qaala abashshartumoonee 'alaa am massaniyal-kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
map.15:55: Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bil-haqqi falaa takum minal-qaaniteen
map.15:56: Qaala wamay yaqnatu mir rahmati rabbihee illad-daalloon
map.15:58: Qaaloo innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
map.15:59: Illaa aala loot, innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een
map.15:63: Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon
map.15:65: Fa'asri bi'ahlika biqit'im minal-layli wattabi' adbaarahum walaa yaltafit minkum ahaduw wamdoo haythu tu'maroon
map.15:66: Waqadaynaa ilayhi dhaalikal-amra anna daabira haa'ulaa'i maqtoo'um musbiheen
map.15:68: Qaala inna haa'ulaa'i dayfee falaa tafdahoon
map.15:71: Qaala haa'ulaa'i banaatee in kuntum faa'ileen
map.15:74: Faja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa'amtarnaa 'alayhim hijaaratam min sijjeel
map.15:85: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqq, wa'innas-saa'ata la'aatiyatun fasfahis-safhal-jameel
map.15:88: Laa tamuddanna 'aynayka ilaa maa matta'naa bihee azwaajam minhum walaa tahzan 'alayhim wakhfid janaahaka lil-mu'mineen
map.15:96: Al-ladheena yaj'aloona ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhar, fasawfa ya'lamoon
map.15:97: Walaqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
map.16:1: Ataa amrullaahi falaa tasta'jilooh, subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.16:2: Yunazzilul-malaa'ikata bir-roohi min amrihee 'alaa may yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee an andhiroo annahoo laa ilaaha illaa ana fattaqoon
map.16:4: Khalaqal-insaana min nutfatin fa'idhaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
map.16:5: Wal-an'aama khalaqahaa lakum feehaa dif'uw wamanaafi'u waminhaa ta'kuloon
map.16:6: Walakum feehaa jamaalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoon
map.16:7: Watahmilu athqaalakum ilaa baladil lam takoonoo baaligheehi illaa bishiqqil-anfus, inna rabbakum lara'oofur raheem
map.16:8: Wal-khayla wal-bighaala wal-hameera litarkaboohaa wazeenah, wayakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
map.16:9: Wa'alallaahi qasdus-sabeeli waminhaa jaa'ir, walaw shaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een
map.16:10: Huwal-ladhee anzala minas-samaa'i maa'al lakum minhu sharaabuw waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon
map.16:11: Yumbitu lakum bihiz-zar'a waz-zaytoona wan-nakheela wal-a'naaba wamin kullith-thamaraat, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.16:12: Wasakhkhara lakumul-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamar, wan-nujoomu musakhkharaatum bi'amrih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.16:13: Wamaa dhara'a lakum fil-ardi mukhtalifan alwaanuh, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy yadhdhakkaroon
map.16:14: Wahuwal-ladhee sakhkharal-bahra lita'kuloo minhu lahman tariyyaw watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonahaa, wataral-fulka mawaakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
map.16:15: Wa'alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa'anhaaraw wasubulal la'allakum tahtadoon
map.16:17: Afamay yakhluqu kamal laa yakhluq, afalaa tadhakkaroon
map.16:18: Wa'in ta'uddoo ni'matallaahi laa tuhsoohaa, innallaaha laghafoorur raheem
map.16:19: Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoon
map.16:20: Wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonillaahi laa yakhluqoona shay'aw wahum yukhlaqoon
map.16:21: Amwaatun ghayru ahyaa', wamaa yash'uroona ayyaana yub'athoon
map.16:22: Ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, fal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati quloobuhum munkiratuw wahum mustakbiroon
map.16:23: Laa jarama annallaaha ya'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoon, innahoo laa yuhibbul-mustakbireen
map.16:24: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum maadhaa anzala rabbukum qaaloo asaateerul-awwaleen
map.16:25: Liyahmiloo awzaarahum kaamilatay yawmal-qiyaamati wamin awzaaril-ladheena yudilloonahum bighayri 'ilm, alaa saa'a maa yaziroon
map.16:26: Qad makaral-ladheena min qablihim fa'atallaahu bunyaanahum minal-qawaa'idi fakharra 'alayhimus-saqfu min fawqihim wa'ataahumul-'adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
map.16:27: Thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum tushaaqqoona feehim, qaalal-ladheena ootul-'ilma innal-khizyal-yawma was-soo'a 'alal-kaafireen
map.16:28: Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu zaalimee anfusihim, fa'alqawus-salama maa kunnaa na'malu min soo', balaa innallaaha 'aleemum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.16:29: Fadkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa, falabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
map.16:30: Waqeela lilladheenattaqaw maadhaa anzala rabbukum, qaaloo khayraa, lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanah, waladaarul-aakhirati khayr, walani'ma daarul-muttaqeen
map.16:31: Jannaatu 'adniy yadkhuloonahaa tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oon, kadhaalika yajzillaahul-muttaqeen
map.16:32: Al-ladheena tatawaffaahumul-malaa'ikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salaamun 'alaykumudkhulul-jannata bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.16:33: Hal yanzuroona illaa an ta'tiyahumul-malaa'ikatu aw ya'tiya amru rabbik, kadhaalika fa'alal-ladheena min qablihim, wamaa zalamahumullaahu walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.16:34: Fa'asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa 'amiloo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.16:35: Waqaalal-ladheena ashrakoo law shaa'allaahu maa 'abadnaa min doonihee min shay'in nahnu walaa aabaa'unaa walaa harramnaa min doonihee min shay', kadhaalika fa'alal-ladheena min qablihim, fahal 'alar-rusuli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
map.16:36: Walaqad ba'athnaa fee kulli ummatir rasoolan ani'budullaaha wajtanibut-taaghoot, faminhum man hadallaahu waminhum man haqqat 'alayhid-dalaalah, faseeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mukadhdhibeen
map.16:37: In tahris 'alaa hudaahum fa'innallaaha laa yahdee may yudillu wamaa lahum min naasireen
map.16:38: Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim laa yab'athullaahu may yamoot, balaa wa'dan 'alayhi haqqaw walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.16:39: Liyubayyina lahumul-ladhee yakhtalifoona feehi waliya'lamal-ladheena kafaroo annahum kaanoo kaadhibeen
map.16:40: Innamaa qawlunaa lishay'in idhaa aradnaahu an naqoola lahoo kun fayakoon
map.16:41: Wal-ladheena haajaroo fillaahi mim ba'di maa zulimoo lanubawwi'annahum fid-dunyaa hasanah, wala'ajrul-aakhirati akbar, law kaanoo ya'lamoon
map.16:43: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim fas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
map.16:44: Bil-bayyinaati waz-zubur, wa'anzalnaa ilaykadh-dhikra litubayyina lin-naasi maa nuzzila ilayhim wala'allahum yatafakkaroon
map.16:45: Afa'aminal-ladheena makarus-sayyi'aati ay yakhsifallaahu bihimul-arda aw ya'tiyahumul-'adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
map.16:46: Aw ya'khudhahum fee taqallubihim famaa hum bimu'jizeen
map.16:47: Aw ya'khudhahum 'alaa takhawwuf, fa'inna rabbakum lara'oofur raheem
map.16:48: Awalam yaraw ilaa maa khalaqallaahu min shay'iy yatafayya'u zilaaluhoo 'anil-yameeni wash-shamaa'ili sujjadal lillaahi wahum daakhiroon
map.16:49: Walillaahi yasjudu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi min daabbatiw wal-malaa'ikatu wahum laa yastakbiroon
map.16:50: Yakhaafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
map.16:51: Waqaalallaahu laa tattakhidhoo ilaahaynithnayn, innamaa huwa ilaahuw waahidun fa'iyyaaya farhaboon
map.16:52: Walahoo maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi walahud-deenu waasibaa, afaghayrallaahi tattaqoon
map.16:53: Wamaa bikum min ni'matin faminallaahi thumma idhaa massakumud-durru fa'ilayhi taj'aroon
map.16:54: Thumma idhaa kashafad-durra 'ankum idhaa fareequm minkum birabbihim yushrikoon
map.16:55: Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum, fatamatta'oo, fasawfa ta'lamoon
map.16:56: Wayaj'aloona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseebam mimmaa razaqnaahum, tallaahi latus'alunna 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon
map.16:57: Wayaj'aloona lillaahil-banaati subhaanahoo walahum maa yashtahoon
map.16:58: Wa'idhaa bushshira ahaduhum bil-unthaa zalla wajhuhoo muswaddaw wahuwa kazeem
map.16:59: Yatawaaraa minal-qawmi min soo'i maa bushshira bih, ayumsikuhoo 'alaa hoonin am yadussuhoo fit-turaab, alaa saa'a maa yahkumoon
map.16:60: Lilladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati mathalus-saw', walillaahil-mathalul-a'laa, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.16:61: Walaw yu'aakhidhullaahun-naasa bizulmihim maa taraka 'alayhaa min daabbatiw walaakiy yu'akhkhiruhum ilaa ajalim musammaa, fa'idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum laa yasta'khiroona saa'ataw walaa yastaqdimoon
map.16:62: Wayaj'aloona lillaahi maa yakrahoona watasifu alsinatuhumul-kadhiba anna lahumul-husnaa laa jarama anna lahumun-naara wa'annahum mufratoon
map.16:63: Tallaahi laqad arsalnaa ilaa umamim min qablika fazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul-yawma walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.16:64: Wamaa anzalnaa 'alaykal-kitaaba illaa litubayyina lahumul-ladhikhtalafoo feehi wahudaw warahmatal liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.16:65: Wallaahu anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy yasma'oon
map.16:66: Wa'inna lakum fil-an'aami la'ibrah, nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihee mim bayni farthiw wadamil labanan khaalisan saa'ighal lish-shaaribeen
map.16:67: Wamin thamaraatin-nakheeli wal-a'naabi tattakhidhoona minhu sakaraw warizqan hasanaa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.16:68: Wa'awhaa rabbuka ilan-nahli anittakhidhee minal-jibaali buyootaw waminash-shajari wamimmaa ya'rishoon
map.16:69: Thumma kulee min kullith-thamaraati faslukee subula rabbiki dhululaa, yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaabum mukhtalifun alwaanuh, feehi shifaa'ul lin-naas, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.16:70: Wallaahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffaakum waminkum may yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-'umuri likay laa ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shay'aa, innallaaha 'aleemun qadeer
map.16:71: Wallaahu faddala ba'dakum 'alaa ba'din fir-rizq, famal-ladheena fuddiloo biraaddee rizqihim 'alaa maa malakat aymaanuhum fahum feehi sawaa', afabini'matillaahi yajhadoon
map.16:72: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajaw waja'ala lakum min azwaajikum baneena wahafadataw warazaqakum minat-tayyibaat, afabilbaatili yu'minoona wabini'matillaahi hum yakfuroon
map.16:73: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqam minas-samaawaati wal-ardi shay'aw walaa yastatee'oon
map.16:74: Falaa tadriboo lillaahil-amthaal, innallaaha ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamoon
map.16:75: Daraballaahu mathalan 'abdam mamlookal laa yaqdiru 'alaa shay'iw wamar razaqnaahu minnaa rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirraw wajahraa, hal yastawoon, al-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
map.16:76: Wadaraballaahu mathalar rajulayni ahaduhumaa abkamu laa yaqdiru 'alaa shay'iw wahuwa kallun 'alaa mawlaah, aynamaa yuwajjihhu laa ya'ti bikhayr, hal yastawee huwa wamay ya'muru bil-'adli wahuwa 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.16:77: Walillaahi ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ard, wamaa amrus-saa'ati illaa kalamhil-basari aw huwa aqrab, innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.16:78: Wallaahu akhrajakum mim butooni ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shay'aw waja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata la'allakum tashkuroon
map.16:79: Alam yaraw ilat-tayri musakhkharaatin fee jawwis-samaa', maa yumsikuhunna illallaah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.16:80: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mim buyootikum sakanaw waja'ala lakum min juloodil-an'aami buyootan tastakhiffoonahaa yawma za'nikum wayawma iqaamatikum wamin aswaafihaa wa'awbaarihaa wa'ash'aarihaa athaathaw wamataa'an ilaa heen
map.16:81: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mimmaa khalaqa zilaalaw waja'ala lakum minal-jibaali aknaanaw waja'ala lakum saraabeela taqeekumul-harra wasaraabeela taqeekum ba'sakum, kadhaalika yutimmu ni'matahoo 'alaykum la'allakum tuslimoon
map.16:84: Wayawma nab'athu min kulli ummatin shaheedan thumma laa yu'dhanu lilladheena kafaroo walaa hum yusta'taboon
map.16:85: Wa'idhaa ra'al-ladheena zalamul-'adhaaba falaa yukhaffafu 'anhum walaa hum yunzaroon
map.16:86: Wa'idhaa ra'al-ladheena ashrakoo shurakaa'ahum qaaloo rabbanaa haa'ulaa'i shurakaa'unal-ladheena kunnaa nad'oo min doonik, fa'alqaw ilayhimul-qawla innakum lakaadhiboon
map.16:87: Wa'alqaw ilallaahi yawma'idhinis-salama wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.16:88: Alladheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeelillaahi zidnaahum 'adhaaban fawqal-'adhaabi bimaa kaanoo yufsidoon
map.16:89: Wayawma nab'athu fee kulli ummatin shaheedan 'alayhim min anfusihim waji'naa bika shaheedan 'alaa haa'ulaa', wanazzalnaa 'alaykal-kitaaba tibyaanal likulli shay'iw wahudaw warahmataw wabushraa lil-muslimeen
map.16:90: Innallaaha ya'muru bil-'adli wal-ihsaani wa'eetaa'i dhil-qurbaa wayanhaa 'anil-fahshaa'i wal-munkari wal-baghyi ya'izukum la'allakum tadhakkaroon
map.16:91: Wa'awfoo bi'ahdillaahi idhaa 'aahattum walaa tanqudul-aymaana ba'da tawkeedihaa waqad ja'altumullaaha 'alaykum kafeelaa, innallaaha ya'lamu maa taf'aloon
map.16:92: Walaa takoonoo kal-latee naqadat ghazlahaa mim ba'di quwwatin ankaathaa, tattakhidhoona aymaanakum dakhalam baynakum an takoona ummatun hiya arbaa min ummah, innamaa yablookumullaahu bih, walayubayyinanna lakum yawmal-qiyaamati maa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
map.16:93: Walaw shaa'allaahu laja'alakum ummataw waahidataw walaakiy yudillu may yashaa'u wayahdee may yashaa', walatus'alunna 'ammaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.16:94: Walaa tattakhidhoo aymaanakum dakhalam baynakum fatazilla qadamum ba'da thubootihaa watadhooqus-soo'a bimaa sadattum 'an sabeelillaah, walakum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.16:95: Walaa tashtaroo bi'ahdillaahi thamanan qaleelaa, innamaa 'indallaahi huwa khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.16:96: Maa 'indakum yanfadu wamaa 'indallaahi baaq, walanajziyannal-ladheena sabaroo ajrahum bi'ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.16:97: Man 'amila saaliham min dhakarin aw unthaa wahuwa mu'minun falanuhyiyannahoo hayaatan tayyibah, walanajziyannahum ajrahum bi'ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.16:99: Innahoo laysa lahoo sultaanun 'alal-ladheena aamanoo wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
map.16:100: Innamaa sultaanuhoo 'alal-ladheena yatawallawnahoo wal-ladheena hum bihee mushrikoon
map.16:101: Wa'idhaa baddalnaa aayatam makaana aayatiw wallaahu a'lamu bimaa yunazzilu qaaloo innamaa anta muftar, bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
map.16:102: Qul nazzalahoo roohul-qudusi mir rabbika bil-haqqi liyuthabbital-ladheena aamanoo wahudaw wabushraa lil-muslimeen
map.16:103: Walaqad na'lamu annahum yaqooloona innamaa yu'allimuhoo bashar, lisaanul-ladhee yulhidoona ilayhi a'jamiyyuw wahaadhaa lisaanun 'arabiyyum mubeen
map.16:104: Innal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bi'aayaatillaahi laa yahdeehimullaahu walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.16:105: Innamaa yaftaril-kadhibal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bi'aayaatillaah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-kaadhiboon
map.16:106: Man kafara billaahi mim ba'di eemaanihee illaa man ukriha waqalbuhoo mutma'innum bil-eemaani walaakim man sharaha bil-kufri sadran fa'alayhim ghadabum minallaah, walahum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.16:108: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena taba'allaahu 'alaa quloobihim wasam'ihim wa'absaarihim, wa'ulaa'ika humul-ghaafiloon
map.16:110: Thumma inna rabbaka lilladheena haajaroo mim ba'di maa futinoo thumma jaahadoo wasabaroo, inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoorur raheem
map.16:111: Yawma ta'tee kullu nafsin tujaadilu 'an nafsihaa watuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa 'amilat wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.16:112: Wadaraballaahu mathalan qaryatan kaanat aaminatam mutma'innatay ya'teehaa rizquhaa raghadam min kulli makaanin fakafarat bi'an'umillaahi fa'adhaaqahallaahu libaasal-joo'i wal-khawfi bimaa kaanoo yasna'oon
map.16:113: Walaqad jaa'ahum rasoolum minhum fakadhdhaboohu fa'akhadhahumul-'adhaabu wahum zaalimoon
map.16:114: Fakuloo mimmaa razaqakumullaahu halaalan tayyibaa, washkuroo ni'matallaahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
map.16:115: Innamaa harrama 'alaykumul-maytata wad-dama walahmal-khinzeeri wamaa uhilla lighayrillaahi bih, famanidturra ghayra baaghiw walaa 'aadin fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.16:116: Walaa taqooloo limaa tasifu alsinatukumul-kadhiba haadhaa halaaluw wahaadhaa haraamul litaftaroo 'alallaahil-kadhib, innal-ladheena yaftaroona 'alallaahil-kadhiba laa yuflihoon
map.16:118: Wa'alal-ladheena haadoo harramnaa maa qasasnaa 'alayka min qabl, wamaa zalamnaahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.16:119: Thumma inna rabbaka lilladheena 'amilus-soo'a bijahaalatin thumma taaboo mim ba'di dhaalika wa'aslahoo inna rabbaka mim ba'dihaa laghafoorur raheem
map.16:120: Inna ibraaheema kaana ummatan qaanital lillaahi haneefaa, walam yaku minal-mushrikeen
map.16:121: Shaakiral li'an'umih, ijtabaahu wahadaahu ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.16:122: Wa'aataynaahu fid-dunyaa hasanah, wa'innahoo fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
map.16:123: Thumma awhaynaa ilayka anittabi' millata ibraaheema haneefaa, wamaa kaana minal-mushrikeen
map.16:124: Innamaa ju'ilas-sabtu 'alal-ladheenakhtalafoo feeh, wa'inna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
map.16:125: Ud'u ilaa sabeeli rabbika bil-hikmati wal-maw'izatil-hasanati wajaadilhum bil-latee hiya ahsan, inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
map.16:126: Wa'in 'aaqabtum fa'aaqiboo bimithli maa 'ooqibtum bih, wala'in sabartum lahuwa khayrul lis-saabireen
map.16:127: Wasbir wamaa sabruka illaa billaahi walaa tahzan 'alayhim walaa taku fee dayqim mimmaa yamkuroon
map.17:1: Subhaanal-ladhee asraa bi'abdihee laylam minal-masjidil-haraami ilal-masjidil-aqsal-ladhee baaraknaa hawlahoo linuriyahoo min aayaatinaa, innahoo huwas-samee'ul-baseer
map.17:2: Wa'aataynaa moosal-kitaaba waja'alnaahu hudal libanee israa'eela allaa tattakhidhoo min doonee wakeelaa
map.17:3: Dhurriyyata man hamalnaa ma'a nooh, innahoo kaana 'abdan shakooraa
map.17:4: Waqadaynaa ilaa banee israa'eela fil-kitaabi latufsidunna fil-ardi marratayni walata'lunna 'uluwwan kabeeraa
map.17:5: Fa'idhaa jaa'a wa'du oolaahumaa ba'athnaa 'alaykum 'ibaadal lanaa ulee ba'sin shadeedin fajaasoo khilaalad-diyaar, wakaana wa'dam maf'oolaa
map.17:6: Thumma radadnaa lakumul-karrata 'alayhim wa'amdadnaakum bi'amwaaliw wabaneena waja'alnaakum akthara nafeeraa
map.17:7: In ahsantum ahsantum li'anfusikum, wa'in asa'tum falahaa, fa'idhaa jaa'a wa'dul-aakhirati liyasoo'oo wujoohakum waliyadkhulul-masjida kamaa dakhaloohu awwala marratiw waliyutabbiroo maa 'alaw tatbeeraa
map.17:8: 'Asaa rabbukum ay yarhamakum, wa'in 'uttum 'udnaa, waja'alnaa jahannama lil-kaafireena haseeraa
map.17:9: Inna haadhal-qur'aana yahdee lillatee hiya aqwamu wayubashshirul-mu'mineenal-ladheena ya'maloonas-saalihaati anna lahum ajran kabeeraa
map.17:10: Wa'annal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati a'tadnaa lahum 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.17:12: Waja'alnal-layla wan-nahaara aayatayni famahawnaa aayatal-layli waja'alnaa aayatan-nahaari mubsiratal litabtaghoo fadlam mir rabbikum walita'lamoo 'adadas-sineena wal-hisaab, wakulla shay'in fassalnaahu tafseelaa
map.17:13: Wakulla insaanin alzamnaahu taa'irahoo fee 'unuqih, wanukhriju lahoo yawmal-qiyaamati kitaabay yalqaahu manshooraa
map.17:15: Manihtadaa fa'innamaa yahtadee linafsih, waman dalla fa'innamaa yadillu 'alayhaa, walaa taziru waaziratuw wizra ukhraa, wamaa kunnaa mu'adhdhibeena hattaa nab'atha rasoolaa
map.17:16: Wa'idhaa aradnaa an nuhlika qaryatan amarnaa mutrafeehaa fafasaqoo feehaa fahaqqa 'alayhal-qawlu fadammarnaahaa tadmeeraa
map.17:17: Wakam ahlaknaa minal-qurooni mim ba'di nooh, wakafaa birabbika bidhunoobi 'ibaadihee khabeeram baseeraa
map.17:18: Man kaana yureedul-'aajilata 'ajjalnaa lahoo feehaa maa nashaa'u liman nureedu thumma ja'alnaa lahoo jahannam, yaslaahaa madhmoomam madhooraa
map.17:19: Waman araadal-aakhirata wasa'aa lahaa sa'yahaa wahuwa mu'minun fa'ulaa'ika kaana sa'yuhum mashkooraa
map.17:20: Kullan numiddu haa'ulaa'i wahaa'ulaa'i min 'ataa'i rabbik, wamaa kaana 'ataa'u rabbika mahzooraa
map.17:21: Unzur kayfa faddalnaa ba'dahum 'alaa ba'd, walal'aakhiratu akbaru darajaatiw wa'akbaru tafdeelaa
map.17:22: Laa taj'al ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fataq'uda madhmoomam makhdhoolaa
map.17:23: Waqadaa rabbuka allaa ta'budoo illaa iyyaahu wabil-waalidayni ihsaanaa, immaa yablughanna 'indakal-kibara ahaduhumaa aw kilaahumaa falaa taqul lahumaa uffiw walaa tanharhumaa waqul lahumaa qawlan kareemaa
map.17:24: Wakhfid lahumaa janaahadh-dhulli minar-rahmati waqur rabbirhamhumaa kamaa rabbayaanee sagheeraa
map.17:25: Rabbukum a'lamu bimaa fee nufoosikum, in takoonoo saaliheena fa'innahoo kaana lil-awwaabeena ghafooraa
map.17:26: Wa'aati dhal-qurbaa haqqahoo wal-miskeena wabnas-sabeeli walaa tubadhdhir tabdheeraa
map.17:27: Innal-mubadhdhireena kaanoo ikhwaanash-shayaateen, wakaanash-shaytaanu lirabbihee kafooraa
map.17:28: Wa'immaa tu'ridanna 'anhumubtighaa'a rahmatim mir rabbika tarjoohaa faqul lahum qawlam maysooraa
map.17:29: Walaa taj'al yadaka maghloolatan ilaa 'unuqika walaa tabsuthaa kullal-basti fataq'uda maloomam mahsooraa
map.17:30: Inna rabbaka yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, innahoo kaana bi'ibaadihee khabeeram baseeraa
map.17:31: Walaa taqtuloo awlaadakum khashyata imlaaq, nahnu narzuquhum wa'iyyaakum, inna qatlahum kaana khit'an kabeeraa
map.17:32: Walaa taqrabuz-zinaa innahoo kaana faahishah, wasaa'a sabeelaa
map.17:33: Walaa taqtulun-nafsal-latee harramallaahu illaa bil-haqq, waman qutila mazlooman faqad ja'alnaa liwaliyyihee sultaanan falaa yusrif fil-qatl, innahoo kaana mansooraa
map.17:34: Walaa taqraboo maalal-yateemi illaa bil-latee hiya ahsanu hattaa yablugha ashuddah, wa'awfoo bil-'ahd, innal-'ahda kaana mas'oolaa
map.17:35: Wa'awful-kayla idhaa kiltum wazinoo bil-qistaasil-mustaqeem, dhaalika khayruw wa'ahsanu ta'weelaa
map.17:36: Walaa taqfu maa laysa laka bihee 'ilm, innas-sam'a wal-basara wal-fu'aada kullu ulaa'ika kaana 'anhu mas'oolaa
map.17:37: Walaa tamshi fil-ardi marahaa, innaka lan takhriqal-arda walan tablughal-jibaala toolaa
map.17:38: Kullu dhaalika kaana sayyi'uhoo 'inda rabbika makroohaa
map.17:39: Dhaalika mimmaa awhaa ilayka rabbuka minal-hikmah, walaa taj'al ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fatulqaa fee jahannama maloomam madhooraa
map.17:40: Afa'asfaakum rabbukum bil-baneena wattakhadha minal-malaa'ikati inaathaa, innakum lataqooloona qawlan 'azeemaa
map.17:41: Walaqad sarrafnaa fee haadhal-qur'aani liyadhdhakkaroo, wamaa yazeeduhum illaa nufooraa
map.17:42: Qul law kaana ma'ahoo aalihatun kamaa yaqooloona idhal labtaghaw ilaa dhil-'arshi sabeelaa
map.17:44: Tusabbihu lahus-samaawaatus-sab'u wal-ardu waman feehinn, wa'im min shay'in illaa yusabbihu bihamdihee walaakil laa tafqahoona tasbeehahum, innahoo kaana haleeman ghafooraa
map.17:45: Wa'idhaa qara'tal-qur'aana ja'alnaa baynaka wabaynal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati hijaabam mastooraa
map.17:46: Waja'alnaa 'alaa quloobihim akinnatan ay yafqahoohu wafee aadhaanihim waqraa, wa'idhaa dhakarta rabbaka fil-qur'aani wahdahoo wallaw 'alaa adbaarihim nufooraa
map.17:47: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yastami'oona bihee idh yastami'oona ilayka wa'idh hum najwaa idh yaqooluz-zaalimoona in tattabi'oona illaa rajulam mashooraa
map.17:48: Unzur kayfa daraboo lakal-amthaala fadalloo falaa yastatee'oona sabeelaa
map.17:49: Waqaaloo a'idhaa kunnaa 'izaamaw warufaatan a'innaa lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeedaa
map.17:51: Aw khalqam mimmaa yakburu fee sudoorikum, fasayaqooloona may yu'eedunaa, qulil-ladhee fatarakum awwala marrah, fasayunghidoona ilayka ru'oosahum wayaqooloona mataa huw, qul 'asaa ay yakoona qareebaa
map.17:52: Yawma yad'ookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihee watazunnoona il labithtum illaa qaleelaa
map.17:53: Waqul li'ibaadee yaqoolul-latee hiya ahsan, innash-shaytaana yanzaghu baynahum, innash-shaytaana kaana lil-insaani 'aduwwam mubeenaa
map.17:54: Rabbukum a'lamu bikum iy yasha' yarhamkum aw iy yasha' yu'adhdhibkum, wamaa arsalnaaka 'alayhim wakeelaa
map.17:55: Warabbuka a'lamu biman fis-samaawaati wal-ard, walaqad faddalnaa ba'dan-nabiyyeena 'alaa ba'diw wa'aataynaa daawooda zabooraa
map.17:56: Qulid'ul-ladheena za'amtum min doonihee falaa yamlikoona kashfad-durri 'ankum walaa tahweelaa
map.17:57: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena yad'oona yabtaghoona ilaa rabbihimul-waseelata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahoo wayakhaafoona 'adhaabah, inna 'adhaaba rabbika kaana mahdhooraa
map.17:58: Wa'im min qaryatin illaa nahnu muhlikoohaa qabla yawmil-qiyaamati aw mu'adhdhiboohaa 'adhaaban shadeedaa, kaana dhaalika fil-kitaabi mastooraa
map.17:59: Wamaa mana'anaa an nursila bil-aayaati illaa an kadhdhaba bihal-awwaloon, wa'aataynaa thamoodan-naaqata mubsiratan fazalamoo bihaa, wamaa nursilu bil-aayaati illaa takhweefaa
map.17:60: Wa'idh qulnaa laka inna rabbaka ahaata bin-naas, wamaa ja'alnar-ru'yal-latee araynaaka illaa fitnatal lin-naasi wash-shajaratal-mal'oonata fil-qur'aan, wanukhawwifuhum famaa yazeeduhum illaa tughyaanan kabeeraa
map.17:61: Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa iblees, qaala a'asjudu liman khalaqta teenaa
map.17:62: Qaala ara'aytaka haadhal-ladhee karramta 'alayya la'in akhkhartani ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati la'ahtanikanna dhurriyyatahoo illaa qaleelaa
map.17:63: Qaaladhhab faman tabi'aka minhum fa'inna jahannama jazaa'ukum jazaa'am mawfooraa
map.17:64: Wastafziz manistata'ta minhum bisawtika wa'ajlib 'alayhim bikhaylika warajilika washaarikhum fil-amwaali wal-awlaadi wa'idhum, wamaa ya'iduhumush-shaytaanu illaa ghurooraa
map.17:65: Inna 'ibaadee laysa laka 'alayhim sultaan, wakafaa birabbika wakeelaa
map.17:66: Rabbukumul-ladhee yuzjee lakumul-fulka fil-bahri litabtaghoo min fadlih, innahoo kaana bikum raheemaa
map.17:67: Wa'idhaa massakumud-durru fil-bahri dalla man tad'oona illaa iyyaah, falammaa najjaakum ilal-barri a'radtum, wakaanal-insaanu kafooraa
map.17:68: Afa'amintum ay yakhsifa bikum jaanibal-barri aw yursila 'alaykum haasiban thumma laa tajidoo lakum wakeelaa
map.17:69: Am amintum ay yu'eedakum feehi taaratan ukhraa fayursila 'alaykum qaasifam minar-reehi fayughriqakum bimaa kafartum thumma laa tajidoo lakum 'alaynaa bihee tabee'aa
map.17:70: Walaqad karramnaa banee aadama wahamalnaahum fil-barri wal-bahri warazaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati wafaddalnaahum 'alaa katheerim mimman khalaqnaa tafdeelaa
map.17:71: Yawma nad'oo kulla unaasim bi'imaamihim, faman ootiya kitaabahoo biyameenihee fa'ulaa'ika yaqra'oona kitaabahum walaa yuzlamoona fateelaa
map.17:72: Waman kaana fee haadhihee a'maa fahuwa fil-aakhirati a'maa wa'adallu sabeelaa
map.17:73: Wa'in kaadoo layaftinoonaka 'anil-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka litaftariya 'alaynaa ghayrah, wa'idhal lattakhadhooka khaleelaa
map.17:74: Walawlaa an thabbatnaaka laqad kitta tarkanu ilayhim shay'an qaleelaa
map.17:75: Idhal la'adhaqnaaka di'fal-hayaati wadi'fal-mamaati thumma laa tajidu laka 'alaynaa naseeraa
map.17:76: Wa'in kaadoo layastafizzoonaka minal-ardi liyukhrijooka minhaa wa'idhal laa yalbathoona khilaafaka illaa qaleelaa
map.17:77: Sunnata man qad arsalnaa qablaka mir rusulinaa walaa tajidu lisunnatinaa tahweelaa
map.17:78: Aqimis-salaata lidulookish-shamsi ilaa ghasaqil-layli waqur'aanal-fajr, inna qur'aanal-fajri kaana mashhoodaa
map.17:79: Waminal-layli fatahajjad bihee naafilatal lak, 'asaa ay yab'athaka rabbuka maqaamam mahmoodaa
map.17:80: Waqur rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqiw wa'akhrijnee mukhraja sidqiw waj'al lee mil ladunka sultaanan naseeraa
map.17:81: Waqul jaa'al-haqqu wazahaqal-baatil, innal-baatila kaana zahooqaa
map.17:82: Wanunazzilu minal-qur'aani maa huwa shifaa'uw warahmatul lil-mu'mineena walaa yazeeduz-zaalimeena illaa khasaaraa
map.17:83: Wa'idhaa an'amnaa 'alal-insaani a'rada wana'aa bijaanibih, wa'idhaa massahush-sharru kaana ya'oosaa
map.17:84: Qul kulluy ya'malu 'alaa shaakilatih, farabbukum a'lamu biman huwa ahdaa sabeelaa
map.17:85: Wayas'aloonaka 'anir-rooh, qulir-roohu min amri rabbee wamaa ooteetum minal-'ilmi illaa qaleelaa
map.17:86: Wala'in shi'naa lanadhhabanna bil-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka thumma laa tajidu laka bihee 'alaynaa wakeelaa
map.17:87: Illaa rahmatam mir rabbik, inna fadlahoo kaana 'alayka kabeeraa
map.17:88: Qul la'inijtama'atil-insu wal-jinnu 'alaa ay ya'too bimithli haadhal-qur'aani laa ya'toona bimithlihee walaw kaana ba'duhum liba'din zaheeraa
map.17:89: Walaqad sarrafnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathal, fa'abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
map.17:90: Waqaaloo lan nu'mina laka hattaa tafjura lanaa minal-ardi yamboo'aa
map.17:91: Aw takoona laka jannatum min nakheeliw wa'inabin fatufajjiral-anhaara khilaalahaa tafjeeraa
map.17:92: Aw tusqitas-samaa'a kamaa za'amta 'alaynaa kisafan aw ta'tiya billaahi wal-malaa'ikati qabeelaa
map.17:93: Aw yakoona laka baytum min zukhrufin aw tarqaa fis-samaa', walan nu'mina liruqiyyika hattaa tunazzila 'alaynaa kitaaban naqra'uh, qul subhaana rabbee hal kuntu illaa basharar rasoolaa
map.17:94: Wamaa mana'an-naasa ay yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa illaa an qaaloo aba'athallaahu basharar rasoolaa
map.17:95: Qul law kaana fil-ardi malaa'ikatuy yamshoona mutma'inneena lanazzalnaa 'alayhim minas-samaa'i malakar rasoolaa
map.17:96: Qul kafaa billaahi shaheedam baynee wabaynakum, innahoo kaana bi'ibaadihee khabeeram baseeraa
map.17:97: Wamay yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtad, wamay yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa'a min doonih, wanahshuruhum yawmal-qiyaamati 'alaa wujoohihim 'umyaw wabukmaw wasummaa, ma'waahum jahannam, kullamaa khabat zidnaahum sa'eeraa
map.17:98: Dhaalika jazaa'uhum bi'annahum kafaroo bi'aayaatinaa waqaaloo a'idhaa kunnaa 'izaamaw warufaatan a'innaa lamab'oothoona khalqan jadeedaa
map.17:99: Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda qaadirun 'alaa ay yakhluqa mithlahum waja'ala lahum ajalal laa rayba feeh, fa'abaz-zaalimoona illaa kufooraa
map.17:100: Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaa'ina rahmati rabbee idhal la'amsaktum khashyatal-infaaq, wakaanal-insaanu qatooraa
map.17:101: Walaqad aataynaa moosaa tis'a aayaatim bayyinaatin fas'al banee israa'eela idh jaa'ahum faqaala lahoo fir'awnu innee la'azunnuka yaamoosaa mashooraa
map.17:102: Qaala laqad 'alimta maa anzala haa'ulaa'i illaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi basaa'ir, wa'innee la'azunnuka yaafir'awnu mathbooraa
map.17:103: Fa'araada ay yastafizzahum minal-ardi fa'aghraqnaahu wamam ma'ahoo jamee'aa
map.17:104: Waqulnaa mim ba'dihee libanee israa'eelaskunul-arda fa'idhaa jaa'a wa'dul-aakhirati ji'naa bikum lafeefaa
map.17:105: Wabil-haqqi anzalnaahu wabil-haqqi nazal, wamaa arsalnaaka illaa mubashshiraw wanadheeraa
map.17:106: Waqur'aanan faraqnaahu litaqra'ahoo 'alan-naasi 'alaa mukthiw wanazzalnaahu tanzeelaa
map.17:107: Qul aaminoo bihee aw laa tu'minoo, innal-ladheena ootul-'ilma min qablihee idhaa yutlaa 'alayhim yakhirroona lil-adhqaani sujjadaa
map.17:108: Wayaqooloona subhaana rabbinaa in kaana wa'du rabbinaa lamaf'oolaa
map.17:110: Qulid'ullaaha awid'ur-rahmaan, ayyam maa tad'oo falahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa, walaa tajhar bisalaatika walaa tukhaafit bihaa wabtaghi bayna dhaalika sabeelaa
map.17:111: Waqulil-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee lam yattakhidh waladaw walam yakul lahoo shareekun fil-mulki walam yakul lahoo waliyyum minadh-dhulli wakabbirhu takbeeraa
map.18:1: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee anzala 'alaa 'abdihil-kitaaba walam yaj'al lahoo 'iwajaa
map.18:2: Qayyimal liyundhira ba'san shadeedam mil ladunhu wayubashshiral-mu'mineenal-ladheena ya'maloonas-saalihaati anna lahum ajran hasanaa
map.18:5: Maa lahum bihee min 'ilmiw walaa li'aabaa'ihim, kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwaahihim, iy yaqooloona illaa kadhibaa
map.18:6: Fala'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka 'alaa aathaarihim il lam yu'minoo bihaadhal-hadeethi asafaa
map.18:7: Innaa ja'alnaa maa 'alal-ardi zeenatal lahaa linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu 'amalaa
map.18:9: Am hasibta anna ashaabal-kahfi war-raqeemi kaanoo min aayaatinaa 'ajabaa
map.18:10: Idh awal-fityatu ilal-kahfi faqaaloo rabbanaa aatinaa mil ladunka rahmataw wahayyi' lanaa min amrinaa rashadaa
map.18:12: Thumma ba'athnaahum lina'lama ayyul-hizbayni ahsaa limaa labithoo amadaa
map.18:13: Nahnu naqussu 'alayka naba'ahum bil-haqq, innahum fityatun aamanoo birabbihim wazidnaahum hudaa
map.18:14: Warabatnaa 'alaa quloobihim idh qaamoo faqaaloo rabbunaa rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi lan nad'uwa min doonihee ilaahal laqad qulnaa idhan shatataa
map.18:15: Haa'ulaa'i qawmunattakhadhoo min doonihee aalihah, lawlaa ya'toona 'alayhim bisultaanim bayyin, faman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhibaa
map.18:16: Wa'idhi'tazaltumoohum wamaa ya'budoona illallaaha fa'woo ilal-kahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum mir rahmatihee wayuhayyi' lakum min amrikum mirfaqaa
map.18:17: Watarash-shamsa idhaa tala'at tazaawaru 'an kahfihim dhaatal-yameeni wa'idhaa gharabat taqriduhum dhaatash-shimaali wahum fee fajwatim minh, dhaalika min aayaatillaah, may yahdillaahu fahuwal-muhtadi wamay yudlil falan tajida lahoo waliyyam murshidaa
map.18:18: Watahsabuhum ayqaazaw wahum ruqood, wanuqallibuhum dhaatal-yameeni wadhaatash-shimaal, wakalbuhum baasitun dhiraa'ayhi bil-waseed, lawittala'ta 'alayhim lawallayta minhum firaaraw walamuli'ta minhum ru'baa
map.18:19: Wakadhaalika ba'athnaahum liyatasaa'aloo baynahum, qaala qaa'ilum minhum kam labithtum, qaaloo labithnaa yawman aw ba'da yawm, qaaloo rabbukum a'lamu bimaa labithtum, fab'athoo ahadakum biwariqikum haadhihee ilal-madeenati falyanzur ayyuhaa azkaa ta'aaman falya'tikum birizqim minhu walyatalattaf walaa yush'iranna bikum ahadaa
map.18:20: Innahum iy yazharoo 'alaykum yarjumookum aw yu'eedookum fee millatihim walan tuflihoo idhan abadaa
map.18:21: Wakadhaalika a'tharnaa 'alayhim liya'lamoo anna wa'dallaahi haqquw wa'annas-saa'ata laa rayba feehaa, idh yatanaaza'oona baynahum amrahum faqaalubnoo 'alayhim bunyaanaa, rabbuhum a'lamu bihim, qaalal-ladheena ghalaboo 'alaa amrihim lanattakhidhanna 'alayhim masjidaa
map.18:22: Sayaqooloona thalaathatur raabi'uhum kalbuhum, wayaqooloona khamsatun saadisuhum kalbuhum rajmam bil-ghayb, wayaqooloona sab'atuw wathaaminuhum kalbuhum, qur rabbee a'lamu bi'iddatihim maa ya'lamuhum illaa qaleel, falaa tumaari feehim illaa miraa'an zaahiraa, walaa tastafti feehim minhum ahadaa
map.18:23: Walaa taqoolanna lishay'in innee faa'ilun dhaalika ghadaa
map.18:24: Illaa ay yashaa'allaah, wadhkur rabbaka idhaa naseeta waqul 'asaa ay yahdiyani rabbee li'aqraba min haadhaa rashadaa
map.18:25: Walabithoo fee kahfihim thalaatha mi'atin sineena wazdaadoo tis'aa
map.18:26: Qulillaahu a'lamu bimaa labithoo, lahoo ghaybus-samaawaati wal-ard, absir bihee wa'asmi', maa lahum min doonihee miw waliyy, walaa yushriku fee hukmihee ahadaa
map.18:27: Watlu maa oohiya ilayka min kitaabi rabbik, laa mubaddila likalimaatih, walan tajida min doonihee multahadaa
map.18:28: Wasbir nafsaka ma'al-ladheena yad'oona rabbahum bil-ghadaati wal-'ashiyyi yureedoona wajhahoo walaa ta'du 'aynaaka 'anhum, tureedu zeenatal-hayaatid-dunyaa, walaa tuti' man aghfalnaa qalbahoo 'an dhikrinaa wattaba'a hawaahu wakaana amruhoo furutaa
map.18:29: Waqulil-haqqu mir rabbikum, faman shaa'a falyu'miw waman shaa'a falyakfur, innaa a'tadnaa liz-zaalimeena naaran ahaata bihim suraadiquhaa, wa'iy yastagheethoo yughaathoo bimaa'in kal-muhli yashwil-wujooh, bi'sash-sharaab, wasaa'at murtafaqaa
map.18:30: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati innaa laa nudee'u ajra man ahsana 'amalaa
map.18:31: Ulaa'ika lahum jannaatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihimul-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabiw wayalbasoona thiyaaban khudram min sundusiw wa'istabraqim muttaki'eena feehaa 'alal-araa'ik, ni'math-thawaab, wahasunat murtafaqaa
map.18:32: Wadrib lahum mathalar rajulayni ja'alnaa li'ahadihimaa jannatayni min a'naabiw wahafafnaahumaa binakhliw waja'alnaa baynahumaa zar'aa
map.18:33: Kiltal-jannatayni aatat ukulahaa walam tazlim minhu shay'aw wafajjarnaa khilaalahumaa naharaa
map.18:34: Wakaana lahoo thamar, faqaala lisaahibihee wahuwa yuhaawiruhoo ana aktharu minka maalaw wa'a'azzu nafaraa
map.18:35: Wadakhala jannatahoo wahuwa zaalimul linafsih, qaala maa azunnu an tabeeda haadhihee abadaa
map.18:36: Wamaa azunnus-saa'ata qaa'imataw wala'ir rudittu ilaa rabbee la'ajidanna khayram minhaa munqalabaa
map.18:37: Qaala lahoo saahibuhoo wahuwa yuhaawiruhoo akafarta bil-ladhee khalaqaka min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaaka rajulaa
map.18:38: Laakinna huwallaahu rabbee walaa ushriku birabbee ahadaa
map.18:39: Walawlaa idh dakhalta jannataka qulta maa shaa'allaahu laa quwwata illaa billaah, in tarani ana aqalla minka maalaw wawaladaa
map.18:40: Fa'asaa rabbee ay yu'tiyani khayram min jannatika wayursila 'alayhaa husbaanam minas-samaa'i fatusbiha sa'eedan zalaqaa
map.18:41: Aw yusbiha maa'uhaa ghawran falan tastatee'a lahoo talabaa
map.18:42: Wa'uheeta bithamarihee fa'asbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi 'alaa maa anfaqa feehaa wahiya khaawiyatun 'alaa 'urooshihaa wayaqoolu yaalaytanee lam ushrik birabbee ahadaa
map.18:43: Walam takul lahoo fi'atuy yansuroonahoo min doonillaahi wamaa kaana muntasiraa
map.18:44: Hunaalikal-walaayatu lillaahil-haqq, huwa khayrun thawaabaw wakhayrun 'uqbaa
map.18:45: Wadrib lahum mathalal-hayaatid-dunyaa kamaa'in anzalnaahu minas-samaa'i fakhtalata bihee nabaatul-ardi fa'asbaha hasheeman tadhroohur-riyaah, wakaanallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'im muqtadiraa
map.18:46: Al-maalu wal-banoona zeenatul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wal-baaqiyaatus-saalihaatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaabaw wakhayrun amalaa
map.18:47: Wayawma nusayyirul-jibaala wataral-arda baarizataw wahasharnaahum falam nughaadir minhum ahadaa
map.18:48: Wa'uridoo 'alaa rabbika saffaa, laqad ji'tumoonaa kamaa khalaqnaakum awwala marrah, bal za'amtum allan naj'ala lakum maw'idaa
map.18:49: Wawudi'al-kitaabu fataral-mujrimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa feehi wayaqooloona yaawaylatanaa maali haadhal-kitaabi laa yughaadiru sagheerataw walaa kabeeratan illaa ahsaahaa, wawajadoo maa 'amiloo haadiraa, walaa yazlimu rabbuka ahadaa
map.18:50: Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa iblees, kaana minal-jinni fafasaqa 'an amri rabbih, afatattakhidhoonahoo wadhurriyyatahoo awliyaa'a min doonee wahum lakum 'aduww, bi'sa liz-zaalimeena badalaa
map.18:51: Maa ashhattuhum khalqas-samaawaati wal-ardi walaa khalqa anfusihim, wamaa kuntu muttakhidhal-mudilleena 'adudaa
map.18:52: Wayawma yaqoolu naadoo shurakaa'iyal-ladheena za'amtum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum waja'alnaa baynahum mawbiqaa
map.18:53: Wara'al-mujrimoonan-naara fazannoo annahum muwaaqi'oohaa walam yajidoo 'anhaa masrifaa
map.18:54: Walaqad sarrafnaa fee haadhal-qur'aani lin-naasi min kulli mathal, wakaanal-insaanu akthara shay'in jadalaa
map.18:55: Wamaa mana'an-naasa ay yu'minoo idh jaa'ahumul-hudaa wayastaghfiroo rabbahum illaa an ta'tiyahum sunnatul-awwaleena aw ya'tiyahumul-'adhaabu qubulaa
map.18:56: Wamaa nursilul-mursaleena illaa mubashshireena wamundhireen, wayujaadilul-ladheena kafaroo bil-baatili liyudhidoo bihil-haqqa wattakhadhoo aayaatee wamaa undhiroo huzuwaa
map.18:57: Waman azlamu mimman dhukkira bi'aayaati rabbihee fa'a'rada 'anhaa wanasiya maa qaddamat yadaah, innaa ja'alnaa 'alaa quloobihim akinnatan ay yafqahoohu wafee aadhaanihim waqraa, wa'in tad'uhum ilal-hudaa falay yahtadoo idhan abadaa
map.18:58: Warabbukal-ghafooru dhur-rahmah, law yu'aakhidhuhum bimaa kasaboo la'ajjala lahumul-'adhaab, bal lahum maw'idul lay yajidoo min doonihee maw'ilaa
map.18:59: Watilkal-quraa ahlaknaahum lammaa zalamoo waja'alnaa limahlikihim maw'idaa
map.18:60: Wa'idh qaala moosaa lifataahu laa abrahu hattaa ablugha majma'al-bahrayni aw amdiya huqubaa
map.18:61: Falammaa balaghaa majma'a baynihimaa nasiyaa hootahumaa fattakhadha sabeelahoo fil-bahri sarabaa
map.18:62: Falammaa jaawazaa qaala lifataahu aatinaa ghadaa'anaa, laqad laqeenaa min safarinaa haadhaa nasabaa
map.18:63: Qaala ara'ayta idh awaynaa ilas-sakhrati fa'innee naseetul-hoot, wamaa ansaaneehu illash-shaytaanu an adhkurah, wattakhadha sabeelahoo fil-bahri 'ajabaa
map.18:64: Qaala dhaalika maa kunnaa nabgh, fartaddaa 'alaa aathaarihimaa qasasaa
map.18:65: Fawajadaa 'abdam min 'ibaadinaa aataynaahu rahmatam min 'indinaa wa'allamnaahu mil ladunnaa 'ilmaa
map.18:66: Qaala lahoo moosaa hal attabi'uka 'alaa an tu'allimani mimmaa 'ullimta rushdaa
map.18:67: Qaala innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
map.18:68: Wakayfa tasbiru 'alaa maa lam tuhit bihee khubraa
map.18:69: Qaala satajidunee in shaa'allaahu saabiraw walaa a'see laka amraa
map.18:70: Qaala fa'inittaba'tanee falaa tas'alnee 'an shay'in hattaa uhditha laka minhu dhikraa
map.18:71: Fantalaqaa, hattaa idhaa rakibaa fis-safeenati kharaqahaa, qaala akharaqtahaa litughriqa ahlahaa, laqad ji'ta shay'an imraa
map.18:72: Qaala alam aqul innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
map.18:73: Qaala laa tu'aakhidhnee bimaa naseetu walaa turhiqnee min amree 'usraa
map.18:74: Fantalaqaa, hattaa idhaa laqiyaa ghulaaman faqatalahoo qaala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatam bighayri nafs, laqad ji'ta shay'an nukraa
map.18:75: Qaala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastatee'a ma'iya sabraa
map.18:76: Qaala in sa'altuka 'an shay'im ba'dahaa falaa tusaahibnee, qad balaghta mil ladunnee 'udhraa
map.18:77: Fantalaqaa, hattaa idhaa atayaa ahla qaryatinistat'amaa ahlahaa fa'abaw ay yudayyifoohumaa fawajadaa feehaa jidaaray yureedu ay yanqadda fa'aqaamah, qaala law shi'ta lattakhadhta 'alayhi ajraa
map.18:78: Qaala haadhaa firaaqu baynee wabaynik, sa'unabbi'uka bita'weeli maa lam tastati' 'alayhi sabraa
map.18:79: Ammas-safeenatu fakaanat limasaakeena ya'maloona fil-bahri fa'arattu an a'eebahaa, wakaana waraa'ahum malikuy ya'khudhu kulla safeenatin ghasbaa
map.18:80: Wa'ammal-ghulaamu fakaana abawaahu mu'minayni fakhasheenaa ay yurhiqahumaa tughyaanaw wakufraa
map.18:81: Fa'aradnaa ay yubdilahumaa rabbuhumaa khayram minhu zakaataw wa'aqraba ruhmaa
map.18:82: Wa'ammal-jidaaru fakaana lighulaamayni yateemayni fil-madeenati wakaana tahtahoo kanzul lahumaa wakaana aboohumaa saalihaa, fa'araada rabbuka ay yablughaa ashuddahumaa wayastakhrijaa kanzahumaa rahmatam mir rabbik, wamaa fa'altuhoo 'an amree, dhaalika ta'weelu maa lam tasti' 'alayhi sabraa
map.18:83: Wayas'aloonaka 'an dhil-qarnayn, qul sa'atloo 'alaykum minhu dhikraa
map.18:84: Innaa makkannaa lahoo fil-ardi wa'aataynaahu min kulli shay'in sababaa
map.18:86: Hattaa idhaa balagha maghribash-shamsi wajadahaa taghrubu fee 'aynin hami'atiw wawajada 'indahaa qawmaa, qulnaa yaadhal-qarnayni immaa an tu'adhdhiba wa'immaa an tattakhidha feehim husnaa
map.18:87: Qaala ammaa man zalama fasawfa nu'adhdhibuhoo thumma yuraddu ilaa rabbihee fayu'adhdhibuhoo 'adhaaban nukraa
map.18:88: Wa'ammaa man aamana wa'amila saalihan falahoo jazaa'anil-husnaa, wasanaqoolu lahoo min amrinaa yusraa
map.18:90: Hattaa idhaa balagha matli'ash-shamsi wajadahaa tatlu'u 'alaa qawmil lam naj'al lahum min doonihaa sitraa
map.18:91: Kadhaalik, waqad ahatnaa bimaa ladayhi khubraa
map.18:93: Hattaa idhaa balagha baynas-saddayni wajada min doonihimaa qawmal laa yakaadoona yafqahoona qawlaa
map.18:94: Qaaloo yaadhal-qarnayni inna ya'jooja wama'jooja mufsidoona fil-ardi fahal naj'alu laka kharjan 'alaa an taj'ala baynanaa wabaynahum saddaa
map.18:95: Qaala maa makkannee feehi rabbee khayrun fa'a'eenoonee biquwwatin aj'al baynakum wabaynahum radmaa
map.18:96: Aatoonee zubaral-hadeed, hattaa idhaa saawaa baynas-sadafayni qaalanfukhoo, hattaa idhaa ja'alahoo naaran qaala aatoonee ufrigh 'alayhi qitraa
map.18:97: Famastaa'oo ay yazharoohu wamastataa'oo lahoo naqbaa
map.18:98: Qaala haadhaa rahmatum mir rabbee, fa'idhaa jaa'a wa'du rabbee ja'alahoo dakkaa', wakaana wa'du rabbee haqqaa
map.18:99: Wataraknaa ba'dahum yawma'idhiy yamooju fee ba'diw wanufikha fis-soori fajama'naahum jam'aa
map.18:101: Al-ladheena kaanat a'yunuhum fee ghitaa'in 'an dhikree wakaanoo laa yastatee'oona sam'aa
map.18:102: Afahasibal-ladheena kafaroo ay yattakhidhoo 'ibaadee min doonee awliyaa', innaa a'tadnaa jahannama lil-kaafireena nuzulaa
map.18:104: Alladheena dalla sa'yuhum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wahum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sun'aa
map.18:105: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaati rabbihim waliqaa'ihee fahabitat a'maaluhum falaa nuqeemu lahum yawmal-qiyaamati waznaa
map.18:106: Dhaalika jazaa'uhum jahannamu bimaa kafaroo wattakhadhoo aayaatee warusulee huzuwaa
map.18:107: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati kaanat lahum jannaatul-firdawsi nuzulaa
map.18:109: Qul law kaanal-bahru midaadal likalimaati rabbee lanafidal-bahru qabla an tanfada kalimaatu rabbee walaw ji'naa bimithlihee madadaa
map.18:110: Qul innamaa ana basharum mithlukum yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, faman kaana yarjoo liqaa'a rabbihee falya'mal 'amalan saalihaw walaa yushrik bi'ibaadati rabbihee ahadaa
map.19:4: Qaala rabbi innee wahanal-'azmu minnee washta'alar-ra'su shaybaw walam akum bidu'aa'ika rabbi shaqiyyaa
map.19:5: Wa'innee khiftul-mawaaliya miw waraa'ee wakaanatimra'atee 'aaqiran fahab lee mil ladunka waliyyaa
map.19:6: Yarithunee wayarithu min aali ya'qooba waj'alhu rabbi radiyyaa
map.19:7: Yaazakariyyaa innaa nubashshiruka bighulaaminismuhoo yahyaa lam naj'al lahoo min qablu samiyyaa
map.19:8: Qaala rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamuw wakaanatimra'atee 'aaqiraw waqad balaghtu minal-kibari 'itiyyaa
