map.19:9: Qaala kadhaalik, qaala rabbuka huwa 'alayya hayyinuw waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shay'aa
map.19:10: Qaala rabbij'al lee aayah, qaala aayatuka allaa tukalliman-naasa thalaatha layaalin sawiyyaa
map.19:11: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee minal-mihraabi fa'awhaa ilayhim an sabbihoo bukrataw wa'ashiyyaa
map.19:13: Wahanaanam mil ladunnaa wazakaah, wakaana taqiyyaa
map.19:15: Wasalaamun 'alayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yub'athu hayyaa
map.19:16: Wadhkur fil-kitaabi maryam, idhintabadhat min ahlihaa makaanan sharqiyyaa
map.19:17: Fattakhadhat min doonihim hijaabaa, fa'arsalnaa ilayhaa roohanaa fatamaththala lahaa basharan sawiyyaa
map.19:18: Qaalat innee a'oodhu bir-rahmaani minka in kunta taqiyyaa
map.19:19: Qaala innamaa ana rasoolu rabbik, li'ahaba laki ghulaaman zakiyyaa
map.19:20: Qaalat annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamuw walam yamsasnee basharuw walam aku baghiyyaa
map.19:21: Qaala kadhaalik, qaala rabbuki huwa 'alayya hayyin, walinaj'alahoo aayatal lin-naasi warahmatam minnaa, wakaana amram maqdiyyaa
map.19:23: Fa'ajaa'ahal-makhaadu ilaa jidh'in-nakhlah, qaalat yaalaytanee mittu qabla haadhaa wakuntu nasyam mansiyyaa
map.19:24: Fanaadaahaa min tahtihaa allaa tahzanee qad ja'ala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyaa
map.19:25: Wahuzzee ilayki bijidh'in-nakhlati tusaaqit 'alayki rutaban janiyyaa
map.19:26: Fakulee washrabee waqarree 'aynaa, fa'immaa tarayinna minal-bashari ahadan faqoolee innee nadhartu lir-rahmaani sawman falan ukallimal-yawma insiyyaa
map.19:27: Fa'atat bihee qawmahaa tahmiluh, qaaloo yaamaryamu laqad ji'ti shay'an fariyyaa
map.19:28: Yaa ukhta haaroona maa kaana abookimra'a saw'iw wamaa kaanat ummuki baghiyyaa
map.19:29: Fa'ashaarat ilayh, qaaloo kayfa nukallimu man kaana fil-mahdi sabiyyaa
map.19:31: Waja'alanee mubaarakan ayna maa kunt, wa'awsaanee bis-salaati waz-zakaati maa dumtu hayyaa
map.19:32: Wabarram biwaalidatee walam yaj'alnee jabbaaran shaqiyyaa
map.19:33: Was-salaamu 'alayya yawma wulittu wayawma amootu wayawma ub'athu hayyaa
map.19:35: Maa kaana lillaahi ay yattakhidha miw waladin subhaanah, idhaa qadaa amran fa'innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
map.19:36: Wa'innallaaha rabbee warabbukum fa'budooh, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
map.19:37: Fakhtalafal-ahzaabu mim baynihim, fawaylul lilladheena kafaroo mim mashhadi yawmin 'azeem
map.19:38: Asmi' bihim wa'absir yawma ya'toonanaa laakiniz-zaalimoonal-yawma fee dalaalim mubeen
map.19:39: Wa'andhirhum yawmal-hasrati idh qudiyal-amr, wahum fee ghaflatiw wahum laa yu'minoon
map.19:40: Innaa nahnu narithul-arda waman 'alayhaa wa'ilaynaa yurja'oon
map.19:41: Wadhkur fil-kitaabi ibraaheem, innahoo kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa
map.19:42: Idh qaala li'abeehi yaa abati lima ta'budu maa laa yasma'u walaa yubsiru walaa yughnee 'anka shay'aa
map.19:43: Yaa abati innee qad jaa'anee minal-'ilmi maa lam ya'tika fattabi'nee ahdika siraatan sawiyyaa
map.19:44: Yaa abati laa ta'budish-shaytaan, innash-shaytaana kaana lir-rahmaani 'asiyyaa
map.19:45: Yaa abati innee akhaafu ay yamassaka 'adhaabum minar-rahmaani fatakoona lish-shaytaani waliyyaa
map.19:46: Qaala araaghibun anta 'an aalihatee yaa ibraaheem, la'il lam tantahi la'arjumannaka wahjurnee maliyyaa
map.19:47: Qaala salaamun 'alayk, sa'astaghfiru laka rabbee, innahoo kaana bee hafiyyaa
map.19:48: Wa'a'tazilukum wamaa tad'oona min doonillaahi wa'ad'oo rabbee, 'asaa allaa akoona bidu'aa'i rabbee shaqiyyaa
map.19:49: Falamma'tazalahum wamaa ya'budoona min doonillaahi wahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya'qoob, wakullan ja'alnaa nabiyyaa
map.19:50: Wawahabnaa lahum mir rahmatinaa waja'alnaa lahum lisaana sidqin 'aliyyaa
map.19:51: Wadhkur fil-kitaabi moosaa, innahoo kaana mukhlasaw wakaana rasoolan nabiyyaa
map.19:53: Wawahabnaa lahoo mir rahmatinaa akhaahu haaroona nabiyyaa
map.19:54: Wadhkur fil-kitaabi ismaa'eel, innahoo kaana saadiqal-wa'di wakaana rasoolan nabiyyaa
map.19:55: Wakaana ya'muru ahlahoo bis-salaati waz-zakaah, wakaana 'inda rabbihee mardiyyaa
map.19:56: Wadhkur fil-kitaabi idrees, innahoo kaana siddeeqan nabiyyaa
map.19:58: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena an'amallaahu 'alayhim minan-nabiyyeena min dhurriyyati aadama wamimman hamalnaa ma'a nooh, wamin dhurriyyati ibraaheema wa'israa'eel, wamimman hadaynaa wajtabaynaa, idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatur-rahmaani kharroo sujjadaw wabukiyyaa
map.19:59: Fakhalafa mim ba'dihim khalfun adaa'us-salaata wattaba'ush-shahawaati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyaa
map.19:60: Illaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amila saalihan fa'ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata walaa yuzlamoona shay'aa
map.19:61: Jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'adar-rahmaanu 'ibaadahoo bil-ghayb, innahoo kaana wa'duhoo ma'tiyyaa
map.19:62: Laa yasma'oona feehaa laghwan illaa salaamaa, walahum rizquhum feehaa bukrataw wa'ashiyyaa
map.19:63: Tilkal-jannatul-latee noorithu min 'ibaadinaa man kaana taqiyyaa
map.19:64: Wamaa natanazzalu illaa bi'amri rabbik, lahoo maa bayna aydeenaa wamaa khalfanaa wamaa bayna dhaalika wamaa kaana rabbuka nasiyyaa
map.19:65: Rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa fa'budhu wastabir li'ibaadatih, hal ta'lamu lahoo samiyyaa
map.19:66: Wayaqoolul-insaanu a'idhaa maa mittu lasawfa ukhraju hayyaa
map.19:67: Awalaa yadhkurul-insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min qablu walam yaku shay'aa
map.19:68: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum wash-shayaateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyaa
map.19:69: Thumma lananzi'anna min kulli shee'atin ayyuhum ashaddu 'alar-rahmaani 'itiyyaa
map.19:70: Thumma lanahnu a'lamu bil-ladheena hum awlaa bihaa siliyyaa
map.19:71: Wa'im minkum illaa waariduhaa, kaana 'alaa rabbika hatmam maqdiyyaa
map.19:73: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo ayyul-fareeqayni khayrum maqaamaw wa'ahsanu nadiyyaa
map.19:74: Wakam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athaathaw wari'yaa
map.19:75: Qul man kaana fid-dalaalati falyamdud lahur-rahmaanu maddaa, hattaa idhaa ra'aw maa yoo'adoona immal-'adhaaba wa'immas-saa'ah, fasaya'lamoona man huwa sharrum makaanaw wa'ad'afu jundaa
map.19:76: Wayazeedullaahul-ladheenahtadaw hudaa, wal-baaqiyaatus-saalihaatu khayrun 'inda rabbika thawaabaw wakhayrum maraddaa
map.19:77: Afara'aytal-ladhee kafara bi'aayaatinaa waqaala la'ootayanna maalaw wawaladaa
map.19:79: Kallaa, sanaktubu maa yaqoolu wanamuddu lahoo minal-'adhaabi maddaa
map.19:81: Wattakhadhoo min doonillaahi aalihatal liyakoonoo lahum 'izzaa
map.19:83: Alam tara annaa arsalnash-shayaateena 'alal-kaafireena ta'uzzuhum azzaa
map.19:90: Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqul-ardu watakhirrul-jibaalu haddaa
map.19:92: Wamaa yambaghee lir-rahmaani ay yattakhidha waladaa
map.19:93: In kullu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi illaa aatir-rahmaani 'abdaa
map.19:96: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati sayaj'alu lahumur-rahmaanu wuddaa
map.19:97: Fa'innamaa yassarnaahu bilisaanika litubashshira bihil-muttaqeena watundhira bihee qawmal luddaa
map.19:98: Wakam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarn, hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasma'u lahum rikzaa
map.20:6: Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wamaa baynahumaa wamaa tahtath-tharaa
map.20:7: Wa'in tajhar bil-qawli fa'innahoo ya'lamus-sirra wa'akhfaa
map.20:8: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, lahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa
map.20:10: Idh ra'aa naaran faqaala li'ahlihimkuthoo innee aanastu naaral la'allee aateekum minhaa biqabasin aw ajidu 'alan-naari hudaa
map.20:12: Innee ana rabbuka fakhla' na'layk, innaka bil-waadil-muqaddasi tuwaa
map.20:14: Innanee anallaahu laa ilaaha illaa ana fa'budnee wa'aqimis-salaata lidhikree
map.20:15: Innas-saa'ata aatiyatun akaadu ukhfeehaa litujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa tas'aa
map.20:16: Falaa yasuddannaka 'anhaa mal laa yu'minu bihaa wattaba'a hawaahu fatardaa
map.20:18: Qaala hiya 'asaay, atawakka'u 'alayhaa wa'ahushshu bihaa 'alaa ghanamee waliya feehaa ma'aaribu ukhraa
map.20:21: Qaala khudhhaa walaa takhaf, sanu'eeduhaa seeratahal-oolaa
map.20:22: Wadmum yadaka ilaa janaahika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo'in aayatan ukhraa
map.20:38: Idh awhaynaa ilaa ummika maa yoohaa
map.20:39: Aniqdhifeehi fit-taabooti faqdhifeehi fil-yammi falyulqihil-yammu bis-saahili ya'khudhhu 'aduwwul lee wa'aduwwul lah, wa'alqaytu 'alayka mahabbatam minnee, walitusna'a 'alaa 'aynee
map.20:40: Idh tamshee ukhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum 'alaa may yakfuluh, faraja'naaka ilaa ummika kay taqarra 'aynuhaa walaa tahzan, waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaaka minal-ghammi wafatannaaka futoonaa, falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma ji'ta 'alaa qadariy yaamoosaa
map.20:42: Idhhab anta wa'akhooka bi'aayaatee walaa taniyaa fee dhikree
map.20:44: Faqoolaa lahoo qawlal layyinal la'allahoo yatadhakkaru aw yakhshaa
map.20:45: Qaalaa rabbanaa innanaa nakhaafu ay yafruta 'alaynaa aw ay yatghaa
map.20:46: Qaala laa takhaafaa innanee ma'akumaa asma'u wa'araa
map.20:47: Fa'tiyaahu faqoolaa innaa rasoolaa rabbika fa'arsil ma'anaa banee israa'eela walaa tu'adhdhibhum, qad ji'naaka bi'aayatim mir rabbik, was-salaamu 'alaa manittaba'al-hudaa
map.20:48: Innaa qad oohiya ilaynaa annal-'adhaaba 'alaa man kadhdhaba watawallaa
map.20:50: Qaala rabbunal-ladhee a'taa kulla shay'in khalqahoo thumma hadaa
map.20:52: Qaala 'ilmuhaa 'inda rabbee fee kitaab, laa yadillu rabbee walaa yansaa
map.20:53: Al-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda mahdaw wasalaka lakum feehaa subulaw wa'anzala minas-samaa'i maa'aa, fa'akhrajnaa bihee azwaajam min nabaatin shattaa
map.20:54: Kuloo war'aw an'aamakum, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil li'ulin-nuhaa
map.20:55: Minhaa khalaqnaakum wafeehaa nu'eedukum waminhaa nukhrijukum taaratan ukhraa
map.20:56: Walaqad araynaahu aayaatinaa kullahaa fakadhdhaba wa'abaa
map.20:57: Qaala aji'tanaa litukhrijanaa min ardinaa bisihrika yaamoosaa
map.20:58: Falana'tiyannaka bisihrim mithlihee faj'al baynanaa wabaynaka maw'idal laa nukhlifuhoo nahnu walaa anta makaanan suwaa
map.20:59: Qaala maw'idukum yawmuz-zeenati wa'ay yuhsharan-naasu duhaa
map.20:60: Fatawallaa fir'awnu fajama'a kaydahoo thumma ataa
map.20:61: Qaala lahum moosaa waylakum laa taftaroo 'alallaahi kadhiban fayushitakum bi'adhaab, waqad khaaba maniftaraa
map.20:63: Qaaloo in haadhaani lasaahiraani yureedaani ay yukhrijaakum min ardikum bisihrihimaa wayadhhabaa bitareeqatikumul-muthlaa
map.20:64: Fa'ajmi'oo kaydakum thumma'too saffaa, waqad aflahal-yawma manista'laa
map.20:65: Qaaloo yaamoosaa immaa an tulqiya wa'immaa an nakoona awwala man alqaa
map.20:66: Qaala bal alqoo, fa'idhaa hibaaluhum wa'isiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annahaa tas'aa
map.20:69: Wa'alqi maa fee yameenika talqaf maa sana'oo, innamaa sana'oo kaydu saahir, walaa yuflihus-saahiru haythu ataa
map.20:70: Fa'ulqiyas-saharatu sujjadan qaaloo aamannaa birabbi haaroona wamoosaa
map.20:71: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aadhana lakum, innahoo lakabeerukumul-ladhee 'allamakumus-sihr, fala'uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa'arjulakum min khilaafiw wala'usallibannakum fee judhoo'in-nakhl, walata'lamunna ayyunaa ashaddu 'adhaabaw wa'abqaa
map.20:72: Qaaloo lan nu'thiraka 'alaa maa jaa'anaa minal-bayyinaati wal-ladhee fataranaa faqdi maa anta qaad, innamaa taqdee haadhihil-hayaatad-dunyaa
map.20:73: Innaa aamannaa birabbinaa liyaghfira lanaa khataayaanaa wamaa akrahtanaa 'alayhi minas-sihr, wallaahu khayruw wa'abqaa
map.20:74: Innahoo may ya'ti rabbahoo mujriman fa'inna lahoo jahannam, laa yamootu feehaa walaa yahyaa
map.20:75: Wamay ya'tihee mu'minan qad 'amilas-saalihaati fa'ulaa'ika lahumud-darajaatul-'ulaa
map.20:76: Jannaatu 'adnin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, wadhaalika jazaa'u man tazakkaa
map.20:77: Walaqad awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an asri bi'ibaadee fadrib lahum tareeqan fil-bahri yabasal laa takhaafu darakaw walaa takhshaa
map.20:78: Fa'atba'ahum fir'awnu bijunoodihee faghashiyahum minal-yammi maa ghashiyahum
map.20:80: Yaabanee israa'eela qad anjaynaakum min 'aduwwikum wawaa'adnaakum jaanibat-tooril-aymana wanazzalnaa 'alaykumul-manna was-salwaa
map.20:81: Kuloo min tayyibaati maa razaqnaakum walaa tatghaw feehi fayahilla 'alaykum ghadabee, wamay yahlil 'alayhi ghadabee faqad hawaa
map.20:82: Wa'innee laghaffaarul liman taaba wa'aamana wa'amila saalihan thummahtadaa
map.20:84: Qaala hum ulaa'i 'alaa atharee wa'ajiltu ilayka rabbi litardaa
map.20:85: Qaala fa'innaa qad fatannaa qawmaka mim ba'dika wa'adallahumus-saamiriyy
map.20:86: Faraja'a moosaa ilaa qawmihee ghadbaana asifaa, qaala yaaqawmi alam ya'idkum rabbukum wa'dan hasanaa, afataala 'alaykumul-'ahdu am arattum ay yahilla 'alaykum ghadabum mir rabbikum fa'akhlaftum maw'idee
map.20:87: Qaaloo maa akhlafnaa maw'idaka bimalkinaa walaakinnaa hummilnaa awzaaram min zeenatil-qawmi faqadhafnaahaa fakadhaalika alqas-saamiriyy
map.20:88: Fa'akhraja lahum 'ijlan jasadal lahoo khuwaarun faqaaloo haadhaa ilaahukum wa'ilaahu moosaa fanasiy
map.20:89: Afalaa yarawna allaa yarji'u ilayhim qawlaw walaa yamliku lahum darraw walaa naf'aa
map.20:90: Walaqad qaala lahum haaroonu min qablu yaaqawmi innamaa futintum bih, wa'inna rabbakumur-rahmaanu fattabi'oonee wa'atee'oo amree
map.20:91: Qaaloo lan nabraha 'alayhi 'aakifeena hattaa yarji'a ilaynaa moosaa
map.20:92: Qaala yaahaaroonu maa mana'aka idh ra'aytahum dalloo
map.20:94: Qaala yabna'umma laa ta'khudh bilihyatee walaa bira'see, innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israa'eela walam tarqub qawlee
map.20:96: Qaala basurtu bimaa lam yabsuroo bihee faqabadtu qabdatam min atharir-rasooli fanabadhtuhaa wakadhaalika sawwalat lee nafsee
map.20:97: Qaala fadhhab fa'inna laka fil-hayaati an taqoola laa misaas, wa'inna laka maw'idal lan tukhlafah, wanzur ilaa ilaahikal-ladhee zalta 'alayhi 'aakifaa, lanuharriqannahoo thumma lanansifannahoo fil-yammi nasfaa
map.20:98: Innamaa ilaahukumullaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, wasi'a kulla shay'in 'ilmaa
map.20:99: Kadhaalika naqussu 'alayka min ambaa'i maa qad sabaq, waqad aataynaaka mil ladunnaa dhikraa
map.20:100: Man a'rada 'anhu fa'innahoo yahmilu yawmal-qiyaamati wizraa
map.20:101: Khaalideena feeh, wasaa'a lahum yawmal-qiyaamati himlaa
map.20:102: Yawma yunfakhu fis-soori wanahshurul-mujrimeena yawma'idhin zurqaa
map.20:104: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona idh yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan il labithtum illaa yawmaa
map.20:108: Yawma'idhiy yattabi'oonad-daa'iya laa 'iwaja lah, wakhasha'atil-aswaatu lir-rahmaani falaa tasma'u illaa hamsaa
map.20:109: Yawma'idhil laa tanfa'ush-shafaa'atu illaa man adhina lahur-rahmaanu waradiya lahoo qawlaa
map.20:110: Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yuheetoona bihee 'ilmaa
map.20:111: Wa'anatil-wujoohu lil-hayyil-qayyoom, waqad khaaba man hamala zulmaa
map.20:112: Wamay ya'mal minas-saalihaati wahuwa mu'minun falaa yakhaafu zulmaw walaa hadmaa
map.20:113: Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu qur'aanan 'arabiyyaw wasarrafnaa feehi minal-wa'eedi la'allahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum dhikraa
map.20:114: Fata'aalallaahul-malikul-haqq, walaa ta'jal bil-qur'aani min qabli ay yuqdaa ilayka wahyuh, waqur rabbi zidnee 'ilmaa
map.20:115: Walaqad 'ahidnaa ilaa aadama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahoo 'azmaa
map.20:116: Wa'idh qulnaa lil-malaa'ikatisjudoo li'aadama fasajadoo illaa ibleesa abaa
map.20:117: Faqulnaa yaa aadamu inna haadhaa 'aduwwul laka walizawjika falaa yukhrijannakumaa minal-jannati fatashqaa
map.20:118: Inna laka allaa tajoo'a feehaa walaa ta'raa
map.20:119: Wa'annaka laa tazma'u feehaa walaa tadhaa
map.20:120: Fawaswasa ilayhish-shaytaanu qaala yaa aadamu hal adulluka 'alaa shajaratil-khuldi wamulkil laa yablaa
map.20:121: Fa'akalaa minhaa fabadat lahumaa saw'aatuhumaa watafiqaa yakhsifaani 'alayhimaa miw waraqil-jannah, wa'asaa aadamu rabbahoo faghawaa
map.20:123: Qaalahbitaa minhaa jamee'am ba'dukum liba'din 'aduww, fa'immaa ya'tiyannakum minnee hudan famanittaba'a hudaaya falaa yadillu walaa yashqaa
map.20:124: Waman a'rada 'an dhikree fa'inna lahoo ma'eeshatan dankaw wanahshuruhoo yawmal-qiyaamati a'maa
map.20:125: Qaala rabbi lima hashartanee a'maa waqad kuntu baseeraa
map.20:126: Qaala kadhaalika atatka aayaatunaa fanaseetahaa, wakadhaalikal-yawma tunsaa
map.20:127: Wakadhaalika najzee man asrafa walam yu'mim bi'aayaati rabbih, wala'adhaabul-aakhirati ashaddu wa'abqaa
map.20:128: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil li'ulin-nuhaa
map.20:129: Walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika lakaana lizaamaw wa'ajalum musammaa
map.20:130: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'ish-shamsi waqabla ghuroobihaa, wamin aanaa'il-layli fasabbih wa'atraafan-nahaari la'allaka tardaa
map.20:131: Walaa tamuddanna 'aynayka ilaa maa matta'naa bihee azwaajam minhum zahratal-hayaatid-dunyaa linaftinahum feeh, warizqu rabbika khayruw wa'abqaa
map.20:132: Wa'mur ahlaka bis-salaati wastabir 'alayhaa, laa nas'aluka rizqaa, nahnu narzuquk, wal-'aaqibatu lit-taqwaa
map.20:133: Waqaaloo lawlaa ya'teenaa bi'aayatim mir rabbih, awalam ta'tihim bayyinatu maa fis-suhufil-oolaa
map.20:134: Walaw annaa ahlaknaahum bi'adhaabim min qablihee laqaaloo rabbanaa lawlaa arsalta ilaynaa rasoolan fanattabi'a aayaatika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhzaa
map.20:135: Qul kullum mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo, fasata'lamoona man ashaabus-siraatis-sawiyyi wamanihtadaa
map.21:1: Iqtaraba lin-naasi hisaabuhum wahum fee ghaflatim mu'ridoon
map.21:2: Maa ya'teehim min dhikrim mir rabbihim muhdathin illastama'oohu wahum yal'aboon
map.21:3: Laahiyatan quloobuhum, wa'asarrun-najwaa, al-ladheena zalamoo, hal haadhaa illaa basharum mithlukum, afata'toonas-sihra wa'antum tubsiroon
map.21:4: Qaala rabbee ya'lamul-qawla fis-samaa'i wal-ard, wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.21:5: Bal qaaloo adghaathu ahlaamim baliftaraahu bal huwa shaa'ir, falya'tinaa bi'aayatin kamaa ursilal-awwaloon
map.21:6: Maa aamanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa, afahum yu'minoon
map.21:7: Wamaa arsalnaa qablaka illaa rijaalan noohee ilayhim fas'aloo ahladh-dhikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
map.21:8: Wamaa ja'alnaahum jasadal laa ya'kuloonat-ta'aama wamaa kaanoo khaalideen
map.21:9: Thumma sadaqnaahumul-wa'da fa'anjaynaahum waman nashaa'u wa'ahlaknal-musrifeen
map.21:10: Laqad anzalnaa ilaykum kitaaban feehi dhikrukum, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.21:11: Wakam qasamnaa min qaryatin kaanat zaalimataw wa'ansha'naa ba'dahaa qawman aakhareen
map.21:12: Falammaa ahassoo ba'sanaa idhaa hum minhaa yarkudoon
map.21:13: Laa tarkudoo warji'oo ilaa maa utriftum feehi wamasaakinikum la'allakum tus'aloon
map.21:15: Famaa zaalat tilka da'waahum hattaa ja'alnaahum haseedan khaamideen
map.21:16: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
map.21:17: Law aradnaa an nattakhidha lahwal lattakhadhnaahu mil ladunnaa, in kunnaa faa'ileen
map.21:18: Bal naqdhifu bil-haqqi 'alal-baatili fayadmaghuhoo fa'idhaa huwa zaahiq, walakumul-waylu mimmaa tasifoon
map.21:19: Walahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ard, waman 'indahoo laa yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatihee walaa yastahsiroon
map.21:22: Law kaana feehimaa aalihatun illallaahu lafasadataa, fasubhaanallaahi rabbil-'arshi 'ammaa yasifoon
map.21:24: Amittakhadhoo min doonihee aalihah, qul haatoo burhaanakum, haadhaa dhikru mam ma'iya wadhikru man qablee, bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoonal-haqqa fahum mu'ridoon
map.21:25: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika mir rasoolin illaa noohee ilayhi annahoo laa ilaaha illaa ana fa'budoon
map.21:27: Laa yasbiqoonahoo bil-qawli wahum bi'amrihee ya'maloon
map.21:28: Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum walaa yashfa'oona illaa limanirtadaa wahum min khashyatihee mushfiqoon
map.21:29: Wamay yaqul minhum innee ilaahum min doonihee fadhaalika najzeehi jahannam, kadhaalika najziz-zaalimeen
map.21:30: Awalam yaral-ladheena kafaroo annas-samaawaati wal-arda kaanataa ratqan fafataqnaahumaa, waja'alnaa minal-maa'i kulla shay'in hayy, afalaa yu'minoon
map.21:31: Waja'alnaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bihim, waja'alnaa feehaa fijaajan subulal la'allahum yahtadoon
map.21:32: Waja'alnas-samaa'a saqfam mahfoozaa, wahum 'an aayaatihaa mu'ridoon
map.21:33: Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqal-layla wan-nahaara wash-shamsa wal-qamar, kullun fee falakiy yasbahoon
map.21:34: Wamaa ja'alnaa libasharim min qablikal-khuld, afa'im mitta fahumul-khaalidoon
map.21:35: Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawt, wanablookum bish-sharri wal-khayri fitnah, wa'ilaynaa turja'oon
map.21:36: Wa'idhaa ra'aakal-ladheena kafaroo iy yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwaa, ahaadhal-ladhee yadhkuru aalihatakum, wahum bidhikrir-rahmaani hum kaafiroon
map.21:37: Khuliqal-insaanu min 'ajal, sa'ureekum aayaatee falaa tasta'jiloon
map.21:38: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
map.21:39: Law ya'lamul-ladheena kafaroo heena laa yakuffoona 'aw wujoohihimun-naara walaa 'an zuhoorihim walaa hum yunsaroon
map.21:40: Bal ta'teehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falaa yastatee'oona raddahaa walaa hum yunzaroon
map.21:41: Walaqadistuhzi'a birusulim min qablika fahaaqa bil-ladheena sakhiroo minhum maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.21:42: Qul may yakla'ukum bil-layli wan-nahaari minar-rahmaan, bal hum 'an dhikri rabbihim mu'ridoon
map.21:43: Am lahum aalihatun tamna'uhum min dooninaa, laa yastatee'oona nasra anfusihim walaa hum minnaa yushaboon
map.21:44: Bal matta'naa haa'ulaa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa taala 'alayhimul-'umur, afalaa yarawna annaa na'til-arda nanqusuhaa min atraafihaa, afahumul-ghaaliboon
map.21:45: Qul innamaa undhirukum bil-wahy, walaa yasma'us-summud-du'aa'a idhaa maa yundharoon
map.21:46: Wala'im massathum nafhatum min 'adhaabi rabbika layaqoolunna yaawaylanaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen
map.21:47: Wanada'ul-mawaazeenal-qista liyawmil-qiyaamati falaa tuzlamu nafsun shay'aa, wa'in kaana mithqaala habbatim min khardalin ataynaa bihaa, wakafaa binaa haasibeen
map.21:48: Walaqad aataynaa moosaa wahaaroonal-furqaana wadiyaa'aw wadhikral lil-muttaqeen
map.21:49: Al-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum minas-saa'ati mushfiqoon
map.21:50: Wahaadhaa dhikrum mubaarakun anzalnaah, afa'antum lahoo munkiroon
map.21:51: Walaqad aataynaa ibraaheema rushdahoo min qablu wakunnaa bihee 'aalimeen
map.21:52: Idh qaala li'abeehi waqawmihee maa haadhihit-tamaatheelul-latee antum lahaa 'aakifoon
map.21:54: Qaala laqad kuntum antum wa'aabaa'ukum fee dalaalim mubeen
map.21:55: Qaaloo aji'tanaa bil-haqqi am anta minallaa'ibeen
map.21:56: Qaala bar rabbukum rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardil-ladhee fatarahunn, wa'ana 'alaa dhaalikum minash-shaahideen
map.21:57: Watallaahi la'akeedanna asnaamakum ba'da an tuwalloo mudbireen
map.21:58: Faja'alahum judhaadhan illaa kabeeral lahum la'allahum ilayhi yarji'oon
map.21:59: Qaaloo man fa'ala haadhaa bi'aalihatinaa innahoo laminaz-zaalimeen
map.21:60: Qaaloo sami'naa fatay yadhkuruhum yuqaalu lahoo ibraaheem
map.21:61: Qaaloo fa'too bihee 'alaa a'yunin-naasi la'allahum yashhadoon
map.21:62: Qaaloo a'anta fa'alta haadhaa bi'aalihatinaa yaa ibraaheem
map.21:63: Qaala bal fa'alahoo kabeeruhum haadhaa fas'aloohum in kaanoo yantiqoon
map.21:64: Faraja'oo ilaa anfusihim faqaaloo innakum antumuz-zaalimoon
map.21:65: Thumma nukisoo 'alaa ru'oosihim, laqad 'alimta maa haa'ulaa'i yantiqoon
map.21:66: Qaala afata'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'ukum shay'aw walaa yadurrukum
map.21:67: Uffil lakum walimaa ta'budoona min doonillaah, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.21:68: Qaaloo harriqoohu wansuroo aalihatakum in kuntum faa'ileen
map.21:69: Qulnaa yaanaaru koonee bardaw wasalaaman 'alaa ibraaheem
map.21:71: Wanajjaynaahu walootan ilal-ardil-latee baarakn'a feehaa lil-'aalameen
map.21:72: Wawahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya'qooba naafilah, wakullan ja'alnaa saaliheen
map.21:73: Waja'alnaahum a'immatay yahdoona bi'amrinaa wa'awhaynaa ilayhim fi'lal-khayraati wa'iqaamas-salaati wa'eetaa'az-zakaah, wakaanoo lanaa 'aabideen
map.21:74: Walootan aataynaahu hukmaw wa'ilmaw wanajjaynaahu minal-qaryatil-latee kaanat ta'malul-khabaa'ith, innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in faasiqeen
map.21:76: Wanoohan idh naadaa min qablu fastajabnaa lahoo fanajjaynaahu wa'ahlahoo minal-karbil-'azeem
map.21:77: Wanasarnaahu minal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, innahum kaanoo qawma saw'in fa'aghraqnaahum ajma'een
map.21:78: Wadaawooda wasulaymaana idh yahkumaani fil-harthi idh nafashat feehi ghanamul-qawm, wakunnaa lihukmihim shaahideen
map.21:79: Fafahhamnaahaa sulaymaan, wakullan aataynaa hukmaw wa'ilmaa, wasakhkharnaa ma'a daawoodal-jibaala yusabbihna wat-tayr, wakunnaa faa'ileen
map.21:80: Wa'allamnaahu san'ata laboosil lakum lituhsinakum mim ba'sikum, fahal antum shaakiroon
map.21:81: Walisulaymaanar-reeha 'aasifatan tajree bi'amrihee ilal-ardil-latee baaraknaa feehaa, wakunnaa bikulli shay'in 'aalimeen
map.21:82: Waminash-shayaateeni may yaghoosoona lahoo waya'maloona 'amalan doona dhaalik, wakunnaa lahum haafizeen
map.21:83: Wa'ayyooba idh naadaa rabbahoo annee massaniyad-durru wa'anta arhamur-raahimeen
map.21:84: Fastajabnaa lahoo fakashafnaa maa bihee min durriw wa'aataynaahu ahlahoo wamithlahum ma'ahum rahmatam min 'indinaa wadhikraa lil-'aabideen
map.21:87: Wadhan-nooni idh dhahaba mughaadiban fazanna al lan naqdira 'alayhi fanaadaa fiz-zulumaati al laa ilaaha illaa anta subhaanaka innee kuntu minaz-zaalimeen
map.21:88: Fastajabnaa lahoo wanajjaynaahu minal-ghamm, wakadhaalika nujil-mu'mineen
map.21:89: Wazakariyyaa idh naadaa rabbahoo rabbi laa tadharnee fardaw wa'anta khayrul-waaritheen
map.21:90: Fastajabnaa lah, wawahabnaa lahoo yahyaa wa'aslahnaa lahoo zawjah, innahum kaanoo yusaari'oona fil-khayraati wayad'oonanaa raghabaw warahabaa, wakaanoo lanaa khaashi'een
map.21:91: Wal-latee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehaa mir roohinaa waja'alnaahaa wabnahaa aayatal lil-'aalameen
map.21:92: Inna haadhihee ummatukum ummataw waahidah, wa'ana rabbukum fa'budoon
map.21:93: Wataqatta'oo amrahum baynahum, kullun ilaynaa raaji'oon
map.21:94: Famay ya'mal minas-saalihaati wahuwa mu'minun falaa kufraana lisa'yih, wa'innaa lahoo kaatiboon
map.21:95: Waharaamun 'alaa qaryatin ahlaknaahaa annahum laa yarji'oon
map.21:96: Hattaa idhaa futihat ya'jooju wama'jooju wahum min kulli hadabiy yansiloon
map.21:97: Waqtarabal-wa'dul-haqqu fa'idhaa hiya shaakhisatun absaarul-ladheena kafaroo, yaawaylanaa qad kunnaa fee ghaflatim min haadhaa bal kunnaa zaalimeen
map.21:98: Innakum wamaa ta'budoona min doonillaahi hasabu jahannam, antum lahaa waaridoon
map.21:99: Law kaana haa'ulaa'i aalihatam maa waradoohaa, wakullun feehaa khaalidoon
map.21:100: Lahum feehaa zafeeruw wahum feehaa laa yasma'oon
map.21:101: Innal-ladheena sabaqat lahum minnal-husnaa ulaa'ika 'anhaa mub'adoon
map.21:102: Laa yasma'oona haseesahaa, wahum fee mashtahat anfusuhum khaalidoon
map.21:103: Laa yahzunuhumul-faza'ul-akbaru watatalaqqaahumul-malaa'ikah, haadhaa yawmukumul-ladhee kuntum too'adoon
map.21:104: Yawma natwis-samaa'a katayyis-sijilli lil-kutub, kamaa bada'naa awwala khalqin nu'eeduh, wa'dan 'alaynaa, innaa kunnaa faa'ileen
map.21:105: Walaqad katabnaa fiz-zaboori mim ba'didh-dhikri annal-arda yarithuhaa 'ibaadiyas-saalihoon
map.21:108: Qul innamaa yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahuw waahid, fahal antum muslimoon
map.21:109: Fa'in tawallaw faqul aadhantukum 'alaa sawaa', wa'in adree aqareebun am ba'eedum maa too'adoon
map.21:110: Innahoo ya'lamul-jahra minal-qawli waya'lamu maa taktumoon
map.21:111: Wa'in adree la'allahoo fitnatul lakum wamataa'un ilaa heen
map.21:112: Qaala rabbihkum bil-haqq, warabbunar-rahmaanul-musta'aanu 'alaa maa tasifoon
map.22:1: Yaa ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakum, inna zalzalatas-saa'ati shay'un 'azeem
map.22:2: Yawma tarawnahaa tadhhalu kullu murdi'atin 'ammaa arda'at watada'u kullu dhaati hamlin hamlahaa wataran-naasa sukaaraa wamaa hum bisukaaraa walaakinna 'adhaaballaahi shadeed
map.22:3: Waminan-naasi may yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri 'ilmiw wayattabi'u kulla shaytaanim mareed
map.22:4: Kutiba 'alayhi annahoo man tawallaahu fa'annahoo yudilluhoo wayahdeehi ilaa 'adhaabis-sa'eer
map.22:5: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu in kuntum fee raybim minal-ba'thi fa'innaa khalaqnaakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma mim mudghatim mukhallaqatiw waghayri mukhallaqatil linubayyina lakum, wanuqirru fil-arhaami maa nashaa'u ilaa ajalim musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum, waminkum may yutawaffaa waminkum may yuraddu ilaa ardhalil-'umuri likaylaa ya'lama mim ba'di 'ilmin shay'aa, wataral-arda haamidatan fa'idhaa anzalnaa 'alayhal-maa'ahtazzat warabat wa'ambatat min kulli zawjim baheej
map.22:6: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'annahoo yuhyil-mawtaa wa'annahoo 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.22:7: Wa'annas-saa'ata aatiyatul laa rayba feehaa wa'annallaaha yab'athu man fil-quboor
map.22:8: Waminan-naasi may yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri 'ilmiw walaa hudaw walaa kitaabim muneer
map.22:9: Thaaniya 'itfihee liyudilla 'an sabeelillaah, lahoo fid-dunyaa khizyuw wanudheequhoo yawmal-qiyaamati 'adhaabal-hareeq
map.22:10: Dhaalika bimaa qaddamat yadaaka wa'annallaaha laysa bizallaamil lil-'abeed
map.22:11: Waminan-naasi may ya'budullaaha 'alaa harf, fa'in asaabahoo khayrunitma'anna bih, wa'in asaabathu fitnatuninqalaba 'alaa wajhih, khasirad-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen
map.22:12: Yad'oo min doonillaahi maa laa yadurruhoo wamaa laa yanfa'uh, dhaalika huwad-dalaalul-ba'eed
map.22:13: Yad'oo laman darruhoo aqrabu min naf'ih, labi'sal-mawlaa walabi'sal-'asheer
map.22:14: Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, innallaaha yaf'alu maa yureed
map.22:15: Man kaana yazunnu al lay yansurahullaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati falyamdud bisababin ilas-samaa'i thumma lyaqta' falyanzur hal yudhhibanna kayduhoo maa yagheez
map.22:16: Wakadhaalika anzalnaahu aayaatim bayyinaatiw wa'annallaaha yahdee may yureed
map.22:17: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wal-ladheena haadoo was-saabi'eena wan-nasaaraa wal-majoosa wal-ladheena ashrakoo, innallaaha yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamah, innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
map.22:18: Alam tara annallaaha yasjudu lahoo man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ardi wash-shamsu wal-qamaru wan-nujoomu wal-jibaalu wash-shajaru wad-dawaabbu wakatheerum minan-naas, wakatheerun haqqa 'alayhil-'adhaab, wamay yuhinillaahu famaa lahoo mim mukrim, innallaaha yaf'alu maa yashaa'
map.22:19: Haadhaani khasmaanikhtasamoo fee rabbihim fal-ladheena kafaroo qutti'at lahum thiyaabum min naar, yusabbu min fawqi ru'oosihimul-hameem
map.22:20: Yusharu bihee maa fee butoonihim wal-julood
map.22:22: Kullamaa araadoo ay yakhrujoo minhaa min ghammin u'eedoo feehaa wadhooqoo 'adhaabal-hareeq
map.22:23: Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabiw walu'lu'aa, walibaasuhum feehaa hareer
map.22:24: Wahudoo ilat-tayyibi minal-qawl, wahudoo ilaa siraatil-hameed
map.22:25: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wayasuddoona 'an sabeelillaahi wal-masjidil-haraamil-ladhee ja'alnaahu lin-naasi sawaa'anil-'aakifu feehi wal-baad, wamay yurid feehi bi'ilhaadim bizulmin nudhiqhu min 'adhaabin aleem
map.22:26: Wa'idh bawwa'naa li'ibraaheema makaanal-bayti al laa tushrik bee shay'aw watahhir baytiya lit-taa'ifeena wal-qaa'imeena war-rukka'is-sujood
map.22:27: Wa'adhdhin fin-naasi bil-hajji ya'tooka rijaalaw wa'alaa kulli daamiriy ya'teena min kulli fajjin 'ameeq
map.22:28: Liyashhadoo manaafi'a lahum wayadhkurusmallaahi fee ayyaamim ma'loomaatin 'alaa maa razaqahum mim baheematil-an'aam, fakuloo minhaa wa'at'imul-baa'isal-faqeer
map.22:29: Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nudhoorahum walyattawwafoo bil-baytil-'ateeq
map.22:30: Dhaalika wamay yu'azzim hurumaatillaahi fahuwa khayrul lahoo 'inda rabbih, wa'uhillat lakumul-an'aamu illaa maa yutlaa 'alaykum fajtanibur-rijsa minal-awthaani wajtaniboo qawlaz-zoor
map.22:31: Hunafaa'a lillaahi ghayra mushrikeena bih, wamay yushrik billaahi faka'annamaa kharra minas-samaa'i fatakhtafuhut-tayru aw tahwee bihir-reehu fee makaanin saheeq
map.22:32: Dhaalika wamay yu'azzim sha'aa'irallaahi fa'innahaa min taqwal-quloob
map.22:33: Lakum feehaa manaafi'u ilaa ajalim musamman thumma mahilluhaa ilal-baytil-'ateeq
map.22:34: Walikulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakal liyadhkurusmallaahi 'alaa maa razaqahum mim baheematil-an'aam, fa'ilaahukum ilaahuw waahidun falahoo aslimoo, wabashshiril-mukhbiteen
map.22:35: Al-ladheena idhaa dhukirallaahu wajilat quloobuhum was-saabireena 'alaa maa asaabahum wal-muqeemis-salaati wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
map.22:36: Wal-budna ja'alnaahaa lakum min sha'aa'irillaahi lakum feehaa khayr, fadhkurusmallaahi 'alayhaa sawaaff, fa'idhaa wajabat junoobuhaa fakuloo minhaa wa'at'imul-qaani'a wal-mu'tarr, kadhaalika sakhkharnaahaa lakum la'allakum tashkuroon
map.22:37: Lay yanaalallaaha luhoomuhaa walaa dimaa'uhaa walaakiy yanaaluhut-taqwaa minkum, kadhaalika sakhkharahaa lakum litukabbirullaaha 'alaa maa hadaakum, wabashshiril-muhsineen
map.22:38: Innallaaha yudaafi'u 'anil-ladheena aamanoo, innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla khawwaanin kafoor
map.22:39: Udhina lilladheena yuqaataloona bi'annahum zulimoo, wa'innallaaha 'alaa nasrihim laqadeer
map.22:40: Al-ladheena ukhrijoo min diyaarihim bighayri haqqin illaa ay yaqooloo rabbunallaah, walawlaa daf'ullaahin-naasa ba'dahum biba'dil lahuddimat sawaami'u wabiya'uw wasalawaatuw wamasaajidu yudhkaru feehasmullaahi katheeraa, walayansurannallaahu may yansuruh, innallaaha laqawiyyun 'azeez
map.22:41: Alladheena im makkannaahum fil-ardi aqaamus-salaata wa'aatawuz-zakaata wa'amaroo bil-ma'roofi wanahaw 'anil-munkar, walillaahi 'aaqibatul-umoor
map.22:42: Wa'iy yukadhdhibooka faqad kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wa'aaduw wathamood
map.22:44: Wa'ashaabu madyan, wakudhdhiba moosaa fa'amlaytu lil-kaafireena thumma akhadhtuhum, fakayfa kaana nakeer
map.22:45: Faka'ayyim min qaryatin ahlaknaahaa wahiya zaalimatun fahiya khaawiyatun 'alaa 'urooshihaa, wabi'rim mu'attalatiw waqasrim masheed
map.22:46: Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fatakoona lahum quloobuy ya'qiloona bihaa aw aadhaanuy yasma'oona bihaa, fa'innahaa laa ta'mal-absaaru walaakin ta'mal-quloobul-latee fis-sudoor
map.22:47: Wayasta'jiloonaka bil-'adhaabi walay yukhlifallaahu wa'dah, wa'inna yawman 'inda rabbika ka'alfi sanatim mimmaa ta'uddoon
map.22:48: Waka'ayyim min qaryatin amlaytu lahaa wahiya zaalimatun thumma akhadhtuhaa, wa'ilayyal-maseer
map.22:49: Qul yaa ayyuhan-naasu innamaa ana lakum nadheerum mubeen
map.22:50: Fal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratuw warizqun kareem
map.22:51: Wal-ladheena sa'aw fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
map.22:52: Wamaa arsalnaa min qablika mir rasooliw walaa nabiyyin illaa idhaa tamannaa alqash-shaytaanu fee umniyyatih, fayansakhullaahu maa yulqish-shaytaanu thumma yuhkimullaahu aayaatih, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.22:53: Liyaj'ala maa yulqish-shaytaanu fitnatal lilladheena fee quloobihim maraduw wal-qaasiyati quloobuhum, wa'innaz-zaalimeena lafee shiqaaqim ba'eed
map.22:54: Waliya'lamal-ladheena ootul-'ilma annahul-haqqu mir rabbika fayu'minoo bihee fatukhbita lahoo quloobuhum, wa'innallaaha lahaadil-ladheena aamanoo ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.22:55: Walaa yazaalul-ladheena kafaroo fee miryatim minhu hattaa ta'tiyahumus-saa'atu baghtatan aw ya'tiyahum 'adhaabu yawmin 'aqeem
map.22:56: Al-mulku yawma'idhil lillaah, yahkumu baynahum, fal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fee jannaatin-na'eem
map.22:57: Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa fa'ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabum muheen
map.22:58: Wal-ladheena haajaroo fee sabeelillaahi thumma qutiloo aw maatoo layarzuqannahumullaahu rizqan hasanaa, wa'innallaaha lahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
map.22:59: Layudkhilannahum mudkhalay yardawnah, wa'innallaaha la'aleemun haleem
map.22:60: Dhaalika waman 'aaqaba bimithli maa 'ooqiba bihee thumma bughiya 'alayhi layansurannahullaah, innallaaha la'afuwwun ghafoor
map.22:61: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wa'annallaaha samee'um baseer
map.22:62: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'anna maa yad'oona min doonihee huwal-baatilu wa'annallaaha huwal-'aliyyul-kabeer
map.22:63: Alam tara annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'aa, fatusbihul-ardu mukhdarrah, innallaaha lateefun khabeer
map.22:64: Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wa'innallaaha lahuwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
map.22:65: Alam tara annallaaha sakhkhara lakum maa fil-ardi wal-fulka tajree fil-bahri bi'amrih, wayumsikus-samaa'a an taqa'a 'alal-ardi illaa bi'idhnih, innallaaha bin-naasi lara'oofur raheem
map.22:66: Wahuwal-ladhee ahyaakum, thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum, innal-insaana lakafoor
map.22:67: Likulli ummatin ja'alnaa mansakan hum naasikoohu falaa yunaazi'unnaka fil-amri wad'u ilaa rabbik, innaka la'alaa hudam mustaqeem
map.22:68: Wa'in jaadalooka faqulillaahu a'lamu bimaa ta'maloon
map.22:69: Allaahu yahkumu baynakum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
map.22:70: Alam ta'lam annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaa'i wal-ard, inna dhaalika fee kitaab, inna dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseer
map.22:71: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaanaw wamaa laysa lahum bihee 'ilm, wamaa liz-zaalimeena min naseer
map.22:72: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin ta'rifu fee wujoohil-ladheena kafarul-munkar, yakaadoona yastoona bil-ladheena yatloona 'alayhim aayaatinaa, qul afa'unabbi'ukum bisharrim min dhaalikum, an-naar, wa'adahallaahul-ladheena kafaroo, wabi'sal-maseer
map.22:73: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu duriba mathalun fastami'oo lah, innal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi lay yakhluqoo dhubaabaw walawijtama'oo lah, wa'iy yaslubhumudh-dhubaabu shay'al laa yastanqidhoohu minh, da'ufat-taalibu wal-matloob
map.22:74: Maa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrih, innallaaha laqawiyyun 'azeez
map.22:75: Allaahu yastafee minal-malaa'ikati rusulaw waminan-naas, innallaaha samee'um baseer
map.22:76: Ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum, wa'ilallaahi turja'ul-umoor
map.22:77: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanurka'oo wasjudoo wa'budoo rabbakum waf'alul-khayra la'allakum tuflihoon
map.22:78: Wajaahidoo fillaahi haqqa jihaadih, huwajtabaakum wamaa ja'ala 'alaykum fid-deeni min haraj, millata abeekum ibraaheem, huwa sammaakumul-muslimeena min qablu wafee haadhaa liyakoonar-rasoolu shaheedan 'alaykum watakoonoo shuhadaa'a 'alan-naas, fa'aqeemus-salaata wa'aatuz-zakaata wa'tasimoo billaah, huwa mawlaakum, fani'mal-mawlaa wani'man-naseer
map.23:6: Illaa 'alaa azwaajihim aw maa malakat aymaanuhum fa'innahum ghayru maloomeen
map.23:12: Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana min sulaalatim min teen
map.23:13: Thumma ja'alnaahu nutfatan fee qaraarim makeen
map.23:14: Thumma khalaqnan-nutfata 'alaqatan fakhalaqnal-'alaqata mudghatan fakhalaqnal-mudghata 'izaaman fakasawnal-'izaama lahman thumma ansha'naahu khalqan aakhar, fatabaarakallaahu ahsanul-khaaliqeen
map.23:17: Walaqad khalaqnaa fawqakum sab'a taraa'iq, wamaa kunnaa 'anil-khalqi ghaafileen
map.23:18: Wa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'am biqadarin fa'askannaahu fil-ard, wa'innaa 'alaa dhahaabim bihee laqaadiroon
map.23:19: Fa'ansha'naa lakum bihee jannaatim min nakheeliw wa'a'naab, lakum feehaa fawaakihu katheeratuw waminhaa ta'kuloon
map.23:20: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa'a tambutu bid-duhni wasibghil lil-aakileen
map.23:21: Wa'inna lakum fil-an'aami la'ibrah, nusqeekum mimmaa fee butoonihaa walakum feehaa manaafi'u katheeratuw waminhaa ta'kuloon
map.23:23: Walaqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee faqaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, afalaa tattaqoon
map.23:24: Faqaalal-mala'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qawmihee maa haadhaa illaa basharum mithlukum yureedu ay yatafaddala 'alaykum, walaw shaa'allaahu la'anzala malaa'ikah, maa sami'naa bihaadhaa fee aabaa'inal-awwaleen
map.23:25: In huwa illaa rajulum bihee jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihee hattaa heen
map.23:27: Fa'awhaynaa ilayhi anisna'il-fulka bi'a'yuninaa wawahyinaa fa'idhaa jaa'a amrunaa wafaarat-tannooru fasluk feehaa min kullin zawjaynithnayni wa'ahlaka illaa man sabaqa 'alayhil-qawlu minhum, walaa tukhaatibnee fil-ladheena zalamoo, innahum mughraqoon
map.23:28: Fa'idhastawayta anta wamam ma'aka 'alal-fulki faqulil-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee najjaanaa minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.23:29: Waqur rabbi anzilnee munzalam mubaarakaw wa'anta khayrul-munzileen
map.23:30: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatiw wa'in kunnaa lamubtaleen
map.23:31: Thumma ansha'naa mim ba'dihim qarnan aakhareen
map.23:32: Fa'arsalnaa feehim rasoolam minhum ani'budullaaha maa lakum min ilaahin ghayruh, afalaa tattaqoon
map.23:33: Waqaalal-mala'u min qawmihil-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo biliqaa'il-aakhirati wa'atrafnaahum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa maa haadhaa illaa basharum mithlukum ya'kulu mimmaa ta'kuloona minhu wayashrabu mimmaa tashraboon
map.23:34: Wala'in ata'tum basharam mithlakum innakum idhal lakhaasiroon
map.23:35: Aya'idukum annakum idhaa mittum wakuntum turaabaw wa'izaaman annakum mukhrajoon
map.23:37: In hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa namootu wanahyaa wamaa nahnu bimab'ootheen
map.23:38: In huwa illaa rajuluniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhibaw wamaa nahnu lahoo bimu'mineen
map.23:41: Fa'akhadhathumus-sayhatu bil-haqqi faja'alnaahum ghuthaa'aa, fabu'dal lil-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.23:42: Thumma ansha'naa mim ba'dihim quroonan aakhareen
map.23:43: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wamaa yasta'khiroon
map.23:44: Thumma arsalnaa rusulanaa tatraa, kullamaa jaa'a ummatar rasooluhaa kadhdhaboohu fa'atba'naa ba'dahum ba'daw waja'alnaahum ahaadeeth, fabu'dal liqawmil laa yu'minoon
map.23:45: Thumma arsalnaa moosaa wa'akhaahu haaroona bi'aayaatinaa wasultaanim mubeen
map.23:46: Ilaa fir'awna wamala'ihee fastakbaroo wakaanoo qawman 'aaleen
map.23:47: Faqaaloo anu'minu libasharayni mithlinaa waqawmuhumaa lanaa 'aabidoon
map.23:50: Waja'alnabna maryama wa'ummahoo aayataw wa'aawaynaahumaa ilaa rabwatin dhaati qaraariw wama'een
map.23:51: Yaa ayyuhar-rusulu kuloo minat-tayyibaati wa'maloo saalihaa, innee bimaa ta'maloona 'aleem
map.23:52: Wa'inna haadhihee ummatukum ummataw waahidataw wa'ana rabbukum fattaqoon
map.23:53: Fataqatta'oo amrahum baynahum zuburaa, kullu hizbim bimaa ladayhim farihoon
map.23:55: Ayahsaboona annamaa numidduhum bihee mim maaliw wabaneen
map.23:56: Nusaari'u lahum fil-khayraat, bal laa yash'uroon
map.23:57: Innal-ladheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoon
map.23:60: Wal-ladheena yu'toona maa aataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ilaa rabbihim raaji'oon
map.23:61: Ulaa'ika yusaari'oona fil-khayraati wahum lahaa saabiqoon
map.23:62: Walaa nukallifu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa, waladaynaa kitaabuy yantiqu bil-haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.23:63: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratim min haadhaa walahum a'maalum min dooni dhaalika hum lahaa 'aamiloon
map.23:64: Hattaa idhaa akhadhnaa mutrafeehim bil-'adhaabi idhaa hum yaj'aroon
map.23:65: Laa taj'arul-yawm, innakum minnaa laa tunsaroon
map.23:66: Qad kaanat aayaatee tutlaa 'alaykum fakuntum 'alaa a'qaabikum tankisoon
map.23:68: Afalam yaddabbarul-qawla am jaa'ahum maa lam ya'ti aabaa'ahumul-awwaleen
map.23:69: Am lam ya'rifoo rasoolahum fahum lahoo munkiroon
map.23:70: Am yaqooloona bihee jinnah, bal jaa'ahum bil-haqqi wa'aktharuhum lil-haqqi kaarihoon
map.23:71: Walawittaba'al-haqqu ahwaa'ahum lafasadatis-samaawaatu wal-ardu waman feehinn, bal ataynaahum bidhikrihim fahum 'an dhikrihim mu'ridoon
map.23:72: Am tas'aluhum kharjan fakharaaju rabbika khayr, wahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
map.23:75: Walaw rahimnaahum wakashafnaa maa bihim min durril lalajjoo fee tughyaanihim ya'mahoon
map.23:76: Walaqad akhadhnaahum bil-'adhaabi famastakaanoo lirabbihim wamaa yatadarra'oon
map.23:77: Hattaa idhaa fatahnaa 'alayhim baaban dhaa 'adhaabin shadeedin idhaa hum feehi mublisoon
map.23:78: Wahuwal-ladhee ansha'a lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idah, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
map.23:80: Wahuwal-ladhee yuhyee wayumeetu walahukhtilaaful-layli wan-nahaar, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.23:82: Qaaloo a'idhaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaabaw wa'izaaman a'innaa lamab'oothoon
map.23:83: Laqad wu'idnaa nahnu wa'aabaa'unaa haadhaa min qablu in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
map.23:84: Qul limanil-ardu waman feehaa in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.23:88: Qul mam biyadihee malakootu kulli shay'iw wahuwa yujeeru walaa yujaaru 'alayhi in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.23:91: Mattakhadhallaahu miw waladiw wamaa kaana ma'ahoo min ilaahin idhal ladhahaba kullu ilaahim bimaa khalaqa wala'alaa ba'duhum 'alaa ba'd, subhaanallaahi 'ammaa yasifoon
map.23:93: Qur rabbi immaa turiyannee maa yoo'adoon
map.23:95: Wa'innaa 'alaa an nuriyaka maa na'iduhum laqaadiroon
map.23:96: Idfa' bil-latee hiya ahsanus-sayyi'ah, nahnu a'lamu bimaa yasifoon
map.23:97: Waqur rabbi a'oodhu bika min hamazaatish-shayaateen
map.23:99: Hattaa idhaa jaa'a ahadahumul-mawtu qaala rabbirji'oon
map.23:100: La'allee a'malu saalihan feemaa taraktu kallaa, innahaa kalimatun huwa qaa'iluhaa, wamiw waraa'ihim barzakhun ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
map.23:101: Fa'idhaa nufikha fis-soori falaa ansaaba baynahum yawma'idhiw walaa yatasaa'aloon
map.23:103: Waman khaffat mawaazeenuhoo fa'ulaa'ikal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khaalidoon
map.23:105: Alam takun aayaatee tutlaa 'alaykum fakuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
map.23:106: Qaaloo rabbanaa ghalabat 'alaynaa shiqwatunaa wakunnaa qawman daal-leen
map.23:107: Rabbanaa akhrijnaa minhaa fa'in 'udnaa fa'innaa zaalimoon
map.23:109: Innahoo kaana fareequm min 'ibaadee yaqooloona rabbanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa warhamnaa wa'anta khayrur-raahimeen
map.23:110: Fattakhadhtumoohum sikhriyyan hattaa ansawkum dhikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoon
map.23:111: Innee jazaytuhumul-yawma bimaa sabaroo annahum humul-faa'izoon
map.23:113: Qaaloo labithnaa yawman aw ba'da yawmin fas'alil-'aaddeen
map.23:114: Qaala il labithtum illaa qaleelal law annakum kuntum ta'lamoon
map.23:115: Afahasibtum annamaa khalaqnaakum 'abathaw wa'annakum ilaynaa laa turja'oon
map.23:116: Fata'aalallaahul-malikul-haqq, laa ilaaha illaa huw, rabbul-'arshil-kareem
map.23:117: Wamay yad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara laa burhaana lahoo bihee fa'innamaa hisaabuhoo 'inda rabbih, innahoo laa yuflihul-kaafiroon
map.24:1: Sooratun anzalnaahaa wafaradnaahaa wa'anzalnaa feehaa aayaatim bayyinaatil la'allakum tadhakkaroon
map.24:2: Az-zaaniyatu waz-zaanee fajlidoo kulla waahidim minhumaa mi'ata jaldah, walaa ta'khudhkum bihimaa ra'fatun fee deenillaahi in kuntum tu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, walyashhad 'adhaabahumaa taa'ifatum minal-mu'mineen
map.24:3: Az-zaanee laa yankihu illaa zaaniyatan aw mushrikah, waz-zaaniyatu laa yankihuhaa illaa zaanin aw mushrik, wahurrima dhaalika 'alal-mu'mineen
map.24:4: Wal-ladheena yarmoonal-muhsanaati thumma lam ya'too bi'arba'ati shuhadaa'a fajlidoohum thamaaneena jaldataw walaa taqbaloo lahum shahaadatan abadaa, wa'ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
map.24:5: Illal-ladheena taaboo mim ba'di dhaalika wa'aslahoo, fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.24:6: Wal-ladheena yarmoona azwaajahum walam yakul lahum shuhadaa'u illaa anfusuhum fashahaadatu ahadihim arba'u shahaadaatim billaahi innahoo laminas-saadiqeen
map.24:7: Wal-khaamisatu anna la'natallaahi 'alayhi in kaana minal-kaadhibeen
map.24:8: Wayadra'u 'anhal-'adhaaba an tashhada arba'a shahaadaatim billaahi innahoo laminal-kaadhibeen
map.24:9: Wal-khaamisata anna ghadaballaahi 'alayhaa in kaana minas-saadiqeen
map.24:10: Walawlaa fadlullaahi 'alaykum warahmatuhoo wa'annallaaha tawwaabun hakeem
map.24:11: Innal-ladheena jaa'oo bil-ifki 'usbatum minkum, laa tahsaboohu sharral lakum, bal huwa khayrul lakum, likullimri'im minhum maktasaba minal-ithm, wal-ladhee tawallaa kibrahoo minhum lahoo 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.24:12: Lawlaa idh sami'tumoohu zannal-mu'minoona wal-mu'minaatu bi'anfusihim khayraw waqaaloo haadhaa ifkum mubeen
map.24:13: Lawlaa jaa'oo 'alayhi bi'arba'ati shuhadaa', fa'idh lam ya'too bish-shuhadaa'i fa'ulaa'ika 'indallaahi humul-kaadhiboon
map.24:14: Walawlaa fadlullaahi 'alaykum warahmatuhoo fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati lamassakum fee maa afadtum feehi 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.24:15: Idh talaqqawnahoo bi'alsinatikum wataqooloona bi'afwaahikum maa laysa lakum bihee 'ilmuw watahsaboonahoo hayyinaw wahuwa 'indallaahi 'azeem
map.24:16: Walawlaa idh sami'tumoohu qultum maa yakoonu lanaa an natakallama bihaadhaa, subhaanaka haadhaa buhtaanun 'azeem
map.24:17: Ya'izukumullaahu an ta'oodoo limithlihee abadan in kuntum mu'mineen
map.24:19: Innal-ladheena yuhibboona an tashee'al-faahishatu fil-ladheena aamanoo lahum 'adhaabun aleemun fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirah, wallaahu ya'lamu wa'antum laa ta'lamoon
map.24:20: Walawlaa fadlullaahi 'alaykum warahmatuhoo wa'annallaaha ra'oofur raheem
map.24:21: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattabi'oo khutuwaatish-shaytaan, wamay yattabi' khutuwaatish-shaytaani fa'innahoo ya'muru bil-fahshaa'i wal-munkar, walawlaa fadlullaahi 'alaykum warahmatuhoo maa zakaa minkum min ahadin abadaw walaakinnallaaha yuzakkee may yashaa', wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.24:22: Walaa ya'tali ulul-fadli minkum was-sa'ati ay yu'too ulil-qurbaa wal-masaakeena wal-muhaajireena fee sabeelillaah, walya'foo walyasfahoo, alaa tuhibboona ay yaghfirallaahu lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.24:24: Yawma tashhadu 'alayhim alsinatuhum wa'aydeehim wa'arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.24:25: Yawma'idhiy yuwaffeehimullaahu deenahumul-haqqa waya'lamoona annallaaha huwal-haqqul-mubeen
map.24:26: Al-khabeethaatu lil-khabeetheena wal-khabeethoona lil-khabeethaat, wat-tayyibaatu lit-tayyibeena wat-tayyiboona lit-tayyibaat, ulaa'ika mubarra'oona mimmaa yaqooloon, lahum maghfiratuw warizqun kareem
map.24:27: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hattaa tasta'nisoo watusallimoo 'alaa ahlihaa, dhaalikum khayrul lakum la'allakum tadhakkaroon
map.24:28: Fa'il lam tajidoo feehaa ahadan falaa tadkhuloohaa hattaa yu'dhana lakum wa'in qeela lakumurji'oo farji'oo huwa azkaa lakum, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona 'aleem
map.24:29: Laysa 'alaykum junaahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feehaa mataa'ul lakum, wallaahu ya'lamu maa tubdoona wamaa taktumoon
map.24:30: Qul lil-mu'mineena yaghuddoo min absaarihim wayahfazoo furoojahum, dhaalika azkaa lahum, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa yasna'oon
map.24:31: Waqul lil-mu'minaati yaghdudna min absaarihinna wayahfazna furoojahunna walaa yubdeena zeenatahunna illaa maa zahara minhaa walyadribna bikhumurihinna 'alaa juyoobihinn, walaa yubdeena zeenatahunna illaa libu'oolatihinna aw aabaa'ihinna aw aabaa'i bu'oolatihinna aw abnaa'ihinna aw abnaa'i bu'oolatihinna aw ikhwaanihinna aw banee ikhwaanihinna aw banee akhawaatihinna aw nisaa'ihinna aw maa malakat aymaanuhunna awit-taabi'eena ghayri ulil-irbati minar-rijaali awit-tiflil-ladheena lam yazharoo 'alaa 'awraatin-nisaa', walaa yadribna bi'arjulihinna liyu'lama maa yukhfeena min zeenatihinn, watooboo ilallaahi jamee'an ayyuhal-mu'minoona la'allakum tuflihoon
map.24:32: Wa'ankihul-ayaamaa minkum was-saaliheena min 'ibaadikum wa'imaa'ikum, iy yakoonoo fuqaraa'a yughnihimullaahu min fadlih, wallaahu waasi'un 'aleem
map.24:33: Walyasta'fifil-ladheena laa yajidoona nikaahan hattaa yughniyahumullaahu min fadlih, wal-ladheena yabtaghoonal-kitaaba mimmaa malakat aymaanukum fakaatiboohum in 'alimtum feehim khayraw wa'aatoohum mim maalillaahil-ladhee aataakum, walaa tukrihoo fatayaatikum 'alal-bighaa'i in aradna tahassunal litabtaghoo 'aradal-hayaatid-dunyaa, wamay yukrihhunna fa'innallaaha mim ba'di ikraahihinna ghafoorur raheem
map.24:34: Walaqad anzalnaa ilaykum aayaatim mubayyinaatiw wamathalam minal-ladheena khalaw min qablikum wamaw'izatal lil-muttaqeen
map.24:35: Allaahu noorus-samaawaati wal-ard, mathalu noorihee kamishkaatin feehaa misbaah, al-misbaahu fee zujaajah, az-zujaajatu ka'annahaa kawkabun durriyyuy yooqadu min shajaratim mubaarakatin zaytoonatil laa sharqiyyatiw walaa gharbiyyatiy yakaadu zaytuhaa yudee'u walaw lam tamsashu naar, noorun 'alaa noor, yahdillaahu linoorihee may yashaa', wayadribullaahul-amthaala lin-naas, wallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.24:36: Fee buyootin adhinallaahu an turfa'a wayudhkara feehasmuhoo yusabbihu lahoo feehaa bil-ghuduwwi wal-aasaal
map.24:37: Rijaalul laa tulheehim tijaaratuw walaa bay'un 'an dhikrillaahi wa'iqaamis-salaati wa'eetaa'iz-zakaati yakhaafoona yawman tataqallabu feehil-quloobu wal-absaar
map.24:38: Liyajziyahumullaahu ahsana maa 'amiloo wayazeedahum min fadlih, wallaahu yarzuqu may yashaa'u bighayri hisaab
map.24:39: Wal-ladheena kafaroo a'maaluhum kasaraabim biqee'atiy yahsabuhuz-zam'aanu maa'aa, hattaa idhaa jaa'ahoo lam yajidhu shay'aw wawajadallaaha 'indahoo fawaffaahu hisaabah, wallaahu saree'ul-hisaab
map.24:40: Aw kazulumaatin fee bahril lujjiyyiy yaghshaahu mawjum min fawqihee mawjum min fawqihee sahaab, zulumaatum ba'duhaa fawqa ba'd, idhaa akhraja yadahoo lam yakad yaraahaa, wamal lam yaj'alillaahu lahoo nooran famaa lahoo min noor
map.24:41: Alam tara annallaaha yusabbihu lahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wat-tayru saaffaat, kullun qad 'alima salaatahoo watasbeehah, wallaahu 'aleemum bimaa yaf'aloon
map.24:43: Alam tara annallaaha yuzjee sahaaban thumma yu'allifu baynahoo thumma yaj'aluhoo rukaaman fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalih, wayunazzilu minas-samaa'i min jibaalin feehaa mim baradin fayuseebu bihee may yashaa'u wayasrifuhoo 'am may yashaa', yakaadu sanaa barqihee yadhhabu bil-absaar
map.24:44: Yuqallibullaahul-layla wan-nahaar, inna fee dhaalika la'ibratal li'ulil-absaar
map.24:45: Wallaahu khalaqa kulla daabbatim mim maa', faminhum may yamshee 'alaa batnih, waminhum may yamshee 'alaa rijlayn, waminhum may yamshee 'alaa arba', yakhluqullaahu maa yashaa', innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.24:46: Laqad anzalnaa aayaatim mubayyinaat, wallaahu yahdee may yashaa'u ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.24:47: Wayaqooloona aamannaa billaahi wabir-rasooli wa'ata'naa thumma yatawallaa fareequm minhum mim ba'di dhaalik, wamaa ulaa'ika bil-mu'mineen
map.24:48: Wa'idhaa du'oo ilallaahi warasoolihee liyahkuma baynahum idhaa fareequm minhum mu'ridoon
map.24:49: Wa'iy yakul lahumul-haqqu ya'too ilayhi mudh'ineen
map.24:50: Afee quloobihim maradun amirtaaboo am yakhaafoona ay yaheefallaahu 'alayhim warasooluh, bal ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.24:51: Innamaa kaana qawlal-mu'mineena idhaa du'oo ilallaahi warasoolihee liyahkuma baynahum ay yaqooloo sami'naa wa'ata'naa, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.24:52: Wamay yuti'illaaha warasoolahoo wayakhshallaaha wayattaqhi fa'ulaa'ika humul-faa'izoon
map.24:53: Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim la'in amartahum layakhrujunn, qul laa tuqsimoo, taa'atum ma'roofah, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.24:54: Qul atee'ullaaha wa'atee'ur-rasool, fa'in tawallaw fa'innamaa 'alayhi maa hummila wa'alaykum maa hummiltum, wa'in tutee'oohu tahtadoo, wamaa 'alar-rasooli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
map.24:55: Wa'adallaahul-ladheena aamanoo minkum wa'amilus-saalihaati layastakhlifannahum fil-ardi kamastakhlafal-ladheena min qablihim, walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumul-ladhirtadaa lahum walayubaddilannahum mim ba'di khawfihim amnaa, ya'budoonanee laa yushrikoona bee shay'aa, waman kafara ba'da dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
map.24:57: Laa tahsabannal-ladheena kafaroo mu'jizeena fil-ard, wama'waahumun-naar, walabi'sal-maseer
map.24:58: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo liyasta'dhinkumul-ladheena malakat aymaanukum wal-ladheena lam yablughul-huluma minkum thalaatha marraat, min qabli salaatil-fajri waheena tada'oona thiyaabakum minaz-zaheerati wamim ba'di salaatil-'ishaa', thalaathu 'awraatil lakum, laysa 'alaykum walaa 'alayhim junaahum ba'dahunn, tawwaafoona 'alaykum ba'dukum 'alaa ba'd, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaat, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.24:59: Wa'idhaa balaghal-atfaalu minkumul-huluma falyasta'dhinoo kamasta'dhanal-ladheena min qablihim, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakum aayaatih, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.24:60: Wal-qawaa'idu minan-nisaa'illaatee laa yarjoona nikaahan falaysa 'alayhinna junaahun ay yada'na thiyaabahunna ghayra mutabarrijaatim bizeenah, wa'ay yasta'fifna khayrul lahunn, wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
map.24:61: Laysa 'alal-a'maa harajuw walaa 'alal-a'raji harajuw walaa 'alal-mareedi harajuw walaa 'alaa anfusikum an ta'kuloo mim buyootikum aw buyooti aabaa'ikum aw buyooti ummahaatikum aw buyooti ikhwaanikum aw buyooti akhawaatikum aw buyooti a'maamikum aw buyooti 'ammaatikum aw buyooti akhwaalikum aw buyooti khaalaatikum aw maa malaktum mafaatihahoo aw sadeeqikum, laysa 'alaykum junaahun an ta'kuloo jamee'an aw ashtaataa, fa'idhaa dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo 'alaa anfusikum tahiyyatam min 'indillaahi mubaarakatan tayyibah, kadhaalika yubayyinullaahu lakumul-aayaati la'allakum ta'qiloon
map.24:62: Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warasoolihee wa'idhaa kaanoo ma'ahoo 'alaa amrin jaami'il lam yadhhaboo hattaa yasta'dhinooh, innal-ladheena yasta'dhinoonaka ulaa'ikal-ladheena yu'minoona billaahi warasoolih, fa'idhasta'dhanooka liba'di sha'nihim fa'dhal liman shi'ta minhum wastaghfir lahumullaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.24:63: Laa taj'aloo du'aa'ar-rasooli baynakum kadu'aa'i ba'dikum ba'daa, qad ya'lamullaahul-ladheena yatasallaloona minkum liwaadhaa, falyahdharil-ladheena yukhaalifoona 'an amrihee an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.24:64: Alaa inna lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, qad ya'lamu maa antum 'alayh, wayawma yurja'oona ilayhi fayunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo, wallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.25:2: Al-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi walam yattakhidh waladaw walam yakul lahoo shareekun fil-mulki wakhalaqa kulla shay'in faqaddarahoo taqdeeraa
map.25:3: Wattakhadhoo min doonihee aalihatal laa yakhluqoona shay'aw wahum yukhlaqoona walaa yamlikoona li'anfusihim darraw walaa naf'aw walaa yamlikoona mawtaw walaa hayaataw walaa nushooraa
map.25:4: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo in haadhaa illaa ifkuniftaraahu wa'a'aanahoo 'alayhi qawmun aakharoon, faqad jaa'oo zulmaw wazooraa
map.25:5: Waqaaloo asaateerul-awwaleenaktatabahaa fahiya tumlaa 'alayhi bukrataw wa'aseelaa
map.25:6: Qul anzalahul-ladhee ya'lamus-sirra fis-samaawaati wal-ard, innahoo kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
map.25:7: Waqaaloo maali haadhar-rasooli ya'kulut-ta'aama wayamshee fil-aswaaq, lawlaa unzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona ma'ahoo nadheeraa
map.25:8: Aw yulqaa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahoo jannatuy ya'kulu minhaa, waqaalaz-zaalimoona in tattabi'oona illaa rajulam mashooraa
map.25:9: Unzur kayfa daraboo lakal-amthaala fadalloo falaa yastatee'oona sabeelaa
map.25:10: Tabaarakal-ladhee in shaa'a ja'ala laka khayram min dhaalika jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wayaj'al laka qusooraa
map.25:11: Bal kadhdhaboo bis-saa'ati wa'a'tadnaa liman kadhdhaba bis-saa'ati sa'eeraa
map.25:12: Idhaa ra'athum mim makaanim ba'eedin sami'oo lahaa taghayyuzaw wazafeeraa
map.25:13: Wa'idhaa ulqoo minhaa makaanan dayyiqam muqarraneena da'aw hunaalika thubooraa
map.25:14: Laa tad'ul-yawma thubooraw waahidaw wad'oo thubooran katheeraa
map.25:15: Qul adhaalika khayrun am jannatul-khuldil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoon, kaanat lahum jazaa'aw wamaseeraa
map.25:16: Lahum feehaa maa yashaa'oona khaalideen, kaana 'alaa rabbika wa'dam mas'oolaa
map.25:17: Wayawma yahshuruhum wamaa ya'budoona min doonillaahi fayaqoolu a'antum adlaltum 'ibaadee haa'ulaa'i am hum dallus-sabeel
map.25:18: Qaaloo subhaanaka maa kaana yambaghee lanaa an nattakhidha min doonika min awliyaa'a walaakim matta'tahum wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa nasudh-dhikr, wakaanoo qawmam booraa
map.25:19: Faqad kadhdhabookum bimaa taqooloona famaa tastatee'oona sarfaw walaa nasraa, wamay yazlim minkum nudhiqhu 'adhaaban kabeeraa
map.25:20: Wamaa arsalnaa qablaka minal-mursaleena illaa innahum laya'kuloonat-ta'aama wayamshoona fil-aswaaq, waja'alnaa ba'dakum liba'din fitnah, atasbiroon, wakaana rabbuka baseeraa
map.25:21: Waqaalal-ladheena laa yarjoona liqaa'anaa lawlaa unzila 'alaynal-malaa'ikatu aw naraa rabbanaa, laqadistakbaroo fee anfusihim wa'ataw 'utuwwan kabeeraa
map.25:22: Yawma yarawnal-malaa'ikata laa bushraa yawma'idhil lil-mujrimeena wayaqooloona hijram mahjooraa
map.25:23: Waqadimnaa ilaa maa 'amiloo min 'amalin faja'alnaahu habaa'am manthooraa
map.25:24: Ashaabul-jannati yawma'idhin khayrum mustaqarraw wa'ahsanu maqeelaa
map.25:27: Wayawma ya'adduz-zaalimu 'alaa yadayhi yaqoolu yaalaytanittakhadhtu ma'ar-rasooli sabeelaa
map.25:28: Yaawaylataa laytanee lam attakhidh fulaanan khaleelaa
map.25:29: Laqad adallanee 'anidh-dhikri ba'da idh jaa'anee, wakaanash-shaytaanu lil-insaani khadhoolaa
map.25:30: Waqaalar-rasoolu yaarabbi inna qawmittakhadhoo haadhal-qur'aana mahjooraa
map.25:31: Wakadhaalika ja'alnaa likulli nabiyyin 'aduwwam minal-mujrimeen, wakafaa birabbika haadiyaw wanaseeraa
map.25:32: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lawlaa nuzzila 'alayhil-qur'aanu jumlataw waahidatan kadhaalik, linuthabbita bihee fu'aadaka warattalnaahu tarteelaa
map.25:33: Walaa ya'toonaka bimathalin illaa ji'naaka bil-haqqi wa'ahsana tafseeraa
map.25:34: Alladheena yuhsharoona 'alaa wujoohihim ilaa jahannama ulaa'ika sharrum makaanaw wa'adallu sabeelaa
map.25:35: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba waja'alnaa ma'ahoo akhaahu haaroona wazeeraa
map.25:36: Faqulnadhhabaa ilal-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa, fadammarnaahum tadmeeraa
map.25:37: Waqawma noohil lammaa kadhdhabur-rusula aghraqnaahum waja'alnaahum lin-naasi aayah, wa'a'tadnaa liz-zaalimeena 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.25:38: Wa'aadaw wathamooda wa'ashaabar-rassi waquroonam bayna dhaalika katheeraa
map.25:39: Wakullan darabnaa lahul-amthaal, wakullan tabbarnaa tatbeeraa
map.25:40: Walaqad ataw 'alal-qaryatil-latee umtirat mataras-saw', afalam yakoonoo yarawnahaa, bal kaanoo laa yarjoona nushooraa
map.25:41: Wa'idhaa ra'awka iy yattakhidhoonaka illaa huzuwaa, ahaadhal-ladhee ba'athallaahu rasoolaa
map.25:42: In kaada layudillunaa 'an aalihatinaa lawlaa an sabarnaa 'alayhaa, wasawfa ya'lamoona heena yarawnal-'adhaaba man adallu sabeelaa
map.25:43: Ara'ayta manittakhadha ilaahahoo hawaah, afa'anta takoonu 'alayhi wakeelaa
map.25:44: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasma'oona aw ya'qiloon, in hum illaa kal-an'aami bal hum adallu sabeelaa
map.25:45: Alam tara ilaa rabbika kayfa maddaz-zill, walaw shaa'a laja'alahoo saakinaa, thumma ja'alnash-shamsa 'alayhi daleelaa
map.25:47: Wahuwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla libaasaw wan-nawma subaataw waja'alan-nahaara nushooraa
map.25:48: Wahuwal-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha bushram bayna yaday rahmatih, wa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an tahooraa
map.25:49: Linuhyi bihee baldatam maytaw wanusqiyahoo mimmaa khalaqnaa an'aamaw wa'anaasiyya katheeraa
map.25:50: Walaqad sarrafnaahu baynahum liyadhdhakkaroo, fa'abaa aktharun-naasi illaa kufooraa
map.25:51: Walaw shi'naa laba'athnaa fee kulli qaryatin nadheeraa
map.25:52: Falaa tuti'il-kaafireena wajaahidhum bihee jihaadan kabeeraa
map.25:53: Wahuwal-ladhee marajal-bahrayni haadhaa 'adhbun furaatuw wahaadhaa milhun ujaaj, waja'ala baynahumaa barzakhaw wahijram mahjooraa
map.25:54: Wahuwal-ladhee khalaqa minal-maa'i basharan faja'alahoo nasabaw wasihraa, wakaana rabbuka qadeeraa
map.25:55: Waya'budoona min doonillaahi maa laa yanfa'uhum walaa yadurruhum, wakaanal-kaafiru 'alaa rabbihee zaheeraa
map.25:57: Qul maa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin illaa man shaa'a ay yattakhidha ilaa rabbihee sabeelaa
map.25:58: Watawakkal 'alal-hayyil-ladhee laa yamootu wasabbih bihamdih, wakafaa bihee bidhunoobi 'ibaadihee khabeeraa
map.25:59: Alladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arsh, ar-rahmaanu fas'al bihee khabeeraa
map.25:60: Wa'idhaa qeela lahumusjudoo lir-rahmaani qaaloo wamar-rahmaanu anasjudu limaa ta'murunaa wazaadahum nufooraa
map.25:61: Tabaarakal-ladhee ja'ala fis-samaa'i buroojaw waja'ala feehaa siraajaw waqamaram muneeraa
map.25:62: Wahuwal-ladhee ja'alal-layla wan-nahaara khilfatal liman araada ay yadhdhakkara aw araada shukooraa
map.25:63: Wa'ibaadur-rahmaanil-ladheena yamshoona 'alal-ardi hawnaw wa'idhaa khaatabahumul-jaahiloona qaaloo salaamaa
map.25:65: Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanasrif 'annaa 'adhaaba jahannam, inna 'adhaabahaa kaana gharaamaa
map.25:67: Wal-ladheena idhaa anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakaana bayna dhaalika qawaamaa
map.25:68: Wal-ladheena laa yad'oona ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara walaa yaqtuloonan-nafsal-latee harramallaahu illaa bil-haqqi walaa yaznoon, wamay yaf'al dhaalika yalqa athaamaa
map.25:69: Yudaa'af lahul-'adhaabu yawmal-qiyaamati wayakhlud feehee muhaanaa
map.25:70: Illaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amila 'amalan saalihan fa'ulaa'ika yubaddilullaahu sayyi'aatihim hasanaat, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.25:71: Waman taaba wa'amila saalihan fa'innahoo yatoobu ilallaahi mataabaa
map.25:72: Wal-ladheena laa yashhadoonaz-zoora wa'idhaa marroo bil-laghwi marroo kiraamaa
map.25:73: Wal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bi'aayaati rabbihim lam yakhirroo 'alayhaa summaw wa'umyaanaa
map.25:74: Wal-ladheena yaqooloona rabbanaa hab lanaa min azwaajinaa wadhurriyyaatinaa qurrata a'yuniw waj'alnaa lil-muttaqeena imaamaa
map.25:75: Ulaa'ika yujzawnal-ghurfata bimaa sabaroo wayulaqqawna feehaa tahiyyataw wasalaamaa
map.25:77: Qul maa ya'ba'u bikum rabbee lawlaa du'aa'ukum, faqad kadhdhabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaamaa
map.26:3: La'allaka baakhi'un nafsaka allaa yakoonoo mu'mineen
map.26:4: In nasha' nunazzil 'alayhim minas-samaa'i aayatan fazallat a'naaquhum lahaa khaadi'een
map.26:5: Wamaa ya'teehim min dhikrim minar-rahmaani muhdathin illaa kaanoo 'anhu mu'rideen
map.26:6: Faqad kadhdhaboo fasaya'teehim ambaa'u maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.26:7: Awalam yaraw ilal-ardi kam ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
map.26:8: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayah, wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
map.26:12: Qaala rabbi innee akhaafu ay yukadhdhiboon
map.26:13: Wayadeequ sadree walaa yantaliqu lisaanee fa'arsil ilaa haaroon
map.26:15: Qaala kallaa, fadhhabaa bi'aayaatinaa innaa ma'akum mustami'oon
map.26:16: Fa'tiyaa fir'awna faqoolaa innaa rasoolu rabbil-'aalameen
map.26:18: Qaala alam nurabbika feenaa waleedaw walabithta feenaa min 'umurika sineen
map.26:21: Fafarartu minkum lammaa khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukmaw waja'alanee minal-mursaleen
map.26:22: Watilka ni'matun tamunnuhaa 'alayya an 'abbatta banee israa'eel
map.26:24: Qaala rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, in kuntum mooqineen
map.26:27: Qaala inna rasoolakumul-ladhee ursila ilaykum lamajnoon
map.26:28: Qaala rabbul-mashriqi wal-maghribi wamaa baynahumaa, in kuntum ta'qiloon
map.26:29: Qaala la'inittakhadhta ilaahan ghayree la'aj'alannaka minal-masjooneen
map.26:31: Qaala fa'ti bihee in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.26:33: Wanaza'a yadahoo fa'idhaa hiya baydaa'u lin-naazireen
map.26:34: Qaala lil-mala'i hawlahoo inna haadhaa lasaahirun 'aleem
map.26:35: Yureedu ay yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrih, famaadhaa ta'muroon
map.26:36: Qaaloo arjih wa'akhaahu wab'ath fil-madaa'ini haashireen
map.26:41: Falammaa jaa'as-saharatu qaaloo lifir'awna a'inna lanaa la'ajran in kunnaa nahnul-ghaalibeen
map.26:43: Qaala lahum moosaa alqoo maa antum mulqoon
map.26:44: Fa'alqaw hibaalahum wa'isiyyahum waqaaloo bi'izzati fir'awna innaa lanahnul-ghaaliboon
map.26:45: Fa'alqaa moosaa 'asaahu fa'idhaa hiya talqafu maa ya'fikoon
map.26:49: Qaala aamantum lahoo qabla an aadhana lakum, innahoo lakabeerukumul-ladhee 'allamakumus-sihr, falasawfa ta'lamoon, la'uqatti'anna aydiyakum wa'arjulakum min khilaafiw wala'usallibannakum ajma'een
map.26:50: Qaaloo laa dayr, innaa ilaa rabbinaa munqaliboon

map.26:52: Wa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa an asri bi'ibaadee innakum muttaba'oon
map.26:61: Falammaa taraa'al-jam'aani qaala ashaabu moosaa innaa lamudrakoon
map.26:62: Qaala kallaa, inna ma'iya rabbee sayahdeen
map.26:63: Fa'awhaynaa ilaa moosaa anidrib bi'asaakal-bahr, fanfalaqa fakaana kullu firqin kat-tawdil-'azeem

map.26:70: Idh qaala li'abeehi waqawmihee maa ta'budoon

map.26:82: Wal-ladhee atma'u ay yaghfira lee khatee'atee yawmad-deen
map.26:83: Rabbi hab lee hukmaw wa'alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
map.26:88: Yawma laa yanfa'u maaluw walaa banoon

map.26:139: Fakadhdhaboohu fa'ahlaknaahum, inna fee dhaalika la'aayah, wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen

map.26:154: Maa anta illaa basharum mithlunaa fa'ti bi'aayatin in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.26:155: Qaala haadhihee naaqatul lahaa shirbuw walakum shirbu yawmim ma'loom
map.26:158: Fa'akhadhahumul-'adhaab, inna fee dhaalika la'aayah, wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
map.26:161: Idh qaala lahum akhoohum lootun alaa tattaqoon
map.26:164: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
map.26:166: Watadharoona maa khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwaajikum, bal antum qawmun 'aadoon

map.26:174: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayah, wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen

map.26:180: Wamaa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajrin in ajriya illaa 'alaa rabbil-'aalameen
map.26:183: Walaa tabkhasun-naasa ashyaa'ahum walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
map.26:186: Wamaa anta illaa basharum mithlunaa wa'in nazunnuka laminal-kaadhibeen
map.26:187: Fa'asqit 'alaynaa kisafam minas-samaa'i in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.26:189: Fakadhdhaboohu fa'akhadhahum 'adhaabu yawmiz-zullah, innahoo kaana 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
map.26:190: Inna fee dhaalika la'aayah, wamaa kaana aktharuhum mu'mineen
map.26:197: Awalam yakul lahum aayatan ay ya'lamahoo 'ulamaa'u banee israa'eel
map.26:208: Wamaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa lahaa mundhiroon
map.26:213: Falaa tad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fatakoona minal-mu'adhdhabeen
map.26:216: Fa'in 'asawka faqul innee baree'um mimmaa ta'maloon
map.26:225: Alam tara annahum fee kulli waadiy yaheemoon
map.26:227: Illal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wadhakarullaaha katheeraw wantasaroo mim ba'di maa zulimoo, wasaya'lamul-ladheena zalamoo ayya munqalabiy yanqaliboon
map.27:1: Taa seen, tilka aayaatul-qur'aani wakitaabim mubeen
map.27:3: Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
map.27:4: Innal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati zayyannaa lahum a'maalahum fahum ya'mahoon
map.27:5: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena lahum soo'ul-'adhaabi wahum fil-aakhirati humul-akhsaroon
map.27:7: Idh qaala moosaa li'ahlihee innee aanastu naaraa, sa'aateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw aateekum bishihaabin qabasil la'allakum tastaloon
map.27:8: Falammaa jaa'ahaa noodiya am boorika man fin-naari waman hawlahaa, wasubhaanallaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.27:10: Wa'alqi 'asaak, falammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu ka'annahaa jaannuw wallaa mudbiraw walam yu'aqqib, yaamoosaa laa takhaf, innee laa yakhaafu ladayyal-mursaloon
map.27:11: Illaa man zalama thumma baddala husnam ba'da soo'in fa'innee ghafoorur raheem
map.27:12: Wa'adkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo'in fee tis'i aayaatin ilaa fir'awna waqawmih, innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
map.27:13: Falammaa jaa'athum aayaatunaa mubsiratan qaaloo haadhaa sihrum mubeen
map.27:14: Wajahadoo bihaa wastayqanathaa anfusuhum zulmaw wa'uluwwaa, fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mufsideen
map.27:15: Walaqad aataynaa daawooda wasulaymaana 'ilmaa, waqaalal-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee faddalanaa 'alaa katheerim min 'ibaadihil-mu'mineen
map.27:16: Wawaritha sulaymaanu daawooda waqaala yaa ayyuhan-naasu 'ullimnaa mantiqat-tayri wa'ooteenaa min kulli shay', inna haadhaa lahuwal-fadlul-mubeen
map.27:17: Wahushira lisulaymaana junooduhoo minal-jinni wal-insi wat-tayri fahum yooza'oon
map.27:18: Hattaa idhaa ataw 'alaa waadin-namli qaalat namlatuy yaa ayyuhan-namludkhuloo masaakinakum, laa yahtimannakum sulaymaanu wajunooduhoo wahum laa yash'uroon
map.27:19: Fatabassama daahikam min qawlihaa waqaala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa'alaa waalidayya wa'an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa'adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen
map.27:20: Watafaqqadat-tayra faqaala maa liya laa aral-hudhud, am kaana minal-ghaa'ibeen
map.27:21: La'u'adhdhibannahoo 'adhaaban shadeedan aw la'adhbahannahoo aw laya'tiyannee bisultaanim mubeen
map.27:22: Famakatha ghayra ba'eedin faqaala ahattu bimaa lam tuhit bihee waji'tuka min saba'im binaba'iy yaqeen
map.27:23: Innee wajattumra'atan tamlikuhum wa'ootiyat min kulli shay'iw walahaa 'arshun 'azeem
map.27:24: Wajattuhaa waqawmahaa yasjudoona lish-shamsi min doonillaahi wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis-sabeeli fahum laa yahtadoon
map.27:25: Allaa yasjudoo lillaahil-ladhee yukhrijul-khab'a fis-samaawaati wal-ardi waya'lamu maa tukhfoona wamaa tu'linoon
map.27:26: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huwa rabbul-'arshil-'azeem
map.27:27: Qaala sananzuru asadaqta am kunta minal-kaadhibeen
map.27:28: Idhhab bikitaabee haadhaa fa'alqih ilayhim thumma tawalla 'anhum fanzur maadhaa yarji'oon
map.27:29: Qaalat yaa ayyuhal-mala'u innee ulqiya ilayya kitaabun kareem
map.27:32: Qaalat yaa ayyuhal-mala'u aftoonee fee amree, maa kuntu qaati'atan amran hattaa tashhadoon
map.27:33: Qaaloo nahnu uloo quwwatiw wa'uloo ba'sin shadeediw wal-amru ilayki fanzuree maadhaa ta'mureen
map.27:34: Qaalat innal-mulooka idhaa dakhaloo qaryatan afsadoohaa waja'aloo a'izzata ahlihaa adhillah, wakadhaalika yaf'aloon
map.27:35: Wa'innee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanaaziratum bima yarji'ul-mursaloon
map.27:36: Falammaa jaa'a sulaymaana qaala atumiddoonani bimaalin famaa aataanillaahu khayrum mimmaa aataakum, bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoon
map.27:37: Irji' ilayhim falana'tiyannahum bijunoodil laa qibala lahum bihaa walanukhrijannahum minhaa adhillataw wahum saaghiroon
map.27:38: Qaala yaa ayyuhal-mala'u ayyukum ya'teenee bi'arshihaa qabla ay ya'toonee muslimeen
map.27:39: Qaala 'ifreetum minal-jinni ana aateeka bihee qabla an taqooma mim maqaamik, wa'innee 'alayhi laqawiyyun ameen
map.27:40: Qaalal-ladhee 'indahoo 'ilmum minal-kitaabi ana aateeka bihee qabla ay yartadda ilayka tarfuk, falammaa ra'aahu mustaqirran 'indahoo qaala haadhaa min fadli rabbee, liyabluwanee a'ashkuru am akfur, waman shakara fa'innamaa yashkuru linafsih, waman kafara fa'inna rabbee ghaniyyun kareem
map.27:41: Qaala nakkiroo lahaa 'arshahaa nanzur atahtadee am takoonu minal-ladheena laa yahtadoon
map.27:42: Falammaa jaa'at qeela ahaakadhaa 'arshuk, qaalat ka'annahoo huw, wa'ooteenal-'ilma min qablihaa wakunnaa muslimeen
map.27:43: Wasaddahaa maa kaanat ta'budu min doonillaah, innahaa kaanat min qawmin kaafireen
map.27:44: Qeela lahadkhulis-sarh, falammaa ra'athu hasibathu lujjataw wakashafat 'an saaqayhaa, qaala innahoo sarhum mumarradum min qawaareer, qaalat rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee wa'aslamtu ma'a sulaymaana lillaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.27:45: Walaqad arsalnaa ilaa thamooda akhaahum saalihan ani'budullaaha fa'idhaa hum fareeqaani yakhtasimoon
map.27:46: Qaala yaaqawmi lima tasta'jiloona bis-sayyi'ati qablal-hasanah, lawlaa tastaghfiroonallaaha la'allakum turhamoon
map.27:47: Qaaluttayyarnaa bika wabimam ma'ak, qaala taa'irukum 'indallaahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoon
map.27:48: Wakaana fil-madeenati tis'atu rahtiy yufsidoona fil-ardi walaa yuslihoon
map.27:49: Qaaloo taqaasamoo billaahi lanubayyitannahoo wa'ahlahoo thumma lanaqoolanna liwaliyyihee maa shahidnaa mahlika ahlihee wa'innaa lasaadiqoon
map.27:50: Wamakaroo makraw wamakarnaa makraw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.27:51: Fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatu makrihim annaa dammarnaahum waqawmahum ajma'een
map.27:52: Fatilka buyootuhum khaawiyatam bimaa zalamoo, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.27:54: Walootan idh qaala liqawmihee ata'toonal-faahishata wa'antum tubsiroon
map.27:55: A'innakum lata'toonar-rijaala shahwatam min doonin-nisaa', bal antum qawmun tajhaloon
map.27:56: Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaaloo akhrijoo aala lootim min qaryatikum innahum unaasuy yatatahharoon
map.27:59: Qulil-hamdu lillaahi wasalaamun 'alaa 'ibaadihil-ladheenastafaa, aallaahu khayrun ammaa yushrikoon
map.27:60: Amman khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wa'anzala lakum minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ambatnaa bihee hadaa'iqa dhaata bahjah, maa kaana lakum an tumbitoo shajarahaa, a'ilaahum ma'allaah, bal hum qawmuy ya'diloon
map.27:61: Amman ja'alal-arda qaraaraw waja'ala khilaalahaa anhaaraw waja'ala lahaa rawaasiya waja'ala baynal-bahrayni haajizaa, a'ilaahum ma'allaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
map.27:62: Ammay yujeebul-mudtarra idhaa da'aahu wayakshifus-soo'a wayaj'alukum khulafaa'al-ard, a'ilaahum ma'allaah, qaleelam maa tadhakkaroon
map.27:63: Ammay yahdeekum fee zulumaatil-barri wal-bahri wamay yursilur-riyaaha bushram bayna yaday rahmatih, a'ilaahum ma'allaah, ta'aalallaahu 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.27:64: Ammay yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo wamay yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ard, a'ilaahum ma'allaah, qul haatoo burhaanakum in kuntum saadiqeen
map.27:65: Qul laa ya'lamu man fis-samaawaati wal-ardil-ghayba illallaah, wamaa yash'uroona ayyaana yub'athoon
map.27:66: Baliddaaraka 'ilmuhum fil-aakhirah, bal hum fee shakkim minhaa, bal hum minhaa 'amoon
map.27:67: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo a'idhaa kunnaa turaabaw wa'aabaa'unaa a'innaa lamukhrajoon
map.27:68: Laqad wu'idnaa haadhaa nahnu wa'aabaa'unaa min qablu in haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
map.27:69: Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-mujrimeen
map.27:70: Walaa tahzan 'alayhim walaa takun fee dayqim mimmaa yamkuroon
map.27:71: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
map.27:72: Qul 'asaa ay yakoona radifa lakum ba'dul-ladhee tasta'jiloon
map.27:73: Wa'inna rabbaka ladhoo fadlin 'alan-naasi walaakinna aktharahum laa yashkuroon
map.27:74: Wa'inna rabbaka laya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu'linoon
map.27:75: Wamaa min ghaa'ibatin fis-samaa'i wal-ardi illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
map.27:76: Inna haadhal-qur'aana yaqussu 'alaa banee israa'eela aktharal-ladhee hum feehi yakhtalifoon
map.27:78: Inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum bihukmih, wahuwal-'azeezul-'aleem
map.27:80: Innaka laa tusmi'ul-mawtaa walaa tusmi'us-summad-du'aa'a idhaa wallaw mudbireen
map.27:81: Wamaa anta bihaadil-'umyi 'an dalaalatihim, in tusmi'u illaa may yu'minu bi'aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
map.27:82: Wa'idhaa waqa'al-qawlu 'alayhim akhrajnaa lahum daabbatam minal-ardi tukallimuhum annan-naasa kaanoo bi'aayaatinaa laa yooqinoon
map.27:83: Wayawma nahshuru min kulli ummatin fawjam mimmay yukadhdhibu bi'aayaatinaa fahum yooza'oon
map.27:84: Hattaa idhaa jaa'oo qaala akadhdhabtum bi'aayaatee walam tuheetoo bihaa 'ilman ammaadhaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.27:85: Wawaqa'al-qawlu 'alayhim bimaa zalamoo fahum laa yantiqoon
map.27:86: Alam yaraw annaa ja'alnal-layla liyaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiraa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.27:87: Wayawma yunfakhu fis-soori fafazi'a man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ardi illaa man shaa'allaah, wakullun atawhu daakhireen
map.27:88: Wataral-jibaala tahsabuhaa jaamidataw wahiya tamurru marras-sahaab, sun'allaahil-ladhee atqana kulla shay', innahoo khabeerum bimaa taf'aloon
map.27:89: Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahoo khayrum minhaa, wahum min faza'iy yawma'idhin aaminoon
map.27:90: Waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati fakubbat wujoohuhum fin-naar, hal tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.27:91: Innamaa umirtu an a'buda rabba haadhihil-baldatil-ladhee harramahaa walahoo kullu shay'iw wa'umirtu an akoona minal-muslimeen
map.27:92: Wa'an atluwal-qur'aan, famanihtadaa fa'innamaa yahtadee linafsih, waman dalla faqul innamaa ana minal-mundhireen
map.27:93: Waqulil-hamdu lillaahi sayureekum aayaatihee fata'rifoonahaa, wamaa rabbuka bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
map.28:3: Natloo 'alayka min naba'i moosaa wafir'awna bil-haqqi liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.28:4: Inna fir'awna 'alaa fil-ardi waja'ala ahlahaa shiya'ay yastad'ifu taa'ifatam minhum yudhabbihu abnaa'ahum wayastahyee nisaa'ahum, innahoo kaana minal-mufsideen
map.28:5: Wanureedu an namunna 'alal-ladheenastud'ifoo fil-ardi wanaj'alahum a'immataw wanaj'alahumul-waaritheen
map.28:6: Wanumakkina lahum fil-ardi wanuriya fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa minhum maa kaanoo yahdharoon
map.28:7: Wa'awhaynaa ilaa ummi moosaa an ardi'eeh, fa'idhaa khifti 'alayhi fa'alqeehi fil-yammi walaa takhaafee walaa tahzanee, innaa raaddoohu ilayki wajaa'iloohu minal-mursaleen
map.28:8: Fal-taqatahoo aalu fir'awna liyakoona lahum 'aduwwaw wahazanaa, inna fir'awna wahaamaana wajunoodahumaa kaanoo khaati'een
map.28:9: Waqaalatimra'atu fir'awna qurratu 'aynil lee walak, laa taqtulooh, 'asaa ay yanfa'anaa aw nattakhidhahoo waladaw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.28:10: Wa'asbaha fu'aadu ummi moosaa faarighaa, in kaadat latubdee bihee lawlaa ar rabatnaa 'alaa qalbihaa litakoona minal-mu'mineen
map.28:11: Waqaalat li'ukhtihee qusseeh, fabasurat bihee 'an junubiw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.28:12: Waharramnaa 'alayhil-maraadi'a min qablu faqaalat hal adullukum 'alaa ahli baytiy yakfuloonahoo lakum wahum lahoo naasihoon
