map.28:13: Faradadnaahu ilaa ummihee kay taqarra 'aynuhaa walaa tahzana walita'lama anna wa'dallaahi haqquw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.28:14: Walammaa balagha ashuddahoo wastawaa aataynaahu hukmaw wa'ilmaa, wakadhaalika najzil-muhsineen
map.28:15: Wadakhalal-madeenata 'alaa heeni ghaflatim min ahlihaa fawajada feehaa rajulayni yaqtatilaan, haadhaa min shee'atihee wahaadhaa min 'aduwwih, fastaghaathahul-ladhee min shee'atihee 'alal-ladhee min 'aduwwihee fawakazahoo moosaa faqadaa 'alayh, qaala haadhaa min 'amalish-shaytaan, innahoo 'aduwwum mudillum mubeen
map.28:16: Qaala rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafara lah, innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
map.28:17: Qaala rabbi bimaa an'amta 'alayya falan akoona zaheeral lil-mujrimeen
map.28:18: Fa'asbaha fil-madeenati khaa'ifay yataraqqabu fa'idhal-ladhistansarahoo bil-amsi yastasrikhuh, qaala lahoo moosaa innaka laghawiyyum mubeen
map.28:19: Falammaa an araada ay yabtisha bil-ladhee huwa 'aduwwul lahumaa qaala yaamoosaa atureedu an taqtulanee kamaa qatalta nafsam bil-ams, in tureedu illaa an takoona jabbaaran fil-ardi wamaa tureedu an takoona minal-musliheen
map.28:20: Wajaa'a rajulum min aqsal-madeenati yas'aa, qaala yaamoosaa innal-mala'a ya'tamiroona bika liyaqtulooka fakhruj innee laka minan-naasiheen
map.28:21: Fakharaja minhaa khaa'ifay yataraqqab, qaala rabbi najjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.28:22: Walammaa tawajjaha tilqaa'a madyana qaala 'asaa rabbee ay yahdiyanee sawaa'as-sabeel
map.28:23: Walammaa warada maa'a madyana wajada 'alayhi ummatam minan-naasi yasqoon, wawajada min doonihimumra'atayni tadhoodaan, qaala maa khatbukumaa, qaalataa laa nasqee hattaa yusdirar-ri'aa'u wa'aboonaa shaykhun kabeer
map.28:24: Fasaqaa lahumaa thumma tawallaa ilaz-zilli faqaala rabbi innee limaa anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeer
map.28:25: Fajaa'athu ihdaahumaa tamshee 'alastihyaa', qaalat inna abee yad'ooka liyajziyaka ajra maa saqayta lanaa, falammaa jaa'ahoo waqassa 'alayhil-qasasa qaala laa takhaf, najawta minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.28:26: Qaalat ihdaahumaa yaa abatista'jirh, inna khayra manista'jartal-qawiyyul-ameen
map.28:27: Qaala innee ureedu an unkihaka ihdabnatayya haatayni 'alaa an ta'juranee thamaaniya hijaj, fa'in atmamta 'ashran famin 'indik, wamaa ureedu an ashuqqa 'alayk, satajidunee in shaa'allaahu minas-saaliheen
map.28:28: Qaala dhaalika baynee wabaynak, ayyamal-ajalayni qadaytu falaa 'udwaana 'alayy, wallaahu 'alaa maa naqoolu wakeel
map.28:29: Falammaa qadaa moosal-ajala wasaara bi'ahlihee aanasa min jaanibit-toori naaraa, qaala li'ahlihimkuthoo innee aanastu naaral la'allee aateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw jadhwatim minan-naari la'allakum tastaloon
map.28:30: Falammaa ataahaa noodiya min shaati'il-waadil-aymani fil-buq'atil-mubaarakati minash-shajarati ay yaamoosaa innee anallaahu rabbul-'aalameen
map.28:31: Wa'an alqi 'asaak, falammaa ra'aahaa tahtazzu ka'annahaa jaannuw wallaa mudbiraw walam yu'aqqib, yaamoosaa aqbil walaa takhaf, innaka minal-aamineen
map.28:32: Usluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa'a min ghayri soo', wadmum ilayka janaahaka minar-rahbi fadhaanika burhaanaani mir rabbika ilaa fir'awna wamala'ih, innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
map.28:33: Qaala rabbi innee qataltu minhum nafsan fa'akhaafu ay yaqtuloon
map.28:34: Wa'akhee haaroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisaanan fa'arsilhu ma'iya rid'ay yusaddiqunee, innee akhaafu ay yukadhdhiboon
map.28:35: Qaala sanashuddu 'adudaka bi'akheeka wanaj'alu lakumaa sultaanan falaa yasiloona ilaykumaa bi'aayaatinaa, antumaa wamanittaba'akumal-ghaaliboon
map.28:36: Falammaa jaa'ahum moosaa bi'aayaatinaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa sihrum muftaraw wamaa sami'naa bihaadhaa fee aabaa'inal-awwaleen
map.28:37: Waqaala moosaa rabbee a'lamu biman jaa'a bil-hudaa min 'indihee waman takoonu lahoo 'aaqibatud-daar, innahoo laa yuflihuz-zaalimoon
map.28:38: Waqaala fir'awnu yaa ayyuhal-mala'u maa 'alimtu lakum min ilaahin ghayree, fa'awqid lee yaahaamaanu 'alat-teeni faj'al lee sarhal la'allee attali'u ilaa ilaahi moosaa wa'innee la'azunnuhoo minal-kaadhibeen
map.28:39: Wastakbara huwa wajunooduhoo fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wazannoo annahum ilaynaa laa yurja'oon
map.28:40: Fa'akhadhnaahu wajunoodahoo fanabadhnaahum fil-yamm, fanzur kayfa kaana 'aaqibatuz-zaalimeen
map.28:41: Waja'alnaahum a'immatay yad'oona ilan-naar, wayawmal-qiyaamati laa yunsaroon
map.28:42: Wa'atba'naahum fee haadhihid-dunyaa la'nah, wayawmal-qiyaamati hum minal-maqbooheen
map.28:43: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba mim ba'di maa ahlaknal-quroonal-oolaa basaa'ira lin-naasi wahudaw warahmatal la'allahum yatadhakkaroon
map.28:44: Wamaa kunta bijaanibil-gharbiyyi idh qadaynaa ilaa moosal-amra wamaa kunta minash-shaahideen
map.28:45: Walaakinnaa ansha'naa quroonan fatataawala 'alayhimul-'umur, wamaa kunta thaawiyan fee ahli madyana tatloo 'alayhim aayaatinaa walaakinnaa kunnaa mursileen
map.28:46: Wamaa kunta bijaanibit-toori idh naadaynaa walaakir rahmatam mir rabbika litundhira qawmam maa ataahum min nadheerim min qablika la'allahum yatadhakkaroon
map.28:47: Walawlaa an tuseebahum museebatum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbanaa lawlaa arsalta ilaynaa rasoolan fanattabi'a aayaatika wanakoona minal-mu'mineen
map.28:48: Falammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu min 'indinaa qaaloo lawlaa ootiya mithla maa ootiya moosaa, awalam yakfuroo bimaa ootiya moosaa min qabl, qaaloo sihraani tazaaharaa, waqaaloo innaa bikullin kaafiroon
map.28:49: Qul fa'too bikitaabim min 'indillaahi huwa ahdaa minhumaa attabi'hu in kuntum saadiqeen
map.28:50: Fa'il lam yastajeeboo laka fa'lam annamaa yattabi'oona ahwaa'ahum, waman adallu mimmanittaba'a hawaahu bighayri hudam minallaah, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.28:52: Alladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba min qablihee hum bihee yu'minoon
map.28:53: Wa'idhaa yutlaa 'alayhim qaaloo aamannaa bihee innahul-haqqu mir rabbinaa innaa kunnaa min qablihee muslimeen
map.28:54: Ulaa'ika yu'tawna ajrahum marratayni bimaa sabaroo wayadra'oona bil-hasanatis-sayyi'ata wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
map.28:55: Wa'idhaa sami'ul-laghwa a'radoo 'anhu waqaaloo lanaa a'maalunaa walakum a'maalukum, salaamun 'alaykum, laa nabtaghil-jaahileen
map.28:56: Innaka laa tahdee man ahbabta walaakinnallaaha yahdee may yashaa', wahuwa a'lamu bil-muhtadeen
map.28:57: Waqaaloo in nattabi'il-hudaa ma'aka nutakhattaf min ardinaa, awalam numakkil lahum haraman aaminay yujbaa ilayhi thamaraatu kulli shay'ir rizqam mil ladunnaa walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.28:58: Wakam ahlaknaa min qaryatim batirat ma'eeshatahaa, fatilka masaakinuhum lam tuskam mim ba'dihim illaa qaleelaa, wakunnaa nahnul-waaritheen
map.28:59: Wamaa kaana rabbuka muhlikal-quraa hattaa yab'atha fee ummihaa rasoolay yatloo 'alayhim aayaatinaa, wamaa kunnaa muhlikil-quraa illaa wa'ahluhaa zaalimoon
map.28:60: Wamaa ooteetum min shay'in famataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa wazeenatuhaa, wamaa 'indallaahi khayruw wa'abqaa, afalaa ta'qiloon
map.28:61: Afamaw wa'adnaahu wa'dan hasanan fahuwa laaqeehi kamam matta'naahu mataa'al-hayaatid-dunyaa thumma huwa yawmal-qiyaamati minal-muhdareen
map.28:62: Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum taz'umoon
map.28:63: Qaalal-ladheena haqqa 'alayhimul-qawlu rabbanaa haa'ulaa'il-ladheena aghwaynaa, aghwaynaahum kamaa ghawaynaa, tabarra'naa ilayka maa kaanoo iyyaanaa ya'budoon
map.28:64: Waqeelad'oo shurakaa'akum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum, wara'awul-'adhaab, law annahum kaanoo yahtadoon
map.28:67: Fa'ammaa man taaba wa'aamana wa'amila saalihan fa'asaa ay yakoona minal-mufliheen
map.28:68: Warabbuka yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wayakhtaar, maa kaana lahumul-khiyarah, subhaanallaahi wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.28:69: Warabbuka ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wamaa yu'linoon
map.28:70: Wahuwallaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, lahul-hamdu fil-oolaa wal-aakhirah, walahul-hukmu wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.28:71: Qul ara'aytum in ja'alallaahu 'alaykumul-layla sarmadan ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man ilaahun ghayrullaahi ya'teekum bidiyaa', afalaa tasma'oon
map.28:72: Qul ara'aytum in ja'alallaahu 'alaykumun-nahaara sarmadan ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati man ilaahun ghayrullaahi ya'teekum bilaylin taskunoona feeh, afalaa tubsiroon
map.28:73: Wamir rahmatihee ja'ala lakumul-layla wan-nahaara litaskunoo feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
map.28:74: Wayawma yunaadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaa'iyal-ladheena kuntum taz'umoon
map.28:75: Wanaza'naa min kulli ummatin shaheedan faqulnaa haatoo burhaanakum fa'alimoo annal-haqqa lillaahi wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.28:76: Inna qaaroona kaana min qawmi moosaa fabaghaa 'alayhim, wa'aataynaahu minal-kunoozi maa inna mafaatihahoo latanoo'u bil-'usbati ulil-quwwati idh qaala lahoo qawmuhoo laa tafrah innallaaha laa yuhibbul-fariheen
map.28:77: Wabtaghi feemaa aataakallaahud-daaral-aakhirata walaa tansa naseebaka minad-dunyaa wa'ahsin kamaa ahsanallaahu ilayka walaa tabghil-fasaada fil-ard, innallaaha laa yuhibbul-mufsideen
map.28:78: Qaala innamaa ooteetuhoo 'alaa 'ilmin 'indee, awalam ya'lam annallaaha qad ahlaka min qablihee minal-qurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwataw wa'aktharu jam'aa, walaa yus'alu 'an dhunoobihimul-mujrimoon
map.28:79: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee fee zeenatih, qaalal-ladheena yureedoonal-hayaatad-dunyaa yaalayta lanaa mithla maa ootiya qaaroonu innahoo ladhoo hazzin 'azeem
map.28:80: Waqaalal-ladheena ootul-'ilma waylakum thawaabullaahi khayrul liman aamana wa'amila saalihaa, walaa yulaqqaahaa illas-saabiroon
map.28:81: Fakhasafnaa bihee wabidaarihil-ard, famaa kaana lahoo min fi'atiy yansuroonahoo min doonillaah, wamaa kaana minal-muntasireen
map.28:82: Wa'asbahal-ladheena tamannaw makaanahoo bil-amsi yaqooloona wayka'annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee wayaqdir, lawlaa am mannallaahu 'alaynaa lakhasafa binaa, wayka'annahoo laa yuflihul-kaafiroon
map.28:83: Tilkad-daarul-aakhiratu naj'aluhaa lilladheena laa yureedoona 'uluwwan fil-ardi walaa fasaadaa, wal-'aaqibatu lil-muttaqeen
map.28:84: Man jaa'a bil-hasanati falahoo khayrum minhaa, waman jaa'a bis-sayyi'ati falaa yujzal-ladheena 'amilus-sayyi'aati illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.28:85: Innal-ladhee farada 'alaykal-qur'aana laraadduka ilaa ma'aad, qur rabbee a'lamu man jaa'a bil-hudaa waman huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
map.28:86: Wamaa kunta tarjoo ay yulqaa ilaykal-kitaabu illaa rahmatam mir rabbika falaa takoonanna zaheeral lil-kaafireen
map.28:87: Walaa yasuddunnaka 'an aayaatillaahi ba'da idh unzilat ilayka wad'u ilaa rabbika walaa takoonanna minal-mushrikeen
map.28:88: Walaa tad'u ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhar, laa ilaaha illaa huw, kullu shay'in haalikun illaa wajhah, lahul-hukmu wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.29:2: Ahasiban-naasu ay yutrakoo ay yaqooloo aamannaa wahum laa yuftanoon
map.29:3: Walaqad fatannal-ladheena min qablihim falaya'lamannallaahul-ladheena sadaqoo walaya'lamannal-kaadhibeen
map.29:4: Am hasibal-ladheena ya'maloonas-sayyi'aati ay yasbiqoonaa, saa'a maa yahkumoon
map.29:5: Man kaana yarjoo liqaa'allaahi fa'inna ajalallaahi la'aat, wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.29:6: Waman jaahada fa'innamaa yujaahidu linafsih, innallaaha laghaniyyun 'anil-'aalameen
map.29:7: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lanukaffiranna 'anhum sayyi'aatihim walanajziyannahum ahsanal-ladhee kaanoo ya'maloon
map.29:8: Wawassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi husnaa, wa'in jaahadaaka litushrika bee maa laysa laka bihee 'ilmun falaa tuti'humaa, ilayya marji'ukum fa'unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.29:10: Waminan-naasi may yaqoolu aamannaa billaahi fa'idhaa oodhiya fillaahi ja'ala fitnatan-naasi ka'adhaabillaah, wala'in jaa'a nasrum mir rabbika layaqoolunna innaa kunnaa ma'akum, awalaysallaahu bi'a'lama bimaa fee sudooril-'aalameen
map.29:12: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanuttabi'oo sabeelanaa walnahmil khataayaakum, wamaa hum bihaamileena min khataayaahum min shay', innahum lakaadhiboon
map.29:13: Walayahmilunna athqaalahum wa'athqaalam ma'a athqaalihim walayus'alunna yawmal-qiyaamati 'ammaa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.29:14: Walaqad arsalnaa noohan ilaa qawmihee falabitha feehim alfa sanatin illaa khamseena 'aamaa, fa'akhadhahumut-toofaanu wahum zaalimoon
map.29:16: Wa'ibraaheema idh qaala liqawmihi'budullaaha wattaqooh, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.29:17: Innamaa ta'budoona min doonillaahi awthaanaw watakhluqoona ifkaa, innal-ladheena ta'budoona min doonillaahi laa yamlikoona lakum rizqan fabtaghoo 'indallaahir-rizqa wa'budoohu washkuroo lah, ilayhi turja'oon
map.29:18: Wa'in tukadhdhiboo faqad kadhdhaba umamum min qablikum, wamaa 'alar-rasooli illal-balaaghul-mubeen
map.29:19: Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdi'ullaahul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduh, inna dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseer
map.29:20: Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa bada'al-khalqa thummallaahu yunshi'un-nash'atal-aakhirah, innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.29:21: Yu'adhdhibu may yashaa'u wayarhamu may yashaa', wa'ilayhi tuqlaboon
map.29:22: Wamaa antum bimu'jizeena fil-ardi walaa fis-samaa', wamaa lakum min doonillaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
map.29:23: Wal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi waliqaa'ihee ulaa'ika ya'isoo mir rahmatee wa'ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.29:24: Famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaaluqtuloohu aw harriqoohu fa'anjaahullaahu minan-naar, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.29:25: Waqaala innamattakhadhtum min doonillaahi awthaanam mawaddata baynikum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, thumma yawmal-qiyaamati yakfuru ba'dukum biba'diw wayal'anu ba'dukum ba'daa, wama'waakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min naasireen
map.29:26: Fa'aamana lahoo loot, waqaala innee muhaajirun ilaa rabbee, innahoo huwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.29:27: Wawahabnaa lahoo ishaaqa waya'qooba waja'alnaa fee dhurriyyatihin-nubuwwata wal-kitaaba wa'aataynaahu ajrahoo fid-dunyaa, wa'innahoo fil-aakhirati laminas-saaliheen
map.29:28: Walootan idh qaala liqawmihee innakum lata'toonal-faahishah, maa sabaqakum bihaa min ahadim minal-'aalameen
map.29:29: A'innakum lata'toonar-rijaala wataqta'oonas-sabeela wata'toona fee naadeekumul-munkar, famaa kaana jawaaba qawmihee illaa an qaalu'tinaa bi'adhaabillaahi in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.29:31: Walammaa jaa'at rusulunaa ibraaheema bil-bushraa qaaloo innaa muhlikoo ahli haadhihil-qaryah, inna ahlahaa kaanoo zaalimeen
map.29:32: Qaala inna feehaa lootaa, qaaloo nahnu a'lamu biman feehaa, lanunajjiyannahoo wa'ahlahoo illamra'atahoo kaanat minal-ghaabireen
map.29:33: Walammaa an jaa'at rusulunaa lootan see'a bihim wadaaqa bihim dhar'aw waqaaloo laa takhaf walaa tahzan, innaa munajjooka wa'ahlaka illamra'ataka kaanat minal-ghaabireen
map.29:34: Innaa munziloona 'alaa ahli haadhihil-qaryati rijzam minas-samaa'i bimaa kaanoo yafsuqoon
map.29:35: Walaqat taraknaa minhaa aayatam bayyinatal liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.29:36: Wa'ilaa madyana akhaahum shu'ayban faqaala yaaqawmi'budullaaha warjul-yawmal-aakhira walaa ta'thaw fil-ardi mufsideen
map.29:37: Fakadhdhaboohu fa'akhadhathumur-rajfatu fa'asbahoo fee daarihim jaathimeen
map.29:38: Wa'aadaw wathamooda waqat tabayyana lakum mim masaakinihim, wazayyana lahumush-shaytaanu a'maalahum fasaddahum 'anis-sabeeli wakaanoo mustabsireen
map.29:39: Waqaaroona wafir'awna wahaamaan, walaqad jaa'ahum moosaa bil-bayyinaati fastakbaroo fil-ardi wamaa kaanoo saabiqeen
map.29:40: Fakullan akhadhnaa bidhambihee faminhum man arsalnaa 'alayhi haasibaa, waminhum man akhadhathus-sayhah, waminhum man khasafnaa bihil-ard, waminhum man aghraqnaa, wamaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.29:41: Mathalul-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonillaahi awliyaa'a kamathalil-'ankaboot, ittakhadhat baytaa, wa'inna awhanal-buyooti labaytul-'ankaboot, law kaanoo ya'lamoon
map.29:42: Innallaaha ya'lamu maa yad'oona min doonihee min shay', wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.29:43: Watilkal-amthaalu nadribuhaa lin-naas, wamaa ya'qiluhaa illal-'aalimoon
map.29:44: Khalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal lil-mu'mineen
map.29:45: Utlu maa oohiya ilayka minal-kitaabi wa'aqimis-salaah, innas-salaata tanhaa 'anil-fahshaa'i wal-munkar, waladhikrullaahi akbar, wallaahu ya'lamu maa tasna'oon
map.29:46: Walaa tujaadiloo ahlal-kitaabi illaa bil-latee hiya ahsan, illal-ladheena zalamoo minhum waqooloo aamannaa bil-ladhee unzila ilaynaa wa'unzila ilaykum wa'ilaahunaa wa'ilaahukum waahiduw wanahnu lahoo muslimoon
map.29:47: Wakadhaalika anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaab, fal-ladheena aataynaahumul-kitaaba yu'minoona bih, wamin haa'ulaa'i may yu'minu bih, wamaa yajhadu bi'aayaatinaa illal-kaafiroon
map.29:48: Wamaa kunta tatloo min qablihee min kitaabiw walaa takhuttuhoo biyameenika idhal lartaabal-mubtiloon
map.29:49: Bal huwa aayaatum bayyinaatun fee sudooril-ladheena ootul-'ilm, wamaa yajhadu bi'aayaatinaa illaz-zaalimoon
map.29:50: Waqaaloo lawlaa unzila 'alayhi aayaatum mir rabbih, qul innamal-aayaatu 'indallaah, wa'innamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
map.29:51: Awalam yakfihim annaa anzalnaa 'alaykal-kitaaba yutlaa 'alayhim, inna fee dhaalika larahmataw wadhikraa liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.29:52: Qul kafaa billaahi baynee wabaynakum shaheedaa, ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wal-ladheena aamanoo bil-baatili wakafaroo billaahi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.29:53: Wayasta'jiloonaka bil-'adhaab, walawlaa ajalum musammal lajaa'ahumul-'adhaab, walaya'tiyannahum baghtataw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.29:54: Yasta'jiloonaka bil-'adhaab, wa'inna jahannama lamuheetatum bil-kaafireen
map.29:55: Yawma yaghshaahumul-'adhaabu min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim wayaqoolu dhooqoo maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.29:56: Yaa'ibaadiyal-ladheena aamanoo inna ardee waasi'atun fa'iyyaaya fa'budoon
map.29:57: Kullu nafsin dhaa'iqatul-mawt, thumma ilaynaa turja'oon
map.29:58: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lanubawwi'annahum minal-jannati ghurafan tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, ni'ma ajrul-'aamileen
map.29:60: Waka'ayyim min daabbatil laa tahmilu rizqahaa, allaahu yarzuquhaa wa'iyyaakum wahuwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.29:61: Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara layaqoolunnallaah, fa'annaa yu'fakoon
map.29:62: Allaahu yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee wayaqdiru lah, innallaaha bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.29:63: Wala'in sa'altahum man nazzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ahyaa bihil-arda mim ba'di mawtihaa layaqoolunnallaahu qulil-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya'qiloon
map.29:64: Wamaa haadhihil-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa lahwuw wala'ib, wa'innad-daaral-aakhirata lahiyal-hayawaan, law kaanoo ya'lamoon
map.29:65: Fa'idhaa rakiboo fil-fulki da'awullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deen, falammaa najjaahum ilal-barri idhaa hum yushrikoon
map.29:66: Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum waliyatamatta'oo, fasawfa ya'lamoon
map.29:67: Awalam yaraw annaa ja'alnaa haraman aaminaw wayutakhattafun-naasu min hawlihim, afabilbaatili yu'minoona wabini'matillaahi yakfuroon
map.29:68: Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban aw kadhdhaba bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ah, alaysa fee jahannama mathwal lil-kaafireen
map.29:69: Wal-ladheena jaahadoo feenaa lanahdiyannahum subulanaa, wa'innallaaha lama'al-muhsineen
map.30:3: Fee adnal-ardi wahum mim ba'di ghalabihim sayaghliboon
map.30:4: Fee bid'i sineen, lillaahil-amru min qablu wamim ba'd, wayawma'idhiy yafrahul-mu'minoon
map.30:6: Wa'dallaah, laa yukhlifullaahu wa'dahoo walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.30:7: Ya'lamoona zaahiram minal-hayaatid-dunyaa, wahum 'anil-aakhirati hum ghaafiloon
map.30:8: Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim, maa khalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa'ajalim musammaa, wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi biliqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiroon
map.30:9: Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, kaanoo ashadda minhum quwwataw wa'athaarul-arda wa'amaroohaa akthara mimmaa 'amaroohaa wajaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaat, famaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
map.30:10: Thumma kaana 'aaqibatal-ladheena asaa'us-soo'aa an kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaahi wakaanoo bihaa yastahzi'oon
map.30:11: Allaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo thumma ilayhi turja'oon
map.30:13: Walam yakul lahum min shurakaa'ihim shufa'aa'u wakaanoo bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
map.30:15: Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fahum fee rawdatiy yuhbaroon
map.30:16: Wa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa waliqaa'il-aakhirati fa'ulaa'ika fil-'adhaabi muhdaroon
map.30:18: Walahul-hamdu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa'ashiyyaw waheena tuzhiroon
map.30:19: Yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wayukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wayuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa, wakadhaalika tukhrajoon
map.30:20: Wamin aayaatihee an khalaqakum min turaabin thumma idhaa antum basharun tantashiroon
map.30:21: Wamin aayaatihee an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwaajal litaskunoo ilayhaa waja'ala baynakum mawaddataw warahmah, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.30:22: Wamin aayaatihee khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafu alsinatikum wa'alwaanikum, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil lil-'aalimeen
map.30:23: Wamin aayaatihee manaamukum bil-layli wan-nahaari wabtighaa'ukum min fadlih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yasma'oon
map.30:24: Wamin aayaatihee yureekumul-barqa khawfaw watama'aw wayunazzilu minas-samaa'i maa'an fayuhyee bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.30:25: Wamin aayaatihee an taqoomas-samaa'u wal-ardu bi'amrih, thumma idhaa da'aakum da'wah, minal-ardi idhaa antum takhrujoon
map.30:26: Walahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ard, kullul lahoo qaanitoon
map.30:27: Wahuwal-ladhee yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo wahuwa ahwanu 'alayh, walahul-mathalul-a'laa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.30:28: Daraba lakum mathalam min anfusikum, hal lakum mim maa malakat aymaanukum min shurakaa'a fee maa razaqnaakum fa'antum feehi sawaa'un takhaafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum, kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.30:29: Balittaba'al-ladheena zalamoo ahwaa'ahum bighayri 'ilm, famay yahdee man adallallaah, wamaa lahum min naasireen
map.30:30: Fa'aqim wajhaka lid-deeni haneefaa, fitratallaahil-latee fataran-naasa 'alayhaa, laa tabdeela likhalqillaah, dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.30:31: Muneebeena ilayhi wattaqoohu wa'aqeemus-salaata walaa takoonoo minal-mushrikeen
map.30:32: Minal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wakaanoo shiya'aa, kullu hizbim bimaa ladayhim farihoon
map.30:33: Wa'idhaa massan-naasa durrun da'aw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma idhaa adhaaqahum minhu rahmatan idhaa fareequm minhum birabbihim yushrikoon
map.30:34: Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum, fatamatta'oo, fasawfa ta'lamoon
map.30:35: Am anzalnaa 'alayhim sultaanan fahuwa yatakallamu bimaa kaanoo bihee yushrikoon
map.30:36: Wa'idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatan farihoo bihaa, wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim idhaa hum yaqnatoon
map.30:37: Awalam yaraw annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.30:38: Fa'aati dhal-qurbaa haqqahoo wal-miskeena wabnas-sabeel, dhaalika khayrul lilladheena yureedoona wajhallaah, wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.30:39: Wamaa aataytum mir ribal liyarbuwa fee amwaalin-naasi falaa yarboo 'indallaah, wamaa aataytum min zakaatin tureedoona wajhallaahi fa'ulaa'ika humul-mud'ifoon
map.30:40: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum, hal min shurakaa'ikum may yaf'alu min dhaalikum min shay', subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.30:41: Zaharal-fasaadu fil-barri wal-bahri bimaa kasabat aydin-naasi liyudheeqahum ba'dal-ladhee 'amiloo la'allahum yarji'oon
map.30:42: Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qabl, kaana aktharuhum mushrikeen
map.30:43: Fa'aqim wajhaka lid-deenil-qayyimi min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa maradda lahoo minallaahi yawma'idhiy yassadda'oon
map.30:44: Man kafara fa'alayhi kufruh, waman 'amila saalihan fali'anfusihim yamhadoon
map.30:45: Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati min fadlih, innahoo laa yuhibbul-kaafireen
map.30:46: Wamin aayaatihee ay yursilar-riyaaha mubashshiraatiw waliyudheeqakum mir rahmatihee walitajriyal-fulku bi'amrihee walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
map.30:47: Walaqad arsalnaa min qablika rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati fantaqamnaa minal-ladheena ajramoo, wakaana haqqaa, 'alaynaa nasrul-mu'mineen
map.30:48: Allaahul-ladhee yursilur-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fayabsutuhoo fis-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wayaj'aluhoo kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalih, fa'idhaa asaaba bihee may yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee idhaa hum yastabshiroon
map.30:49: Wa'in kaanoo min qabli ay yunazzala 'alayhim min qablihee lamubliseen
map.30:50: Fanzur ilaa aathaari rahmatillaahi kayfa yuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa, inna dhaalika lamuhyil-mawtaa, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.30:51: Wala'in arsalnaa reehan fara'awhu musfarral lazalloo mim ba'dihee yakfuroon
map.30:52: Fa'innaka laa tusmi'ul-mawtaa walaa tusmi'us-summad-du'aa'a idhaa wallaw mudbireen
map.30:53: Wamaa anta bihaadil-'umyi 'an dalaalatihim, in tusmi'u illaa may yu'minu bi'aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
map.30:54: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum min da'fin thumma ja'ala mim ba'di da'fin quwwatan thumma ja'ala mim ba'di quwwatin da'faw washaybah, yakhluqu maa yashaa', wahuwal-'aleemul-qadeer
map.30:55: Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yuqsimul-mujrimoona maa labithoo ghayra saa'ah, kadhaalika kaanoo yu'fakoon
map.30:56: Waqaalal-ladheena ootul-'ilma wal-eemaana laqad labithtum fee kitaabillaahi ilaa yawmil-ba'th, fahaadhaa yawmul-ba'thi walaakinnakum kuntum laa ta'lamoon
map.30:57: Fayawma'idhil laa yanfa'ul-ladheena zalamoo ma'dhiratuhum walaa hum yusta'taboon
map.30:58: Walaqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathal, wala'in ji'tahum bi'aayatil layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in antum illaa mubtiloon
map.30:60: Fasbir inna wa'dallaahi haqquw walaa yastakhiffannakal-ladheena laa yooqinoon
map.31:4: Al-ladheena yuqeemoonas-salaata wayu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil-aakhirati hum yooqinoon
map.31:5: Ulaa'ika 'alaa hudam mir rabbihim wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.31:6: Waminan-naasi may yashtaree lahwal-hadeethi liyudilla 'an sabeelillaahi bighayri 'ilm, wayattakhidhahaa huzuwaa, ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabum muheen
map.31:7: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhi aayaatunaa wallaa mustakbiran ka'al lam yasma'haa ka'anna fee udhunayhi waqraa, fabashshirhu bi'adhaabin aleem
map.31:10: Khalaqas-samaawaati bighayri 'amadin tarawnahaa wa'alqaa fil-ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wabaththa feehaa min kulli daabbah, wa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin kareem
map.31:11: Haadhaa khalqullaahi fa'aroonee maadhaa khalaqal-ladheena min doonih, baliz-zaalimoona fee dalaalim mubeen
map.31:12: Walaqad aataynaa luqmaanal-hikmata anishkur lillaah, wamay yashkur fa'innamaa yashkuru linafsih, waman kafara fa'innallaaha ghaniyyun hameed
map.31:13: Wa'idh qaala luqmaanu libnihee wahuwa ya'izuhoo yaabunayya laa tushrik billaah, innash-shirka lazulmun 'azeem
map.31:14: Wawassaynal-insaana biwaalidayh, hamalathu ummuhoo wahnan 'alaa wahniw wafisaaluhoo fee 'aamayni anishkur lee waliwaalidayk, ilayyal-maseer
map.31:15: Wa'in jaahadaaka 'alaa an tushrika bee maa laysa laka bihee 'ilmun falaa tuti'humaa wasaahibhumaa fid-dunyaa ma'roofaa, wattabi' sabeela man anaaba ilayy, thumma ilayya marji'ukum fa'unabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.31:16: Yaabunayya innahaa in taku mithqaala habbatim min khardalin fatakun fee sakhratin aw fis-samaawaati aw fil-ardi ya'ti bihallaah, innallaaha lateefun khabeer
map.31:17: Yaabunayya aqimis-salaata wa'mur bil-ma'roofi wanha 'anil-munkari wasbir 'alaa maa asaabak, inna dhaalika min 'azmil-umoor
map.31:18: Walaa tusa''ir khaddaka lin-naasi walaa tamshi fil-ardi marahaa, innallaaha laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
map.31:19: Waqsid fee mashyika waghdud min sawtik, inna ankaral-aswaati lasawtul-hameer
map.31:20: Alam taraw annallaaha sakhkhara lakum maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi wa'asbagha 'alaykum ni'amahoo zaahirataw wabaatinah, waminan-naasi may yujaadilu fillaahi bighayri 'ilmiw walaa hudaw walaa kitaabim muneer
map.31:21: Wa'idhaa qeela lahumuttabi'oo maa anzalallaahu qaaloo bal nattabi'u maa wajadnaa 'alayhi aabaa'anaa, awalaw kaanash-shaytaanu yad'oohum ilaa 'adhaabis-sa'eer
map.31:22: Wamay yuslim wajhahoo ilallaahi wahuwa muhsinun faqadistamsaka bil-'urwatil-wuthqaa, wa'ilallaahi 'aaqibatul-umoor
map.31:23: Waman kafara falaa yahzunka kufruh, ilaynaa marji'uhum fanunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo, innallaaha 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.31:24: Numatti'uhum qaleelan thumma nadtarruhum ilaa 'adhaabin ghaleez
map.31:25: Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunnallaah, qulil-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
map.31:26: Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
map.31:27: Walaw anna maa fil-ardi min shajaratin aqlaamuw wal-bahru yamudduhoo mim ba'dihee sab'atu abhurim maa nafidat kalimaatullaah, innallaaha 'azeezun hakeem
map.31:28: Maa khalqukum walaa ba'thukum illaa kanafsiw waahidah, innallaaha samee'um baseer
map.31:29: Alam tara annallaaha yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamar, kulluy yajree ilaa ajalim musammaw wa'annallaaha bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.31:30: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha huwal-haqqu wa'anna maa yad'oona min doonihil-baatilu wa'annallaaha huwal-'aliyyul-kabeer
map.31:31: Alam tara annal-fulka tajree fil-bahri bini'matillaahi liyuriyakum min aayaatih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
map.31:32: Wa'idhaa ghashiyahum mawjun kaz-zulali da'awullaaha mukhliseena lahud-deen, falammaa najjaahum ilal-barri faminhum muqtasid, wamaa yajhadu bi'aayaatinaa illaa kullu khattaarin kafoor
map.31:33: Yaa ayyuhan-naasuttaqoo rabbakum wakhshaw yawmal laa yajzee waalidun 'aw waladih, walaa mawloodun huwa jaazin 'aw waalidihee shay'aa, inna wa'dallaahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, walaa yaghurrannakum billaahil-gharoor
map.31:34: Innallaaha 'indahoo 'ilmus-saa'ah, wayunazzilul-ghayth, waya'lamu maa fil-arhaam, wamaa tadree nafsum maadhaa taksibu ghadaa, wamaa tadree nafsum bi'ayyi ardin tamoot, innallaaha 'aleemun khabeer
map.32:2: Tanzeelul-kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rabbil-'aalameen
map.32:3: Am yaqooloonaftaraah, bal huwal-haqqu mir rabbika litundhira qawmam maa ataahum min nadheerim min qablika la'allahum yahtadoon
map.32:4: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arsh, maa lakum min doonihee miw waliyyiw walaa shafee', afalaa tatadhakkaroon
map.32:5: Yudabbirul-amra minas-samaa'i ilal-ardi thumma ya'ruju ilayhi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo alfa sanatim mimmaa ta'uddoon
map.32:7: Al-ladhee ahsana kulla shay'in khalaqahoo wabada'a khalqal-insaani min teen
map.32:8: Thumma ja'ala naslahoo min sulaalatim mim maa'im maheen
map.32:9: Thumma sawwaahu wanafakha feehi mir roohihee waja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idah, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
map.32:10: Waqaaloo a'idhaa dalalnaa fil-ardi a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeed, bal hum biliqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
map.32:11: Qul yatawaffaakum malakul-mawtil-ladhee wukkila bikum thumma ilaa rabbikum turja'oon
map.32:12: Walaw taraa idhil-mujrimoona naakisoo ru'oosihim 'inda rabbihim, rabbanaa absarnaa wasami'naa farji'naa na'mal saalihan innaa mooqinoon
map.32:13: Walaw shi'naa la'aataynaa kulla nafsin hudaahaa walaakin haqqal-qawlu minnee la'amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma'een
map.32:14: Fadhooqoo bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa, innaa naseenaakum wadhooqoo 'adhaabal-khuldi bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.32:15: Innamaa yu'minu bi'aayaatinal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bihaa kharroo sujjadaw wasabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wahum laa yastakbiroon
map.32:16: Tatajaafaa junoobuhum 'anil-madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfaw watama'aa, wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
map.32:17: Falaa ta'lamu nafsum maa ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yun, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.32:18: Afaman kaana mu'minan kaman kaana faasiqaa, laa yastawoon
map.32:19: Ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati falahum jannaatul-ma'waa, nuzulam bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.32:20: Wa'ammal-ladheena fasaqoo fama'waahumun-naaru kullamaa araadoo ay yakhrujoo minhaa u'eedoo feehaa waqeela lahum dhooqoo 'adhaaban-naaril-ladhee kuntum bihee tukadhdhiboon
map.32:22: Waman azlamu mimman dhukkira bi'aayaati rabbihee thumma a'rada 'anhaa, innaa minal-mujrimeena muntaqimoon
map.32:23: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba falaa takun fee miryatim mil liqaa'ihee waja'alnaahu hudal libanee israa'eel
map.32:24: Waja'alnaa minhum a'immatay yahdoona bi'amrinaa lammaa sabaroo, wakaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yooqinoon
map.32:25: Inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
map.32:26: Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa min qablihim minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaat, afalaa yasma'oon
map.32:27: Awalam yaraw annaa nasooqul-maa'a ilal-ardil-juruzi fanukhriju bihee zar'an ta'kulu minhu an'aamuhum wa'anfusuhum, afalaa yubsiroon
map.32:28: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-fathu in kuntum saadiqeen
map.32:29: Qul yawmal-fathi laa yanfa'ul-ladheena kafaroo eemaanuhum walaa hum yunzaroon
map.33:1: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyuttaqillaaha walaa tuti'il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeen, innallaaha kaana 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.33:2: Wattabi' maa yoohaa ilayka mir rabbik, innallaaha kaana bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
map.33:4: Maa ja'alallaahu lirajulim min qalbayni fee jawfih, wamaa ja'ala azwaajakumullaa'ee tuzaahiroona minhunna ummahaatikum, wamaa ja'ala ad'iyaa'akum abnaa'akum, dhaalikum qawlukum bi'afwaahikum, wallaahu yaqoolul-haqqa wahuwa yahdis-sabeel
map.33:5: Ud'oohum li'aabaa'ihim huwa aqsatu 'indallaah, fa'il lam ta'lamoo aabaa'ahum fa'ikhwaanukum fid-deeni wamawaaleekum, walaysa 'alaykum junaahun feemaa akhta'tum bihee walaakim maa ta'ammadat quloobukum, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.33:6: An-nabiyyu awlaa bil-mu'mineena min anfusihim wa'azwaajuhoo ummahaatuhum, wa'ulul-arhaami ba'duhum awlaa biba'din fee kitaabillaahi minal-mu'mineena wal-muhaajireena illaa an taf'aloo ilaa awliyaa'ikum ma'roofaa, kaana dhaalika fil-kitaabi mastooraa
map.33:7: Wa'idh akhadhnaa minan-nabiyyeena meethaaqahum waminka wamin noohiw wa'ibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesabni maryam, wa'akhadhnaa minhum meethaaqan ghaleezaa
map.33:9: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanudhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum idh jaa'atkum junoodun fa'arsalnaa 'alayhim reehaw wajunoodal lam tarawhaa, wakaanallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseeraa
map.33:10: Idh jaa'ookum min fawqikum wamin asfala minkum wa'idh zaaghatil-absaaru wabalaghatil-quloobul-hanaajira watazunnoona billaahiz-zunoonaa
map.33:12: Wa'idh yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradum maa wa'adanallaahu warasooluhoo illaa ghurooraa
map.33:13: Wa'idh qaalat taa'ifatum minhum yaa ahla yathriba laa muqaama lakum farji'oo, wayasta'dhinu fareequm minhumun-nabiyya yaqooloona inna buyootanaa 'awrah, wamaa hiya bi'awrah, iy yureedoona illaa firaaraa
map.33:14: Walaw dukhilat 'alayhim min aqtaarihaa thumma su'ilul-fitnata la'aatawhaa wamaa talabbathoo bihaa illaa yaseeraa
map.33:15: Walaqad kaanoo 'aahadullaaha min qablu laa yuwalloonal-adbaar, wakaana 'ahdullaahi mas'oolaa
map.33:16: Qul lay yanfa'akumul-firaaru in farartum minal-mawti awil-qatli wa'idhal laa tumatta'oona illaa qaleelaa
map.33:17: Qul man dhal-ladhee ya'simukum minallaahi in araada bikum soo'an aw araada bikum rahmah, walaa yajidoona lahum min doonillaahi waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
map.33:18: Qad ya'lamullaahul-mu'awwiqeena minkum wal-qaa'ileena li'ikhwaanihim halumma ilaynaa, walaa ya'toonal-ba'sa illaa qaleelaa
map.33:19: Ashihhatan 'alaykum, fa'idhaa jaa'al-khawfu ra'aytahum yanzuroona ilayka tadooru a'yunuhum kal-ladhee yughshaa 'alayhi minal-mawt, fa'idhaa dhahabal-khawfu salaqookum bi'alsinatin hidaadin ashihhatan 'alal-khayr, ulaa'ika lam yu'minoo fa'ahbatallaahu a'maalahum, wakaana dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseeraa
map.33:20: Yahsaboonal-ahzaaba lam yadhhaboo, wa'iy ya'til-ahzaabu yawaddoo law annahum baadoona fil-a'raabi yas'aloona 'an ambaa'ikum, walaw kaanoo feekum maa qaataloo illaa qaleelaa
map.33:21: Laqad kaana lakum fee rasoolillaahi uswatun hasanatul liman kaana yarjullaaha wal-yawmal-aakhira wadhakarallaaha katheeraa
map.33:22: Walammaa ra'al-mu'minoonal-ahzaaba qaaloo haadhaa maa wa'adanallaahu warasooluhoo wasadaqallaahu warasooluh, wamaa zaadahum illaa eemaanaw watasleemaa
map.33:23: Minal-mu'mineena rijaalun sadaqoo maa 'aahadullaaha 'alayh, faminhum man qadaa nahbahoo waminhum may yantazir, wamaa baddaloo tabdeelaa
map.33:24: Liyajziyallaahus-saadiqeena bisidqihim wayu'adhdhibal-munaafiqeena in shaa'a aw yatooba 'alayhim, innallaaha kaana ghafoorar raheemaa
map.33:25: Waraddallaahul-ladheena kafaroo bighayzihim lam yanaaloo khayraa, wakafallaahul-mu'mineenal-qitaal, wakaanallaahu qawiyyan 'azeezaa
map.33:26: Wa'anzalal-ladheena zaaharoohum min ahlil-kitaabi min sayaaseehim waqadhafa fee quloobihimur-ru'ba fareeqan taqtuloona wata'siroona fareeqaa
map.33:27: Wa'awrathakum ardahum wadiyaarahum wa'amwaalahum wa'ardal lam tata'oohaa, wakaanallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeeraa
map.33:28: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'azwaajika in kuntunna turidnal-hayaatad-dunyaa wazeenatahaa fata'aalayna umatti'kunna wa'usarrihkunna saraahan jameelaa
map.33:29: Wa'in kuntunna turidnallaaha warasoolahoo wad-daaral-aakhirata fa'innallaaha a'adda lil-muhsinaati minkunna ajran 'azeemaa
map.33:30: Yaanisaa'an-nabiyyi may ya'ti minkunna bifaahishatim mubayyinatiy yudaa'af lahal-'adhaabu di'fayn, wakaana dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseeraa
map.33:31: Wamay yaqnut minkunna lillaahi warasoolihee wata'mal saalihan nu'tihaa ajrahaa marratayni wa'a'tadnaa lahaa rizqan kareemaa
map.33:32: Yaanisaa'an-nabiyyi lastunna ka'ahadim minan-nisaa'i inittaqaytunna falaa takhda'na bil-qawli fayatma'al-ladhee fee qalbihee maraduw waqulna qawlam ma'roofaa
map.33:33: Waqarna fee buyootikunna walaa tabarrajna tabarrujal-jaahiliyyatil-oolaa wa'aqimnas-salaata wa'aateenaz-zakaata wa'ati'nallaaha warasoolah, innamaa yureedullaahu liyudhhiba 'ankumur-rijsa ahlal-bayti wayutahhirakum tatheeraa
map.33:34: Wadhkurna maa yutlaa fee buyootikunna min aayaatillaahi wal-hikmah, innallaaha kaana lateefan khabeeraa
map.33:35: Innal-muslimeena wal-muslimaati wal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati wal-qaaniteena wal-qaanitaati was-saadiqeena was-saadiqaati was-saabireena was-saabiraati wal-khaashi'eena wal-khaashi'aati wal-mutasaddiqeena wal-mutasaddiqaati was-saa'imeena was-saa'imaati wal-haafizeena furoojahum wal-haafizaati wadh-dhaakireenallaaha katheeraw wadh-dhaakiraati a'addallaahu lahum maghfirataw wa'ajran 'azeemaa
map.33:36: Wamaa kaana limu'miniw walaa mu'minatin idhaa qadallaahu warasooluhoo amran ay yakoona lahumul-khiyaratu min amrihim, wamay ya'sillaaha warasoolahoo faqad dalla dalaalam mubeenaa
map.33:37: Wa'idh taqoolu lilladhee an'amallaahu 'alayhi wa'an'amta 'alayhi amsik 'alayka zawjaka wattaqillaaha watukhfee fee nafsika mallaahu mubdeehi watakhshan-naas, wallaahu ahaqqu an takhshaah, falammaa qadaa zaydum minhaa wataraa, zawwajnaakahaa likay laa yakoona 'alal-mu'mineena harajun fee azwaaji ad'iyaa'ihim idhaa qadaw minhunna wataraa, wakaana amrullaahi maf'oolaa
map.33:38: Maa kaana 'alan-nabiyyi min harajin feemaa faradallaahu lah, sunnatallaahi fil-ladheena khalaw min qabl, wakaana amrullaahi qadaram maqdooraa
map.33:39: Al-ladheena yuballighoona risaalaatillaahi wayakhshawnahoo walaa yakhshawna ahadan illallaah, wakafaa billaahi haseebaa
map.33:40: Maa kaana muhammadun abaa ahadim mir rijaalikum walaakir rasoolallaahi wakhaataman-nabiyyeen, wakaanallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleemaa
map.33:43: Huwal-ladhee yusallee 'alaykum wamalaa'ikatuhoo liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wakaana bil-mu'mineena raheemaa
map.33:44: Tahiyyatuhum yawma yalqawnahoo salaam, wa'a'adda lahum ajran kareemaa
map.33:45: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa arsalnaaka shaahidaw wamubashshiraw wanadheeraa
map.33:47: Wabashshiril-mu'mineena bi'anna lahum minallaahi fadlan kabeeraa
map.33:48: Walaa tuti'il-kaafireena wal-munaafiqeena wada' adhaahum watawakkal 'alallaah, wakafaa billaahi wakeelaa
map.33:49: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa nakahtumul-mu'minaati thumma tallaqtumoohunna min qabli an tamassoohunna famaa lakum 'alayhinna min 'iddatin ta'taddoonahaa, famatti'oohunna wasarrihoohunna saraahan jameelaa
map.33:50: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu innaa ahlalnaa laka azwaajakallaatee aatayta ujoorahunna wamaa malakat yameenuka mimmaa afaa'allaahu 'alayka wabanaati 'ammika wabanaati 'ammaatika wabanaati khaalika wabanaati khaalaatikallaatee haajarna ma'ak, wamra'atam mu'minatan iw wahabat nafsahaa lin-nabiyyi in araadan-nabiyyu ay yastankihahaa khaalisatal laka min doonil-mu'mineen, qad 'alimnaa maa faradnaa 'alayhim fee azwaajihim wamaa malakat aymaanuhum likaylaa yakoona 'alayka haraj, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.33:51: Turjee man tashaa'u minhunna watu'wee ilayka man tashaa', wamanibtaghayta mimman 'azalta falaa junaaha 'alayk, dhaalika adnaa an taqarra a'yunuhunna walaa yahzanna wayardayna bimaa aataytahunna kulluhunn, wallaahu ya'lamu maa fee quloobikum, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman haleemaa
map.33:52: Laa yahillu lakan-nisaa'u mim ba'du walaa an tabaddala bihinna min azwaajiw walaw a'jabaka husnuhunna illaa maa malakat yameenuk, wakaanallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'ir raqeebaa
map.33:53: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tadkhuloo buyootan-nabiyyi illaa ay yu'dhana lakum ilaa ta'aamin ghayra naazireena inaahu walaakin idhaa du'eetum fadkhuloo fa'idhaa ta'imtum fantashiroo walaa musta'niseena lihadeeth, inna dhaalikum kaana yu'dhin-nabiyya fayastahyee minkum, wallaahu laa yastahyee minal-haqq, wa'idhaa sa'altumoohunna mataa'an fas'aloohunna miw waraa'i hijaab, dhaalikum atharu liquloobikum waquloobihinn, wamaa kaana lakum an tu'dhoo rasoolallaahi walaa an tankihoo azwaajahoo mim ba'dihee abadaa, inna dhaalikum kaana 'indallaahi 'azeemaa
map.33:54: In tubdoo shay'an aw tukhfoohu fa'innallaaha kaana bikulli shay'in 'aleemaa
map.33:55: Laa junaaha 'alayhinna fee aabaa'ihinna walaa abnaa'ihinna walaa ikhwaanihinna walaa abnaa'i ikhwaanihinna walaa abnaa'i akhawaatihinna walaa nisaa'ihinna walaa maa malakat aymaanuhunn, wattaqeenallaah, innallaaha kaana 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheedaa
map.33:56: Innallaaha wamalaa'ikatahoo yusalloona 'alan-nabiyy, yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo salloo 'alayhi wasallimoo tasleemaa
map.33:57: Innal-ladheena yu'dhoonallaaha warasoolahoo la'anahumullaahu fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati wa'a'adda lahum 'adhaabam muheenaa
map.33:58: Wal-ladheena yu'dhoonal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati bighayri maktasaboo faqadihtamaloo buhtaanaw wa'ithmam mubeenaa
map.33:59: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu qul li'azwaajika wabanaatika wanisaa'il-mu'mineena yudneena 'alayhinna min jalaabeebihinn, dhaalika adnaa ay yu'rafna falaa yu'dhayn, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.33:60: La'il lam yantahil-munaafiqoona wal-ladheena fee quloobihim maraduw wal-murjifoona fil-madeenati lanughriyannaka bihim thumma laa yujaawiroonaka feehaa illaa qaleelaa
map.33:61: Mal'ooneen, aynamaa thuqifoo ukhidhoo waquttiloo taqteelaa
map.33:62: Sunnatallaahi fil-ladheena khalaw min qabl, walan tajida lisunnatillaahi tabdeelaa
map.33:63: Yas'alukan-naasu 'anis-saa'ah, qul innamaa 'ilmuhaa 'indallaah, wamaa yudreeka la'allas-saa'ata takoonu qareebaa
map.33:65: Khaalideena feehaa abadaa, laa yajidoona waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
map.33:66: Yawma tuqallabu wujoohuhum fin-naari yaqooloona yaalaytanaa ata'nallaaha wa'ata'nar-rasoolaa
map.33:67: Waqaaloo rabbanaa innaa ata'naa saadatanaa wakubaraa'anaa fa'adalloonas-sabeelaa
map.33:68: Rabbanaa aatihim di'fayni minal-'adhaabi wal-'anhum la'nan kabeeraa
map.33:69: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa takoonoo kal-ladheena aadhaw moosaa fabarra'ahullaahu mimmaa qaaloo, wakaana 'indallaahi wajeehaa
map.33:70: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha waqooloo qawlan sadeedaa
map.33:71: Yuslih lakum a'maalakum wayaghfir lakum dhunoobakum, wamay yuti'illaaha warasoolahoo faqad faaza fawzan 'azeemaa
map.33:72: Innaa 'aradnal-amaanata 'alas-samaawaati wal-ardi wal-jibaali fa'abayna ay yahmilnahaa wa'ashfaqna minhaa wahamalahal-insaan, innahoo kaana zalooman jahoolaa
map.33:73: Liyu'adhdhiballaahul-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-mushrikeena wal-mushrikaati wayatooballaahu 'alal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaat, wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.34:1: Al-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi walahul-hamdu fil-aakhirah, wahuwal-hakeemul-khabeer
map.34:2: Ya'lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa, wahuwar-raheemul-ghafoor
map.34:3: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta'teenas-saa'ah, qul balaa warabbee lata'tiyannakum 'aalimil-ghaybi laa ya'zubu 'anhu mithqaalu dharratin fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ardi walaa asgharu min dhaalika walaa akbaru illaa fee kitaabim mubeen
map.34:4: Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaat, ulaa'ika lahum maghfiratuw warizqun kareem
map.34:5: Wal-ladheena sa'aw fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabum mir rijzin aleem
map.34:6: Wayaral-ladheena ootul-'ilmal-ladhee unzila ilayka mir rabbika huwal-haqqa wayahdee ilaa siraatil-'azeezil-hameed
map.34:7: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo hal nadullukum 'alaa rajuliy yunabbi'ukum idhaa muzziqtum kulla mumazzaqin innakum lafee khalqin jadeed
map.34:8: Aftaraa 'alallaahi kadhiban am bihee jinnah, balil-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati fil-'adhaabi wad-dalaalil-ba'eed
map.34:9: Afalam yaraw ilaa maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum minas-samaa'i wal-ard, in nasha' nakhsif bihimul-arda aw nusqit 'alayhim kisafam minas-samaa', inna fee dhaalika la'aayatal likulli 'abdim muneeb
map.34:10: Walaqad aataynaa daawooda minnaa fadlaa, yaajibaalu awwibee ma'ahoo wat-tayr, wa'alannaa lahul-hadeed
map.34:11: Ani'mal saabighaatiw waqaddir fis-sardi wa'maloo saalihaa, innee bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.34:12: Walisulaymaanar-reeha ghuduwwuhaa shahruw warawaahuhaa shahr, wa'asalnaa lahoo 'aynal-qitr, waminal-jinni may ya'malu bayna yadayhi bi'idhni rabbih, wamay yazigh minhum 'an amrinaa nudhiqhu min 'adhaabis-sa'eer
map.34:13: Ya'maloona lahoo maa yashaa'u mim mahaareeba watamaatheela wajifaanin kal-jawaabi waqudoorir raasiyaat, i'maloo aala daawooda shukraa, waqaleelum min 'ibaadiyash-shakoor
map.34:14: Falammaa qadaynaa 'alayhil-mawta maa dallahum 'alaa mawtihee illaa daabbatul-ardi ta'kulu minsa'atah, falammaa kharra tabayyanatil-jinnu al law kaanoo ya'lamoonal-ghayba maa labithoo fil-'adhaabil-muheen
map.34:15: Laqad kaana lisaba'in fee maskanihim aayah, jannataani 'ay yameeniw washimaal, kuloo mir rizqi rabbikum washkuroo lah, baldatun tayyibatuw warabbun ghafoor
map.34:16: Fa'a'radoo fa'arsalnaa 'alayhim saylal-'arimi wabaddalnaahum bijannatayhim jannatayni dhawaatay ukulin khamtiw wa'athliw washay'im min sidrin qaleel
map.34:17: Dhaalika jazaynaahum bimaa kafaroo, wahal nujaazee illal-kafoor
map.34:18: Waja'alnaa baynahum wabaynal-qural-latee baaraknaa feehaa quran zaahirataw waqaddarnaa feehas-sayr, seeroo feehaa layaaliya wa'ayyaaman aamineen
map.34:19: Faqaaloo rabbanaa baa'id bayna asfaarinaa wazalamoo anfusahum faja'alnaahum ahaadeetha wamazzaqnaahum kulla mumazzaq, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
map.34:20: Walaqad saddaqa 'alayhim ibleesu zannahoo fattaba'oohu illaa fareeqam minal-mu'mineen
map.34:21: Wamaa kaana lahoo 'alayhim min sultaanin illaa lina'lama may yu'minu bil-aakhirati mimman huwa minhaa fee shakk, warabbuka 'alaa kulli shay'in hafeez
map.34:22: Qulid'ul-ladheena za'amtum min doonillaah, laa yamlikoona mithqaala dharratin fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ardi wamaa lahum feehimaa min shirkiw wamaa lahoo minhum min zaheer
map.34:23: Walaa tanfa'ush-shafaa'atu 'indahoo illaa liman adhina lah, hattaa idhaa fuzzi'a 'an quloobihim qaaloo maadhaa qaala rabbukum, qaalul-haqq, wahuwal-'aliyyul-kabeer
map.34:24: Qul may yarzuqukum minas-samaawaati wal-ard, qulillaahu wa'innaa aw iyyaakum la'alaa hudan aw fee dalaalim mubeen
map.34:25: Qul laa tus'aloona 'ammaa ajramnaa walaa nus'alu 'ammaa ta'maloon
map.34:26: Qul yajma'u baynanaa rabbunaa thumma yaftahu baynanaa bil-haqq, wahuwal-fattaahul-'aleem
map.34:27: Qul arooniyal-ladheena alhaqtum bihee shurakaa'a kallaa, bal huwallaahul-'azeezul-hakeem
map.34:28: Wamaa arsalnaaka illaa kaaffatal lin-naasi basheeraw wanadheeraw walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.34:29: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
map.34:30: Qul lakum mee'aadu yawmil laa tasta'khiroona 'anhu saa'ataw walaa tastaqdimoon
map.34:31: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lan nu'mina bihaadhal-qur'aani walaa bil-ladhee bayna yadayh, walaw taraa idhiz-zaalimoona mawqoofoona 'inda rabbihim, yarji'u ba'duhum ilaa ba'dinil-qawl, yaqoolul-ladheenastud'ifoo lilladheenastakbaroo lawlaa antum lakunnaa mu'mineen
map.34:32: Qaalal-ladheenastakbaroo lilladheenastud'ifoo anahnu sadadnaakum 'anil-hudaa ba'da idh jaa'akum bal kuntum mujrimeen
map.34:33: Waqaalal-ladheenastud'ifoo lilladheenastakbaroo bal makrul-layli wan-nahaari idh ta'muroonanaa an nakfura billaahi wanaj'ala lahoo andaadaa, wa'asarrun-nadaamata lammaa ra'awul-'adhaab, waja'alnal-aghlaala fee a'naaqil-ladheena kafaroo, hal yujzawna illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.34:34: Wamaa arsalnaa fee qaryatim min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
map.34:35: Waqaaloo nahnu aktharu amwaalaw wa'awlaadaw wamaa nahnu bimu'adhdhabeen
map.34:36: Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdiru walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.34:37: Wamaa amwaalukum walaa awlaadukum bil-latee tuqarribukum 'indanaa zulfaa illaa man aamana wa'amila saalihan fa'ulaa'ika lahum jazaa'ud-di'fi bimaa 'amiloo wahum fil-ghurufaati aaminoon
map.34:38: Wal-ladheena yas'awna fee aayaatinaa mu'aajizeena ulaa'ika fil-'adhaabi muhdaroon
map.34:39: Qul inna rabbee yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee wayaqdiru lah, wamaa anfaqtum min shay'in fahuwa yukhlifuh, wahuwa khayrur-raaziqeen
map.34:40: Wayawma yahshuruhum jamee'an thumma yaqoolu lil-malaa'ikati ahaa'ulaa'i iyyaakum kaanoo ya'budoon
map.34:41: Qaaloo subhaanaka anta waliyyunaa min doonihim, bal kaanoo ya'budoonal-jinna aktharuhum bihim mu'minoon
map.34:42: Fal-yawma laa yamliku ba'dukum liba'din naf'aw walaa darraa, wanaqoolu lilladheena zalamoo dhooqoo 'adhaaban-naaril-latee kuntum bihaa tukadhdhiboon
map.34:43: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaaloo maa haadhaa illaa rajuluy yureedu ay yasuddakum 'ammaa kaana ya'budu aabaa'ukum, waqaaloo maa haadhaa illaa ifkum muftaraa, waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
map.34:44: Wamaa aataynaahum min kutubiy yadrusoonahaa wamaa arsalnaa ilayhim qablaka min nadheer
map.34:45: Wakadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim wamaa balaghoo mi'shaara maa aataynaahum fakadhdhaboo rusulee, fakayfa kaana nakeer
map.34:46: Qul innamaa a'izukum biwaahidah, an taqoomoo lillaahi mathnaa wafuraadaa thumma tatafakkaroo, maa bisaahibikum min jinnah, in huwa illaa nadheerul lakum bayna yaday 'adhaabin shadeed
map.34:47: Qul maa sa'altukum min ajrin fahuwa lakum, in ajriya illaa 'alallaah, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
map.34:49: Qul jaa'al-haqqu wamaa yubdi'ul-baatilu wamaa yu'eed
map.34:50: Qul in dalaltu fa'innamaa adillu 'alaa nafsee, wa'inihtadaytu fabimaa yoohee ilayya rabbee, innahoo samee'un qareeb
map.34:51: Walaw taraa idh fazi'oo falaa fawta wa'ukhidhoo mim makaanin qareeb
map.34:52: Waqaaloo aamannaa bih, wa'annaa lahumut-tanaawushu mim makaanim ba'eed
map.34:53: Waqad kafaroo bihee min qabl, wayaqdhifoona bil-ghaybi mim makaanim ba'eed
map.34:54: Waheela baynahum wabayna maa yashtahoona kamaa fu'ila bi'ashyaa'ihim min qabl, innahum kaanoo fee shakkim mureeb
map.35:1: Al-hamdu lillaahi faatiris-samaawaati wal-ardi jaa'ilil-malaa'ikati rusulan ulee ajnihatim mathnaa wathulaatha warubaa', yazeedu fil-khalqi maa yashaa', innallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.35:2: Maa yaftahillaahu lin-naasi mir rahmatin falaa mumsika lahaa, wamaa yumsik falaa mursila lahoo mim ba'dih, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.35:3: Yaa ayyuhan-naasudhkuroo ni'matallaahi 'alaykum, hal min khaaliqin ghayrullaahi yarzuqukum minas-samaa'i wal-ard, laa ilaaha illaa huw, fa'annaa tu'fakoon
map.35:4: Wa'iy yukadhdhibooka faqad kudhdhibat rusulum min qablik, wa'ilallaahi turja'ul-umoor
map.35:5: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu inna wa'dallaahi haqqun falaa taghurrannakumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, walaa yaghurrannakum billaahil-gharoor
map.35:6: Innash-shaytaana lakum 'aduwwun fattakhidhoohu 'aduwwaa, innamaa yad'oo hizbahoo liyakoonoo min ashaabis-sa'eer
map.35:7: Alladheena kafaroo lahum 'adhaabun shadeed, wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun kabeer
map.35:8: Afaman zuyyina lahoo soo'u 'amalihee fara'aahu hasanaa, fa'innallaaha yudillu may yashaa'u wayahdee may yashaa', falaa tadhhab nafsuka 'alayhim hasaraat, innallaaha 'aleemum bimaa yasna'oon
map.35:9: Wallaahul-ladhee arsalar-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fasuqnaahu ilaa baladim mayyitin fa'ahyaynaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa, kadhaalikan-nushoor
map.35:10: Man kaana yureedul-'izzata falillaahil-'izzatu jamee'aa, ilayhi yas'adul-kalimut-tayyibu wal-'amalus-saalihu yarfa'uh, wal-ladheena yamkuroonas-sayyi'aati lahum 'adhaabun shadeed, wamakru ulaa'ika huwa yaboor
map.35:11: Wallaahu khalaqakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma ja'alakum azwaajaa, wamaa tahmilu min unthaa walaa tada'u illaa bi'ilmih, wamaa yu'ammaru mim mu'ammariw walaa yunqasu min 'umurihee illaa fee kitaab, inna dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseer
map.35:12: Wamaa yastawil-bahraan, haadhaa 'adhbun furaatun saa'ighun sharaabuhoo wahaadhaa milhun ujaaj, wamin kullin ta'kuloona lahman tariyyaw watastakhrijoona hilyatan talbasoonahaa, wataral-fulka feehi mawaakhira litabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
map.35:13: Yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layl, wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamara kulluy yajree li'ajalim musammaa, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum lahul-mulk, wal-ladheena tad'oona min doonihee maa yamlikoona min qitmeer
map.35:14: In tad'oohum laa yasma'oo du'aa'akum, walaw sami'oo mastajaaboo lakum, wayawmal-qiyaamati yakfuroona bishirkikum, walaa yunabbi'uka mithlu khabeer
map.35:15: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu antumul-fuqaraa'u ilallaah, wallaahu huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
map.35:16: Iy yasha' yudhhibkum waya'ti bikhalqin jadeed
map.35:18: Walaa taziru waaziratuw wizra ukhraa, wa'in tad'u muthqalatun ilaa himlihaa laa yuhmal minhu shay'uw walaw kaana dhaa qurbaa, innamaa tundhirul-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wa'aqaamus-salaah, waman tazakkaa fa'innamaa yatazakkaa linafsih, wa'ilallaahil-maseer
map.35:22: Wamaa yastawil-ahyaa'u walal-amwaat, innallaaha yusmi'u may yashaa', wamaa anta bimusmi'im man fil-quboor
map.35:24: Innaa arsalnaaka bil-haqqi basheeraw wanadheeraa, wa'im min ummatin illaa khalaa feehaa nadheer
map.35:25: Wa'iy yukadhdhibooka faqad kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim, jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati wabiz-zuburi wabil-kitaabil-muneer
map.35:26: Thumma akhadhtul-ladheena kafaroo fakayfa kaana nakeer
map.35:27: Alam tara annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'aa, fa'akhrajnaa bihee thamaraatim mukhtalifan alwaanuhaa, waminal-jibaali judadum beeduw wahumrum mukhtalifun alwaanuhaa wagharaabeebu sood
map.35:28: Waminan-naasi wad-dawaabbi wal-an'aami mukhtalifun alwaanuhoo kadhaalik, innamaa yakhshallaaha min 'ibaadihil-'ulamaa', innallaaha 'azeezun ghafoor
map.35:29: Innal-ladheena yatloona kitaaballaahi wa'aqaamus-salaata wa'anfaqoo mimmaa razaqnaahum sirraw wa'alaaniyatay yarjoona tijaaratal lan taboor
map.35:30: Liyuwaffiyahum ujoorahum wayazeedahum min fadlih, innahoo ghafoorun shakoor
map.35:31: Wal-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka minal-kitaabi huwal-haqqu musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayh, innallaaha bi'ibaadihee lakhabeerum baseer
map.35:32: Thumma awrathnal-kitaabal-ladheenastafaynaa min 'ibaadinaa, faminhum zaalimul linafsih, waminhum muqtasid, waminhum saabiqum bil-khayraati bi'idhnillaah, dhaalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer
map.35:33: Jannaatu 'adniy yadkhuloonahaa yuhallawna feehaa min asaawira min dhahabiw walu'lu'aa, walibaasuhum feehaa hareer
map.35:34: Waqaalul-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee adhhaba 'annal-hazan, inna rabbanaa laghafoorun shakoor
map.35:35: Al-ladhee ahallanaa daaral-muqaamati min fadlih, laa yamassunaa feehaa nasabuw walaa yamassunaa feehaa lughoob
map.35:36: Wal-ladheena kafaroo lahum naaru jahannam, laa yuqdaa 'alayhim fayamootoo walaa yukhaffafu 'anhum min 'adhaabihaa, kadhaalika najzee kulla kafoor
map.35:37: Wahum yastarikhoona feehaa, rabbanaa akhrijnaa na'mal saalihan ghayral-ladhee kunnaa na'mal, awalam nu'ammirkum maa yatadhakkaru feehi man tadhakkara wajaa'akumun-nadheer, fadhooqoo famaa liz-zaalimeena min naseer
map.35:39: Huwal-ladhee ja'alakum khalaa'ifa fil-ard, faman kafara fa'alayhi kufruh, walaa yazeedul-kaafireena kufruhum 'inda rabbihim illaa maqtaa, walaa yazeedul-kaafireena kufruhum illaa khasaaraa
map.35:40: Qul ara'aytum shurakaa'akumul-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaah, aroonee maadhaa khalaqoo minal-ardi am lahum shirkun fis-samaawaat, am aataynaahum kitaaban fahum 'alaa bayyinatim minh, bal iy ya'iduz-zaalimoona ba'duhum ba'dan illaa ghurooraa
map.35:41: Innallaaha yumsikus-samaawaati wal-arda an tazoolaa, wala'in zaalataa in amsakahumaa min ahadim mim ba'dih, innahoo kaana haleeman ghafooraa
map.35:42: Wa'aqsamoo billaahi jahda aymaanihim la'in jaa'ahum nadheerul layakoonunna ahdaa min ihdal-umam, falammaa jaa'ahum nadheerum maa zaadahum illaa nufooraa
map.35:43: Istikbaaran fil-ardi wamakras-sayyi', walaa yaheequl-makrus-sayyi'u illaa bi'ahlih, fahal yanzuroona illaa sunnatal-awwaleen, falan tajida lisunnatillaahi tabdeelaa, walan tajida lisunnatillaahi tahweelaa
map.35:44: Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim wakaanoo ashadda minhum quwwah, wamaa kaanallaahu liyu'jizahoo min shay'in fis-samaawaati walaa fil-ard, innahoo kaana 'aleeman qadeeraa
map.35:45: Walaw yu'aakhidhullaahun-naasa bimaa kasaboo maa taraka 'alaa zahrihaa min daabbatiw walaakiy yu'akhkhiruhum ilaa ajalim musammaa, fa'idhaa jaa'a ajaluhum fa'innallaaha kaana bi'ibaadihee baseeraa
map.36:6: Litundhira qawmam maa undhira aabaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon
map.36:7: Laqad haqqal-qawlu 'alaa aktharihim fahum laa yu'minoon
map.36:8: Innaa ja'alnaa fee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal-adhqaani fahum muqmahoon
map.36:9: Waja'alnaa mim bayni aydeehim saddaw wamin khalfihim saddan fa'aghshaynaahum fahum laa yubsiroon
map.36:10: Wasawaa'un 'alayhim a'andhartahum am lam tundhirhum laa yu'minoon
map.36:11: Innamaa tundhiru manittaba'adh-dhikra wakhashiyar-rahmaana bil-ghayb, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratiw wa'ajrin kareem
map.36:12: Innaa nahnu nuhyil-mawtaa wanaktubu maa qaddamoo wa'aathaarahum, wakulla shay'in ahsaynaahu fee imaamim mubeen
map.36:13: Wadrib lahum mathalan ashaabal-qaryah, idh jaa'ahal-mursaloon
map.36:14: Idh arsalnaa ilayhimuthnayni fakadhdhaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bithaalithin faqaaloo innaa ilaykum mursaloon
map.36:15: Qaaloo maa antum illaa basharum mithlunaa wamaa anzalar-rahmaanu min shay'in in antum illaa takdhiboon
map.36:16: Qaaloo rabbunaa ya'lamu innaa ilaykum lamursaloon
map.36:18: Qaaloo innaa tatayyarnaa bikum, la'il lam tantahoo lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minnaa 'adhaabun aleem
map.36:19: Qaaloo taa'irukum ma'akum, a'in dhukkirtum, bal antum qawmum musrifoon
map.36:20: Wajaa'a min aqsal-madeenati rajuluy yas'aa qaala yaaqawmittabi'ul-mursaleen
map.36:21: Ittabi'oo mal laa yas'alukum ajraw wahum muhtadoon
map.36:22: Wamaa liya laa a'budul-ladhee fataranee wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.36:23: A'attakhidhu min doonihee aalihatan iy yuridnir-rahmaanu bidurril laa tughni 'annee shafaa'atuhum shay'aw walaa yunqidhoon
map.36:27: Bimaa ghafara lee rabbee waja'alanee minal-mukrameen
map.36:28: Wamaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaa'i wamaa kunnaa munzileen
map.36:29: In kaanat illaa sayhataw waahidatan fa'idhaa hum khaamidoon
map.36:30: Yaahasratan 'alal-'ibaad, maa ya'teehim mir rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.36:31: Alam yaraw kam ahlaknaa qablahum minal-qurooni annahum ilayhim laa yarji'oon
map.36:32: Wa'in kullul lammaa jamee'ul ladaynaa muhdaroon
map.36:33: Wa'aayatul lahumul-ardul-maytah, ahyaynaahaa wa'akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu ya'kuloon
map.36:34: Waja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheeliw wa'a'naabiw wafajjarnaa feehaa minal-'uyoon
map.36:35: Liya'kuloo min thamarihee wamaa 'amilathu aydeehim, afalaa yashkuroon
map.36:36: Subhaanal-ladhee khalaqal-azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul-ardu wamin anfusihim wamimmaa laa ya'lamoon
map.36:37: Wa'aayatul lahumul-layl, naslakhu minhun-nahaara fa'idhaa hum muzlimoon
map.36:38: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa, dhaalika taqdeerul-'azeezil-'aleem
map.36:40: Lash-shamsu yambaghee lahaa an tudrikal-qamara walal-laylu saabiqun-nahaar, wakullun fee falakiy yasbahoon
map.36:41: Wa'aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa dhurriyyatahum fil-fulkil-mashhoon
map.36:42: Wakhalaqnaa lahum mim mithlihee maa yarkaboon
map.36:43: Wa'in nasha' nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum walaa hum yunqadhoon
map.36:44: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wamataa'an ilaa heen
map.36:45: Wa'idhaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa bayna aydeekum wamaa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
map.36:46: Wamaa ta'teehim min aayatim min aayaati rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
map.36:47: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumullaahu qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo anut'imu mal law yashaa'ullaahu at'amah, in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
map.36:48: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
map.36:49: Maa yanzuroona illaa sayhataw waahidatan ta'khudhuhum wahum yakhissimoon
map.36:50: Falaa yastatee'oona tawsiyataw walaa ilaa ahlihim yarji'oon
map.36:51: Wanufikha fis-soori fa'idhaa hum minal-ajdaathi ilaa rabbihim yansiloon
map.36:52: Qaaloo yaawaylanaa mam ba'athanaa mim marqadinaa... haadhaa maa wa'adar-rahmaanu wasadaqal-mursaloon
map.36:53: In kaanat illaa sayhataw waahidatan fa'idhaa hum jamee'ul ladaynaa muhdaroon
map.36:54: Fal-yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shay'aw walaa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.36:57: Lahum feehaa faakihatuw walahum maa yadda'oon
map.36:60: Alam a'had ilaykum yaabanee aadama al laa ta'budush-shaytaan, innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
map.36:62: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeraa, afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
map.36:65: Al-yawma nakhtimu 'alaa afwaahihim watukallimunaa aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.36:66: Walaw nashaa'u latamasnaa 'alaa a'yunihim fastabaqus-siraata fa'annaa yubsiroon
map.36:67: Walaw nashaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famastataa'oo mudiyyaw walaa yarji'oon
map.36:68: Waman nu'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq, afalaa ya'qiloon
map.36:69: Wamaa 'allamnaahush-shi'ra wamaa yambaghee lah, in huwa illaa dhikruw waqur'aanum mubeen
map.36:71: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aydeenaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
map.36:72: Wadhallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum waminhaa ya'kuloon
map.36:73: Walahum feehaa manaafi'u wamashaarib, afalaa yashkuroon
map.36:74: Wattakhadhoo min doonillaahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
map.36:75: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wahum lahum jundum muhdaroon
map.36:76: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum, innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wamaa yu'linoon
map.36:77: Awalam yaral-insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa'idhaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
map.36:78: Wadaraba lanaa mathalaw wanasiya khalqah, qaala may yuhyil-'izaama wahiya rameem
map.36:79: Qul yuhyeehal-ladhee ansha'ahaa awwala marrah, wahuwa bikulli khalqin 'aleem
map.36:80: Al-ladhee ja'ala lakum minash-shajaril-akhdari naaran fa'idhaa antum minhu tooqidoon
map.36:81: Awalaysal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda biqaadirin 'alaa ay yakhluqa mithlahum, balaa wahuwal-khallaaqul-'aleem
map.36:82: Innamaa amruhoo idhaa araada shay'aa, ay yaqoola lahoo kun fayakoon
map.36:83: Fasubhaanal-ladhee biyadihee malakootu kulli shay'iw wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.37:8: Laa yassamma'oona ilal-mala'il-a'laa wayuqdhafoona min kulli jaanib
map.37:10: Illaa man khatifal-khatfata fa'atba'ahoo shihaabun thaaqib
map.37:11: Fastaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnaa, innaa khalaqnaahum min teenil laazib
map.37:15: Waqaaloo in haadhaa illaa sihrum mubeen
map.37:16: A'idhaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaabaw wa'izaaman a'innaa lamab'oothoon
map.37:19: Fa'innamaa hiya zajratuw waahidatun fa'idhaa hum yanzuroon
map.37:22: Uhshurul-ladheena zalamoo wa'azwaajahum wamaa kaanoo ya'budoon
map.37:30: Wamaa kaana lanaa 'alaykum min sultaan, bal kuntum qawman taagheen
map.37:35: Innahum kaanoo idhaa qeela lahum laa ilaaha illallaahu yastakbiroon
map.37:36: Wayaqooloona a'innaa lataarikoo aalihatinaa lishaa'irim majnoon
map.37:39: Wamaa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.37:47: Laa feehaa ghawluw walaa hum 'anhaa yunzafoon
map.37:51: Qaala qaa'ilum minhum innee kaana lee qareen
map.37:53: A'idhaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaabaw wa'izaaman a'innaa lamadeenoon
map.37:67: Thumma inna lahum 'alayhaa lashawbam min hameem
map.37:85: Idh qaala li'abeehi waqawmihee maadhaa ta'budoon
map.37:91: Faraagha ilaa aalihatihim faqaala alaa ta'kuloon
map.37:99: Waqaala innee dhaahibun ilaa rabbee sayahdeen
map.37:102: Falammaa balagha ma'ahus-sa'ya qaala yaabunayya innee araa fil-manaami annee adhbahuka fanzur maadhaa taraa, qaala yaa abatif'al maa tu'mar, satajidunee in shaa'allaahu minas-saabireen
map.37:113: Wabaaraknaa 'alayhi wa'alaa ishaaq, wamin dhurriyyatihimaa muhsinuw wazaalimul linafsihee mubeen
map.37:144: Lalabitha fee batnihee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
map.37:147: Wa'arsalnaahu ilaa mi'ati alfin aw yazeedoon
map.37:158: Waja'aloo baynahoo wabaynal-jinnati nasabaa, walaqad 'alimatil-jinnatu innahum lamuhdaroon
map.37:164: Wamaa minnaa illaa lahoo maqaamum ma'loom
map.38:3: Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw walaata heena manaas
map.38:4: Wa'ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirum minhum, waqaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa saahirun kadhdhaab
map.38:5: Aja'alal-aalihata ilaahaw waahidaa, inna haadhaa lashay'un 'ujaab
map.38:6: Wantalaqal-mala'u minhum animshoo wasbiroo 'alaa aalihatikum, inna haadhaa lashay'uy yuraad
map.38:7: Maa sami'naa bihaadhaa fil-millatil-aakhirah, in haadhaa illakhtilaaq
map.38:8: A'unzila 'alayhidh-dhikru mim bayninaa, bal hum fee shakkim min dhikree, bal lammaa yadhooqoo 'adhaab
map.38:10: Am lahum mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, falyartaqoo fil-asbaab
map.38:12: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wa'aaduw wafir'awnu dhul-awtaad
map.38:13: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootiw wa'ashaabu l'aykah, ulaa'ikal-ahzaab
map.38:15: Wamaa yanzuru haa'ulaa'i illaa sayhataw waahidatam maa lahaa min fawaaq
map.38:16: Waqaaloo rabbanaa 'ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla yawmil-hisaab
map.38:17: Isbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wadhkur 'abdanaa daawooda dhal-ayd, innahoo awwaab
map.38:18: Innaa sakhkharnal-jibaala ma'ahoo yusabbihna bil-'ashiyyi wal-ishraaq
map.38:22: Idh dakhaloo 'alaa daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo laa takhaf, khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa 'alaa ba'din fahkum baynanaa bil-haqqi walaa tushtit wahdinaa ilaa sawaa'is-siraat
map.38:23: Inna haadhaa akhee, lahoo tis'uw watis'oona na'jataw waliya na'jatuw waahidah, faqaala akfilneehaa wa'azzanee fil-khitaab
map.38:24: Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu'aali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajih, wa'inna katheeram minal-khulataa'i layabghee ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din illal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati waqaleelum maa hum, wazanna daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghfara rabbahoo wakharra raaki'aw wa'anaab
map.38:25: Faghafarnaa lahoo dhaalik, wa'inna lahoo 'indanaa lazulfaa wahusna ma'aab
map.38:26: Yaadaawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil-ardi fahkum baynan-naasi bil-haqqi walaa tattabi'il-hawaa fayudillaka 'an sabeelillaah, innal-ladheena yadilloona 'an sabeelillaahi lahum 'adhaabun shadeedum bimaa nasoo yawmal-hisaab
map.38:27: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa baatilaa, dhaalika zannul-ladheena kafaroo fawaylul lilladheena kafaroo minan-naar
map.38:28: Am naj'alul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati kal-mufsideena fil-ard, am naj'alul-muttaqeena kal-fujjaar
map.38:29: Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilayka mubaarakul liyaddabbaroo aayaatihee waliyatadhakkara ulul-albaab
map.38:30: Wawahabnaa lidaawooda sulaymaan, ni'mal-'abd, innahoo awwaab
map.38:32: Faqaala innee ahbabtu hubbal-khayri 'an dhikri rabbee, hattaa tawaarat bil-hijaab
map.38:34: Walaqad fatannaa sulaymaana wa'alqaynaa 'alaa kursiyyihee jasadan thumma anaab
map.38:35: Qaala rabbighfir lee wahab lee mulkal laa yambaghee li'ahadim mim ba'dee, innaka antal-wahhaab
map.38:36: Fasakhkharnaa lahur-reeha tajree bi'amrihee rukhaa'an haythu asaab
map.38:39: Haadhaa 'ataa'unaa famnun aw amsik bighayri hisaab
map.38:41: Wadhkur 'abdanaa ayyoob, idh naadaa rabbahoo annee massaniyash-shaytaanu binusbiw wa'adhaab
map.38:42: Urkud birijlik, haadhaa mughtasalum baariduw washaraab
map.38:43: Wawahabnaa lahoo ahlahoo wamithlahum ma'ahum rahmatam minnaa wadhikraa li'ulil-albaab
map.38:44: Wakhudh biyadika dighthan fadrib bihee walaa tahnath, innaa wajadnaahu saabiraa, ni'mal-'abd, innahoo awwaab
map.38:45: Wadhkur 'ibaadanaa ibraaheema wa'ishaaqa waya'qooba ulil-aydee wal-absaar
map.38:48: Wadhkur ismaa'eela wal-yasa'a wadhal-kifl, wakullum minal-akhyaar
map.38:49: Haadhaa dhikr, wa'inna lil-muttaqeena lahusna ma'aab
map.38:51: Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin katheeratiw washaraab
map.38:54: Inna haadhaa larizqunaa maa lahoo min nafaad
map.38:59: Haadhaa fawjum muqtahimum ma'akum, laa marhabam bihim, innahum saalun-naar
map.38:60: Qaaloo bal antum laa marhabam bikum, antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa, fabi'sal-qaraar
map.38:61: Qaaloo rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haadhaa fazidhu 'adhaaban di'fan fin-naar
map.38:62: Waqaaloo maa lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal-ashraar
map.38:65: Qul innamaa ana mundhir, wamaa min ilaahin illallaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
map.38:69: Maa kaana liya min 'ilmim bil-mala'il-a'laa idh yakhtasimoon
map.38:70: Iy yoohaa ilayya illaa annamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
map.38:71: Idh qaala rabbuka lil-malaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min teen
map.38:72: Fa'idhaa sawwaytuhoo wanafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen
map.38:75: Qaala yaa ibleesu maa mana'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadayy, astakbarta am kunta minal-'aaleen
map.38:76: Qaala ana khayrum minhu khalaqtanee min naariw wakhalaqtahoo min teen
map.38:79: Qaala rabbi fa'anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
map.38:85: La'amla'anna jahannama minka wamimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een
map.38:86: Qul maa as'alukum 'alayhi min ajriw wamaa ana minal-mutakallifeen
map.39:2: Innaa anzalnaa ilaykal-kitaaba bil-haqqi fa'budillaaha mukhlisal lahud-deen
map.39:3: Alaa lillaahid-deenul-khaalis, wal-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa', maa na'buduhum illaa liyuqarriboonaa ilallaahi zulfaa, innallaaha yahkumu baynahum fee maa hum feehi yakhtalifoon, innallaaha laa yahdee man huwa kaadhibun kaffaar
map.39:4: Law araadallaahu ay yattakhidha waladal lastafaa mimmaa yakhluqu maa yashaa'u subhaanah, huwallaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
map.39:5: Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqq, yukawwirul-layla 'alan-nahaari wayukawwirun-nahaara 'alal-layli wasakhkharash-shamsa wal-qamar, kulluy yajree li'ajalim musammaa, alaa huwal-'azeezul-ghaffaar
map.39:6: Khalaqakum min nafsiw waahidatin thumma ja'ala minhaa zawjahaa wa'anzala lakum minal-an'aami thamaaniyata azwaaj, yakhluqukum fee butooni ummahaatikum khalqam mim ba'di khalqin fee zulumaatin thalaath, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum lahul-mulk, laa ilaaha illaa huw, fa'annaa tusrafoon
map.39:7: In takfuroo fa'innallaaha ghaniyyun 'ankum, walaa yardaa li'ibaadihil-kufr, wa'in tashkuroo yardahu lakum, walaa taziru waaziratuw wizra ukhraa, thumma ilaa rabbikum marji'ukum fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon, innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.39:8: Wa'idhaa massal-insaana durrun da'aa rabbahoo muneeban ilayhi thumma idhaa khawwalahoo ni'matam minhu nasiya maa kaana yad'oo ilayhi min qablu waja'ala lillaahi andaadal liyudilla 'an sabeelih, qul tamatta' bikufrika qaleelaa, innaka min ashaabin-naar
map.39:9: Amman huwa qaanitun aanaa'al-layli saajidaw waqaa'imay yahdharul-aakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbih, qul hal yastawil-ladheena ya'lamoona wal-ladheena laa ya'lamoon, innamaa yatadhakkaru ulul-albaab
map.39:10: Qul yaa'ibaadil-ladheena aamanuttaqoo rabbakum, lilladheena ahsanoo fee haadhihid-dunyaa hasanah, wa'ardullaahi waasi'ah, innamaa yuwaffas-saabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisaab
map.39:11: Qul innee umirtu an a'budallaaha mukhlisal lahud-deen
map.39:13: Qul innee akhaafu in 'asaytu rabbee 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
map.39:15: Fa'budoo maa shi'tum min doonih, qul innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa'ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamah, alaa dhaalika huwal-khusraanul-mubeen
map.39:16: Lahum min fawqihim zulalum minan-naari wamin tahtihim zulal, dhaalika yukhawwifullaahu bihee 'ibaadah, yaa'ibaadi fattaqoon
map.39:17: Wal-ladheenajtanabut-taaghoota ay ya'budoohaa wa'anaaboo ilallaahi lahumul-bushraa, fabashshir 'ibaad
map.39:18: Al-ladheena yastami'oonal-qawla fayattabi'oona ahsanah, ulaa'ikal-ladheena hadaahumullaahu wa'ulaa'ika hum ulul-albaab
map.39:19: Afaman haqqa 'alayhi kalimatul-'adhaab, afa'anta tunqidhu man fin-naar
map.39:20: Laakinil-ladheenattaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafum min fawqihaa ghurafum mabniyyatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, wa'dallaah, laa yukhlifullaahul-mee'aad
map.39:21: Alam tara annallaaha anzala minas-samaa'i maa'an fasalakahoo yanaabee'a fil-ardi thumma yukhriju bihee zar'am mukhtalifan alwaanuhoo thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarran thumma yaj'aluhoo hutaamaa, inna fee dhaalika ladhikraa li'ulil-albaab
map.39:22: Afaman sharahallaahu sadrahoo lil-islaami fahuwa 'alaa noorim mir rabbih, fawaylul lil-qaasiyati quloobuhum min dhikrillaah, ulaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen
map.39:23: Allaahu nazzala ahsanal-hadeethi kitaabam mutashaabiham mathaaniya taqsha'irru minhu juloodul-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum, thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ilaa dhikrillaah, dhaalika hudallaahi yahdee bihee may yashaa', wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
map.39:24: Afamay yattaqee biwajhihee soo'al-'adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamah, waqeela liz-zaalimeena dhooqoo maa kuntum taksiboon
map.39:25: Kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fa'ataahumul-'adhaabu min haythu laa yash'uroon
map.39:26: Fa'adhaaqahumullaahul-khizya fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wala'adhaabul-aakhirati akbar, law kaanoo ya'lamoon
map.39:27: Walaqad darabnaa lin-naasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalil la'allahum yatadhakkaroon
map.39:29: Daraballaahu mathalar rajulan feehi shurakaa'u mutashaakisoona warajulan salamal lirajulin hal yastawiyaani mathalaa, al-hamdu lillaah, bal aktharuhum laa ya'lamoon
map.39:32: Faman azlamu mimman kadhaba 'alallaahi wakadhdhaba bis-sidqi idh jaa'ah, alaysa fee jahannama mathwal lil-kaafireen
map.39:33: Wal-ladhee jaa'a bis-sidqi wasaddaqa bihee ulaa'ika humul-muttaqoon
map.39:34: Lahum maa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim, dhaalika jazaa'ul-muhsineen
map.39:35: Liyukaffirallaahu 'anhum aswa'al-ladhee 'amiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum bi'ahsanil-ladhee kaanoo ya'maloon
map.39:36: Alaysallaahu bikaafin 'abdah, wayukhawwifoonaka bil-ladheena min doonih, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
map.39:37: Wamay yahdillaahu famaa lahoo mim mudill, alaysallaahu bi'azeezin dhintiqaam
map.39:38: Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunnallaah, qul afara'aytum maa tad'oona min doonillaahi in araadaniyallaahu bidurrin hal hunna kaashifaatu durrihee aw araadanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikaatu rahmatih, qul hasbiyallaah, 'alayhi yatawakkalul-mutawakkiloon
map.39:39: Qul yaaqawmi'maloo 'alaa makaanatikum innee 'aamil, fasawfa ta'lamoon
map.39:41: Innaa anzalnaa 'alaykal-kitaaba lin-naasi bil-haqq, famanihtadaa falinafsih, waman dalla fa'innamaa yadillu 'alayhaa, wamaa anta 'alayhim biwakeel
map.39:42: Allaahu yatawaffal-anfusa heena mawtihaa wal-latee lam tamut fee manaamihaa, fayumsikul-latee qadaa 'alayhal-mawta wayursilul-ukhraa ilaa ajalim musammaa, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.39:43: Amittakhadhoo min doonillaahi shufa'aa', qul awalaw kaanoo laa yamlikoona shay'aw walaa ya'qiloon
map.39:44: Qul lillaahish-shafaa'atu jamee'aa, lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, thumma ilayhi turja'oon
map.39:45: Wa'idhaa dhukirallaahu wahdahushma'azzat quloobul-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirah, wa'idhaa dhukiral-ladheena min doonihee idhaa hum yastabshiroon
map.39:46: Qulillaahumma faatiras-samaawaati wal-ardi 'aalimal-ghaybi wash-shahaadati anta tahkumu bayna 'ibaadika fee maa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
map.39:47: Walaw anna lilladheena zalamoo maa fil-ardi jamee'aw wamithlahoo ma'ahoo laftadaw bihee min soo'il-'adhaabi yawmal-qiyaamah, wabadaa lahum minallaahi maa lam yakoonoo yahtasiboon
map.39:48: Wabadaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.39:49: Fa'idhaa massal-insaana durrun da'aanaa, thumma idhaa khawwalnaahu ni'matam minnaa qaala innamaa ooteetuhoo 'alaa 'ilm, bal hiya fitnatuw walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.39:50: Qad qaalahal-ladheena min qablihim famaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.39:51: Fa'asaabahum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo, wal-ladheena zalamoo min haa'ulaa'i sayuseebuhum sayyi'aatu maa kasaboo wamaa hum bimu'jizeen
map.39:52: Awalam ya'lamoo annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yu'minoon
map.39:53: Qul yaa'ibaadiyal-ladheena asrafoo 'alaa anfusihim laa taqnatoo mir rahmatillaah, innallaaha yaghfirudh-dhunooba jamee'aa, innahoo huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
map.39:54: Wa'aneeboo ilaa rabbikum wa'aslimoo lahoo min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul-'adhaabu thumma laa tunsaroon
map.39:55: Wattabi'oo ahsana maa unzila ilaykum mir rabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiyakumul-'adhaabu baghtataw wa'antum laa tash'uroon
map.39:56: An taqoola nafsuy yaahasrataa 'alaa maa farrattu fee jambillaahi wa'in kuntu laminas-saakhireen
map.39:57: Aw taqoola law annallaaha hadaanee lakuntu minal-muttaqeen
map.39:58: Aw taqoola heena taral-'adhaaba law anna lee karratan fa'akoona minal-muhsineen
map.39:59: Balaa qad jaa'atka aayaatee fakadhdhabta bihaa wastakbarta wakunta minal-kaafireen
map.39:60: Wayawmal-qiyaamati taral-ladheena kadhaboo 'alallaahi wujoohuhum muswaddah, alaysa fee jahannama mathwal lil-mutakabbireen
map.39:61: Wayunajjillaahul-ladheenattaqaw bimafaazatihim, laa yamassuhumus-soo'u walaa hum yahzanoon
map.39:62: Allaahu khaaliqu kulli shay'iw wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'iw wakeel
map.39:63: Lahoo maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ard, wal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaatillaahi ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.39:65: Walaqad oohiya ilayka wa'ilal-ladheena min qablik, la'in ashrakta layahbatanna 'amaluka walatakoonanna minal-khaasireen
map.39:67: Wamaa qadarullaaha haqqa qadrih, wal-ardu jamee'an qabdatuhoo yawmal-qiyaamati was-samaawaatu matwiyyaatum biyameenih, subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.39:68: Wanufikha fis-soori fasa'iqa man fis-samaawaati waman fil-ardi illaa man shaa'allaah, thumma nufikha feehi ukhraa fa'idhaa hum qiyaamuy yanzuroon
map.39:69: Wa'ashraqatil-ardu binoori rabbihaa wawudi'al-kitaabu wajee'a bin-nabiyyeena wash-shuhadaa'i waqudiya baynahum bil-haqqi wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.39:70: Wawuffiyat kullu nafsim maa 'amilat wahuwa a'lamu bimaa yaf'aloon
map.39:71: Waseeqal-ladheena kafaroo ilaa jahannama zumaraa, hattaa idhaa jaa'oohaa futihat abwaabuhaa waqaala lahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum rusulum minkum yatloona 'alaykum aayaati rabbikum wayundhiroonakum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa, qaaloo balaa walaakin haqqat kalimatul-'adhaabi 'alal-kaafireen
map.39:72: Qeeladkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa, fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
map.39:73: Waseeqal-ladheenattaqaw rabbahum ilal-jannati zumaraa, hattaa idhaa jaa'oohaa wafutihat abwaabuhaa waqaala lahum khazanatuhaa salaamun 'alaykum tibtum fadkhuloohaa khaalideen
map.39:74: Waqaalul-hamdu lillaahil-ladhee sadaqanaa wa'dahoo wa'awrathanal-arda natabawwa'u minal-jannati haythu nashaa', fani'ma ajrul-'aamileen
