map.39:75: Wataral-malaa'ikata haaffeena min hawlil-'arshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim, waqudiya baynahum bil-haqqi waqeelal-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.40:3: Ghaafiridh-dhambi waqaabilit-tawbi shadeedil-'iqaabi dhit-tawl, laa ilaaha illaa huw, ilayhil-maseer
map.40:4: Maa yujaadilu fee aayaatillaahi illal-ladheena kafaroo falaa yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil-bilaad
map.40:5: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wal-ahzaabu mim ba'dihim, wahammat kullu ummatim birasoolihim liya'khudhoohu wajaadaloo bil-baatili liyudhidoo bihil-haqqa fa'akhadhtuhum, fakayfa kaana 'iqaab
map.40:6: Wakadhaalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika 'alal-ladheena kafaroo annahum ashaabun-naar
map.40:7: Alladheena yahmiloonal-'arsha waman hawlahoo yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayu'minoona bihee wayastaghfiroona lilladheena aamanoo, rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shay'ir rahmataw wa'ilman faghfir lilladheena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka waqihim 'adhaabal-jaheem
map.40:8: Rabbanaa wa'adkhilhum jannaati 'adninil-latee wa'attahum waman salaha min aabaa'ihim wa'azwaajihim wadhurriyyaatihim, innaka antal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.40:9: Waqihimus-sayyi'aat, waman taqis-sayyi'aati yawma'idhin faqad rahimtah, wadhaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem
map.40:10: Innal-ladheena kafaroo yunaadawna lamaqtullaahi akbaru mim maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'awna ilal-eemaani fatakfuroon
map.40:11: Qaaloo rabbanaa amattanathnatayni wa'ahyaytanathnatayni fa'tarafnaa bidhunoobinaa fahal ilaa khuroojim min sabeel
map.40:12: Dhaalikum bi'annahoo idhaa du'iyallaahu wahdahoo kafartum, wa'iy yushrak bihee tu'minoo, fal-hukmu lillaahil-'aliyyil-kabeer
map.40:13: Huwal-ladhee yureekum aayaatihee wayunazzilu lakum minas-samaa'i rizqaa, wamaa yatadhakkaru illaa may yuneeb
map.40:15: Rafee'ud-darajaati dhul-'arsh, yulqir-rooha min amrihee 'alaa may yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee liyundhira yawmat-talaaq
map.40:16: Yawma hum baarizoon, laa yakhfaa 'alallaahi minhum shay', limanil-mulkul-yawm, lillaahil-waahidil-qahhaar
map.40:17: Al-yawma tujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat, laa zulmal-yawm, innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
map.40:18: Wa'andhirhum yawmal-aazifati idhil-quloobu ladal-hanaajiri kaazimeen, maa liz-zaalimeena min hameemiw walaa shafee'iy yutaa'
map.40:20: Wallaahu yaqdee bil-haqq, wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonihee laa yaqdoona bishay', innallaaha huwas-samee'ul-baseer
map.40:21: Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena kaanoo min qablihim, kaanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwataw wa'aathaaran fil-ardi fa'akhadhahumullaahu bidhunoobihim, wamaa kaana lahum minallaahi miw waaq
map.40:22: Dhaalika bi'annahum kaanat ta'teehim rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati fakafaroo fa'akhadhahumullaah, innahoo qawiyyun shadeedul-'iqaab
map.40:23: Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa wasultaanim mubeen
map.40:24: Ilaa fir'awna wahaamaana waqaaroona faqaaloo saahirun kadhdhaab
map.40:25: Falammaa jaa'ahum bil-haqqi min 'indinaa qaaluqtuloo abnaa'al-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahoo wastahyoo nisaa'ahum, wamaa kaydul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
map.40:26: Waqaala fir'awnu dharoonee aqtul moosaa walyad'u rabbah, innee akhaafu ay yubaddila deenakum aw ay yuzhira fil-ardil-fasaad
map.40:27: Waqaala moosaa innee 'udhtu birabbee warabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril laa yu'minu biyawmil-hisaab
map.40:28: Waqaala rajulum mu'min, min aali fir'awna yaktumu eemaanahoo ataqtuloona rajulan ay yaqoola rabbiyallaahu waqad jaa'akum bil-bayyinaati mir rabbikum, wa'iy yaku kaadhiban fa'alayhi kadhibuh, wa'iy yaku saadiqay yusibkum ba'dul-ladhee ya'idukum, innallaaha laa yahdee man huwa musrifun kadhdhaab
map.40:29: Yaaqawmi lakumul-mulkul-yawma zaahireena fil-ard, famay yansurunaa mim ba'sillaahi in jaa'anaa, qaala fir'awnu maa ureekum illaa maa araa wamaa ahdeekum illaa sabeelar-rashaad
map.40:30: Waqaalal-ladhee aamana yaaqawmi innee akhaafu 'alaykum mithla yawmil-ahzaab
map.40:31: Mithla da'bi qawmi noohiw wa'aadiw wathamooda wal-ladheena mim ba'dihim, wamallaahu yureedu zulmal lil-'ibaad
map.40:33: Yawma tuwalloona mudbireen, maa lakum minallaahi min 'aasim, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min haad
map.40:34: Walaqad jaa'akum yoosufu min qablu bil-bayyinaati famaa ziltum fee shakkim mimmaa jaa'akum bih, hattaa idhaa halaka qultum lay yab'athallaahu mim ba'dihee rasoolaa, kadhaalika yudillullaahu man huwa musrifum murtaab
map.40:35: Al-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatillaahi bighayri sultaanin ataahum, kabura maqtan 'indallaahi wa'indal-ladheena aamanoo, kadhaalika yatba'ullaahu 'alaa kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbaar
map.40:36: Waqaala fir'awnu yaahaamaanubni lee sarhal la'allee ablughul-asbaab
map.40:37: Asbaabas-samaawaati fa'attali'a ilaa ilaahi moosaa wa'innee la'azunnuhoo kaadhibaa, wakadhaalika zuyyina lifir'awna soo'u 'amalihee wasudda 'anis-sabeel, wamaa kaydu fir'awna illaa fee tabaab
map.40:39: Yaaqawmi innamaa haadhihil-hayaatud-dunyaa mataa', wa'innal-aakhirata hiya daarul-qaraar
map.40:40: Man 'amila sayyi'atan falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa, waman 'amila saaliham min dhakarin aw unthaa wahuwa mu'minun fa'ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighayri hisaab
map.40:41: Wayaaqawmi maa lee ad'ookum ilan-najaati watad'oonanee ilan-naar
map.40:42: Tad'oonanee li'akfura billaahi wa'ushrika bihee maa laysa lee bihee 'ilmuw wa'ana ad'ookum ilal-'azeezil-ghaffaar
map.40:43: Laa jarama annamaa tad'oonanee ilayhi laysa lahoo da'watun fid-dunyaa walaa fil-aakhirati wa'anna maraddanaa ilallaahi wa'annal-musrifeena hum ashaabun-naar
map.40:44: Fasatadhkuroona maa aqoolu lakum, wa'ufawwidu amree ilallaah, innallaaha baseerum bil-'ibaad
map.40:45: Fawaqaahullaahu sayyi'aati maa makaroo wahaaqa bi'aali fir'awna soo'ul-'adhaab
map.40:46: An-naaru yu'radoona 'alayhaa ghuduwwaw wa'ashiyyaa, wayawma taqoomus-saa'ah, adkhiloo aala fir'awna ashaddal-'adhaab
map.40:47: Wa'idh yatahaajjoona fin-naari fayaqoolud-du'afaa'u lilladheenastakbaroo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona 'annaa naseebam minan-naar
map.40:48: Qaalal-ladheenastakbaroo innaa kullun feehaa innallaaha qad hakama baynal-'ibaad
map.40:49: Waqaalal-ladheena fin-naari likhazanati jahannamad'oo rabbakum yukhaffif 'annaa yawmam minal-'adhaab
map.40:50: Qaaloo awalam taku ta'teekum rusulukum bil-bayyinaat, qaaloo balaa, qaaloo fad'oo, wamaa du'aa'ul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
map.40:51: Innaa lanansuru rusulanaa wal-ladheena aamanoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wayawma yaqoomul-ashhaad
map.40:52: Yawma laa yanfa'uz-zaalimeena ma'dhiratuhum walahumul-la'natu walahum soo'ud-daar
map.40:53: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-hudaa wa'awrathnaa banee israa'eelal-kitaab
map.40:55: Fasbir inna wa'dallaahi haqquw wastaghfir lidhambika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bil-'ashiyyi wal-ibkaar
map.40:56: Innal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatillaahi bighayri sultaanin ataahum in fee sudoorihim illaa kibrum maa hum bibaaligheeh, fasta'idh billaah, innahoo huwas-samee'ul-baseer
map.40:57: Lakhalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.40:58: Wamaa yastawil-a'maa wal-baseeru wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati walal-musee', qaleelam maa tatadhakkaroon
map.40:59: Innas-saa'ata la'aatiyatul laa rayba feehaa, walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
map.40:60: Waqaala rabbukumud'oonee astajib lakum, innal-ladheena yastakbiroona 'an 'ibaadatee sayadkhuloona jahannama daakhireen
map.40:61: Allaahul-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla litaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiraa, innallaaha ladhoo fadlin 'alan-naasi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
map.40:62: Dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum khaaliqu kulli shay', laa ilaaha illaa huw, fa'annaa tu'fakoon
map.40:64: Allaahul-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda qaraaraw was-samaa'a binaa'aw wasawwarakum fa'ahsana suwarakum warazaqakum minat-tayyibaat, dhaalikumullaahu rabbukum, fatabaarakallaahu rabbul-'aalameen
map.40:65: Huwal-hayyu laa ilaaha illaa huwa fad'oohu mukhliseena lahud-deen, al-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-'aalameen
map.40:66: Qul innee nuheetu an a'budal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi lammaa jaa'aniyal-bayyinaatu mir rabbee wa'umirtu an uslima lirabbil-'aalameen
map.40:67: Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min 'alaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum thumma litakoonoo shuyookhaa, waminkum may yutawaffaa min qablu walitablughoo ajalam musammaw wala'allakum ta'qiloon
map.40:68: Huwal-ladhee yuhyee wayumeet, fa'idhaa qadaa amran fa'innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
map.40:69: Alam tara ilal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatillaah, annaa yusrafoon
map.40:70: Alladheena kadhdhaboo bil-kitaabi wabimaa arsalnaa bihee rusulanaa, fasawfa ya'lamoon
map.40:73: Thumma qeela lahum ayna maa kuntum tushrikoon
map.40:74: Min doonillaah, qaaloo dalloo 'annaa bal lam nakun nad'oo min qablu shay'aa, kadhaalika yudillullaahul-kaafireen
map.40:75: Dhaalikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wabimaa kuntum tamrahoon
map.40:76: Udkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa, fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
map.40:77: Fasbir inna wa'dallaahi haqq, fa'immaa nuriyannaka ba'dal-ladhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa'ilaynaa yurja'oon
map.40:78: Walaqad arsalnaa rusulam min qablika minhum man qasasnaa 'alayka waminhum mal lam naqsus 'alayk, wamaa kaana lirasoolin ay ya'tiya bi'aayatin illaa bi'idhnillaah, fa'idhaa jaa'a amrullaahi qudiya bil-haqqi wakhasira hunaalikal-mubtiloon
map.40:79: Allaahul-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-an'aama litarkaboo minhaa waminhaa ta'kuloon
map.40:80: Walakum feehaa manaafi'u walitablughoo 'alayhaa haajatan fee sudoorikum wa'alayhaa wa'alal-fulki tuhmaloon
map.40:82: Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, kaanoo akthara minhum wa'ashadda quwwataw wa'aathaaran fil-ardi famaa aghnaa 'anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.40:83: Falammaa jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati farihoo bimaa 'indahum minal-'ilmi wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.40:84: Falammaa ra'aw ba'sanaa, qaaloo aamannaa billaahi wahdahoo wakafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihee mushrikeen
map.40:85: Falam yaku yanfa'uhum eemaanuhum lammaa ra'aw ba'sanaa, sunnatallaahil-latee qad khalat fee 'ibaadih, wakhasira hunaalikal-kaafiroon
map.41:3: Kitaabun fussilat aayaatuhoo qur'aanan 'arabiyyal liqawmiy ya'lamoon
map.41:4: Basheeraw wanadheeraa, fa'a'rada aktharuhum fahum laa yasma'oon
map.41:5: Waqaaloo quloobunaa fee akinnatim mimmaa tad'oonaa ilayhi wafee aadhaaninaa waqruw wamim bayninaa wabaynika hijaabun fa'mal innanaa 'aamiloon
map.41:6: Qul innamaa ana basharum mithlukum yoohaa ilayya annamaa ilaahukum ilaahuw waahidun fastaqeemoo ilayhi wastaghfirooh, wawaylul lil-mushrikeen
map.41:7: Al-ladheena laa yu'toonaz-zakaata wahum bil-aakhirati hum kaafiroon
map.41:8: Innal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoon
map.41:9: Qul a'innakum latakfuroona bil-ladhee khalaqal-arda fee yawmayni wataj'aloona lahoo andaadaa, dhaalika rabbul-'aalameen
map.41:10: Waja'ala feehaa rawaasiya min fawqihaa wabaaraka feehaa waqaddara feehaa aqwaatahaa fee arba'ati ayyaam, sawaa'al lis-saa'ileen
map.41:11: Thummastawaa ilas-samaa'i wahiya dukhaanun faqaala lahaa walil'ardi'tiyaa taw'an aw karhaa, qaalataa ataynaa taa'i'een
map.41:12: Faqadaahunna sab'a samaawaatin fee yawmayni wa'awhaa fee kulli samaa'in amrahaa, wazayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeh, wahifzaa, dhaalika taqdeerul-'azeezil-'aleem
map.41:13: Fa'in a'radoo faqul andhartukum saa'iqatam mithla saa'iqati 'aadiw wathamood
map.41:14: Idh jaa'athumur-rusulu mim bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim allaa ta'budoo illallaah, qaaloo law shaa'a rabbunaa la'anzala malaa'ikatan fa'innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
map.41:15: Fa'ammaa 'aadun fastakbaroo fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi waqaaloo man ashaddu minnaa quwwah, awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwah, wakaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yajhadoon
map.41:16: Fa'arsalnaa 'alayhim reehan sarsaran fee ayyaamin nahisaatil linudheeqahum 'adhaabal-khizyi fil-hayaatid-dunyaa, wala'adhaabul-aakhirati akhzaa wahum laa yunsaroon
map.41:17: Wa'ammaa thamoodu fahadaynaahum fastahabbul-'amaa 'alal-hudaa fa'akhadhathum saa'iqatul-'adhaabil-hooni bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.41:19: Wayawma yuhsharu a'daa'ullaahi ilan-naari fahum yooza'oon
map.41:20: Hattaa idhaa maa jaa'oohaa shahida 'alayhim sam'uhum wa'absaaruhum wajulooduhum bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.41:21: Waqaaloo lijuloodihim lima shahittum 'alaynaa, qaaloo antaqanallaahul-ladhee antaqa kulla shay'iw wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratiw wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.41:22: Wamaa kuntum tastatiroona ay yashhada 'alaykum sam'ukum walaa absaarukum walaa juloodukum walaakin zanantum annallaaha laa ya'lamu katheeram mimmaa ta'maloon
map.41:23: Wadhaalikum zannukumul-ladhee zanantum birabbikum ardaakum fa'asbahtum minal-khaasireen
map.41:24: Fa'iy yasbiroo fan-naaru mathwal lahum, wa'iy yasta'tiboo famaa hum minal-mu'tabeen
map.41:25: Waqayyadnaa lahum quranaa'a fazayyanoo lahum maa bayna aydeehim wamaa khalfahum wahaqqa 'alayhimul-qawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins, innahum kaanoo khaasireen
map.41:26: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo laa tasma'oo lihaadhal-qur'aani wal-ghaw feehi la'allakum taghliboon
map.41:27: Falanudheeqannal-ladheena kafaroo 'adhaaban shadeedaw walanajziyannahum aswa'al-ladhee kaanoo ya'maloon
map.41:28: Dhaalika jazaa'u a'daa'illaahin-naaru lahum feehaa daarul-khuld, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yajhadoon
map.41:29: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo rabbanaa arinal-ladhayni adallaanaa minal-jinni wal-insi naj'alhumaa tahta aqdaaminaa liyakoonaa minal-asfaleen
map.41:30: Innal-ladheena qaaloo rabbunallaahu thummastaqaamoo tatanazzalu 'alayhimul-malaa'ikatu allaa takhaafoo walaa tahzanoo wa'abshiroo bil-jannatil-latee kuntum too'adoon
map.41:31: Nahnu awliyaa'ukum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wafil-aakhirah, walakum feehaa maa tashtahee anfusukum walakum feehaa maa tadda'oon
map.41:33: Waman ahsanu qawlam mimman da'aa ilallaahi wa'amila saalihaw waqaala innanee minal-muslimeen
map.41:34: Walaa tastawil-hasanatu walas-sayyi'ah, idfa' bil-latee hiya ahsanu fa'idhal-ladhee baynaka wabaynahoo 'adaawatun ka'annahoo waliyyun hameem
map.41:35: Wamaa yulaqqaahaa illal-ladheena sabaroo, wamaa yulaqqaahaa illaa dhoo hazzin 'azeem
map.41:36: Wa'immaa yanzaghannaka minash-shaytaani nazghun fasta'idh billaah, innahoo huwas-samee'ul-'aleem
map.41:37: Wamin aayaatihil-laylu wan-nahaaru wash-shamsu wal-qamar, laa tasjudoo lish-shamsi walaa lil-qamari wasjudoo lillaahil-ladhee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
map.41:38: Fa'inistakbaroo fal-ladheena 'inda rabbika yusabbihoona lahoo bil-layli wan-nahaari wahum laa yas'amoon
map.41:39: Wamin aayaatihee annaka taral-arda khaashi'atan fa'idhaa anzalnaa 'alayhal-maa'ahtazzat warabat, innal-ladhee ahyaahaa lamuhyil-mawtaa, innahoo 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.41:40: Innal-ladheena yulhidoona fee aayaatinaa laa yakhfawna 'alaynaa, afamay yulqaa fin-naari khayrun am may ya'tee aaminay yawmal-qiyaamah, i'maloo maa shi'tum innahoo bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.41:41: Innal-ladheena kafaroo bidh-dhikri lammaa jaa'ahum, wa'innahoo lakitaabun 'azeez
map.41:42: Laa ya'teehil-baatilu mim bayni yadayhi walaa min khalfih, tanzeelum min hakeemin hameed
map.41:43: Maa yuqaalu laka illaa maa qad qeela lir-rusuli min qablik, inna rabbaka ladhoo maghfiratiw wadhoo 'iqaabin aleem
map.41:44: Walaw ja'alnaahu qur'aanan a'jamiyyal laqaaloo lawlaa fussilat aayaatuh, a'a'jamiyyuw wa'arabiyy, qul huwa lilladheena aamanoo hudaw washifaa', wal-ladheena laa yu'minoona fee aadhaanihim waqruw wahuwa 'alayhim 'amaa, ulaa'ika yunaadawna mim makaanim ba'eed
map.41:45: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba fakhtulifa feeh, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika laqudiya baynahum, wa'innahum lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
map.41:46: Man 'amila saalihan falinafsihee waman asaa'a fa'alayhaa, wamaa rabbuka bizallaamil lil-'abeed
map.41:47: Ilayhi yuraddu 'ilmus-saa'ah, wamaa takhruju min thamaraatim min akmaamihaa wamaa tahmilu min unthaa walaa tada'u illaa bi'ilmih, wayawma yunaadeehim ayna shurakaa'ee qaaloo aadhannaaka maa minnaa min shaheed
map.41:48: Wadalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yad'oona min qablu wazannoo maa lahum mim mahees
map.41:49: Laa yas'amul-insaanu min du'aa'il-khayr, wa'im massahush-sharru faya'oosun qanoot
map.41:50: Wala'in adhaqnaahu rahmatam minnaa mim ba'di darraa'a massathu layaqoolanna haadhaa lee wamaa azunnus-saa'ata qaa'imataw wala'ir ruji'tu ilaa rabbee inna lee 'indahoo lal-husnaa, falanunabbi'annal-ladheena kafaroo bimaa 'amiloo, walanudheeqannahum min 'adhaabin ghaleez
map.41:51: Wa'idhaa an'amnaa 'alal-insaani a'rada wana'aa bijaanibih, wa'idhaa massahush-sharru fadhoo du'aa'in 'areed
map.41:52: Qul ara'aytum in kaana min 'indillaahi thumma kafartum bihee man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaaqim ba'eed
map.41:53: Sanureehim aayaatinaa fil-aafaaqi wafee anfusihim hattaa yatabayyana lahum annahul-haqq, awalam yakfi birabbika annahoo 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
map.41:54: Alaa innahum fee miryatim mil liqaa'i rabbihim, alaa innahoo bikulli shay'im muheet
map.42:3: Kadhaalika yoohee ilayka wa'ilal-ladheena min qablikallaahul-'azeezul-hakeem
map.42:4: Lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wahuwal-'aliyyul-'azeem
map.42:5: Takaadus-samaawaatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna wal-malaa'ikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fil-ard, alaa innallaaha huwal-ghafoorur-raheem
map.42:6: Wal-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa'allaahu hafeezun 'alayhim, wamaa anta 'alayhim biwakeel
map.42:7: Wakadhaalika awhaynaa ilayka qur'aanan 'arabiyyal litundhira ummal-quraa waman hawlahaa watundhira yawmal-jam'i laa rayba feeh, fareequn fil-jannati wafareequn fis-sa'eer
map.42:8: Walaw shaa'allaahu laja'alahum ummataw waahidataw walaakiy yudkhilu may yashaa'u fee rahmatih, waz-zaalimoona maa lahum miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
map.42:9: Amittakhadhoo min doonihee awliyaa', fallaahu huwal-waliyyu wahuwa yuhyil-mawtaa, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.42:10: Wamakhtalaftum feehi min shay'in fahukmuhoo ilallaah, dhaalikumullaahu rabbee 'alayhi tawakkalt, wa'ilayhi uneeb
map.42:11: Faatirus-samaawaati wal-ard, ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajaw waminal-an'aami azwaajaa, yadhra'ukum feeh, laysa kamithlihee shay', wahuwas-samee'ul-baseer
map.42:12: Lahoo maqaaleedus-samaawaati wal-ard, yabsutur-rizqa limay yashaa'u wayaqdir, innahoo bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.42:13: Shara'a lakum minad-deeni maa wassaa bihee noohaw wal-ladhee awhaynaa ilayka wamaa wassaynaa bihee ibraaheema wamoosaa wa'eesaa an aqeemud-deena walaa tatafarraqoo feeh, kabura 'alal-mushrikeena maa tad'oohum ilayh, allaahu yajtabee ilayhi may yashaa'u wayahdee ilayhi may yuneeb
map.42:14: Wamaa tafarraqoo illaa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-'ilmu baghyam baynahum, walawlaa kalimatun sabaqat mir rabbika ilaa ajalim musammal laqudiya baynahum, wa'innal-ladheena oorithul-kitaaba mim ba'dihim lafee shakkim minhu mureeb
map.42:15: Falidhaalika fad', wastaqim kamaa umirt, walaa tattabi' ahwaa'ahum, waqul aamantu bimaa anzalallaahu min kitaab, wa'umirtu li'a'dila baynakum, allaahu rabbunaa warabbukum, lanaa a'maalunaa walakum a'maalukum, laa hujjata baynanaa wabaynakum, allaahu yajma'u baynanaa, wa'ilayhil-maseer
map.42:16: Wal-ladheena yuhaajjoona fillaahi mim ba'di mastujeeba lahoo hujjatuhum daahidatun 'inda rabbihim wa'alayhim ghadabuw walahum 'adhaabun shadeed
map.42:17: Allaahul-ladhee anzalal-kitaaba bil-haqqi wal-meezaan, wamaa yudreeka la'allas-saa'ata qareeb
map.42:18: Yasta'jilu bihal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bihaa, wal-ladheena aamanoo mushfiqoona minhaa waya'lamoona annahal-haqq, alaa innal-ladheena yumaaroona fis-saa'ati lafee dalaalim ba'eed
map.42:19: Allaahu lateefum bi'ibaadihee yarzuqu may yashaa', wahuwal-qawiyyul-'azeez
map.42:20: Man kaana yureedu harthal-aakhirati nazid lahoo fee harthih, waman kaana yureedu harthad-dunyaa nu'tihee minhaa wamaa lahoo fil-aakhirati min naseeb
map.42:21: Am lahum shurakaa'u shara'oo lahum minad-deeni maa lam ya'dham bihillaah, walawlaa kalimatul-fasli laqudiya baynahum, wa'innaz-zaalimeena lahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.42:22: Taraz-zaalimeena mushfiqeena mimmaa kasaboo wahuwa waaqi'um bihim, wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fee rawdaatil-jannaat, lahum maa yashaa'oona 'inda rabbihim, dhaalika huwal-fadlul-kabeer
map.42:23: Dhaalikal-ladhee yubashshirullaahu 'ibaadahul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaat, qul laa as'alukum 'alayhi ajran illal-mawaddata fil-qurbaa, wamay yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahoo feehaa husnaa, innallaaha ghafoorun shakoor
map.42:24: Am yaqooloonaftaraa 'alallaahi kadhibaa, fa'iy yasha'illaahu yakhtim 'alaa qalbik, wayamhullaahul-baatila wayuhiqqul-haqqa bikalimaatih, innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.42:25: Wahuwal-ladhee yaqbalut-tawbata 'an 'ibaadihee waya'foo 'anis-sayyi'aati waya'lamu maa taf'aloon
map.42:26: Wayastajeebul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wayazeeduhum min fadlih, wal-kaafiroona lahum 'adhaabun shadeed
map.42:27: Walaw basatallaahur-rizqa li'ibaadihee labaghaw fil-ardi walaakiy yunazzilu biqadarim maa yashaa', innahoo bi'ibaadihee khabeerum baseer
map.42:28: Wahuwal-ladhee yunazzilul-ghaytha mim ba'di maa qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatah, wahuwal-waliyyul-hameed
map.42:29: Wamin aayaatihee khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baththa feehimaa min daabbah, wahuwa 'alaa jam'ihim idhaa yashaa'u qadeer
map.42:30: Wamaa asaabakum mim museebatin fabimaa kasabat aydeekum waya'foo 'an katheer
map.42:31: Wamaa antum bimu'jizeena fil-ard, wamaa lakum min doonillaahi miw waliyyiw walaa naseer
map.42:33: Iy yasha' yuskinir-reeha fayazlalna rawaakida 'alaa zahrih, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil likulli sabbaarin shakoor
map.42:34: Aw yoobiqhunna bimaa kasaboo waya'fu 'an katheer
map.42:35: Waya'lamal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaatinaa, maa lahum mim mahees
map.42:36: Famaa ooteetum min shay'in famataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wamaa 'indallaahi khayruw wa'abqaa lilladheena aamanoo wa'alaa rabbihim yatawakkaloon
map.42:37: Wal-ladheena yajtaniboona kabaa'iral-ithmi wal-fawaahisha wa'idhaa maa ghadiboo hum yaghfiroon
map.42:38: Wal-ladheenastajaaboo lirabbihim wa'aqaamus-salaah, wa'amruhum shooraa baynahum, wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
map.42:40: Wajazaa'u sayyi'atin sayyi'atum mithluhaa, faman 'afaa wa'aslaha fa'ajruhoo 'alallaah, innahoo laa yuhibbuz-zaalimeen
map.42:41: Walamanintasara ba'da zulmihee fa'ulaa'ika maa 'alayhim min sabeel
map.42:42: Innamas-sabeelu 'alal-ladheena yazlimoonan-naasa wayabghoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqq, ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.42:43: Walaman sabara waghafara inna dhaalika lamin 'azmil-umoor
map.42:44: Wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo miw waliyyim mim ba'dih, wataraz-zaalimeena lammaa ra'awul-'adhaaba yaqooloona hal ilaa maraddim min sabeel
map.42:45: Wataraahum yu'radoona 'alayhaa khaashi'eena minadh-dhulli yanzuroona min tarfin khafiyy, waqaalal-ladheena aamanoo innal-khaasireenal-ladheena khasiroo anfusahum wa'ahleehim yawmal-qiyaamah, alaa innaz-zaalimeena fee 'adhaabim muqeem
map.42:46: Wamaa kaana lahum min awliyaa'a yansuroonahum min doonillaah, wamay yudlilillaahu famaa lahoo min sabeel
map.42:47: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli ay ya'tiya yawmul laa maradda lahoo minallaah, maa lakum mim malja'iy yawma'idhiw wamaa lakum min nakeer
map.42:48: Fa'in a'radoo famaa arsalnaaka 'alayhim hafeezaa, in 'alayka illal-balaagh, wa'innaa idhaa adhaqnal-insaana minnaa rahmatan fariha bihaa, wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim fa'innal-insaana kafoor
map.42:49: Lillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yakhluqu maa yashaa', yahabu limay yashaa'u inaathaw wayahabu limay yashaa'udh-dhukoor
map.42:50: Aw yuzawwijuhum dhukraanaw wa'inaathaa, wayaj'alu may yashaa'u 'aqeemaa, innahoo 'aleemun qadeer
map.42:51: Wamaa kaana libasharin ay yukallimahullaahu illaa wahyan aw miw waraa'i hijaabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya bi'idhnihee maa yashaa', innahoo 'aliyyun hakeem
map.42:52: Wakadhaalika awhaynaa ilayka rooham min amrinaa, maa kunta tadree mal-kitaabu walal-eemaanu walaakin ja'alnaahu nooran nahdee bihee man nashaa'u min 'ibaadinaa, wa'innaka latahdee ilaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.42:53: Siraatillaahil-ladhee lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, alaa ilallaahi taseerul-umoor
map.43:4: Wa'innahoo fee ummil-kitaabi ladaynaa la'aliyyun hakeem
map.43:5: Afanadribu 'ankumudh-dhikra safhan an kuntum qawmam musrifeen
map.43:7: Wamaa ya'teehim min nabiyyin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.43:8: Fa'ahlaknaa ashadda minhum batshaw wamadaa mathalul-awwaleen
map.43:9: Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda layaqoolunna khalaqahunnal-'azeezul-'aleem
map.43:10: Al-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda mahdaw waja'ala lakum feehaa subulal la'allakum tahtadoon
map.43:11: Wal-ladhee nazzala minas-samaa'i maa'am biqadar, fa'ansharnaa bihee baldatam maytaa, kadhaalika tukhrajoon
map.43:12: Wal-ladhee khalaqal-azwaaja kullahaa waja'ala lakum minal-fulki wal-an'aami maa tarkaboon
map.43:13: Litastawoo 'alaa zuhoorihee thumma tadhkuroo ni'mata rabbikum idhastawaytum 'alayhi wataqooloo subhaanal-ladhee sakhkhara lanaa haadhaa wamaa kunnaa lahoo muqrineen
map.43:15: Waja'aloo lahoo min 'ibaadihee juz'aa, innal-insaana lakafoorum mubeen
map.43:16: Amittakhadha mimmaa yakhluqu banaatiw wa'asfaakum bil-baneen
map.43:17: Wa'idhaa bushshira ahaduhum bimaa daraba lir-rahmaani mathalan zalla wajhuhoo muswaddaw wahuwa kazeem
map.43:18: Awamay yunashsha'u fil-hilyati wahuwa fil-khisaami ghayru mubeen
map.43:19: Waja'alul-malaa'ikatal-ladheena hum 'ibaadur-rahmaani inaathaa, ashahidoo khalqahum, satuktabu shahaadatuhum wayus'aloon
map.43:20: Waqaaloo law shaa'ar-rahmaanu maa 'abadnaahum, maa lahum bidhaalika min 'ilmin in hum illaa yakhrusoon
map.43:21: Am aataynaahum kitaabam min qablihee fahum bihee mustamsikoon
map.43:22: Bal qaaloo innaa wajadnaa aabaa'anaa 'alaa ummatiw wa'innaa 'alaa aathaarihim muhtadoon
map.43:23: Wakadhaalika maa arsalnaa min qablika fee qaryatim min nadheerin illaa qaala mutrafoohaa innaa wajadnaa aabaa'anaa 'alaa ummatiw wa'innaa 'alaa aathaarihim muqtadoon
map.43:24: Qaala awalaw ji'tukum bi'ahdaa mimmaa wajattum 'alayhi aabaa'akum, qaaloo innaa bimaa ursiltum bihee kaafiroon
map.43:26: Wa'idh qaala ibraaheemu li'abeehi waqawmihee innanee baraa'um mimmaa ta'budoon
map.43:28: Waja'alahaa kalimatam baaqiyatan fee 'aqibihee la'allahum yarji'oon
map.43:29: Bal matta'tu haa'ulaa'i wa'aabaa'ahum hattaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu warasoolum mubeen
map.43:30: Walammaa jaa'ahumul-haqqu qaaloo haadhaa sihruw wa'innaa bihee kaafiroon
map.43:31: Waqaaloo lawlaa nuzzila haadhal-qur'aanu 'alaa rajulim minal-qaryatayni 'azeem
map.43:32: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbik, nahnu qasamnaa baynahum ma'eeshatahum fil-hayaatid-dunyaa warafa'naa ba'dahum fawqa ba'din darajaatil liyattakhidha ba'duhum ba'dan sukhriyyaa, warahmatu rabbika khayrum mimmaa yajma'oon
map.43:33: Walawlaa ay yakoonan-naasu ummataw waahidatal laja'alnaa limay yakfuru bir-rahmaani libuyootihim suqufam min fiddatiw wama'aarija 'alayhaa yazharoon
map.43:35: Wazukhrufaa, wa'in kullu dhaalika lammaa mataa'ul-hayaatid-dunyaa, wal-aakhiratu 'inda rabbika lil-muttaqeen
map.43:36: Wamay ya'shu 'an dhikrir-rahmaani nuqayyid lahoo shaytaanan fahuwa lahoo qareen
map.43:38: Hattaa idhaa jaa'anaa qaala yaalayta baynee wabaynaka bu'dal-mashriqayni fabi'sal-qareen
map.43:39: Walay yanfa'akumul-yawma iz zalamtum annakum fil-'adhaabi mushtarikoon
map.43:40: Afa'anta tusmi'us-summa aw tahdil-'umya waman kaana fee dalaalim mubeen
map.43:41: Fa'immaa nadhhabanna bika fa'innaa minhum muntaqimoon
map.43:43: Fastamsik bil-ladhee oohiya ilayk, innaka 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.43:44: Wa'innahoo ladhikrul laka waliqawmik, wasawfa tus'aloon
map.43:45: Was'al man arsalnaa min qablika mir rusulinaa, aja'alnaa min doonir-rahmaani aalihatay yu'badoon
map.43:46: Walaqad arsalnaa moosaa bi'aayaatinaa ilaa fir'awna wamala'ihee faqaala innee rasoolu rabbil-'aalameen
map.43:47: Falammaa jaa'ahum bi'aayaatinaa idhaa hum minhaa yadhakoon
map.43:48: Wamaa nureehim min aayatin illaa hiya akbaru min ukhtihaa, wa'akhadhnaahum bil-'adhaabi la'allahum yarji'oon
map.43:49: Waqaaloo yaa ayyuhas-saahirud'u lanaa rabbaka bimaa 'ahida 'indak, innanaa lamuhtadoon
map.43:51: Wanaadaa fir'awnu fee qawmihee qaala yaaqawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahaadhihil-anhaaru tajree min tahtee, afalaa tubsiroon
map.43:52: Am ana khayrum min haadhal-ladhee huwa maheenuw walaa yakaadu yubeen
map.43:53: Falawlaa ulqiya 'alayhi aswiratum min dhahabin aw jaa'a ma'ahul-malaa'ikatu muqtarineen
map.43:54: Fastakhaffa qawmahoo fa'ataa'ooh, innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
map.43:57: Walammaa duribabnu maryama mathalan idhaa qawmuka minhu yasiddoon
map.43:58: Waqaaloo a'aalihatunaa khayrun am huw, maa daraboohu laka illaa jadalaa, bal hum qawmun khasimoon
map.43:59: In huwa illaa 'abdun an'amnaa 'alayhi waja'alnaahu mathalal libanee israa'eel
map.43:60: Walaw nashaa'u laja'alnaa minkum malaa'ikatan fil-ardi yakhlufoon
map.43:61: Wa'innahoo la'ilmul lis-saa'ati falaa tamtarunna bihaa wattabi'oon, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
map.43:63: Walammaa jaa'a 'eesaa bil-bayyinaati qaala qad ji'tukum bil-hikmati wali'ubayyina lakum ba'dal-ladhee takhtalifoona feeh, fattaqullaaha wa'atee'oon
map.43:64: Innallaaha huwa rabbee warabbukum fa'budooh, haadhaa siraatum mustaqeem
map.43:65: Fakhtalafal-ahzaabu mim baynihim, fawaylul lilladheena zalamoo min 'adhaabi yawmin aleem
map.43:66: Hal yanzuroona illas-saa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtataw wahum laa yash'uroon
map.43:68: Yaa'ibaadi laa khawfun 'alaykumul-yawma walaa antum tahzanoon
map.43:71: Yutaafu 'alayhim bisihaafim min dhahabiw wa'akwaab, wafeehaa maa tashtaheehil-anfusu wataladhdhul-a'yun, wa'antum feehaa khaalidoon
map.43:73: Lakum feehaa faakihatun katheeratum minhaa ta'kuloon
map.43:77: Wanaadaw yaamaaliku liyaqdi 'alaynaa rabbuk, qaala innakum maakithoon
map.43:78: Laqad ji'naakum bil-haqqi walaakinna aktharakum lil-haqqi kaarihoon
map.43:80: Am yahsaboona annaa laa nasma'u sirrahum wanajwaahum, balaa warusulunaa ladayhim yaktuboon
map.43:81: Qul in kaana lir-rahmaani walad, fa'ana awwalul-'aabideen
map.43:83: Fadharhum yakhoodoo wayal'aboo hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee yoo'adoon
map.43:84: Wahuwal-ladhee fis-samaa'i ilaahuw wafil-ardi ilaah, wahuwal-hakeemul-'aleem
map.43:85: Watabaarakal-ladhee lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, wa'indahoo 'ilmus-saa'ah, wa'ilayhi turja'oon
map.43:86: Walaa yamlikul-ladheena yad'oona min doonihish-shafaa'ata illaa man shahida bil-haqqi wahum ya'lamoon
map.43:87: Wala'in sa'altahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunnallaahu fa'annaa yu'fakoon
map.43:88: Waqeelihee yaarabbi inna haa'ulaa'i qawmul laa yu'minoon
map.44:3: Innaa anzalnaahu fee laylatim mubaarakatin innaa kunnaa mundhireen
map.44:7: Rabbis-samaawaati wal-ardi wamaa baynahumaa, in kuntum mooqineen
map.44:8: Laa ilaaha illaa huwa yuhyee wayumeet, rabbukum warabbu aabaa'ikumul-awwaleen
map.44:13: Annaa lahumudh-dhikraa waqad jaa'ahum rasoolum mubeen
map.44:17: Walaqad fatannaa qablahum qawma fir'awna wajaa'ahum rasoolun kareem
map.44:18: An addoo ilayya 'ibaadallaah, innee lakum rasoolun ameen
map.44:19: Wa'al laa ta'loo 'alallaah, innee aateekum bisultaanim mubeen
map.44:22: Fada'aa rabbahoo anna haa'ulaa'i qawmum mujrimoon
map.44:29: Famaa bakat 'alayhimus-samaa'u wal-ard, wamaa kaanoo munzareen
map.44:33: Wa'aataynaahum minal-aayaati maa feehi balaa'um mubeen
map.44:35: In hiya illaa mawtatunal-oolaa wamaa nahnu bimunshareen
map.44:37: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubba'iw wal-ladheena min qablihim, ahlaknaahum innahum kaanoo mujrimeen
map.44:38: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa laa'ibeen
map.44:39: Maa khalaqnaahumaa illaa bil-haqqi walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.44:41: Yawma laa yughnee mawlan 'am mawlan shay'aw walaa hum yunsaroon
map.44:50: Inna haadhaa maa kuntum bihee tamtaroon
map.45:4: Wafee khalqikum wamaa yabuththu min daabbatin aayaatul liqawmiy yooqinoon
map.45:5: Wakhtilaafil-layli wan-nahaari wamaa anzalallaahu minas-samaa'i mir rizqin fa'ahyaa bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa watasreefir-riyaahi aayaatul liqawmiy ya'qiloon
map.45:6: Tilka aayaatullaahi natloohaa 'alayka bil-haqq, fabi'ayyi hadeethim ba'dallaahi wa'aayaatihee yu'minoon
map.45:8: Yasma'u aayaatillaahi tutlaa 'alayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran ka'al lam yasma'haa, fabashshirhu bi'adhaabin aleem
map.45:9: Wa'idhaa 'alima min aayaatinaa shay'anittakhadhahaa huzuwaa, ulaa'ika lahum 'adhaabum muheen
map.45:10: Miw waraa'ihim jahannam, walaa yughnee 'anhum maa kasaboo shay'aw walaa mattakhadhoo min doonillaahi awliyaa', walahum 'adhaabun 'azeem
map.45:11: Haadhaa hudaa, wal-ladheena kafaroo bi'aayaati rabbihim lahum 'adhaabum mir rijzin aleem
map.45:12: Allaahul-ladhee sakhkhara lakumul-bahra litajriyal-fulku feehi bi'amrihee walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
map.45:13: Wasakhkhara lakum maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ardi jamee'am minh, inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmiy yatafakkaroon
map.45:14: Qul lilladheena aamanoo yaghfiroo lilladheena laa yarjoona ayyaamallaahi liyajziya qawmam bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
map.45:15: Man 'amila saalihan falinafsih, waman asaa'a fa'alayhaa, thumma ilaa rabbikum turja'oon
map.45:16: Walaqad aataynaa banee israa'eelal-kitaaba wal-hukma wan-nubuwwata warazaqnaahum minat-tayyibaati wafaddalnaahum 'alal-'aalameen
map.45:17: Wa'aataynaahum bayyinaatim minal-amr, famakhtalafoo illaa mim ba'di maa jaa'ahumul-'ilmu baghyam baynahum, inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
map.45:18: Thumma ja'alnaaka 'alaa sharee'atim minal-amri fattabi'haa walaa tattabi' ahwaa'al-ladheena laa ya'lamoon
map.45:19: Innahum lay yughnoo 'anka minallaahi shay'aa, wa'innaz-zaalimeena ba'duhum awliyaa'u ba'd, wallaahu waliyyul-muttaqeen
map.45:20: Haadhaa basaa'iru lin-naasi wahudaw warahmatul liqawmiy yooqinoon
map.45:21: Am hasibal-ladheenajtarahus-sayyi'aati an naj'alahum kal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati sawaa'am mahyaahum wamamaatuhum, saa'a maa yahkumoon
map.45:22: Wakhalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi walitujzaa kullu nafsim bimaa kasabat wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.45:23: Afara'ayta manittakhadha ilaahahoo hawaahu wa'adallahullaahu 'alaa 'ilmiw wakhatama 'alaa sam'ihee waqalbihee waja'ala 'alaa basarihee ghishaawah, famay yahdeehi mim ba'dillaah, afalaa tadhakkaroon
map.45:24: Waqaaloo maa hiya illaa hayaatunad-dunyaa namootu wanahyaa wamaa yuhlikunaa illad-dahr, wamaa lahum bidhaalika min 'ilm, in hum illaa yazunnoon
map.45:25: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatim maa kaana hujjatahum illaa an qaalu'too bi'aabaa'inaa in kuntum saadiqeen
map.45:26: Qulillaahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma'ukum ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati laa rayba feehi walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
map.45:27: Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yawma'idhiy yakhsarul-mubtiloon
map.45:28: Wataraa kulla ummatin jaathiyah, kullu ummatin tud'aa ilaa kitaabihaa, al-yawma tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.45:29: Haadhaa kitaabunaa yantiqu 'alaykum bil-haqq, innaa kunnaa nastansikhu maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.45:30: Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatih, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-mubeen
map.45:31: Wa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo, afalam takun aayaatee tutlaa 'alaykum fastakbartum wakuntum qawmam mujrimeen
map.45:32: Wa'idhaa qeela inna wa'dallaahi haqquw was-saa'atu laa rayba feehaa qultum maa nadree mas-saa'atu in nazunnu illaa zannaw wamaa nahnu bimustayqineen
map.45:33: Wabadaa lahum sayyi'aatu maa 'amiloo wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.45:34: Waqeelal-yawma nansaakum kamaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa wama'waakumun-naaru wamaa lakum min naasireen
map.45:35: Dhaalikum bi'annakumuttakhadhtum aayaatillaahi huzuwaw wagharratkumul-hayaatud-dunyaa, fal-yawma laa yukhrajoona minhaa walaa hum yusta'taboon
map.46:3: Maa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa'ajalim musammaa, wal-ladheena kafaroo 'ammaa undhiroo mu'ridoon
map.46:4: Qul ara'aytum maa tad'oona min doonillaahi aroonee maadhaa khalaqoo minal-ardi am lahum shirkun fis-samaawaat, u'toonee bikitaabim min qabli haadhaa aw athaaratim min 'ilmin in kuntum saadiqeen
map.46:5: Waman adallu mimmay yad'oo min doonillaahi mal laa yastajeebu lahoo ilaa yawmil-qiyaamati wahum 'an du'aa'ihim ghaafiloon
map.46:6: Wa'idhaa hushiran-naasu kaanoo lahum a'daa'aw wakaanoo bi'ibaadatihim kaafireen
map.46:7: Wa'idhaa tutlaa 'alayhim aayaatunaa bayyinaatin qaalal-ladheena kafaroo lil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum haadhaa sihrum mubeen
map.46:8: Am yaqooloonaftaraah, qul iniftaraytuhoo falaa tamlikoona lee minallaahi shay'aa, huwa a'lamu bimaa tufeedoona feeh, kafaa bihee shaheedam baynee wabaynakum, wahuwal-ghafoorur-raheem
map.46:9: Qul maa kuntu bid'am minar-rusuli wamaa adree maa yuf'alu bee walaa bikum, in attabi'u illaa maa yoohaa ilayya wamaa ana illaa nadheerum mubeen
map.46:10: Qul ara'aytum in kaana min 'indillaahi wakafartum bihee washahida shaahidum mim banee israa'eela 'alaa mithlihee fa'aamana wastakbartum, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.46:11: Waqaalal-ladheena kafaroo lilladheena aamanoo law kaana khayram maa sabaqoonaa ilayh, wa'idh lam yahtadoo bihee fasayaqooloona haadhaa ifkun qadeem
map.46:12: Wamin qablihee kitaabu moosaa imaamaw warahmah, wahaadhaa kitaabum musaddiqul lisaanan 'arabiyyal liyundhiral-ladheena zalamoo, wabushraa lil-muhsineen
map.46:13: Innal-ladheena qaaloo rabbunallaahu thummastaqaamoo falaa khawfun 'alayhim walaa hum yahzanoon
map.46:14: Ulaa'ika ashaabul-jannati khaalideena feehaa, jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.46:15: Wawassaynal-insaana biwaalidayhi ihsaanaa, hamalathu ummuhoo kurhaw wawada'athu kurhaa, wahamluhoo wafisaaluhoo thalaathoona shahraa, hattaa idhaa balagha ashuddahoo wabalagha arba'eena sanatan qaala rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'matakal-latee an'amta 'alayya wa'alaa waalidayya wa'an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa'aslih lee fee dhurriyyatee, innee tubtu ilayka wa'innee minal-muslimeen
map.46:16: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena nataqabbalu 'anhum ahsana maa 'amiloo wanatajaawazu 'an sayyi'aatihim fee ashaabil-jannah, wa'das-sidqil-ladhee kaanoo yoo'adoon
map.46:17: Wal-ladhee qaala liwaalidayhi uffil lakumaa ata'idaaninee an ukhraja waqad khalatil-quroonu min qablee, wahumaa yastagheethaanillaaha waylaka aamin, inna wa'dallaahi haqq, fayaqoolu maa haadhaa illaa asaateerul-awwaleen
map.46:18: Ulaa'ikal-ladheena haqqa 'alayhimul-qawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim minal-jinni wal-ins, innahum kaanoo khaasireen
map.46:19: Walikullin darajaatum mimmaa 'amiloo, waliyuwaffiyahum a'maalahum wahum laa yuzlamoon
map.46:20: Wayawma yu'radul-ladheena kafaroo 'alan-naar, adhhabtum tayyibaatikum fee hayaatikumud-dunyaa wastamta'tum bihaa, fal-yawma tujzawna 'adhaabal-hooni bimaa kuntum tastakbiroona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wabimaa kuntum tafsuqoon
map.46:21: Wadhkur akhaa 'aad, idh andhara qawmahoo bil-ahqaafi waqad khalatin-nudhuru mim bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihee allaa ta'budoo illallaah, innee akhaafu 'alaykum 'adhaaba yawmin 'azeem
map.46:22: Qaaloo aji'tanaa lita'fikanaa 'an aalihatinaa, fa'tinaa bimaa ta'idunaa in kunta minas-saadiqeen
map.46:23: Qaala innamal-'ilmu 'indallaah, wa'uballighukum maa ursiltu bihee walaakinnee araakum qawman tajhaloon
map.46:24: Falammaa ra'awhu 'aaridam mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaaloo haadhaa 'aaridum mumtirunaa, bal huwa masta'jaltum bih, reehun feehaa 'adhaabun aleem
map.46:25: Tudammiru kulla shay'im bi'amri rabbihaa fa'asbahoo laa yuraa illaa masaakinuhum, kadhaalika najzil-qawmal-mujrimeen
map.46:26: Walaqad makkannaahum feemaa im makkannaakum feehi waja'alnaa lahum sam'aw wa'absaaraw wa'af'idah, famaa aghnaa 'anhum sam'uhum walaa absaaruhum walaa af'idatuhum min shay'in idh kaanoo yajhadoona bi'aayaatillaahi wahaaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
map.46:27: Walaqad ahlaknaa maa hawlakum minal-quraa wasarrafnal-aayaati la'allahum yarji'oon
map.46:28: Falawlaa nasarahumul-ladheenattakhadhoo min doonillaahi qurbaanan aalihah, bal dalloo 'anhum, wadhaalika ifkuhum wamaa kaanoo yaftaroon
map.46:29: Wa'idh sarafnaa ilayka nafaram minal-jinni yastami'oonal-qur'aan, falammaa hadaroohu qaaloo ansitoo, falammaa qudiya wallaw ilaa qawmihim mundhireen
map.46:30: Qaaloo yaaqawmanaa innaa sami'naa kitaaban unzila mim ba'di moosaa musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayhi yahdee ilal-haqqi wa'ilaa tareeqim mustaqeem
map.46:31: Yaaqawmanaa ajeeboo daa'iyallaahi wa'aaminoo bihee yaghfir lakum min dhunoobikum wayujirkum min 'adhaabin aleem
map.46:32: Wamal laa yujib daa'iyallaahi falaysa bimu'jizin fil-ardi walaysa lahoo min doonihee awliyaa', ulaa'ika fee dalaalim mubeen
map.46:33: Awalam yaraw annallaahal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda walam ya'ya bikhalqihinna biqaadirin 'alaa ay yuhyil-mawtaa, balaa innahoo 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.46:34: Wayawma yu'radul-ladheena kafaroo 'alan-naar, alaysa haadhaa bil-haqq, qaaloo balaa warabbinaa, qaala fadhooqul-'adhaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
map.46:35: Fasbir kamaa sabara ulul-'azmi minar-rusuli walaa tasta'jil lahum, ka'annahum yawma yarawna maa yoo'adoona lam yalbathoo illaa saa'atam min nahaar, balaagh, fahal yuhlaku illal-qawmul-faasiqoon
map.47:1: Alladheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeelillaahi adalla a'maalahum
map.47:2: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati wa'aamanoo bimaa nuzzila 'alaa muhammadiw wahuwal-haqqu mir rabbihim, kaffara 'anhum sayyi'aatihim wa'aslaha baalahum
map.47:3: Dhaalika bi'annal-ladheena kafaruttaba'ul-baatila wa'annal-ladheena aamanuttaba'ul-haqqa mir rabbihim, kadhaalika yadribullaahu lin-naasi amthaalahum
map.47:4: Fa'idhaa laqeetumul-ladheena kafaroo fadarbar-riqaab, hattaa idhaa athkhantumoohum fashuddul-wathaaq, fa'immaa mannam ba'du wa'immaa fidaa'an hattaa tada'al-harbu awzaarahaa dhaalik, walaw yashaa'ullaahu lantasara minhum walaakil liyabluwa ba'dakum biba'd, wal-ladheena qutiloo fee sabeelillaahi falay yudilla a'maalahum
map.47:7: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in tansurullaaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdaamakum
map.47:8: Wal-ladheena kafaroo fata'sal lahum wa'adalla a'maalahum
map.47:9: Dhaalika bi'annahum karihoo maa anzalallaahu fa'ahbata a'maalahum
map.47:10: Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim, dammarallaahu 'alayhim, walilkaafireena amthaaluhaa
map.47:11: Dhaalika bi'annallaaha mawlal-ladheena aamanoo wa'annal-kaafireena laa mawlaa lahum
map.47:12: Innallaaha yudkhilul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, wal-ladheena kafaroo yatamatta'oona waya'kuloona kamaa ta'kulul-an'aamu wan-naaru mathwal lahum
map.47:13: Waka'ayyim min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatam min qaryatikal-latee akhrajatk, ahlaknaahum falaa naasira lahum
map.47:14: Afaman kaana 'alaa bayyinatim mir rabbihee kaman zuyyina lahoo soo'u 'amalihee wattaba'oo ahwaa'ahum
map.47:15: Mathalul-jannatil-latee wu'idal-muttaqoon, feehaa anhaarum mim maa'in ghayri aasin, wa'anhaarum mil labanil lam yataghayyar ta'muh, wa'anhaarum min khamril ladhdhatil lish-shaaribeen, wa'anhaarum min 'asalim musaffaa, walahum feehaa min kullith-thamaraati wamaghfiratum mir rabbihim, kaman huwa khaalidun fin-naari wasuqoo maa'an hameeman faqatta'a am'aa'ahum
map.47:16: Waminhum may yastami'u ilayk, hattaa idhaa kharajoo min 'indika qaaloo lilladheena ootul-'ilma maadhaa qaala aanifaa, ulaa'ikal-ladheena taba'allaahu 'alaa quloobihim wattaba'oo ahwaa'ahum
map.47:18: Fahal yanzuroona illas-saa'ata an ta'tiyahum baghtah, faqad jaa'a ashraatuhaa, fa'annaa lahum idhaa jaa'athum dhikraahum
map.47:19: Fa'lam annahoo laa ilaaha illallaahu wastaghfir lidhambika walilmu'mineena wal-mu'minaat, wallaahu ya'lamu mutaqallabakum wamathwaakum
map.47:20: Wayaqoolul-ladheena aamanoo lawlaa nuzzilat soorah, fa'idhaa unzilat sooratum muhkamatuw wadhukira feehal-qitaalu ra'aytal-ladheena fee quloobihim maraduy yanzuroona ilayka nazaral-maghshiyyi 'alayhi minal-mawt, fa'awlaa lahum
map.47:21: Taa'atuw waqawlum ma'roof, fa'idhaa 'azamal-amr, falaw sadaqullaaha lakaana khayral lahum
map.47:22: Fahal 'asaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fil-ardi watuqatti'oo arhaamakum
map.47:25: Innal-ladheenartaddoo 'alaa adbaarihim mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul-hudash-shaytaanu sawwala lahum, wa'amlaa lahum
map.47:26: Dhaalika bi'annahum qaaloo lilladheena karihoo maa nazzalallaahu sanutee'ukum fee ba'dil-amr, wallaahu ya'lamu israarahum
map.47:27: Fakayfa idhaa tawaffathumul-malaa'ikatu yadriboona wujoohahum wa'adbaarahum
map.47:28: Dhaalika bi'annahumuttaba'oo maa askhatallaaha wakarihoo ridwaanahoo fa'ahbata a'maalahum
map.47:29: Am hasibal-ladheena fee quloobihim maradun al lay yukhrijallaahu adghaanahum
map.47:30: Walaw nashaa'u la'araynaakahum fala'araftahum biseemaahum, walata'rifannahum fee lahnil-qawl, wallaahu ya'lamu a'maalakum
map.47:31: Walanabluwannakum hattaa na'lamal-mujaahideena minkum was-saabireena wanabluwa akhbaarakum
map.47:32: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeelillaahi washaaqqur-rasoola mim ba'di maa tabayyana lahumul-hudaa lay yadurrullaaha shay'aa, wasayuhbitu a'maalahum
map.47:33: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo atee'ullaaha wa'atee'ur-rasoola walaa tubtiloo a'maalakum
map.47:34: Innal-ladheena kafaroo wasaddoo 'an sabeelillaahi thumma maatoo wahum kuffaarun falay yaghfirallaahu lahum
map.47:35: Falaa tahinoo watad'oo ilas-salm, wa'antumul-a'lawn, wallaahu ma'akum walay yatirakum a'maalakum
map.47:36: Innamal-hayaatud-dunyaa la'ibuw walahw, wa'in tu'minoo watattaqoo yu'tikum ujoorakum walaa yas'alkum amwaalakum
map.47:37: Iy yas'alkumoohaa fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghaanakum
map.47:38: Haa'antum haa'ulaa'i tud'awna litunfiqoo fee sabeelillaah, faminkum may yabkhal, wamay yabkhal fa'innamaa yabkhalu 'an nafsih, wallaahul-ghaniyyu wa'antumul-fuqaraa', wa'in tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma laa yakoonoo amthaalakum
map.48:2: Liyaghfira lakallaahu maa taqaddama min dhambika wamaa ta'akhkhara wayutimma ni'matahoo 'alayka wayahdiyaka siraatam mustaqeemaa
map.48:4: Huwal-ladhee anzalas-sakeenata fee quloobil-mu'mineena liyazdaadoo eemaanam ma'a eemaanihim, walillaahi junoodus-samaawaati wal-ard, wakaanallaahu 'aleeman hakeemaa
map.48:5: Liyudkhilal-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wayukaffira 'anhum sayyi'aatihim, wakaana dhaalika 'indallaahi fawzan 'azeemaa
map.48:6: Wayu'adhdhibal-munaafiqeena wal-munaafiqaati wal-mushrikeena wal-mushrikaatiz-zaanneena billaahi zannas-saw', 'alayhim daa'iratus-saw', waghadiballaahu 'alayhim wala'anahum wa'a'adda lahum jahannam, wasaa'at maseeraa
map.48:9: Litu'minoo billaahi warasoolihee watu'azziroohu watuwaqqirooh, watusabbihoohu bukrataw wa'aseelaa
map.48:10: Innal-ladheena yubaayi'oonaka innamaa yubaayi'oonallaah, yadullaahi fawqa aydeehim, faman nakatha fa'innamaa yankuthu 'alaa nafsih, waman awfaa bimaa 'aahada 'alayhullaaha fasayu'teehi ajran 'azeemaa
map.48:11: Sayaqoolu lakal-mukhallafoona minal-a'raabi shaghalatnaa amwaalunaa wa'ahloonaa fastaghfir lanaa, yaqooloona bi'alsinatihim maa laysa fee quloobihim, qul famay yamliku lakum minallaahi shay'an in araada bikum darran aw araada bikum naf'aa, bal kaanallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeeraa
map.48:12: Bal zanantum al lay yanqalibar-rasoolu wal-mu'minoona ilaa ahleehim abadaw wazuyyina dhaalika fee quloobikum wazanantum zannas-saw', wakuntum qawmam booraa
map.48:13: Wamal lam yu'mim billaahi warasoolihee fa'innaa a'tadnaa lil-kaafireena sa'eeraa
map.48:14: Walillaahi mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yaghfiru limay yashaa'u wayu'adhdhibu may yashaa', wakaanallaahu ghafoorar raheemaa
map.48:15: Sayaqoolul-mukhallafoona idhantalaqtum ilaa maghaanima lita'khudhoohaa dharoonaa nattabi'kum, yureedoona ay yubaddiloo kalaamallaah, qul lan tattabi'oonaa kadhaalikum qaalallaahu min qabl, fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonanaa, bal kaanoo laa yafqahoona illaa qaleelaa
map.48:16: Qul lil-mukhallafeena minal-a'raabi satud'awna ilaa qawmin ulee ba'sin shadeedin tuqaatiloonahum aw yuslimoon, fa'in tutee'oo yu'tikumullaahu ajran hasanaa, wa'in tatawallaw kamaa tawallaytum min qablu yu'adhdhibkum 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.48:17: Laysa 'alal-a'maa harajuw walaa 'alal-a'raji harajuw walaa 'alal-mareedi haraj, wamay yuti'illaaha warasoolahoo yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaar, wamay yatawalla yu'adhdhibhu 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.48:18: Laqad radiyallaahu 'anil-mu'mineena idh yubaayi'oonaka tahtash-shajarati fa'alima maa fee quloobihim fa'anzalas-sakeenata 'alayhim wa'athaabahum fathan qareebaa
map.48:20: Wa'adakumullaahu maghaanima katheeratan ta'khudhoonahaa fa'ajjala lakum haadhihee wakaffa aydiyan-naasi 'ankum, walitakoona aayatal lil-mu'mineena wayahdiyakum siraatam mustaqeemaa
map.48:21: Wa'ukhraa lam taqdiroo 'alayhaa qad ahaatallaahu bihaa, wakaanallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeeraa
map.48:22: Walaw qaatalakumul-ladheena kafaroo lawallawul-adbaara thumma laa yajidoona waliyyaw walaa naseeraa
map.48:23: Sunnatallaahil-latee qad khalat min qabl, walan tajida lisunnatillaahi tabdeelaa
map.48:24: Wahuwal-ladhee kaffa aydiyahum 'ankum wa'aydiyakum 'anhum bibatni makkata mim ba'di an azfarakum 'alayhim, wakaanallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseeraa
map.48:25: Humul-ladheena kafaroo wasaddookum 'anil-masjidil-haraami wal-hadya ma'koofan ay yablugha mahillah, walawlaa rijaalum mu'minoona wanisaa'um mu'minaatul lam ta'lamoohum an tata'oohum fatuseebakum minhum ma'arratum bighayri 'ilm, liyudkhilallaahu fee rahmatihee may yashaa', law tazayyaloo la'adhdhabnal-ladheena kafaroo minhum 'adhaaban aleemaa
map.48:26: Idh ja'alal-ladheena kafaroo fee quloobihimul-hamiyyata hamiyyatal-jaahiliyyati fa'anzalallaahu sakeenatahoo 'alaa rasoolihee wa'alal-mu'mineena wa'alzamahum kalimatat-taqwaa wakaanoo ahaqqa bihaa wa'ahlahaa, wakaanallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleemaa
map.48:27: Laqad sadaqallaahu rasoolahur-ru'yaa bil-haqq, latadkhulunnal-masjidal-haraama in shaa'allaahu aamineena muhalliqeena ru'oosakum wamuqassireena laa takhaafoon, fa'alima maa lam ta'lamoo faja'ala min dooni dhaalika fathan qareebaa
map.48:28: Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahoo bil-hudaa wadeenil-haqqi liyuzhirahoo 'alad-deeni kullih, wakafaa billaahi shaheedaa
map.48:29: Muhammadur rasoolullaah, wal-ladheena ma'ahoo ashiddaa'u 'alal-kuffaari ruhamaa'u baynahum taraahum rukka'an sujjaday yabtaghoona fadlam minallaahi waridwaanaa, seemaahum fee wujoohihim min atharis-sujood, dhaalika mathaluhum fit-tawraah, wamathaluhum fil-injeel, kazar'in akhraja shat'ahoo fa'aazarahoo fastaghlaza fastawaa 'alaa sooqihee yu'jibuz-zurraa'a liyagheeza bihimul-kuffaar, wa'adallaahul-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati minhum maghfirataw wa'ajran 'azeemaa
map.49:1: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tuqaddimoo bayna yadayillaahi warasoolihee wattaqullaah, innallaaha samee'un 'aleem
map.49:2: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tarfa'oo aswaatakum fawqa sawtin-nabiyyi walaa tajharoo lahoo bil-qawli kajahri ba'dikum liba'din an tahbata a'maalukum wa'antum laa tash'uroon
map.49:3: Innal-ladheena yaghuddoona aswaatahum 'inda rasoolillaahi ulaa'ikal-ladheenamtahanallaahu quloobahum lit-taqwaa, lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun 'azeem
map.49:4: Innal-ladheena yunaadoonaka miw waraa'il-hujuraati aktharuhum laa ya'qiloon
map.49:5: Walaw annahum sabaroo hattaa takhruja ilayhim lakaana khayral lahum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.49:6: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo in jaa'akum faasiqum binaba'in fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawmam bijahaalatin fatusbihoo 'alaa maa fa'altum naadimeen
map.49:7: Wa'lamoo anna feekum rasoolallaah, law yutee'ukum fee katheerim minal-amri la'anittum walaakinnallaaha habbaba ilaykumul-eemaana wazayyanahoo fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumul-kufra wal-fusooqa wal-'isyaan, ulaa'ika humur-raashidoon
map.49:9: Wa'in taa'ifataani minal-mu'mineenaqtataloo fa'aslihoo baynahumaa, fa'im baghat ihdaahumaa 'alal-ukhraa faqaatilul-latee tabghee hattaa tafee'a ilaa amrillaah, fa'in faa'at fa'aslihoo baynahumaa bil-'adli wa'aqsitoo, innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
map.49:10: Innamal-mu'minoona ikhwatun fa'aslihoo bayna akhawaykum wattaqullaaha la'allakum turhamoon
map.49:11: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa yaskhar qawmum min qawmin 'asaa ay yakoonoo khayram minhum walaa nisaa'um min nisaa'in 'asaa ay yakunna khayram minhunn, walaa talmizoo anfusakum walaa tanaabazoo bil-alqaab, bi'salismul-fusooqu ba'dal-eemaan, wamal lam yatub fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.49:12: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanujtaniboo katheeram minaz-zann, inna ba'daz-zanni ithmuw walaa tajassasoo walaa yaghtab ba'dukum ba'daa, ayuhibbu ahadukum ay ya'kula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumooh, wattaqullaah, innallaaha tawwaabur raheem
map.49:13: Yaa ayyuhan-naasu innaa khalaqnaakum min dhakariw wa'unthaa waja'alnaakum shu'oobaw waqabaa'ila lita'aarafoo, inna akramakum 'indallaahi atqaakum, innallaaha 'aleemun khabeer
map.49:14: Qaalatil-a'raabu aamannaa, qul lam tu'minoo walaakin qooloo aslamnaa walammaa yadkhulil-eemaanu fee quloobikum, wa'in tutee'ullaaha warasoolahoo laa yalitkum min a'maalikum shay'aa, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.49:15: Innamal-mu'minoonal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warasoolihee thumma lam yartaaboo wajaahadoo bi'amwaalihim wa'anfusihim fee sabeelillaah, ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon
map.49:16: Qul atu'allimoonallaaha bideenikum, wallaahu ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.49:17: Yamunnoona 'alayka an aslamoo, qul laa tamunnoo 'alayya islaamakum, balillaahu yamunnu 'alaykum an hadaakum lil-eemaani in kuntum saadiqeen
map.49:18: Innallaaha ya'lamu ghaybas-samaawaati wal-ard, wallaahu baseerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.50:2: Bal 'ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirum minhum faqaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa shay'un 'ajeeb
map.50:3: A'idhaa mitnaa wakunnaa turaabaa, dhaalika raj'um ba'eed
map.50:4: Qad 'alimnaa maa tanqusul-ardu minhum, wa'indanaa kitaabun hafeez
map.50:5: Bal kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fahum fee amrim mareej
map.50:6: Afalam yanzuroo ilas-samaa'i fawqahum kayfa banaynaahaa wazayyannaahaa wamaa lahaa min furooj
map.50:7: Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa'alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjim baheej
map.50:9: Wanazzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'am mubaarakan fa'ambatnaa bihee jannaatiw wahabbal-haseed
map.50:11: Rizqal lil-'ibaadi wa'ahyaynaa bihee baldatam maytaa, kadhaalikal-khurooj
map.50:12: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohiw wa'ashaabur-rassi wathamood
map.50:14: Wa'ashaabul-aykati waqawmu tubba', kullun kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa wa'eed
map.50:15: Afa'ayeenaa bil-khalqil-awwal, bal hum fee labsim min khalqin jadeed
map.50:16: Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana wana'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihee nafsuh, wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-wareed
map.50:18: Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladayhi raqeebun 'ateed
map.50:19: Wajaa'at sakratul-mawti bil-haqq, dhaalika maa kunta minhu taheed
map.50:21: Wajaa'at kullu nafsim ma'ahaa saa'iquw washaheed
map.50:22: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatim min haadhaa fakashafnaa 'anka ghitaa'aka fabasarukal-yawma hadeed
map.50:26: Al-ladhee ja'ala ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fa'alqiyaahu fil-'adhaabish-shadeed
map.50:27: Qaala qareenuhoo rabbanaa maa atghaytuhoo walaakin kaana fee dalaalim ba'eed
map.50:28: Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-wa'eed
map.50:29: Maa yubaddalul-qawlu ladayya wamaa ana bizallaamil lil-'abeed
map.50:30: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama halimtala'ti wataqoolu hal mim mazeed
map.50:32: Haadhaa maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez
map.50:33: Man khashiyar-rahmaana bil-ghaybi wajaa'a biqalbim muneeb
map.50:35: Lahum maa yashaa'oona feehaa waladaynaa mazeed
map.50:36: Wakam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil-bilaad, hal mim mahees
map.50:37: Inna fee dhaalika ladhikraa liman kaana lahoo qalbun aw alqas-sam'a wahuwa shaheed
map.50:38: Walaqad khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaam, wamaa massanaa mil lughoob
map.50:39: Fasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'ish-shamsi waqablal-ghuroob
map.50:41: Wastami' yawma yunaadil-munaadi mim makaanin qareeb
map.50:44: Yawma tashaqqaqul-ardu 'anhum siraa'aa, dhaalika hashrun 'alaynaa yaseer
map.50:45: Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wamaa anta 'alayhim bijabbaar, fadhakkir bil-qur'aani may yakhaafu wa'eed
map.51:14: Dhooqoo fitnatakum, haadhal-ladhee kuntum bihee tasta'jiloon
map.51:16: Aakhidheena maa aataahum rabbuhum, innahum kaanoo qabla dhaalika muhsineen
map.51:23: Fawarabbis-samaa'i wal-ardi innahoo lahaqqum mithla maa annakum tantiqoon
map.51:25: Idh dakhaloo 'alayhi faqaaloo salaamaa, qaala salaam, qawmum munkaroon
map.51:26: Faraagha ilaa ahlihee fajaa'a bi'ijlin sameen
map.51:28: Fa'awjasa minhum kheefah, qaaloo laa takhaf, wabashsharoohu bighulaamin 'aleem
map.51:29: Fa'aqbalatimra'atuhoo fee sarratin fasakkat wajhahaa waqaalat 'ajoozun 'aqeem
map.51:30: Qaaloo kadhaaliki qaala rabbuk, innahoo huwal-hakeemul-'aleem
map.51:32: Qaaloo innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
map.51:36: Famaa wajadnaa feehaa ghayra baytim minal-muslimeen
map.51:38: Wafee moosaa idh arsalnaahu ilaa fir'awna bisultaanim mubeen
map.51:39: Fatawallaa biruknihee waqaala saahirun aw majnoon
map.51:40: Fa'akhadhnaahu wajunoodahoo fanabadhnaahum fil-yammi wahuwa muleem
map.51:42: Maa tadharu min shay'in atat 'alayhi illaa ja'alathu kar-rameem
map.51:43: Wafee thamooda idh qeela lahum tamatta'oo hattaa heen
map.51:44: Fa'ataw 'an amri rabbihim fa'akhadhathumus-saa'iqatu wahum yanzuroon
map.51:45: Famastataa'oo min qiyaamiw wamaa kaanoo muntasireen
map.51:46: Waqawma noohim min qabl, innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
map.51:49: Wamin kulli shay'in khalaqnaa zawjayni la'allakum tadhakkaroon
map.51:50: Fafirroo ilallaah, innee lakum minhu nadheerum mubeen
map.51:51: Walaa taj'aloo ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhar, innee lakum minhu nadheerum mubeen
map.51:52: Kadhaalika maa atal-ladheena min qablihim mir rasoolin illaa qaaloo saahirun aw majnoon
map.51:53: Atawaasaw bih, bal hum qawmun taaghoon
map.51:57: Maa ureedu minhum mir rizqiw wamaa ureedu ay yut'imoon
map.51:59: Fa'inna lilladheena zalamoo dhanoobam mithla dhanoobi ashaabihim falaa yasta'jiloon
map.51:60: Fawaylul lilladheena kafaroo miy yawmihimul-ladhee yoo'adoon
map.52:13: Yawma yuda''oona ilaa naari jahannama da''aa
map.52:15: Afasihrun haadhaa am antum laa tubsiroon
map.52:16: Islawhaa fasbiroo aw laa tasbiroo, sawaa'un 'alaykum, innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.52:18: Faakiheena bimaa aataahum rabbuhum, wawaqaahum rabbuhum 'adhaabal-jaheem
map.52:19: Kuloo washraboo hanee'am bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.52:21: Wal-ladheena aamanoo wattaba'athum dhurriyyatuhum bi'eemaanin alhaqnaa bihim dhurriyyatahum wamaa alatnaahum min 'amalihim min shay', kullumri'im bimaa kasaba raheen
map.52:23: Yatanaaza'oona feehaa ka'sal laa laghwun feehaa walaa ta'theem
map.52:24: Wayatoofu 'alayhim ghilmaanul lahum ka'annahum lu'lu'um maknoon
map.52:26: Qaaloo innaa kunnaa qablu fee ahlinaa mushfiqeen
map.52:28: Innaa kunnaa min qablu nad'ooh, innahoo huwal-barrur-raheem
map.52:29: Fadhakkir famaa anta bini'mati rabbika bikaahiniw walaa majnoon
map.52:30: Am yaqooloona shaa'irun natarabbasu bihee raybal-manoon
map.52:32: Am ta'muruhum ahlaamuhum bihaadhaa am hum qawmun taaghoon
map.52:33: Am yaqooloona taqawwalah, bal laa yu'minoon
map.52:34: Falya'too bihadeethim mithlihee in kaanoo saadiqeen
map.52:35: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shay'in am humul-khaaliqoon
map.52:36: Am khalaqus-samaawaati wal-ard, bal laa yooqinoon
map.52:38: Am lahum sullamuy yastami'oona feeh, falya'ti mustami'uhum bisultaanim mubeen
map.52:40: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim muthqaloon
map.52:42: Am yureedoona kaydaa, fal-ladheena kafaroo humul-makeedoon
map.52:43: Am lahum ilaahun ghayrullaah, subhaanallaahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.52:44: Wa'iy yaraw kisfam minas-samaa'i saaqitay yaqooloo sahaabum markoom
map.52:45: Fadharhum hattaa yulaaqoo yawmahumul-ladhee feehi yus'aqoon
map.52:46: Yawma laa yughnee 'anhum kayduhum shay'aw walaa hum yunsaroon
map.52:47: Wa'inna lilladheena zalamoo 'adhaaban doona dhaalika walaakinna aktharahum laa ya'lamoon
map.52:48: Wasbir lihukmi rabbika fa'innaka bi'a'yuninaa wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoom
