map.57:1: Sabbaha lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.57:2: Lahoo mulkus-samaawaati wal-ard, yuhyee wayumeet, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.57:3: Huwal-awwalu wal-aakhiru waz-zaahiru wal-baatin, wahuwa bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.57:4: Huwal-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arsh, ya'lamu maa yaliju fil-ardi wamaa yakhruju minhaa wamaa yanzilu minas-samaa'i wamaa ya'ruju feehaa, wahuwa ma'akum ayna maa kuntum, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.57:6: Yoolijul-layla fin-nahaari wayoolijun-nahaara fil-layl, wahuwa 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.57:7: Aaminoo billaahi warasoolihee wa'anfiqoo mimmaa ja'alakum mustakhlafeena feeh, fal-ladheena aamanoo minkum wa'anfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeer
map.57:8: Wamaa lakum laa tu'minoona billaah, war-rasoolu yad'ookum litu'minoo birabbikum waqad akhadha meethaaqakum in kuntum mu'mineen
map.57:9: Huwal-ladhee yunazzilu 'alaa 'abdihee aayaatim bayyinaatil liyukhrijakum minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wa'innallaaha bikum lara'oofur raheem
map.57:10: Wamaa lakum allaa tunfiqoo fee sabeelillaahi walillaahi meeraathus-samaawaati wal-ard, laa yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qablil-fathi waqaatal, ulaa'ika a'zamu darajatam minal-ladheena anfaqoo mim ba'du waqaataloo, wakullaw wa'adallaahul-husnaa, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.57:11: Man dhal-ladhee yuqridullaaha qardan hasanan fayudaa'ifahoo lahoo walahoo ajrun kareem
map.57:12: Yawma taral-mu'mineena wal-mu'minaati yas'aa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabi'aymaanihim bushraakumul-yawma jannaatun tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, dhaalika huwal-fawzul-'azeem
map.57:13: Yawma yaqoolul-munaafiqoona wal-munaafiqaatu lilladheena aamanunzuroonaa naqtabis min noorikum, qeelarji'oo waraa'akum fal-tamisoo nooraa, faduriba baynahum bisooril lahoo baab, baatinuhoo feehir-rahmatu wazaahiruhoo min qibalihil-'adhaab
map.57:14: Yunaadoonahum alam nakum ma'akum, qaaloo balaa walaakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wartabtum wagharratkumul-amaaniyyu hattaa jaa'a amrullaahi wagharrakum billaahil-gharoor
map.57:15: Fal-yawma laa yu'khadhu minkum fidyatuw walaa minal-ladheena kafaroo, ma'waakumun-naar, hiya mawlaakum, wabi'sal-maseer
map.57:16: Alam ya'ni lilladheena aamanoo an takhsha'a quloobuhum lidhikrillaahi wamaa nazala minal-haqqi walaa yakoonoo kal-ladheena ootul-kitaaba min qablu fataala 'alayhimul-amadu faqasat quloobuhum, wakatheerum minhum faasiqoon
map.57:17: I'lamoo annallaaha yuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa, qad bayyannaa lakumul-aayaati la'allakum ta'qiloon
map.57:18: Innal-mussaddiqeena wal-mussaddiqaati wa'aqradullaaha qardan hasanay yudaa'afu lahum walahum ajrun kareem
map.57:19: Wal-ladheena aamanoo billaahi warusulihee ulaa'ika humus-siddeeqoon, wash-shuhadaa'u 'inda rabbihim, lahum ajruhum wanooruhum, wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabul-jaheem
map.57:20: I'lamoo annamal-hayaatud-dunyaa la'ibuw walahwuw wazeenatuw watafaakhurum baynakum watakaathurun fil-amwaali wal-awlaad, kamathali ghaythin a'jabal-kuffaara nabaatuhoo thumma yaheeju fataraahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaamaa, wafil-aakhirati 'adhaabun shadeeduw wamaghfiratum minallaahi waridwaan, wamal-hayaatud-dunyaa illaa mataa'ul-ghuroor
map.57:21: Saabiqoo ilaa maghfiratim mir rabbikum wajannatin 'arduhaa ka'ardis-samaa'i wal-ardi u'iddat lilladheena aamanoo billaahi warusulih, dhaalika fadlullaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-'azeem
map.57:22: Maa asaaba mim museebatin fil-ardi walaa fee anfusikum illaa fee kitaabim min qabli an nabra'ahaa, inna dhaalika 'alallaahi yaseer
map.57:23: Likaylaa ta'saw 'alaa maa faatakum walaa tafrahoo bimaa aataakum, wallaahu laa yuhibbu kulla mukhtaalin fakhoor
map.57:24: Al-ladheena yabkhaloona waya'muroonan-naasa bil-bukhl, wamay yatawalla fa'innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
map.57:25: Laqad arsalnaa rusulanaa bil-bayyinaati wa'anzalnaa ma'ahumul-kitaaba wal-meezaana liyaqooman-naasu bil-qist, wa'anzalnal-hadeeda feehi ba'sun shadeeduw wamanaafi'u lin-naasi waliya'lamallaahu may yansuruhoo warusulahoo bil-ghayb, innallaaha qawiyyun 'azeez
map.57:26: Walaqad arsalnaa noohaw wa'ibraaheema waja'alnaa fee dhurriyyatihiman-nubuwwata wal-kitaaba faminhum muhtad, wakatheerum minhum faasiqoon
map.57:27: Thumma qaffaynaa 'alaa aathaarihim birusulinaa waqaffaynaa bi'eesabni maryama wa'aataynaahul-injeela waja'alnaa fee quloobil-ladheenattaba'oohu ra'fataw warahmah, warahbaaniyyatanibtada'oohaa maa katabnaahaa 'alayhim illabtighaa'a ridwaanillaahi famaa ra'awhaa haqqa ri'aayatihaa, fa'aataynal-ladheena aamanoo minhum ajrahum, wakatheerum minhum faasiqoon
map.57:28: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha wa'aaminoo birasoolihee yu'tikum kiflayni mir rahmatihee wayaj'al lakum nooran tamshoona bihee wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.57:29: Li'allaa ya'lama ahlul-kitaabi allaa yaqdiroona 'alaa shay'im min fadlillaahi wa'annal-fadla biyadillaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-'azeem
map.58:1: Qad sami'allaahu qawlal-latee tujaadiluka fee zawjihaa watashtakee ilallaah, wallaahu yasma'u tahaawurakumaa, innallaaha samee'um baseer
map.58:2: Alladheena yuzaahiroona minkum min nisaa'ihim maa hunna ummahaatihim, in ummahaatuhum illallaa'ee waladnahum, wa'innahum layaqooloona munkaram minal-qawli wazooraa, wa'innallaaha la'afuwwun ghafoor
map.58:3: Wal-ladheena yuzaahiroona min nisaa'ihim thumma ya'oodoona limaa qaaloo fatahreeru raqabatim min qabli ay yatamaassaa, dhaalikum too'azoona bih, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.58:4: Famal lam yajid fasiyaamu shahrayni mutataabi'ayni min qabli ay yatamaassaa, famal lam yastati' fa'it'aamu sitteena miskeenaa, dhaalika litu'minoo billaahi warasoolih, watilka hudoodullaah, walilkaafireena 'adhaabun aleem
map.58:5: Innal-ladheena yuhaaddoonallaaha warasoolahoo kubitoo kamaa kubital-ladheena min qablihim waqad anzalnaa aayaatim bayyinaat, walilkaafireena 'adhaabum muheen
map.58:6: Yawma yab'athuhumullaahu jamee'an fayunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo, ahsaahullaahu wanasooh, wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in shaheed
map.58:7: Alam tara annallaaha ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, maa yakoonu min najwaa thalaathatin illaa huwa raabi'uhum walaa khamsatin illaa huwa saadisuhum walaa adnaa min dhaalika walaa akthara illaa huwa ma'ahum ayna maa kaanoo, thumma yunabbi'uhum bimaa 'amiloo yawmal-qiyaamah, innallaaha bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.58:8: Alam tara ilal-ladheena nuhoo 'anin-najwaa thumma ya'oodoona limaa nuhoo 'anhu wayatanaajawna bil-ithmi wal-'udwaani wama'siyatir-rasool, wa'idhaa jaa'ooka hayyawka bimaa lam yuhayyika bihillaahu wayaqooloona fee anfusihim lawlaa yu'adhdhibunallaahu bimaa naqool, hasbuhum jahannam, yaslawnahaa, fabi'sal-maseer
map.58:9: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa tanaajaytum falaa tatanaajaw bil-ithmi wal-'udwaani wama'siyatir-rasooli watanaajaw bil-birri wat-taqwaa, wattaqullaahal-ladhee ilayhi tuhsharoon
map.58:10: Innaman-najwaa minash-shaytaani liyahzunal-ladheena aamanoo walaysa bidaarrihim shay'an illaa bi'idhnillaah, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.58:11: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa qeela lakum tafassahoo fil-majaalisi fafsahoo yafsahillaahu lakum, wa'idhaa qeelanshuzoo fanshuzoo yarfa'illaahul-ladheena aamanoo minkum wal-ladheena ootul-'ilma darajaat, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.58:12: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa naajaytumur-rasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqah, dhaalika khayrul lakum wa'athar, fa'il lam tajidoo fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.58:13: A'ashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwaakum sadaqaat, fa'idh lam taf'aloo wataaballaahu 'alaykum fa'aqeemus-salaata wa'aatuz-zakaata wa'atee'ullaaha warasoolah, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.58:14: Alam tara ilal-ladheena tawallaw qawman ghadiballaahu 'alayhim, maa hum minkum walaa minhum wayahlifoona 'alal-kadhibi wahum ya'lamoon
map.58:15: A'addallaahu lahum 'adhaaban shadeedaa, innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.58:16: Ittakhadhoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo 'an sabeelillaahi falahum 'adhaabum muheen
map.58:17: Lan tughniya 'anhum amwaaluhum walaa awlaaduhum minallaahi shay'aa, ulaa'ika ashaabun-naar, hum feehaa khaalidoon
map.58:18: Yawma yab'athuhumullaahu jamee'an fayahlifoona lahoo kamaa yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona annahum 'alaa shay', alaa innahum humul-kaadhiboon
map.58:19: Istahwadha 'alayhimush-shaytaanu fa'ansaahum dhikrallaah, ulaa'ika hizbush-shaytaan, alaa inna hizbash-shaytaani humul-khaasiroon
map.58:21: Kataballaahu la'aghlibanna ana warusulee, innallaaha qawiyyun 'azeez
map.58:22: Laa tajidu qawmay yu'minoona billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhiri yuwaaddoona man haaddallaaha warasoolahoo walaw kaanoo aabaa'ahum aw abnaa'ahum aw ikhwaanahum aw 'asheeratahum, ulaa'ika kataba fee quloobihimul-eemaana wa'ayyadahum biroohim minh, wayudkhiluhum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa, radiyallaahu 'anhum waradoo 'anh, ulaa'ika hizbullaah, alaa inna hizballaahi humul-muflihoon
map.59:1: Sabbaha lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.59:2: Huwal-ladhee akhrajal-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi min diyaarihim li'awwalil-hashr, maa zanantum ay yakhrujoo wazannoo annahum maani'atuhum husoonuhum minallaahi fa'ataahumullaahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo waqadhafa fee quloobihimur-ru'ba yukhriboona buyootahum bi'aydeehim wa'aydil-mu'mineena fa'tabiroo yaa ulil-absaar
map.59:3: Walawlaa an kataballaahu 'alayhimul-jalaa'a la'adhdhabahum fid-dunyaa, walahum fil-aakhirati 'adhaabun-naar
map.59:4: Dhaalika bi'annahum shaaqqullaaha warasoolah, wamay yushaaqqillaaha fa'innallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.59:5: Maa qata'tum mil leenatin aw taraktumoohaa qaa'imatan 'alaa usoolihaa fabi'idhnillaahi waliyukhziyal-faasiqeen
map.59:6: Wamaa afaa'allaahu 'alaa rasoolihee minhum famaa awjaftum 'alayhi min khayliw walaa rikaabiw walaakinnallaaha yusallitu rusulahoo 'alaa may yashaa', wallaahu 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.59:7: Maa afaa'allaahu 'alaa rasoolihee min ahlil-quraa falillaahi walir-rasooli walidhil-qurbaa wal-yataamaa wal-masaakeeni wabnis-sabeeli kay laa yakoona doolatam baynal-aghniyaa'i minkum, wamaa aataakumur-rasoolu fakhudhoohu wamaa nahaakum 'anhu fantah, wattaqullaah, innallaaha shadeedul-'iqaab
map.59:8: Lil-fuqaraa'il-muhaajireenal-ladheena ukhrijoo min diyaarihim wa'amwaalihim yabtaghoona fadlam minallaahi waridwaanaw wayansuroonallaaha warasoolah, ulaa'ika humus-saadiqoon
map.59:9: Wal-ladheena tabawwa'ud-daara wal-eemaana min qablihim yuhibboona man haajara ilayhim walaa yajidoona fee sudoorihim haajatam mimmaa ootoo wayu'thiroona 'alaa anfusihim walaw kaana bihim khasaasah, wamay yooqa shuhha nafsihee fa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.59:10: Wal-ladheena jaa'oo mim ba'dihim yaqooloona rabbanaghfir lanaa wali'ikhwaaninal-ladheena sabaqoonaa bil-eemaani walaa taj'al fee quloobinaa ghillal lilladheena aamanoo rabbanaa innaka ra'oofur raheem
map.59:11: Alam tara ilal-ladheena naafaqoo yaqooloona li'ikhwaanihimul-ladheena kafaroo min ahlil-kitaabi la'in ukhrijtum lanakhrujanna ma'akum walaa nutee'u feekum ahadan abadaw wa'in qootiltum lanansurannakum, wallaahu yashhadu innahum lakaadhiboon
map.59:12: La'in ukhrijoo laa yakhrujoona ma'ahum, wala'in qootiloo laa yansuroonahum, wala'in nasaroohum layuwallunnal-adbaara thumma laa yunsaroon
map.59:13: La'antum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim minallaah, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa yafqahoon
map.59:14: Laa yuqaatiloonakum jamee'an illaa fee quram muhassanatin aw miw waraa'i judur, ba'suhum baynahum shadeed, tahsabuhum jamee'aw waquloobuhum shattaa, dhaalika bi'annahum qawmul laa ya'qiloon
map.59:15: Kamathalil-ladheena min qablihim qareeban dhaaqoo wabaala amrihim, walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.59:16: Kamathalish-shaytaani idh qaala lil-insaanikfur, falammaa kafara qaala innee baree'um minka innee akhaafullaaha rabbal-'aalameen
map.59:17: Fakaana 'aaqibatahumaa annahumaa fin-naari khaalidayni feehaa, wadhaalika jazaa'uz-zaalimeen
map.59:18: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanuttaqullaaha waltanzur nafsum maa qaddamat lighad, wattaqullaah, innallaaha khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.59:19: Walaa takoonoo kal-ladheena nasullaaha fa'ansaahum anfusahum, ulaa'ika humul-faasiqoon
map.59:20: Laa yastawee ashaabun-naari wa'ashaabul-jannah, ashaabul-jannati humul-faa'izoon
map.59:21: Law anzalnaa haadhal-qur'aana 'alaa jabalil lara'aytahoo khaashi'am mutasaddi'am min khashyatillaah, watilkal-amthaalu nadribuhaa lin-naasi la'allahum yatafakkaroon
map.59:22: Huwallaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, 'aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadah, huwar-rahmaanur-raheem
map.59:23: Huwallaahul-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa huw, al-malikul-quddoosus-salaamul-mu'minul-muhayminul-'azeezul-jabbaarul-mutakabbir, subhaanallaahi 'ammaa yushrikoon
map.59:24: Huwallaahul-khaaliqul-baari'ul-musawwiru lahul-asmaa'ul-husnaa, yusabbihu lahoo maa fis-samaawaati wal-ard, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.60:1: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tattakhidhoo 'aduwwee wa'aduwwakum awliyaa'a tulqoona ilayhim bil-mawaddati waqad kafaroo bimaa jaa'akum minal-haqq, yukhrijoonar-rasoola wa'iyyaakum an tu'minoo billaahi rabbikum, in kuntum kharajtum jihaadan fee sabeelee wabtighaa'a mardaatee tusirroona ilayhim bil-mawaddati wa'ana a'lamu bimaa akhfaytum wamaa a'lantum, wamay yaf'alhu minkum faqad dalla sawaa'as-sabeel
map.60:2: Iy yathqafookum yakoonoo lakum a'daa'aw wayabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum wa'alsinatahum bis-soo'i wawaddoo law takfuroon
map.60:3: Lan tanfa'akum arhaamukum walaa awlaadukum yawmal-qiyaamah, yafsilu baynakum, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.60:4: Qad kaanat lakum uswatun hasanatun fee ibraaheema wal-ladheena ma'ah, idh qaaloo liqawmihim innaa bura'aa'u minkum wamimmaa ta'budoona min doonillaah, kafarnaa bikum wabadaa baynanaa wabaynakumul-'adaawatu wal-baghdaa'u abadan hattaa tu'minoo billaahi wahdahoo illaa qawla ibraaheema li'abeehi la'astaghfiranna laka wamaa amliku laka minallaahi min shay', rabbanaa 'alayka tawakkalnaa wa'ilayka anabnaa wa'ilaykal-maseer
map.60:5: Rabbanaa laa taj'alnaa fitnatal lilladheena kafaroo waghfir lanaa rabbanaa, innaka antal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.60:6: Laqad kaana lakum feehim uswatun hasanatul liman kaana yarjullaaha wal-yawmal-aakhir, wamay yatawalla fa'innallaaha huwal-ghaniyyul-hameed
map.60:7: 'Asallaahu ay yaj'ala baynakum wabaynal-ladheena 'aadaytum minhum mawaddah, wallaahu qadeer, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.60:8: Laa yanhaakumullaahu 'anil-ladheena lam yuqaatilookum fid-deeni walam yukhrijookum min diyaarikum an tabarroohum watuqsitoo ilayhim, innallaaha yuhibbul-muqsiteen
map.60:9: Innamaa yanhaakumullaahu 'anil-ladheena qaatalookum fid-deeni wa'akhrajookum min diyaarikum wazaaharoo 'alaa ikhraajikum an tawallawhum, wamay yatawallahum fa'ulaa'ika humuz-zaalimoon
map.60:10: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa jaa'akumul-mu'minaatu muhaajiraatin famtahinoohunn, allaahu a'lamu bi'eemaanihinna fa'in 'alimtumoohunna mu'minaatin falaa tarji'oohunna ilal-kuffaar, laa hunna hillul lahum walaa hum yahilloona lahunn, wa'aatoohum maa anfaqoo, walaa junaaha 'alaykum an tankihoohunna idhaa aataytumoohunna ujoorahunn, walaa tumsikoo bi'isamil-kawaafiri was'aloo maa anfaqtum walyas'aloo maa anfaqoo, dhaalikum hukmullaah, yahkumu baynakum, wallaahu 'aleemun hakeem
map.60:11: Wa'in faatakum shay'um min azwaajikum ilal-kuffaari fa'aaqabtum fa'aatul-ladheena dhahabat azwaajuhum mithla maa anfaqoo, wattaqullaahal-ladhee antum bihee mu'minoon
map.60:12: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu idhaa jaa'akal-mu'minaatu yubaayi'naka 'alaa al laa yushrikna billaahi shay'aw walaa yasriqna walaa yazneena walaa yaqtulna awlaadahunna walaa ya'teena bibuhtaaniy yaftareenahoo bayna aydeehinna wa'arjulihinna walaa ya'seenaka fee ma'roofin fabaayi'hunna wastaghfir lahunnallaah, innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.60:13: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tatawallaw qawman ghadiballaahu 'alayhim qad ya'isoo minal-aakhirati kamaa ya'isal-kuffaaru min ashaabil-quboor
map.61:1: Sabbaha lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.61:2: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo lima taqooloona maa laa taf'aloon
map.61:3: Kabura maqtan 'indallaahi an taqooloo maa laa taf'aloon
map.61:4: Innallaaha yuhibbul-ladheena yuqaatiloona fee sabeelihee saffan ka'annahum bunyaanum marsoos
map.61:5: Wa'idh qaala moosaa liqawmihee yaaqawmi lima tu'dhoonanee waqat ta'lamoona annee rasoolullaahi ilaykum, falammaa zaaghoo azaaghallaahu quloobahum, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
map.61:6: Wa'idh qaala 'eesabnu maryama yaabanee israa'eela innee rasoolullaahi ilaykum musaddiqal limaa bayna yadayya minat-tawraati wamubashshiram birasooliy ya'tee mim ba'dismuhoo ahmad, falammaa jaa'ahum bil-bayyinaati qaaloo haadhaa sihrum mubeen
map.61:7: Waman azlamu mimmaniftaraa 'alallaahil-kadhiba wahuwa yud'aa ilal-islaam, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.61:8: Yureedoona liyutfi'oo noorallaahi bi'afwaahihim, wallaahu mutimmu noorihee walaw karihal-kaafiroon
map.61:9: Huwal-ladhee arsala rasoolahoo bil-hudaa wadeenil-haqqi liyuzhirahoo 'alad-deeni kullihee walaw karihal-mushrikoon
map.61:10: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo hal adullukum 'alaa tijaaratin tunjeekum min 'adhaabin aleem
map.61:11: Tu'minoona billaahi warasoolihee watujaahidoona fee sabeelillaahi bi'amwaalikum wa'anfusikum, dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.61:12: Yaghfir lakum dhunoobakum wayudkhilkum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru wamasaakina tayyibatan fee jannaati 'adn, dhaalikal-fawzul-'azeem
map.61:13: Wa'ukhraa tuhibboonahaa, nasrum minallaahi wafathun qareeb, wabashshiril-mu'mineen
map.61:14: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo koonoo ansaarallaahi kamaa qaala 'eesabnu maryama lil-hawaariyyeena man ansaaree ilallaah, qaalal-hawaariyyoona nahnu ansaarullaahi fa'aamanat taa'ifatum mim banee israa'eela wakafarat taa'ifah, fa'ayyadnal-ladheena aamanoo 'alaa 'aduwwihim fa'asbahoo zaahireen
map.62:2: Huwal-ladhee ba'atha fil-ummiyyeena rasoolam minhum yatloo 'alayhim aayaatihee wayuzakkeehim wayu'allimuhumul-kitaaba wal-hikmata wa'in kaanoo min qablu lafee dalaalim mubeen
map.62:3: Wa'aakhareena minhum lammaa yalhaqoo bihim, wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
map.62:4: Dhaalika fadlullaahi yu'teehi may yashaa', wallaahu dhul-fadlil-'azeem
map.62:5: Mathalul-ladheena hummilut-tawraata thumma lam yahmiloohaa kamathalil-himaari yahmilu asfaaraa, bi'sa mathalul-qawmil-ladheena kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaah, wallaahu laa yahdil-qawmaz-zaalimeen
map.62:6: Qul yaa ayyuhal-ladheena haadoo in za'amtum annakum awliyaa'u lillaahi min doonin-naasi fatamannawul-mawta in kuntum saadiqeen
map.62:7: Walaa yatamannawnahoo abadam bimaa qaddamat aydeehim, wallaahu 'aleemum biz-zaalimeen
map.62:8: Qul innal-mawtal-ladhee tafirroona minhu fa'innahoo mulaaqeekum thumma turaddoona ilaa 'aalimil-ghaybi wash-shahaadati fayunabbi'ukum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
map.62:9: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo idhaa noodiya lis-salaati miy yawmil-jumu'ati fas'aw ilaa dhikrillaahi wadharul-bay', dhaalikum khayrul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
map.62:10: Fa'idhaa qudiyatis-salaatu fantashiroo fil-ardi wabtaghoo min fadlillaahi wadhkurullaaha katheeral la'allakum tuflihoon
map.62:11: Wa'idhaa ra'aw tijaaratan aw lahwaninfaddoo ilayhaa watarakooka qaa'imaa, qul maa 'indallaahi khayrum minal-lahwi waminat-tijaarah, wallaahu khayrur-raaziqeen
map.63:1: Idhaa jaa'akal-munaafiqoona qaaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolullaah, wallaahu ya'lamu innaka larasooluh, wallaahu yashhadu innal-munaafiqeena lakaadhiboon
map.63:2: Ittakhadhoo aymaanahum junnatan fasaddoo 'an sabeelillaah, innahum saa'a maa kaanoo ya'maloon
map.63:3: Dhaalika bi'annahum aamanoo thumma kafaroo fatubi'a 'alaa quloobihim fahum laa yafqahoon
map.63:4: Wa'idhaa ra'aytahum tu'jibuka ajsaamuhum, wa'iy yaqooloo tasma' liqawlihim, ka'annahum khushubum musannadah, yahsaboona kulla sayhatin 'alayhim, humul-'aduwwu fahdharhum, qaatalahumullaah, annaa yu'fakoon
map.63:5: Wa'idhaa qeela lahum ta'aalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolullaahi lawwaw ru'oosahum wara'aytahum yasuddoona wahum mustakbiroon
map.63:6: Sawaa'un 'alayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum, lay yaghfirallaahu lahum, innallaaha laa yahdil-qawmal-faasiqeen
map.63:7: Humul-ladheena yaqooloona laa tunfiqoo 'alaa man 'inda rasoolillaahi hattaa yanfaddoo, walillaahi khazaa'inus-samaawaati wal-ardi walaakinnal-munaafiqeena laa yafqahoon
map.63:8: Yaqooloona la'ir raja'naa ilal-madeenati layukhrijannal-a'azzu minhal-adhall, walillaahil-'izzatu walirasoolihee walilmu'mineena walaakinnal-munaafiqeena laa ya'lamoon
map.63:9: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo laa tulhikum amwaalukum walaa awlaadukum 'an dhikrillaah, wamay yaf'al dhaalika fa'ulaa'ika humul-khaasiroon
map.63:10: Wa'anfiqoo mim maa razaqnaakum min qabli ay ya'tiya ahadakumul-mawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawlaa akhkhartanee ilaa ajalin qareeb, fa'assaddaqa wa'akum minas-saaliheen
map.63:11: Walay yu'akhkhirallaahu nafsan idhaa jaa'a ajaluhaa, wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
map.64:1: Yusabbihu lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wamaa fil-ard, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.64:2: Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum faminkum kaafiruw waminkum mu'min, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona baseer
map.64:3: Khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda bil-haqqi wasawwarakum fa'ahsana suwarakum, wa'ilayhil-maseer
map.64:4: Ya'lamu maa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi waya'lamu maa tusirroona wamaa tu'linoon, wallaahu 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.64:5: Alam ya'tikum naba'ul-ladheena kafaroo min qabl, fadhaaqoo wabaala amrihim walahum 'adhaabun aleem
map.64:6: Dhaalika bi'annahoo kaanat ta'teehim rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati faqaaloo abasharuy yahdoonanaa, fakafaroo watawallaw wastaghnallaah, wallaahu ghaniyyun hameed
map.64:7: Za'amal-ladheena kafaroo al lay yub'athoo, qul balaa warabbee latub'athunna thumma latunabba'unna bimaa 'amiltum, wadhaalika 'alallaahi yaseer
map.64:8: Fa'aaminoo billaahi warasoolihee wan-nooril-ladhee anzalnaa, wallaahu bimaa ta'maloona khabeer
map.64:9: Yawma yajma'ukum liyawmil-jam'i dhaalika yawmut-taghaabun, wamay yu'mim billaahi waya'mal saalihay yukaffir 'anhu sayyi'aatihee wayudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, dhaalikal-fawzul-'azeem
map.64:10: Wal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa ulaa'ika ashaabun-naari khaalideena feehaa, wabi'sal-maseer
map.64:11: Maa asaaba mim museebatin illaa bi'idhnillaah, wamay yu'mim billaahi yahdi qalbah, wallaahu bikulli shay'in 'aleem
map.64:12: Wa'atee'ullaaha wa'atee'ur-rasool, fa'in tawallaytum fa'innamaa 'alaa rasoolinal-balaaghul-mubeen
map.64:13: Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa huw, wa'alallaahi falyatawakkalil-mu'minoon
map.64:14: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo inna min azwaajikum wa'awlaadikum 'aduwwal lakum fahdharoohum, wa'in ta'foo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fa'innallaaha ghafoorur raheem
map.64:15: Innamaa amwaalukum wa'awlaadukum fitnah, wallaahu 'indahoo ajrun 'azeem
map.64:16: Fattaqullaaha mastata'tum wasma'oo wa'atee'oo wa'anfiqoo khayral li'anfusikum, wamay yooqa shuhha nafsihee fa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
map.64:17: In tuqridullaaha qardan hasanay yudaa'ifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum, wallaahu shakoorun haleem
map.65:1: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu idhaa tallaqtumun-nisaa'a fatalliqoohunna li'iddatihinna wa'ahsul-'iddah, wattaqullaaha rabbakum, laa tukhrijoohunna mim buyootihinna walaa yakhrujna illaa ay ya'teena bifaahishatim mubayyinah, watilka hudoodullaah, wamay yata'adda hudoodallaahi faqad zalama nafsah, laa tadree la'allallaaha yuhdithu ba'da dhaalika amraa
map.65:2: Fa'idhaa balaghna ajalahunna fa'amsikoohunna bima'roofin aw faariqoohunna bima'roofiw wa'ashhidoo dhaway 'adlim minkum wa'aqeemush-shahaadata lillaah, dhaalikum yoo'azu bihee man kaana yu'minu billaahi wal-yawmil-aakhir, wamay yattaqillaaha yaj'al lahoo makhrajaa
map.65:3: Wayarzuqhu min haythu laa yahtasib, wamay yatawakkal 'alallaahi fahuwa hasbuh, innallaaha baalighu amrih, qad ja'alallaahu likulli shay'in qadraa
map.65:4: Wallaa'ee ya'isna minal-maheedi min nisaa'ikum inirtabtum fa'iddatuhunna thalaathatu ashhuriw wallaa'ee lam yahidn, wa'ulaatul-ahmaali ajaluhunna ay yada'na hamlahunn, wamay yattaqillaaha yaj'al lahoo min amrihee yusraa
map.65:5: Dhaalika amrullaahi anzalahoo ilaykum, wamay yattaqillaaha yukaffir 'anhu sayyi'aatihee wayu'zim lahoo ajraa
map.65:6: Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum miw wujdikum walaa tudaarroohunna litudayyiqoo 'alayhinn, wa'in kunna ulaati hamlin fa'anfiqoo 'alayhinna hattaa yada'na hamlahunn, fa'in arda'na lakum fa'aatoohunna ujoorahunn, wa'tamiroo baynakum bima'roof, wa'in ta'aasartum fasaturdi'u lahoo ukhraa
map.65:7: Liyunfiq dhoo sa'atim min sa'atih, waman qudira 'alayhi rizquhoo falyunfiq mimmaa aataahullaah, laa yukallifullaahu nafsan illaa maa aataahaa, sayaj'alullaahu ba'da 'usriy yusraa
map.65:8: Waka'ayyim min qaryatin 'atat 'an amri rabbihaa warusulihee fahaasabnaahaa hisaaban shadeedaw wa'adhdhabnaahaa 'adhaaban nukraa
map.65:9: Fadhaaqat wabaala amrihaa wakaana 'aaqibatu amrihaa khusraa
map.65:10: A'addallaahu lahum 'adhaaban shadeedan fattaqullaaha yaa ulil-albaabil-ladheena aamanoo, qad anzalallaahu ilaykum dhikraa
map.65:11: Rasoolay yatloo 'alaykum aayaatillaahi mubayyinaatil liyukhrijal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati minaz-zulumaati ilan-noor, wamay yu'mim billaahi waya'mal saalihay yudkhilhu jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru khaalideena feehaa abadaa, qad ahsanallaahu lahoo rizqaa
map.65:12: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatiw waminal-ardi mithlahunn, yatanazzalul-amru baynahunna lita'lamoo annallaaha 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeeruw wa'annallaaha qad ahaata bikulli shay'in 'ilmaa
map.66:1: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu lima tuharrimu maa ahallallaahu lak, tabtaghee mardaata azwaajik, wallaahu ghafoorur raheem
map.66:2: Qad faradallaahu lakum tahillata aymaanikum, wallaahu mawlaakum, wahuwal-'aleemul-hakeem
map.66:3: Wa'idh asarran-nabiyyu ilaa ba'di azwaajihee hadeethaa, falammaa nabba'at bihee wa'azharahullaahu 'alayhi 'arrafa ba'dahoo wa'a'rada 'am ba'd, falammaa nabba'ahaa bihee qaalat man amba'aka haadhaa, qaala nabba'aniyal-'aleemul-khabeer
map.66:4: In tatoobaa ilallaahi faqad saghat quloobukumaa, wa'in tazaaharaa 'alayhi fa'innallaaha huwa mawlaahu wajibreelu wasaalihul-mu'mineen, wal-malaa'ikatu ba'da dhaalika zaheer
map.66:5: 'Asaa rabbuhoo in tallaqakunna ay yubdilahoo azwaajan khayram minkunna muslimaatim mu'minaatin qaanitaatin taa'ibaatin 'aabidaatin saa'ihaatin thayyibaatiw wa'abkaaraa
map.66:6: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo qoo anfusakum wa'ahleekum naaraw waqooduhan-naasu wal-hijaaratu 'alayhaa malaa'ikatun ghilaazun shidaadul laa ya'soonallaaha maa amarahum wayaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
map.66:7: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena kafaroo laa ta'tadhirul-yawm, innamaa tujzawna maa kuntum ta'maloon
map.66:8: Yaa ayyuhal-ladheena aamanoo tooboo ilallaahi tawbatan nasoohaa, 'asaa rabbukum ay yukaffira 'ankum sayyi'aatikum wayudkhilakum jannaatin tajree min tahtihal-anhaaru yawma laa yukhzillaahun-nabiyya wal-ladheena aamanoo ma'ah, nooruhum yas'aa bayna aydeehim wabi'aymaanihim yaqooloona rabbanaa atmim lanaa nooranaa waghfir lanaa, innaka 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.66:9: Yaa ayyuhan-nabiyyu jaahidil-kuffaara wal-munaafiqeena waghluz 'alayhim, wama'waahum jahannam, wabi'sal-maseer
map.66:10: Daraballaahu mathalal lilladheena kafarumra'ata noohiw wamra'ata loot, kaanataa tahta 'abdayni min 'ibaadinaa saalihayni fakhaanataahumaa falam yughniyaa 'anhumaa minallaahi shay'aw waqeeladkhulan-naara ma'ad-daakhileen
map.66:11: Wadaraballaahu mathalal lilladheena aamanumra'ata fir'awn, idh qaalat rabbibni lee 'indaka baytan fil-jannati wanajjinee min fir'awna wa'amalihee wanajjinee minal-qawmiz-zaalimeen
map.66:12: Wamaryamabnata 'imraanal-latee ahsanat farjahaa fanafakhnaa feehi mir roohinaa wasaddaqat bikalimaati rabbihaa wakutubihee wakaanat minal-qaaniteen
map.67:1: Tabaarakal-ladhee biyadihil-mulk, wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
map.67:2: Al-ladhee khalaqal-mawta wal-hayaata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu 'amalaa, wahuwal-'azeezul-ghafoor
map.67:3: Al-ladhee khalaqa sab'a samaawaatin tibaaqaa, maa taraa fee khalqir-rahmaani min tafaawut, farji'il-basara hal taraa min futoor
map.67:4: Thummarji'il-basara karratayni yanqalib ilaykal-basaru khaasi'aw wahuwa haseer
map.67:5: Walaqad zayyannas-samaa'ad-dunyaa bimasaabeeha waja'alnaahaa rujoomal lish-shayaateeni wa'a'tadnaa lahum 'adhaabas-sa'eer
map.67:7: Idhaa ulqoo feehaa sami'oo lahaa shaheeqaw wahiya tafoor
map.67:8: Takaadu tamayyazu minal-ghayz, kullamaa ulqiya feehaa fawjun sa'alahum khazanatuhaa alam ya'tikum nadheer
map.67:9: Qaaloo balaa qad jaa'anaa nadheerun fakadhdhabnaa waqulnaa maa nazzalallaahu min shay', in antum illaa fee dalaalin kabeer
map.67:10: Waqaaloo law kunnaa nasma'u aw na'qilu maa kunnaa fee ashaabis-sa'eer
map.67:12: Innal-ladheena yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi lahum maghfiratuw wa'ajrun kabeer
map.67:13: Wa'asirroo qawlakum awijharoo bih, innahoo 'aleemum bidhaatis-sudoor
map.67:15: Huwal-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda dhaloolan famshoo fee manaakibihaa wakuloo mir rizqih, wa'ilayhin-nushoor
map.67:16: A'amintum man fis-samaa'i ay yakhsifa bikumul-arda fa'idhaa hiya tamoor
map.67:17: Am amintum man fis-samaa'i ay yursila 'alaykum haasibaa, fasata'lamoona kayfa nadheer
map.67:18: Walaqad kadhdhabal-ladheena min qablihim fakayfa kaana nakeer
map.67:19: Awalam yaraw ilat-tayri fawqahum saaffaatiw wayaqbidn, maa yumsikuhunna illar-rahmaan, innahoo bikulli shay'im baseer
map.67:20: Amman haadhal-ladhee huwa jundul lakum yansurukum min doonir-rahmaan, inil-kaafiroona illaa fee ghuroor
map.67:21: Amman haadhal-ladhee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqah, bal lajjoo fee 'utuwwiw wanufoor
map.67:22: Afamay yamshee mukibban 'alaa wajhihee ahdaa ammay yamshee sawiyyan 'alaa siraatim mustaqeem
map.67:23: Qul huwal-ladhee ansha'akum waja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idah, qaleelam maa tashkuroon
map.67:24: Qul huwal-ladhee dhara'akum fil-ardi wa'ilayhi tuhsharoon
map.67:25: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
map.67:26: Qul innamal-'ilmu 'indallaah, wa'innamaa ana nadheerum mubeen
map.67:27: Falammaa ra'awhu zulfatan see'at wujoohul-ladheena kafaroo waqeela haadhal-ladhee kuntum bihee tadda'oon
map.67:28: Qul ara'aytum in ahlakaniyallaahu wamam ma'iya aw rahimanaa famay yujeerul-kaafireena min 'adhaabin aleem
